1.text: This Paul talkin', called to be one of Jesus Christ's apostles, not by my own doing, but by God's will. Sosthenes, our brother, right here with me.

2.text: To God's church out in Corinth—to all y'all who've been set apart in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, along with everybody everywhere callin' on Jesus' name. He our Lord—yours and mine.

3.text: Grace and peace to y'all, from God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ.

4.text: I always thank God for y'all, 'cause of the grace He gave y'all through Christ Jesus.

5.text: Y'all been blessed in every way by Him—whether it's how you speak or what you know.

6.text: That gospel about Jesus? It's been proven real in y'all.

7.text: So y'all don't come up short in any spiritual gift, and you still waitin' for Jesus to be revealed.

8.text: He gon' hold y'all down 'til the end, so when He show up, y'all gon' be blameless.

9.text: And best believe—God is faithful. He the one who called y'all to be tight with His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

10.text: Now look—I'm beggin' y'all, fam, in Jesus' name: speak with one voice. Stop all this division. Y'all need to be on the same page, same mindset.

11.text: 'Cause word got back to me from Chloe's people—y'all been beefin'.

12.text: Folks out here sayin', "I rock with Paul," or "I'm team Apollos," or "Cephas my guy," or "I'm with Christ."

13.text: Is Christ split up like that? Did Paul die for you? Y'all got baptized in my name or somethin'?

14.text: I'm thankin' God I ain't baptize none of y'all except Crispus and Gaius.

15.text: That way, ain't nobody out here sayin' I baptized folks in my name.

16.text: Oh—and Stephanas' household too, I did them. Can't remember if I baptized anybody else.

17.text: But real talk, Christ ain't send me to baptize—He sent me to preach the gospel. And not with big words or fancy talk, so the cross of Christ don't lose its power.

18.text: Folks who reject God think the cross is foolish. But for us who believe and gettin' saved? That's God's power right there.

19.text: Scripture say: "I'll shut down the wisdom of the wise, And cancel out the understanding of the smart folks."

20.text: So where the wise ones at? The scholars? The deep debaters of the day? Ain't God flipped this world's wisdom upside down?

21.text: See, the world thought it could find God through its own wisdom—but that ain't how God played it. He decided to use what the world calls "foolishness"—this gospel message—to save those who believe.

22.text: Jews want signs. Greeks want wisdom.

23.text: But we out here preachin' Christ crucified. To Jews, that's a stumbling block. To Gentiles, that's nonsense.

24.text: But to the ones who been called—Jew or Gentile—Christ is God's power and God's wisdom.

25.text: Even God's "foolishness" outsmarts man's brilliance. And His "weakness" stronger than anything man can throw.

26.text: Think about who y'all are, fam. Not many of y'all were considered wise by the world's standards. Not a lot of power or clout.

27.text: But God chose the so-called "foolish" to shame the wise. He chose the weak to humble the strong.

28.text: He chose the low-down, overlooked, and written-off things—to take down the ones that think they up.

29.text: So nobody can flex in God's presence like they did it on their own.

30.text: But it's because of God that you in Christ Jesus. And Christ became everything we needed—God's wisdom, our righteousness, our sanctification, and our redemption.

31.text: So like the Word say, "If you gon' brag, brag on the Lord."

1.text: When I pulled up to y'all, fam, I wasn't tryin' to impress with fancy talk or deep philosophy when I shared God's message.

2.text: I made up my mind to keep it simple—just Jesus Christ, and Him crucified.

3.text: I came in weak, nervous, and shook up.

4.text: My message and preachin'? It wasn't slick talk or human wisdom—it was straight-up Spirit and power.

5.text: That way, your faith wouldn't be built on somebody's intellect, but on the power of God.

6.text: Now don't get it twisted—we do speak wisdom, but only to the ones who are spiritually mature. And it ain't the kind of wisdom this world respects, or the kind these so-called "powerful" folks got—they all on their way out.

7.text: We speak a secret wisdom from God, hidden from the jump—something God set in motion before time to bring us glory.

8.text: None of the rulers of this world had a clue—if they did, they never would've crucified the Lord of Glory.

9.text: Like Scripture say: "Eye ain't seen, ear ain't heard, It ain't even entered the mind of man What God got in store for the ones who love Him."

10.text: But God let us in on it—through the Spirit. The Spirit dig deep, searchin' everything—even the secret stuff of God.

11.text: Who knows what's really goin' on inside a person except that person's own spirit? Same way, nobody knows what's goin' on with God—except God's Spirit.

12.text: But we didn't receive the world's spirit—we got the Spirit that's from God. So now we can understand what God already gave us, for free.

13.text: And when we speak on these things, we don't use human-taught words. We speak with what the Holy Spirit teaches—spiritual language for spiritual truths.

14.text: See, the natural mind can't get with the things of God's Spirit. It sound like nonsense. You can't understand spiritual things without spiritual vision.

15.text: But the one who's spiritual can recognize what's real—and no one else got the right to size them up.

16.text: Who can tell the Lord what to do? Who can give Him advice? But we got the mind of Christ.

1.text: Look, fam—when I first came to y'all, I couldn't even talk to you like spiritual folks. I had to speak to y'all like y'all still in the flesh—like spiritual babies in Christ.

2.text: I had to feed you milk, not solid food. Y'all wasn't ready then, and to be honest… y'all still ain't ready now.

3.text: 'Cause y'all still actin' carnal. You got envy, drama, and division all up in the church. Ain't that proof you still movin' like the world?

4.text: When one person say, "I'm team Paul," and another, "I ride with Apollos," y'all just bein' human. That ain't Spirit-led behavior.

5.text: Who am I? Who Apollos? We just servants God used so y'all could believe. Each of us just did what the Lord gave us to do.

6.text: I planted the seed. Apollos came through and watered it. But God is the one who made it grow.

7.text: So the one who plants and the one who waters? We ain't nothin' without God who brings the increase.

8.text: The planter and the waterer got the same goal, and each one gon' get paid based on their grind.

9.text: We all workin' with God. Y'all are God's field. Y'all are God's building.

10.text: By God's grace, I laid the foundation like a wise master builder. Now others building on it. But everybody need to check how they building.

11.text: Ain't no other foundation but Jesus Christ. That's the only one that counts.

12.text: Now if you build on that foundation with gold, silver, jewels—or wood, hay, and straw—

13.text: What you build gon' get tested. Fire gon' reveal it on that Day. Fire gon' show if your work was real.

14.text: If your work stands the fire, you get your reward.

15.text: If it burns up? You gon' take a loss—but you still saved… just barely, like somebody runnin' out a house on fire.

16.text: Don't you know you the temple of God, and His Spirit live in you?

17.text: If somebody out here tryna wreck God's temple, God gon' wreck them. The temple is holy—and that temple is you.

18.text: Stop foolin' yourself. If you think you wise by the world's standards, you need to become a fool for real so you can become truly wise.

19.text: The world's wisdom? God calls it foolishness. Scripture says: "He catches the wise slippin' with their own schemes."

20.text: And again: "The Lord knows how empty and pointless the so-called 'wise' really think."

21.text: So stop braggin' on human leaders. Don't worship folks. Everything already belong to y'all anyway—

22.text: Whether it's Paul, Apollos, Cephas, the world, life, death, what's now, or what's comin'—all of it is yours.

23.text: And you belong to Christ. And Christ belongs to God.

1.text: So here's how y'all should think of us—we servants of Christ, holdin' it down as stewards of God's mysteries.

2.text: And what's required of a steward? That they be faithful. Period.

3.text: Truth be told, I don't lose sleep over y'all judging me—or any human court for that matter. I don't even judge myself like that.

4.text: I ain't got nothin' on my record that I know of—but that don't make me right. The Lord's the One who judges me.

5.text: So don't go judging before it's time. Wait 'til the Lord shows up. He gon' bring everything in the dark into the light and expose what's really in people's hearts. That's when folks'll get praise—from God.

6.text: Fam, I been usin' me and Apollos as examples to teach y'all somethin'—don't go beyond what's written. Stay grounded, so you don't get puffed up sayin' "I'm with him" or "I roll with them."

7.text: What makes you so different anyway? What do you have that you didn't receive? And if you did receive it, why you actin' like you got it all on your own?

8.text: Oh, y'all think y'all full now? Rich already? Reignin' like royalty? I wish y'all really was—then maybe we could reign with you.

9.text: But from where I'm sittin', God got us apostles lookin' like we last in line—like folks already sentenced to death. We on display out here—spectacles to the world, angels, and people alike.

10.text: We out here lookin' like fools for Christ… while y'all lookin' wise. We weak… y'all strong. Y'all respected… we dishonored.

11.text: Right now, we hungry and thirsty, wearin' rags, takin' beatings, and sleepin' outside.

12.text: We workin' with our own hands. When folks cuss us out, we bless 'em. When they come for us, we take it.

13.text: When they slander us, we still speak peace. We the bottom of the barrel—the world's trash, tossed aside to this day.

14.text: I ain't sayin' all this to shame you—I'm talkin' to you like you my own kids. I'm warnin' you.

15.text: You might have a bunch of church teachers, but you don't have many spiritual fathers. In Christ, I became your father through the gospel.

16.text: So I'm tellin' you—follow my example.

17.text: That's why I'm sendin' Timothy, my beloved and faithful son in the Lord. He gon' remind y'all how I move in Christ—same way I teach everywhere, in every church.

18.text: Some of y'all gettin' cocky like I ain't really comin'.

19.text: But I am comin'—if the Lord say the same. And when I do, I ain't gon' just listen to y'all talk—I'm lookin' for power.

20.text: 'Cause the Kingdom of God ain't just words. It's power.

21.text: So what's the vibe? You want me to come with a rod—or come in love, with a gentle spirit?

1.text: Yo, it's wild out here—I'm hearin' that there's sexual sin goin' down among y'all that even folks in the streets don't do. Somebody sleepin' with his father's wife?!

2.text: And instead of mournin' and checkin' that, y'all puffed up—like it's whatever. Nah. That man shoulda been put out the community.

3.text: I might not be there in person, but in spirit? I already passed judgment like I'm sittin' right there.

4.text: So when y'all come together in Jesus' name, with my spirit present and His power movin'—

5.text: Hand that man over to Satan, so his flesh can get broken down, but his spirit might still get saved when Jesus returns.

6.text: Y'all out here boastin'? That ain't good. Don't you know a little yeast spreads through the whole batch of dough?

7.text: So clean out that old yeast—that sin—so y'all can be a new batch. You already been made new.

8.text: Let's live this thing for real—not with old, moldy ways like malice and wickedness, but with real-deal sincerity and truth.

9.text: I told y'all before—don't mix with folks who livin' in sexual sin.

10.text: And I wasn't talkin' 'bout folks outside the church—that'd mean leavin' the whole world.

11.text: I'm talkin' 'bout folks who say they're brothers and sisters in Christ but still livin' foul—whether they're sexually immoral, greedy, worshippin' idols, talkin' reckless, drunk all the time, or out here robbin' folks. Don't even eat with people like that.

12.text: I ain't worried about judgin' outsiders—that's God's job.

13.text: But folks on the inside? We supposed to hold each other accountable. Like Scripture says: "Put that evil person out from among you."

1.text: For real, y'all? You got beef with a brother or sister and you takin' it to court—in front of unbelievers—instead of bringin' it to the church?

2.text: Don't you know the saints gon' judge the world? And if that's true, can't y'all handle these small disputes?

3.text: Don't you know we gon' judge angels? So why can't y'all settle things in this life?

4.text: If you got issues to judge, why let folks the church don't even respect handle it?

5.text: I'm sayin' this to shame you a little—like, really? Ain't there one wise person among y'all who can mediate between brothers and sisters?

6.text: Instead, y'all takin' each other to court, and lettin' unbelievers watch us tear each other apart. That's not it.

7.text: Honestly, the fact that y'all even suin' each other shows it's already a loss. Why not just take the hit? Why not just let yourself get played?

8.text: But nah, y'all doin' the dirt yourselves—and doin' it to your own family in Christ.

9.text: Don't you know that folks livin' in unrighteousness ain't inheriting the Kingdom? Don't get it twisted.

10.text: folks stealing, greedy, gettin' drunk, talkin' reckless, or extorting folks—none of them gettin' in if they stay in it.

11.text: And let's keep it real—some of y'all used to be like that. But now you been washed. You been made holy. You been justified in Jesus' name and by the Spirit of our God.

12.text: "Everything's allowed for me"—okay, cool, but that don't mean everything good for you. And just 'cause it's allowed don't mean I'ma let it control me.

13.text: Yeah, food for the stomach and stomach for food—but God gon' do away with both. But your body? It ain't for sexual sin—it's for the Lord. And He for your body.

14.text: Just like God raised Jesus, He gon' raise us too—with that same power.

15.text: Don't you know your body is part of Christ now? So how you gon' link Christ to a prostitute? No way.

16.text: When you sleep with somebody, y'all become one flesh. That's not just physical—it's spiritual.

17.text: But when you're joined to the Lord? You one spirit with Him.

18.text: Run from sexual sin. Fast. That one hit different. Other sins happen outside your body—but this one? You hurtin' yourself.

19.text: Don't you know your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit? He's in you. God gave Him to you. You don't even belong to yourself.

20.text: You were bought with a price. So use your body—and your whole being—to glorify God. That's what it's for.

1.text: So, about what y'all wrote me—yeah, it's good for a man to stay single and not be all touchy with a woman.

2.text: But since sexual temptation out here heavy, every man should have his own wife, and every woman her own husband.

3.text: Husbands, show your wife the love and affection she's due—and wives, same goes for y'all.

4.text: Your body ain't just yours anymore. Wives, your husband got claim too. And husbands? Your wife got claim on you, period.

5.text: Don't hold out on each other—unless y'all agree for a season so y'all can fast and pray. But come back together, or the enemy gon' use that against y'all.

6.text: I'm sayin' that as a suggestion, not a hard rule.

7.text: I wish everybody could stay single like me—but hey, everybody got their own gift from God.

8.text: To the single folks and widows: I think it's best if you stay single like I am.

9.text: But if you can't control yourself, it's better to get married than to burn with passion and frustration.

10.text: To the married, this ain't just me talkin'—this from the Lord: a wife shouldn't leave her husband.

11.text: But if she does, she should stay single or get back with her man. And husbands? Don't divorce your wife.

12.text: Now for the rest of y'all—this is me, not the Lord directly: if a man got a wife who ain't a believer, but she's down to stay, don't leave her.

13.text: And if a woman got a man who ain't saved, but he wanna stay with her, let him.

14.text: That believing spouse brings spiritual cover—the unbelieving spouse is touched by that, and the kids are covered too.

15.text: But if the unbeliever wants out, let 'em go. Ain't no chains in situations like that. God called us to peace, not chaos.

16.text: You don't know, sis, if you might lead your man to salvation. And bro, you don't know if you might save your wife.

17.text: However God had you livin' when He called you? Walk in that. That's the same rule I give in every church.

18.text: You were circumcised when you got called? Don't undo it. Uncircumcised? Don't get cut now.

19.text: That outward stuff don't matter. What matters is keepin' God's commandments.

20.text: So however you were when God called you? Stay there.

21.text: You were a slave when you got saved? Don't stress. But if you get a chance to be free, take it.

22.text: 'Cause if you a slave and get saved, you still free in the Lord. And if you free, you still got a master—Christ.

23.text: God paid for you with blood. Don't let people make you slaves again.

24.text: Fam, wherever you were when God called you—stay close to Him right there.

25.text: Now about virgins—I don't have a direct command from the Lord, but I'm givin' my take, since God trusted me with this.

26.text: Because of the hard times right now, I think it's good to stay as you are.

27.text: Got a wife? Don't try to dip. Don't got a wife? Don't go lookin' hard either.

28.text: But if you do get married, you ain't sinnin'. And if a virgin marries, she ain't sinnin' either. Just know—it ain't all roses. Marriage comes with struggle, and I'm tryna spare y'all some of that.

29.text: Look, fam—the time is short. From now on, folks with spouses should live like that ain't their whole identity.

30.text: Mourners—don't get stuck there. Rejoicers—don't get lost in it. Shoppers—don't get attached to the stuff.

31.text: Use the world, but don't abuse it. This world as we know it? It's passin' away.

32.text: I want y'all to live stress-free. Unmarried folks can stay locked in on the Lord—how to please Him.

33.text: But married folks gotta split attention—they tryna please their spouse too.

34.text: Same with women: the single ones focus on the Lord, tryna live holy in body and spirit. Married ones focus on their husband.

35.text: I'm sayin' this to help you—not to trap you. I want you to be able to serve the Lord without distractions.

36.text: If a man think he's actin' wrong toward his girl, and she's grown and ready, and they both know it's time—go ahead and marry. That's not a sin.

37.text: But if he's settled in his heart, got self-control, and decides not to marry her, that's cool too.

38.text: Bottom line: both options are good. But the one who holds off on marriage? He doin' better.

39.text: A wife is bound to her man as long as he's alive. But if he dies, she's free to marry whoever—as long as he's in the Lord.

40.text: But in my opinion, she'd be happier stayin' single—and I think I'm speakin' with the Spirit of God on that.

1.text: Now let's talk about food that's been offered to idols. Yeah, we all got knowledge—but listen: knowledge can puff your head up, but love? Love builds people up.

2.text: If you think you know everything, you probably don't even know what you need to know yet.

3.text: But if you love God? God knows you. That's what really matters.

4.text: So about eatin' food that was offered to idols—we know idols ain't nothin'. Ain't no real gods behind them statues.

5.text: Even though folks out here talkin' about "gods" in the sky and lords on the earth,

6.text: for us, there's only one God—the Father, who everything came from and who we live for. And one Lord—Jesus Christ—who made everything possible and keeps us movin'.

7.text: But not everybody got that kind of understanding. Some folks still see that meat as tied to idol worship, and when they eat it, their conscience gets messed up—'cause it feels wrong to them.

8.text: Truth is, God don't care about what's on your plate. You don't get extra credit for eatin', and you ain't fallin' off for not eatin'.

9.text: But be careful that your freedom don't turn into a trap for somebody else who's weaker in the faith.

10.text: Like, if somebody sees you eatin' at an idol's temple and they not mature in their faith, they might think it's okay and copy you—even though it still feels wrong to them.

11.text: And now, because of your "knowledge," your weaker brother or sister—who Christ died for—might fall off.

12.text: When you hurt their conscience like that, you ain't just sinnin' against them—you sinnin' against Christ.

13.text: So Paul says, "If what I'm eatin' is gon' make my brother fall off, I'll never eat meat again." He'd rather give it up than let it be a stumbling block.

1.text: Ain't I an apostle? Ain't I free? Didn't I see Jesus with my own eyes? Ain't y'all my work in the Lord?

2.text: Even if other folks don't see me as an apostle, y'all know what it is. You the proof of my assignment.

3.text: So here's my defense to the folks questioning me—

4.text: Don't I got the right to eat and drink like everybody else?

5.text: Don't I got the right to travel with a believing wife, like the other apostles do? Like Jesus' brothers? Like Peter (Cephas)?

6.text: Or is it just me and Barnabas who gotta grind without support?

7.text: Who goes to war payin' their own way? Who plants a vineyard and don't eat off it? Who takes care of sheep but don't drink the milk?

8.text: I ain't just talkin' from a human angle—the law backs me up too.

9.text: Moses said, "Don't muzzle the ox while it's treading grain." You think God was talkin' about oxen only?

10.text: Nah, He said that for our sake. Folks who do the work supposed to benefit from the work.

11.text: So if we planted spiritual seed in y'all, is it too much to receive a little material help back?

12.text: If others can do that with you, shouldn't we even more? But we ain't exercise that right—we takin' the high road, so nothin' gets in the way of the gospel.

13.text: Don't y'all know that temple workers ate from what was brought to the temple? Same thing with altar workers—they got a portion too.

14.text: In the same way, Jesus said those who preach the gospel should live from the gospel.

15.text: But me? I didn't use any of that. And I ain't sayin' this so y'all start cuttin' checks. I'd rather die than have somebody act like I'm in this for the money.

16.text: Preachin' the gospel ain't a flex—it's a calling. I have to do this. I'd be lost if I didn't.

17.text: If I do it willingly, there's reward. If not, it's still my assignment.

18.text: So what's my reward? That I preach the gospel for free, without strings, without manipulation. No abuse of authority here.

19.text: Even though I'm free, I made myself a servant to everybody—just to win more souls.

20.text: To the Jews? I move like a Jew to win them. To folks under the law? I meet them where they are.

21.text: To those outside the law? I relate too—but I'm still under Christ's law, always.

22.text: To the weak? I became weak. I've become all things to all people so I might save some.

23.text: And I do it all for the gospel—so I can share in its blessings with y'all.

24.text: Y'all know how in a race, everybody runs—but only one wins? Run like you tryin' to win.

25.text: Athletes train hard for a crown that fades. But we chasin' a crown that's eternal.

26.text: I don't run with no confusion. I don't fight like I'm swingin' at air.

27.text: I keep my body in check—I make it my servant. 'Cause I refuse to preach to others and end up disqualified myself.

1.text: Look fam, I don't want y'all out here clueless. Our ancestors all had the same experience—they were covered by the cloud, walked through the sea,

2.text: and were basically baptized into Moses when they went through that water.

3.text: They all ate the same spiritual food,

4.text: drank the same spiritual drink—from the spiritual Rock that followed them. And that Rock? That was Christ.

5.text: But even after all that, most of them didn't please God—they died out there in the wilderness.

6.text: That right there? That's a warning for us—not to chase evil desires like they did.

7.text: Don't worship idols like some of them did. Remember what's written: "The people sat down to eat and drink, then got up to wild out."

8.text: Don't get caught in sexual sin either. They did, and 23,000 of them dropped in one day.

9.text: Don't test Christ like they did, or you'll end up like them—gettin' destroyed by snakes.

10.text: And don't be out here complainin' and grumblin'. Some of them did that too and got handled by the destroyer.

11.text: All of that happened as a warning for us. It's written down so we stay sharp—especially since we livin' in these last days.

12.text: So if you think you stand strong—watch your step, or you might fall.

13.text: Any temptation you facin'? It ain't new. Everybody go through it. But God is faithful—He won't let you face more than you can handle. And when it does come, He always provides a way out so you can make it through.

14.text: So beloved, run from idolatry. Don't play with it.

15.text: I'm talkin' to folks with sense—judge for yourself what I'm sayin'.

16.text: When we bless the cup, we're sharin' in the blood of Christ. When we break the bread, we're sharin' in His body.

17.text: We might be many, but we one body 'cause we all eat from the same bread—Christ.

18.text: Look at Israel—when they ate from the altar, they were participating in the sacrifice, right?

19.text: I'm not sayin' idols are real or the food itself is somethin'—

20.text: But what folks sacrifice to idols, they really sacrificin' to demons. And I ain't tryna see y'all mixin' with that.

21.text: You can't drink from the Lord's cup and from the demons' cup. You can't sit at both tables.

22.text: You tryna make God jealous? You think you stronger than Him?

23.text: Sure, "everything's lawful"—but that don't mean it's helpful. Just 'cause you can do it don't mean it builds anybody up.

24.text: Don't just look out for yourself—look out for others too.

25.text: If you buy meat from the market, eat it—don't ask no questions for your conscience's sake.

26.text: Remember: "The earth is the Lord's and everything in it."

27.text: If somebody who don't believe invites you to dinner and you down to go, eat what's served. No need to interrogate the menu.

28.text: But if they say, "This meat was offered to idols," then don't eat it—not for your sake, but for theirs.

29.text: I'm talkin' about their conscience, not yours. Why should my freedom be judged by someone else's convictions?

30.text: If I give thanks over it, why I gotta be criticized for it?

31.text: Whether you eat, drink, or whatever you do—do it all for God's glory.

32.text: Don't trip folks up—whether they're Jewish, Gentile, or part of the church.

33.text: I try to meet folks where they are, not just for my gain, but so they can be saved.

1.text: Y'all should follow my example—'cause I'm followin' Christ.

2.text: I respect that y'all still remember what I taught and try to keep the traditions I handed down.

3.text: But let me make this clear: Christ is the head over every man, man is the head over woman, and God is the head over Christ.

4.text: If a man prays or prophesies with something coverin' his head, he disrespectin' his spiritual head.

5.text: And if a woman prays or prophesies with her head uncovered, she disrespectin' hers—it's like she out here with her head shaved off.

6.text: If she won't cover her head, she might as well cut it off. But if that's shameful, then she need to keep it covered.

7.text: A man shouldn't have his head covered, 'cause he reflects God's image and glory. But woman? She's the glory of man.

8.text: Man ain't come from woman—woman came from man.

9.text: And man wasn't made for woman's sake, but woman for man's.

10.text: That's why a woman should wear a symbol of authority on her head—outta respect for the angels, too.

11.text: But hold up—it ain't about who's better. In the Lord, man and woman need each other.

12.text: Yeah, woman came from man, but now every man since been born through a woman—and God is the source of it all.

13.text: Y'all judge it for yourselves—is it really proper for a woman to be praying with her head uncovered?

14.text: Nature itself teach you—if a man got long hair, it's seen as dishonor.

15.text: But a woman with long hair? That's her glory. God gave her hair as a natural covering.

16.text: If somebody wanna argue? Ain't nobody in the churches of God out here makin' this a whole thing—we don't have that kind of drama.

17.text: Now about this next thing—I can't praise y'all. 'Cause when y'all come together, it ain't helpin' y'all—it's hurtin'.

18.text: I'm hearin' there's division in the church when y'all gather. And honestly? I believe some of it.

19.text: Maybe it gotta be that way so the real ones can stand out.

20.text: But when y'all come together to eat, it ain't really the Lord's Supper.

21.text: Folks out here eatin' early, takin' they own food—one person hungry, another drunk!

22.text: Don't y'all got houses for that? Or do you just not care about the church or shame folks who ain't got much? I ain't praisin' that. That's a mess.

23.text: Let me remind y'all what the Lord gave me: The same night Jesus was betrayed, He took bread,

24.text: gave thanks, broke it and said, "This is My body, broken for y'all. Eat this to remember Me."

25.text: Then He took the cup and said, "This cup is the new covenant in My blood. Drink it to remember Me."

26.text: So every time y'all eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord's death—until He comes back.

27.text: So if you eat or drink from the Lord's table in a reckless or unworthy way, you guilty of disrespectin' His body and blood.

28.text: Check yourself. Do a self-check before you eat that bread and sip that cup.

29.text: 'Cause if you don't discern the Lord's body right, you bringin' judgment on yourself.

30.text: That's why some of y'all are weak, sick—and some even sleepin' in the grave.

31.text: If we judged ourselves first, we wouldn't have to be judged.

32.text: But when God does judge us, it's to correct us—not to destroy us like the world.

33.text: So fam, when y'all come together to eat—wait on each other.

34.text: If you starving, eat at home. Don't turn communion into a judgment zone. I'll deal with the rest when I come in person.

1.text: Now let's talk spiritual gifts, fam—I don't want y'all to be clueless out here.

2.text: Remember, back in the day y'all used to follow after dumb idols that couldn't speak—y'all didn't know no better.

3.text: So let me clear this up: nobody talkin' by the Spirit of God is gon' curse Jesus. And ain't nobody sayin' "Jesus is Lord" for real unless the Holy Spirit gave 'em that revelation.

4.text: We got different kinds of gifts, but it's the same Spirit that hands them out.

5.text: Different ways to serve, but it's the same Lord.

6.text: Different ways God moves, but it's still the same God workin' through everybody.

7.text: The Holy Spirit shows up through each one of us—for the benefit of the whole squad.

8.text: Some get wisdom through the Spirit. Some get knowledge.

9.text: Others get deep faith. Some got the gift to heal folks.

10.text: Some can do miracles, some can prophesy. Others can tell the difference between what's from God and what's not. Some speak in all kinds of tongues, and others can interpret those tongues.

11.text: But it's one Spirit doing all this—He hands out the gifts however He wants, to whoever He chooses.

12.text: Just like the body got many parts but still one body, same thing with Christ's people.

13.text: We all got baptized into one body—don't matter if you Jew, Greek, slave, or free—we all drinkin' from the same Spirit.

14.text: The body ain't made of just one part—it's many.

15.text: The foot can't say, "I ain't a hand so I don't belong." Nah—you still part of the body.

16.text: Same if the ear say, "I ain't an eye, so I don't count." You still matter.

17.text: If the whole body was one big eye, who'd hear? If we all hearing, who gon' smell?

18.text: God placed every part exactly where He wanted it in the body.

19.text: If everything was just one part, that wouldn't even be a body.

20.text: But we got many parts—still one body.

21.text: The eye can't say to the hand, "I don't need you." The head can't tell the feet, "Y'all irrelevant."

22.text: Nah—those parts that seem weaker? They essential.

23.text: The ones we don't give much credit to? God puts extra honor on them.

24.text: Some parts need no help—but God arranged the body so every part gets its respect.

25.text: That way, there's no division. Every part lookin' out for the others.

26.text: If one part hurt, the whole body feel it. If one part gets lifted up, the whole body should celebrate.

27.text: Y'all are Christ's body—and every one of y'all got a part to play.

28.text: God placed different roles in the church: First—apostles, Second—prophets, Third—teachers, Then miracle workers, healing hands, helpers, organizers, and those speakin' in different tongues.

29.text: Is everybody an apostle? Everybody a prophet? Everybody a teacher? Can everybody do miracles?

30.text: Can everybody heal, speak in tongues, or interpret them?

31.text: Nah—but you should want the best gifts God got for you. But I'ma show y'all an even better way…

1.text: I could speak every language on earth—even heavenly ones—but if I ain't got love, I'm just makin' noise. Just loud cymbals with no soul.

2.text: I could prophesy like a prophet, understand every deep mystery, hold all the knowledge, and have enough faith to move whole mountains—but if love ain't in me, I'm nothin'.

3.text: I could give away everything I got to feed the poor. I could even give up my body for the cause. But if I ain't got love? It don't mean nothin'.

4.text: Love is patient. Love is kind. It don't envy, it don't show off, it don't walk around with a big head.

5.text: Love don't act rude. It don't make it all about self. It don't get triggered easy and don't keep receipts of wrongs.

6.text: Love don't celebrate mess—it celebrates truth.

7.text: Love holds it down, believes the best, stays hopeful, and don't give up.

8.text: Love never fails—never. Prophecies? They gon' expire. Speaking in tongues? That season gon' pass. Even knowledge? One day, it'll fade.

9.text: 'Cause right now, we only know a little, and we only speak a little of what's true.

10.text: But when perfection comes? That partial stuff gets retired.

11.text: When I was a child, I talked, thought, and reasoned like a child. But when I grew up, I left all that childish stuff behind.

12.text: Right now, it's like lookin' at life through a foggy mirror. But later? We gon' see it clear. Face to face. Right now, I only know part of the picture. But one day, I'ma know fully—just like God fully knows me now.

13.text: So these three still stand strong: faith, hope, and love. But the greatest one? Love.

1.text: Run after love first. But also go after spiritual gifts—especially prophecy.

2.text: See, when you speak in tongues, you talkin' to God, not people. Nobody understands you, 'cause you speakin' mysteries in the Spirit.

3.text: But if you prophesy, you speak life—building folks up, encouraging them, and bringin' comfort.

4.text: Tongues might build you up, but prophecy builds the whole church.

5.text: I'd love for all y'all to speak in tongues, but even more for y'all to prophesy. Prophecy does more unless someone interprets the tongue so the church can grow from it.

6.text: So what good is it if I come speakin' in tongues but don't bring a revelation, knowledge, prophecy, or teaching?

7.text: Think about instruments—flutes or harps. If they just play random sounds, who knows the melody?

8.text: If a trumpet makes a wild, unclear sound, who gon' know it's time for battle?

9.text: Same with y'all—if your words ain't clear, folks just hearin' noise. Ain't nobody gettin' helped.

10.text: There's all kinds of languages in the world, and they all matter.

11.text: But if I don't understand your language, I'm a foreigner to you—and you to me.

12.text: So since y'all so hype about spiritual gifts, focus on helping the whole church, not just flexin'.

13.text: If you speak in tongues, pray for the power to interpret it.

14.text: 'Cause when I pray in tongues, it's my spirit prayin'—but my mind ain't catching none of it.

15.text: So what do I do? I pray in the Spirit and with understanding. I sing in the Spirit and with understanding.

16.text: Otherwise, how can someone say "Amen" if they don't know what you sayin'?

17.text: You might be giving thanks, but the other person ain't bein' built up.

18.text: I thank God I speak in tongues more than all y'all.

19.text: But in church? I'd rather speak 5 words with understanding to teach folks than 10,000 words nobody understands.

20.text: Stop actin' childish with understanding. Be innocent when it comes to evil—but grown in how you think.

21.text: Scripture says, "I'll speak to this people through other tongues… and still, they won't listen."

22.text: So tongues are a sign for unbelievers, not for believers. Prophecy, though? That's for the believers.

23.text: If the whole church speakin' in tongues and somebody new walks in, they'll think y'all lost it.

24.text: But if everybody prophesies, that person gon' get convicted and called out by the Spirit.

25.text: Their whole heart gon' be laid bare, and they'll fall down and say, "God is really here."

26.text: So what's the move, fam? When y'all gather, everybody brings somethin'—a song, a word, a tongue, a revelation, an interpretation. Let it all be done to build folks up.

27.text: If you speak in tongues, let two or three speak—one at a time—and make sure someone interprets.

28.text: No interpreter? Then keep it to yourself and God.

29.text: Let two or three prophets speak, and others should weigh what's said.

30.text: If someone else gets a word mid-service, the first speaker should chill.

31.text: You can all take turns prophesyin' so everyone can learn and be encouraged.

32.text: And prophets? Your spirit stays in check. You ain't outta control.

33.text: 'Cause God ain't about confusion—He's about peace, just like in all His churches.

34.text: Let the women be silent in church. They not permitted to speak but should stay in order, like the law says.

35.text: If they got questions, they can ask their husbands at home—it ain't a good look for women to speak up during church time.

36.text: Y'all think the Word of God started with you? Or only came to you?

37.text: If you really a prophet or spiritually mature, you'll know what I'm saying is from the Lord.

38.text: But if somebody wanna act brand new and ignore it—let 'em stay ignorant.

39.text: So fam—go after prophecy, and don't block folks from speakin' in tongues.

40.text: But make sure everything is done decently, and in order.

1.text: Let me remind y'all of the gospel I already preached to you—the one y'all received and stand on.

2.text: That message? It's what saves you if you hold on tight—unless your belief was empty from the jump.

3.text: Here's what I handed y'all first: Christ died for our sins, just like Scripture said.

4.text: He was buried. Then on the third day? He got up—just like Scripture said.

5.text: He showed Himself to Peter, then to the twelve.

6.text: After that, over 500 folks saw Him at once—most of 'em still around, but some have passed on.

7.text: Then James saw Him. Then the rest of the apostles.

8.text: And last of all, He appeared to me—like one born late to the party.

9.text: I'm the least of the apostles—not even worthy to be called that, 'cause I used to go hard against God's church.

10.text: But by God's grace? I am what I am. And that grace wasn't wasted—I worked harder than all of them. But really? It was God's grace workin' through me.

11.text: Whether it was me or them preachin'—we all gave the same gospel, and y'all believed it.

12.text: So if we preach that Christ rose from the dead, how y'all gon' say there ain't no resurrection?

13.text: If the dead don't rise, then Christ ain't risen.

14.text: And if Christ ain't risen, our whole message is empty—and so is your faith.

15.text: We'd be out here lyin' on God, sayin' He raised Christ—if He really didn't.

16.text: If the dead don't rise, then Jesus ain't rise.

17.text: And if Jesus ain't rise, your faith is useless and you still stuck in your sins.

18.text: That means everybody who died in Christ is just… gone.

19.text: If this life is the only hope we got in Christ? We the most pitiful folks out here.

20.text: But the truth is—Christ has been raised! He the first one out the grave, but not the last.

21.text: Death came through one man—Adam. So resurrection comes through another man—Jesus.

22.text: In Adam, everybody dies. But in Christ, everybody gets brought back to life.

23.text: Christ rose first. Then, when He comes back, His people will rise too.

24.text: Then comes the end—Jesus hands the kingdom back to the Father, after He shuts down every ruler and all power.

25.text: He gon' reign till every enemy is under His feet.

26.text: The last enemy to get destroyed? Death.

27.text: God put everything under His feet. But obviously, God the Father ain't included in that "everything."

28.text: When it's all said and done, the Son Himself will submit to the Father, so God can be all in all.

29.text: If there's no resurrection, why would folks even get baptized for the dead? What's that doin'?

30.text: And why would we risk our lives daily?

31.text: I die daily for this gospel. That's facts.

32.text: If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus for no resurrection? That was pointless. Might as well just say, "Let's eat and drink, 'cause tomorrow we dead."

33.text: Don't get played: "Bad company corrupts good character."

34.text: Wake up. Start livin' right. Some of y'all don't even know God—and that's shameful.

35.text: Somebody might ask, "How the dead gon' be raised? What kind of body they comin' back with?"

36.text: That's a silly question. When you plant a seed, it don't come alive unless it dies first.

37.text: You don't plant the full-grown tree—you plant the seed.

38.text: And God gives it the body He wants. Every seed has its own body.

39.text: All flesh ain't the same—human flesh ain't the same as animals, fish, or birds.

40.text: There's heavenly bodies and earthly bodies—and each one got its own kind of glory.

41.text: The sun got one kind. The moon got another. Stars got theirs—and even stars don't shine the same.

42.text: Same way with the resurrection: Buried in corruption—raised in perfection.

43.text: Buried in dishonor—raised in glory. Buried in weakness—raised in power.

44.text: Buried a natural body—raised a spiritual one. There's a natural body and a spiritual one.

45.text: Adam, the first man, became a living being. But Jesus, the last Adam, became a life-giving Spirit.

46.text: The natural came first, then the spiritual.

47.text: First man was made of dust. Second man came from heaven.

48.text: Earth people like the dusty man. Heaven people like the heavenly one.

49.text: And just like we wore the image of the dusty one, we gon' wear the image of the heavenly one too.

50.text: Listen fam—flesh and blood can't inherit God's kingdom. Corruption can't walk into eternity.

51.text: But here's the mystery: We not all gon' die—but we all gon' be changed.

52.text: In a flash, in the blink of an eye, when the last trumpet sounds—the dead will rise incorruptible, and we'll be changed too.

53.text: This corrupt body gotta be clothed with the incorruptible. This mortal gotta put on immortality.

54.text: And when that happens? The prophecy comes true: "Death is swallowed up in victory."

55.text: "Death, where your sting at? Grave, where your W at?"

56.text: The sting of death is sin, and sin gets its strength from the law.

57.text: But thanks be to God, who gives us the win through our Lord Jesus Christ!

58.text: So fam, stay locked in. Don't move. Keep doin' God's work like it matters—'cause it ain't in vain. God sees you.

1.text: Now about the money for the church fam in need—I gave this instruction to the churches in Galatia, and I need y'all to do the same.

2.text: On the first day of the week, everybody should set aside a little somethin', based on how blessed they been. That way, we don't gotta do a last-minute collection when I get there.

3.text: When I come through, whoever y'all trust and choose, I'll send them with the gift to Jerusalem.

4.text: And if it make sense for me to go too, they can roll with me.

5.text: I plan to come see y'all after I go through Macedonia (I'm already on the way).

6.text: Might even chill with y'all for a bit—or stay through the winter—so y'all can help me get to the next stop.

7.text: I don't wanna just pass through real quick. I'm tryin' to spend some real time with y'all—if the Lord allows.

8.text: For now, I'm stayin' in Ephesus until Pentecost.

9.text: God opened a big door for me here—but trust, it's mad opposition too.

10.text: If Timothy pulls up, make sure he feels safe and welcomed. He's out here doin' God's work just like I am.

11.text: Don't let nobody look down on him. Show him love and send him off in peace—he's comin' back to me, and I'm waitin' on him with the crew.

12.text: About Apollos—I asked him strong to go to y'all with the brothers, but he ain't feel led to go right now. He'll come when the time's right for him.

13.text: Stay woke. Stand firm in the faith. Be bold. Be strong.

14.text: And whatever you do—do it all in love.

15.text: One more thing: y'all know Stephanas and his household were the first folks in Achaia to come to Christ, and they been servin' ever since.

16.text: So show them respect. Same for anybody workin' hard in the ministry alongside us.

17.text: I'm real glad Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus came—they filled the gap for y'all when I needed it.

18.text: They refreshed my soul—and yours too. Recognize folks like them. Real ones.

19.text: The churches out here in Asia send their love. Aquila and Priscilla say what's up in the Lord—same with the church that meets at their house.

20.text: All the brothers and sisters send love. Greet each other with a holy kiss.

21.text: I'm writin' this last part with my own hand—Paul.

22.text: If anybody out here don't love the Lord? Let 'em be cursed. Come on, Jesus—we ready.

23.text: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with y'all.

24.text: And my love? It's with every single one of y'all in Christ Jesus. Amen.

1.text: What was from the very beginning—the Word of Life—we heard it, saw it with our own eyes, looked straight at it, even touched it with our hands.

2.text: That life showed up for real, and we saw it. So now we tell y'all what we know—this eternal life was with the Father and then showed up right here for us to witness.

3.text: What we saw and heard, we tellin' y'all now, so y'all can be part of this too. 'Cause this ain't just us—our connection is with the Father and His Son, Jesus Christ.

4.text: We writin' this so y'all joy can be full—overflowin', not halfway.

5.text: Here's what Jesus told us, and we passin' it to you: God is light. Ain't no darkness in Him, not a drop.

6.text: So if we say, "Yeah, I'm cool with God," but we still out here walkin' in darkness—we lyin'. Ain't no truth in that lifestyle.

7.text: But if we walk in the light, like He in the light? Then we got real community with each other. And the blood of Jesus, His Son, cleans us up from all sin. No stain left behind.

8.text: If we out here actin' like we don't sin, we only foolin' ourselves. The truth ain't even in us.

9.text: But if we keep it real and confess our sins? He faithful and just—He gon' forgive us and wipe away all the mess. Every bit of unrighteousness.

10.text: But if we act like we ain't never sinned? We callin' God a liar. And trust—His word ain't livin' in us.

1.text: My babies, I'm writin' this so y'all don't fall into sin. But if you do mess up, know this—we got an Advocate up in heaven: Jesus Christ, the righteous one.

2.text: He's the one who paid the full price for our sins—and not just ours, but the whole world's.

3.text: Here's how we really know we know Him: if we keep His commandments.

4.text: If somebody say, "I know God," but don't do what He say? That's a straight-up lie, and the truth ain't in 'em.

5.text: But if you keep His word, God's love is perfected in you. That's how we know we in Him.

6.text: If you say you rock with Jesus, then walk how He walked. Point blank.

7.text: Dear fam, this ain't even a new command I'm givin' you. It's the same Word you heard from the jump.

8.text: But in a way, it is new—'cause it's now real in Him and in you. The darkness is gettin' pushed out. The true light is shinin' now.

9.text: If you claim you in the light but hate your brother? Nah, you still walkin' in the dark.

10.text: But if you love your brother, you livin' in the light—and you ain't causin' nobody to trip.

11.text: But hate? That's darkness. And if you walk in hate, you lost—you don't even know where you goin', 'cause the dark done blinded you.

12.text: I'm writin' to you, little ones, 'cause your sins been forgiven in His name.

13.text: I'm writin' to you, fathers—you know the One who been here since the beginning. I'm writin' to y'all, young men—y'all done beat the enemy. I'm writin' to y'all, little children—y'all know the Father.

14.text: I already wrote to the fathers—y'all seasoned. Y'all know Him. To the young men again—you strong. The Word is in you. Y'all done crushed the wicked one.

15.text: Don't love the world or the stuff in it. If that's where your heart at, the love of the Father ain't.

16.text: 'Cause everything the world chasin'—fleshly cravings, flashy eyes, pride in status—it ain't from God. That's worldly noise.

17.text: And the world? It's fading fast. But whoever does God's will? They last forever.

18.text: Little ones, it's the last hour. You've heard the Antichrist comin'. But guess what? Many antichrists already out here. That's how we know it's go-time.

19.text: They used to roll with us—but they left. And that just showed they never really was with us.

20.text: But you? You anointed by the Holy One. You got spiritual insight.

21.text: I'm not writin' like y'all don't know the truth—you do. And no lie lives in truth.

22.text: Who the real liar? The one who denies that Jesus is the Christ. That's the Antichrist—deny the Son, you deny the Father too.

23.text: If you deny the Son, you don't got the Father. But if you got the Son? The Father's yours too.

24.text: So keep what you heard from the start in you. If it stay in you, you gon' stay in the Son and the Father too.

25.text: And what He promised us? Eternal life. That's the deal.

26.text: I'm writin' this 'cause some folks tryna deceive you.

27.text: But you got the anointing, and it stays in you. You don't need somebody new every time to teach you. That anointing gon' show you what's real, what's true—not fake. So stay rooted in Him.

28.text: So now, little ones, stay in Him. That way when He show up, you can stand bold—not be lookin' crazy or ashamed.

29.text: If you know He's righteous, then you know anyone who walkin' right been born of Him.

1.text: Look at this love the Father poured on us—He really called us His kids! And that's exactly who we are. The world don't recognize us, 'cause they ain't recognize Him.

2.text: Beloved, we already God's children. But what we gon' be? That ain't even fully revealed yet. All we know is this: when Jesus show up, we gon' be like Him—'cause we'll see Him face to face.

3.text: And everybody holdin' on to that hope? They stay purifying themselves—just like He pure.

4.text: Everybody who keep sinnin' is breakin' the law—'cause sin is lawlessness.

5.text: And you already know Jesus showed up to take sin away—and there ain't no sin in Him.

6.text: If you really dwellin' in Him, you don't keep livin' in sin. And if you are? You ain't seen Him or known Him.

7.text: Don't let nobody trick you, little ones. Whoever lives right is righteous—just like Jesus.

8.text: But the one who keep on sinning? That's the devil's child. 'Cause the devil been sinning since jump. That's why the Son of God came—to shut the devil's whole operation down.

9.text: If you been born of God, you don't live in sin. God's seed is in you, and you can't keep wildin'—you been born again.

10.text: Here's how you tell who belongs to God and who don't: if you ain't livin' right or lovin' your brother—you ain't God's. Period.

11.text: The message ain't changed: Love one another. Y'all heard that from the beginning.

12.text: Don't be like Cain—he was on that wicked vibe and killed his brother. And why'd he do it? 'Cause his deeds were evil and his brother's were righteous.

13.text: Don't trip when the world hates you, fam. That's part of the walk.

14.text: We know we crossed over from death to life—'cause we love the fam. If you ain't got that love? You still sittin' in spiritual death.

15.text: If you hate your brother? That's murder in your heart. And no murderer got eternal life in them.

16.text: This how we know what love really is: Jesus laid down His life for us. So we oughta lay down our lives for each other.

17.text: If you got the resources and see your brother in need—but close your heart off? How you claim God's love lives in you?

18.text: My little ones, let's not just talk love—live love. Do it in real action and truth.

19.text: That's how we know we belong to the truth—and how we calm our hearts when they start trippin'.

20.text: Even when your heart condemns you, God is bigger than your heart. He know it all.

21.text: But if your heart's clear? You got confidence before God.

22.text: And whatever we ask, we receive—'cause we keep His commandments and do what pleases Him.

23.text: And this is the command: Believe in the name of His Son Jesus Christ, and love each other like He told us to.

24.text: If you keep His commandments, you dwell in Him—and He in you. And how do we know He lives in us? 'Cause His Spirit lives in us.

1.text: Beloved, don't believe every spirit out here—test 'em. Check if they really from God. 'Cause there's a lotta fake prophets runnin' wild in the world.

2.text: Here's how you spot the real Spirit of God: if the spirit confesses that Jesus Christ came in the flesh, that's God's Spirit.

3.text: But any spirit that won't say Jesus came in the flesh? That ain't from God. That's the spirit of the Antichrist—the one y'all heard was comin', and yeah, it's already out here.

4.text: Y'all from God, little ones—and you already beat these false spirits. Why? 'Cause the One in you is greater than the one that's runnin' this world.

5.text: They from the world, so they talk worldly, and the world eats it up.

6.text: But we from God. Whoever knows God gon' hear us. Whoever don't? Won't. That's how we know if a spirit's bringin' truth or bringin' error.

7.text: Beloved, let's love one another. 'Cause love come from God, and everybody who loves is born of God and knows Him.

8.text: But if you don't love? You don't know God. Point blank. 'Cause God is love.

9.text: Here's how He showed love: He sent His one and only Son into the world, so we could live through Him.

10.text: Love ain't about us lovin' God first. Nah—He loved us first, and sent Jesus to take care of our sins.

11.text: So if God loved us like that? We gotta love one another too. No excuses.

12.text: Nobody's seen God face-to-face. But when we love one another? God lives in us. And His love gets fully expressed in us.

13.text: This how we know we're really connected to Him—and He to us: He gave us His Spirit.

14.text: And we seen it. We testifying that the Father sent the Son to save the whole world.

15.text: If you confess Jesus as the Son of God, God lives in you—and you in Him.

16.text: We know the love God got for us, and we believe it. God is love. If you stay rooted in love, you stay rooted in God—and God in you.

17.text: Love matures in us so we can stand bold on judgment day. Why? 'Cause we reppin' Him right here in the world.

18.text: Real love? It don't come with fear. Perfect love kicks fear out, 'cause fear got torment in it. If you still scared, that love ain't fully grown in you yet.

19.text: We love Him—only 'cause He loved us first.

20.text: You sayin', "I love God," but hate your brother? Nah—you lyin'. If you can't love the one right in front of you, how you gon' love the God you ain't even seen?

21.text: And this ain't optional—God already gave us this command: If you love Him, then love your brother too.

1.text: If you believe Jesus is the Christ, you been born of God. And if you love the One who gave birth, you gon' love all His children too.

2.text: This how we know we really love God's people: when we love God and keep His commandments.

3.text: 'Cause loving God ain't just lip service—it means obeying Him. And His commandments? They ain't heavy or hard to carry.

4.text: Anything born of God? Already got the victory over the world. And how we win? Through faith. That's our W.

5.text: So who overcomes the world? The one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God. Period.

6.text: Jesus is the One who came by water and blood—not just water, but both. And the Spirit is the one testifyin', 'cause the Spirit is truth.

7.text: There's three that bear witness in heaven: the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit—and they one.

8.text: And on earth: the Spirit, the water, and the blood—and they all tell the same story.

9.text: If you trust what humans say, trust God more—His witness about His Son hit harder.

10.text: If you believe in the Son, God's truth lives in you. But if you don't? You basically callin' God a liar—'cause you don't believe what He said about Jesus.

11.text: And here's the testimony: God gave us eternal life, and that life is found in His Son.

12.text: If you got the Son, you got life. If not? No life. No cap.

13.text: I'm writin' all this so you who believe in Jesus know you got eternal life—and so you keep believing, even stronger.

14.text: This the confidence we roll with: If we ask anything according to His will, He hearin' us.

15.text: And if we know He hears us? Then we already got what we asked for. That's trust.

16.text: If you see your brother fallin'—but it ain't a sin that leads to death—pray for him. God'll give life. But if it is a sin that leads to death… I ain't sayin' pray on that.

17.text: All unrighteousness is sin, yeah. But not every sin leads to death.

18.text: Whoever been born of God? They don't live in sin. They protect themselves—and the devil can't touch 'em.

19.text: We know we belong to God. But the world? It's caught up in the enemy's grip.

20.text: But we also know this: the Son of God came, gave us understanding, and now we know what's real. We're in Him who's true—Jesus Christ. That's the real God. That's eternal life.

21.text: Little ones, keep yourselves away from idols. Don't let anything fake take God's place.

1.text: This Peter, one of Jesus Christ's apostles, writin' to all the folks scattered across Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia—y'all God's chosen ones on the move.

2.text: Y'all were picked ahead of time by God the Father, set apart by the Spirit, so you could live obedient and get covered by the blood of Jesus. Much love and deep peace to all y'all—may it multiply heavy.

3.text: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! 'Cause of His wild mercy, He gave us new life—a living hope—through Jesus risin' from the dead.

4.text: And now we got an inheritance that can't get messed up, can't be corrupted, and won't ever fade. It's sittin' in heaven, just waitin' for you.

5.text: And you? You stay protected by God's power, through your faith, holdin' on 'til salvation gets fully revealed when the time comes.

6.text: So yeah, you celebrate—even though for now, you might be goin' through it with all kinds of trials.

7.text: But it's all a test to show how real your faith is. That faith? It's more valuable than gold, even though gold gotta go through fire. When Jesus come back, your faith gon' shine with praise, honor, and glory.

8.text: You ain't seen Him, but you still love Him. You don't see Him right now, but you believe in Him—and that got you filled with joy so deep it can't even be explained. Pure glory.

9.text: 'Cause what's comin' at the end of this journey? The salvation of your soul. That's the goal.

10.text: The prophets was searchin' hard for this same salvation—they prophesied about the grace that's hittin' y'all now.

11.text: They kept diggin' to figure out the time and situation the Spirit of Christ in them was pointin' to—about how the Messiah would suffer and then be glorified.

12.text: God showed them that it wasn't about them—it was for us. What they spoke on came to life through the folks who preached the gospel to y'all by the Holy Spirit from heaven. Even angels wanna peek into this—fr fr.

13.text: So lock in your mind. Get your mental right. Stay clear-headed and put your full hope in the grace that's gon' hit when Jesus come back.

14.text: Be obedient like kids who actually listen—don't fall back into your old lusts like you did when you ain't know no better.

15.text: But just like the One who called you is holy, you be holy too—in everything you do.

16.text: 'Cause it's written: "Be holy, 'cause I'm holy."

17.text: And if you call God "Father," the same One who judges everybody fairly based on how they live—then carry yourself with reverence while you here on earth. This ain't your forever home.

18.text: You ain't get saved with stuff that fades like silver or gold—stuff passed down from your folks that didn't really lead nowhere.

19.text: Nah—you were bought with blood. Not just any blood—the precious blood of Christ, like a perfect lamb with no blemish.

20.text: Jesus was chosen for this before the world was even made, but now He stepped into the scene for you—in these last days.

21.text: Through Him, you believe in God—the One who raised Him from the dead and gave Him glory—so your faith and hope could stay rooted in God.

22.text: Since y'all cleaned up your souls by obeyin' the truth—through the Spirit—and now got that real, deep love for your fam in Christ, love each other hard, with pure hearts.

23.text: You been born again—not from no weak, fading seed—but from something that can't die: the livin', everlastin' word of God.

24.text: 'Cause: "All people like grass, And all their glory like a flower— The grass dries up, The flower falls off,

25.text: But the word of the Lord? That joint lasts forever." And that right there—that's the word y'all heard in the gospel.

1.text: So, for real—cut out all the mess: hate, lies, fakin', jealousy, and that reckless mouth.

2.text: Like babies fresh out the womb, crave that pure Word—it's how you grow up in this walk.

3.text: 'Cause if you ever really tasted how good the Lord is, you already know what it is.

4.text: Come to Jesus—the realest one, the livin' stone. Folks might've rejected Him, but God chose Him and calls Him precious.

5.text: And y'all? Y'all livin' stones too. God buildin' somethin' spiritual with you—a whole priesthood, holy and set apart—to bring spiritual offerings that actually please Him through Christ.

6.text: The Scriptures said it: "Look, I'm puttin' down a cornerstone in Zion, Chosen, valuable, the real foundation. Whoever believe in Him won't be ashamed."

7.text: To the believers, He's priceless. But to the ones who don't obey: "The stone the builders tossed aside Ended up bein' the main piece."

8.text: And also: "A rock that trips people up, A stone they stumble over." They fall 'cause they don't wanna listen—and they was already headed that way.

9.text: But you? You different. Chosen generation. Royal priesthood. Holy nation. God's own people. So you can show the world who He is—the One who pulled you outta darkness and lit up your whole life.

10.text: Back then, you wasn't even a people. Now? You God's people. Back then, no mercy. Now? Full access. 💯

11.text: Family, I'm beggin' you—as folks just passin' through this world—stay away from them cravings that try to destroy your soul.

12.text: Live in a way that even when folks talk bad about you, your good deeds shine so hard they end up givin' glory to God when He show up.

13.text: Submit to the laws of the land for the Lord's sake. Whether it's the king or governors—

14.text: They been set up to keep wrongdoers in check and uplift those who do right.

15.text: This God's will: that when you live right, you shut up the foolish talk of ignorant folks.

16.text: You free, yeah—but don't use that freedom to hide bad behavior. Live like God's servants.

17.text: Show respect to everybody. Love your people. Fear God. Respect the ones in charge.

18.text: If you servin' somebody, respect 'em—even the ones that ain't treatin' you right.

19.text: If you endure unjust suffering because you're tryna stay faithful to God, that hits different in His eyes.

20.text: I mean, if you get beat for doin' wrong and take it… that ain't special. But if you do right and still get mistreated, and take that with grace? God honors that.

21.text: This is part of the call—Christ suffered for us and left the blueprint. You supposed to walk in them same steps.

22.text: "He ain't never sinned. Never spoke a lie."

23.text: When folks came for Him, He ain't snap back. When He was sufferin', He ain't threaten nobody. He gave it all over to the One who judges right.

24.text: He carried our sins in His own body—on that cross. So we could die to sin and live for righteousness. And by His wounds? We got healed. 🙌

25.text: You was out here like lost sheep. But now? You home. Back with the Shepherd. Back with the One watchin' over your soul.

1.text: Wives, same way—be respectful and submitted to your own husbands. Even if your man ain't followin' the Word, your lifestyle might be the thing that wins him over—no sermon needed.

2.text: When he sees you movin' with purity and reverence, that's gon' speak for itself.

3.text: Don't just be all about the outside—your hair, your gold, your outfits.

4.text: Let your real beauty be what's inside—a soft, quiet spirit that don't fade. God sees that and calls it precious.

5.text: That's how the OG holy women did it—trustin' God, lovin' their husbands, and stayin' faithful.

6.text: Just like Sarah did with Abraham, callin' him lord. If you walk like that, doin' right and not shakin' in fear, you part of her line.

7.text: Husbands, same goes for y'all—live with your wife in understanding. Show her honor, even if she seem more fragile. Y'all both heirs of this grace-life. Don't block your own prayers bein' outta pocket with her.

8.text: Look, fam—y'all need to be on the same page. Show love. Show empathy. Be tender, humble, and respectful.

9.text: Don't clap back when folks do you wrong. Don't trade insult for insult. Instead, bless them—'cause that's your calling. And that's how you receive your own blessing. 🙌

10.text: "If you wanna live good and see good days, Keep your mouth from talkin' reckless, And don't be out here spreadin' lies.

11.text: Step away from evil and chase what's good. Run after peace like it's a prize."

12.text: The Lord stay watchin' out for the righteous—He hear they prayers. But if you out here actin' up? His face turn the other way.

13.text: Who really gon' mess with you if you stay doin' good?

14.text: But even if they do come for you while you walkin' right—you still blessed. Don't be shook or stressed about their threats.

15.text: Keep God set apart in your heart. Be ready to break down why you got hope—do it humbly and respectfully.

16.text: Keep your conscience clean. So when haters throw dirt on your name, your life gon' expose their lies and leave 'em embarrassed.

17.text: If God allows you to suffer, better it be for doin' right than for doin' wrong.

18.text: Jesus took on suffering too—once and for all. The righteous One died for the unrighteous ones. Why? To bring us close to God. His body died, but the Spirit raised Him up.

19.text: Through that same Spirit, He went and made a move—preached to the souls locked up.

20.text: These were the ones who ain't listen back in Noah's time, while God was patiently waitin' and the ark was bein' built. Only eight folks made it out that water.

21.text: And that same water points to what baptism means for us now—it ain't just about gettin' washed on the outside. It's a sign you got a clean conscience with God, made real through Jesus risin' from the dead.

22.text: And now Jesus sittin' at God's right hand—above every angel, authority, and power. All of it answers to Him now. Crowned up. 👑

1.text: Since Christ went through suffering in His body, you need to suit up with that same mindset. 'Cause when you suffer in the flesh and stay faithful? That's a sign you done with sin.

2.text: You don't waste the rest of your life chasin' what people want—but you live for what God want now.

3.text: We already did enough wildin' in the past—livin' like the world: wild parties, lust, gettin' drunk, worshippin' false stuff. That was then.

4.text: Now folks tryna figure out why you don't run with 'em no more in that same mess. They talkin' reckless 'cause you don't move like them.

5.text: But trust—everybody gon' have to answer to the One who ready to judge both the livin' and the dead.

6.text: That's why the gospel was preached even to folks who gone already—so that even though they were judged by human standards, they could live by God's Spirit.

7.text: The end is close—so lock in. Be serious and alert when you pray.

8.text: Most important, love each other hard. 'Cause real love covers a whole lotta mess.

9.text: Be the kind of person that opens your door and your heart—no grumbling, no side-eye.

10.text: Whatever gift God gave you, use it to serve each other. Be a good steward of His grace—don't sit on what He gave.

11.text: If you speak, speak like God talkin' through you. If you serve, serve with God's strength—so everything lifts Him up. Glory and power? All that belongs to Jesus—forever. Amen. 🙌

12.text: Fam, don't act brand new when fiery trials come. That's not strange—it's part of the walk.

13.text: Instead, rejoice that you get to share in Christ's suffering. 'Cause when He shows up in glory? You gon' be shoutin' too.

14.text: If folks talk down on you 'cause you reppin' Christ, that's actually a blessing. That means God's glory restin' on you—even if they don't get it.

15.text: But don't be out here sufferin' 'cause you doin' wrong—don't be a killer, a thief, a menace, or out here nose-deep in other folks' business.

16.text: But if you catch heat just 'cause you a Christian? Don't be ashamed. Let that be your chance to glorify God.

17.text: Time's up—judgment startin' in the church. If it begins with us, what's it gon' look like for folks who ain't even listenin' to the gospel?

18.text: Like the Word say: "If the righteous barely make it, Where the sinner and the godless gon' end up?"

19.text: So if you suffer and it's God's will, put your soul in His hands and keep doin' good—He a faithful Creator. Trust that.

1.text: To all the elders among y'all—I'm speakin' as a fellow elder, someone who saw what Christ went through and who gon' share in that glory when it's revealed:

2.text: Take care of God's people like a true shepherd. Don't do it just 'cause you got to—do it 'cause you want to. Don't do it for the money bag—do it with a willing heart.

3.text: Don't be out here flexin' on the people God trusted you to lead. Be the example. Let 'em follow your walk, not just your words.

4.text: And when the Chief Shepherd—Jesus—comes back, He got a crown of glory for you. And unlike everything else, it won't fade or get dusty. 👑

5.text: Same thing goes for the younger crew—respect the elders. And all of y'all? Be humble with each other. Wrap yourself in humility like a fresh fit. 'Cause: "God push back on the proud, But He pour grace on the humble."

6.text: So drop your pride, and stay low under God's mighty hand. He gon' lift you up when the time's right.

7.text: And whatever stress, whatever weight you carry? Throw it all on Him—'cause He actually care about you. 👐

8.text: Stay woke. Stay locked in. The devil out here like a lion—roamin', roarin', lookin' for someone to chew up and spit out.

9.text: But you? Stand strong. Don't fold. Keep your faith solid. Know this: your brothers and sisters across the world goin' through the same battles. You ain't alone. 💪🏾

10.text: And after you've suffered a lil' while, the God of all grace—the One who called you into eternal glory through Jesus—He gon' perfect you, establish you, strengthen you, and settle you.

11.text: All the glory and power? It's His. Forever and ever. Amen. 🙌🏾

12.text: I wrote this short letter through my brother Silvanus, who I trust fully. I'm encouragin' y'all and lettin' you know: this is the real deal—the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.

13.text: The one with me in Babylon—chosen just like you—sends love. So does my son Mark.

14.text: Show love to each other with a holy kiss. Peace to every single one of y'all who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

1.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to y'all from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

2.text: We always thank God for you, mentioning you in our prayers,

3.text: Remembering without fail your work of faith, labor of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the presence of our God and Father.

4.text: We know, beloved brothers and sisters, that you've been chosen by God.

5.text: Our gospel didn't just come to you in words, but with power, the Holy Spirit, and full assurance, just like you saw what kind of men we were among you for your sake.

6.text: You followed us and the Lord, even though you received the word in the midst of suffering, but you still had the joy of the Holy Spirit.

7.text: Because of that, you became examples to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia. You showed them how it's done.

8.text: For from you, the word of the Lord has gone out, not just in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place. Your faith in God is so strong, we don't even need to say anything about it.

9.text: People are talking about us, saying how we came to you and how you turned to God from idols, to serve the living and true God,

10.text: And how you're waiting for His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead—Jesus, who delivers us from the coming wrath.

1.text: Y'all know, brothers and sisters, that when we came to you, it wasn't for nothing.

2.text: Even after we got hurt and treated real foul in Philippi, as you know, we still stood strong in God and boldly preached the gospel to you, even though it came with a lot of struggle.

3.text: Our message didn't come from a place of error or impurity, nor was it fake.

4.text: We were approved by God to carry the gospel, and that's how we speak—not to please people, but to please God who checks our hearts.

5.text: We didn't use smooth talk or try to get anything outta y'all, like we see some do. God's our witness.

6.text: We didn't seek glory from men, not from you or anyone else, even though we could've flexed as apostles of Christ.

7.text: We were gentle with you, just like a nursing mother takes care of her kids.

8.text: We loved y'all so much, we didn't just give you the gospel of God, we gave you our lives too, 'cause you became so dear to us.

9.text: You remember, we worked hard for y'all—night and day, so we wouldn't be a burden, and we preached the gospel to you.

10.text: You're witnesses, and God is too, how we lived devout, just, and blameless among you who believe.

11.text: You know how we encouraged, comforted, and challenged each of you, like a father does his own children,

12.text: Telling you to walk worthy of God, who called you into His kingdom and glory.

13.text: For this reason, we thank God all the time, because when you received the word of God we preached, you didn't just take it as our words, but as the truth—it's the word of God, and it works in y'all who believe.

14.text: You, brothers and sisters, became imitators of the churches of God in Judea, who are in Christ Jesus. You even went through the same struggles from your own people, just like they did from the Judeans.

15.text: The same ones who killed Jesus and their own prophets, and now they're out here persecuting us too. They don't please God and they're against everyone.

16.text: They're stopping us from speaking to the Gentiles so they can be saved, always filling up the measure of their sins. But God's wrath is coming down on them, full force.

17.text: But we, brothers and sisters, even though we've been away from you physically for a little while, we still got y'all in our hearts and we've been wanting to see you badly.

18.text: We tried to come to y'all—even me, Paul—over and over, but Satan blocked us.

19.text: What's our hope, or joy, or crown that we'll be bragging about when Jesus comes back? Isn't it even you in His presence?

20.text: You are our glory and joy.

1.text: So when we couldn't stand it no more, we thought it was best to be left in Athens by ourselves,

2.text: And we sent Timothy, our brother, God's minister, and our fellow worker in the gospel of Christ, to build you up and encourage you about your faith,

3.text: So that none of y'all get shaken by all this trouble, 'cause you know we were appointed to go through this.

4.text: We told you when we was with you that we'd face struggles, and now you see it's happening, just like we said.

5.text: So, I couldn't take it anymore, I had to send to check on your faith, to make sure the tempter didn't get to y'all and mess up all the work we put in.

6.text: But now that Timothy came back from you, bringing us the good news of your faith and love, and how you're always remembering us, wanting to see us just like we wanna see you—

7.text: We're encouraged by your faith, even with all the trouble and distress we're going through.

8.text: For now, we alive, knowing you standing strong in the Lord.

9.text: What can we even thank God for you enough? We rejoice for y'all before God,

10.text: Praying day and night, wishing we could see your face and help you grow in your faith.

11.text: Now may our God and Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, lead us to you,

12.text: And may the Lord help you grow more and more in love for each other and for everyone, just like we love you,

13.text: So He can keep your hearts blameless in holiness before God, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints.

1.text: Alright then, brothers and sisters, we're urging y'all in the Lord Jesus to keep growing more and more, just like we showed you how to live to please God,
