2.text: 'Cause you know what we taught you through the Lord Jesus.

3.text: This is God's will for you—your sanctification: Stay away from sexual immorality,

4.text: Each of you should know how to control your own body in sanctification and honor,

5.text: Not in the lustful passion, like the Gentiles who don't know God,

6.text: Don't take advantage of or cheat your brother in this, 'cause the Lord is the one who will punish all those who do that, just like we warned you before.

7.text: God didn't call us to live unclean, but to live holy.

8.text: So, if you reject this, you ain't rejecting people—you rejecting God, who gave us the Holy Spirit.

9.text: Now, about loving each other like brothers and sisters, I don't even need to say much—God's already teaching you to love each other.

10.text: And y'all already doing it to all the believers in Macedonia. But we're telling you, keep stepping it up.

11.text: Make it your goal to live a peaceful life, mind your own business, and work with your own hands, like we told you,

12.text: So that you can live in a way that earns respect from outsiders and not be lacking anything.

13.text: Now, I don't want y'all to be ignorant about those who have passed away, so you don't be sad like people who have no hope.

14.text: We believe that Jesus died and rose again, and just like that, God will bring with Him those who've fallen asleep in Jesus.

15.text: We're telling you this by the word of the Lord: We who are alive when Jesus comes back won't get there before those who've passed away.

16.text: For the Lord Himself will come down from heaven with a shout, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God. And the dead in Christ will rise first.

17.text: Then we who are still alive will be caught up with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And we'll always be with the Lord.

18.text: So, comfort each other with these words.

1.text: Now, concerning the times and seasons, my people, I don't need to tell y'all much.

2.text: You already know that the Day of the Lord is gonna come like a thief in the night.

3.text: When they start talking 'bout "Peace and safety," that's when sudden destruction gon' hit them, like labor pains on a pregnant woman. They ain't gon' escape.

4.text: But y'all ain't in the dark, so that Day ain't gonna sneak up on you like a thief.

5.text: You are children of the light and children of the day. We ain't of the night or the darkness.

6.text: So don't be sleepin' like everybody else, but stay awake and stay sober.

7.text: People who sleep, sleep at night. People who get drunk, get drunk at night.

8.text: But we, who are of the day, gotta stay sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of salvation's hope.

9.text: God didn't choose us for wrath, but for salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

10.text: Who died for us, so that whether we're awake or sleep, we should live together with Him.

11.text: So, comfort each other and keep building each other up, just like y'all been doing.

12.text: Now, we're asking you, brothers and sisters, to recognize those who are working hard among you, who lead you in the Lord and give you guidance,

13.text: And show them mad love, for the work they're doing. Be peaceful with each other.

14.text: Now, we also urge you, warn the ones who are being wild, comfort those who are struggling, support the weak, and be patient with everybody.

15.text: Make sure nobody's paying back evil for evil. Always go after what's good, not just for yourself, but for everyone.

16.text: Rejoice always,

17.text: Pray without stopping,

18.text: Give thanks in everything; this is what God wants from you in Christ Jesus.

19.text: Don't shut down the Spirit.

20.text: Don't dismiss prophecies.

21.text: Test everything; hold on to what's good.

22.text: Stay away from every form of evil.

23.text: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you all the way—your whole spirit, soul, and body, keeping you blameless until the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

24.text: The One who called you is faithful, and He's gonna make it happen.

25.text: Brothers and sisters, pray for us.

26.text: Greet all the believers with a holy kiss.

27.text: I'm charging you by the Lord: Make sure this letter is read to all the believers.

28.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

1.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ, by God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ, our hope,

2.text: To Timothy, my true son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

3.text: As I told you when I went to Macedonia, stay in Ephesus and tell some folks not to teach anything other than the real gospel,

4.text: Don't get caught up in stories and endless family trees that just lead to arguments instead of building up in faith.

5.text: The point of all this teaching is love, coming from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith.

6.text: But some people got distracted and turned to empty talk,

7.text: They wanna be teachers of the law, but don't even understand what they're saying or what they're trying to push.

8.text: But we know that the law is good if you use it right,

9.text: The law isn't for the righteous person, it's for the lawless and rebellious, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for those who kill their fathers and mothers, for murderers,

10.text: For people out here living in sin, for those messing with others' lives, for liars, for those making false oaths, and anything else that's against sound teaching—

11.text: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which I've been trusted with.

12.text: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who gave me strength, because He saw me as faithful and put me in the ministry,

13.text: Even though I was once a blasphemer, a persecutor, and an arrogant person, but I got mercy 'cause I didn't know what I was doing, I was just out here in unbelief.

14.text: The grace of our Lord was so much more than enough, along with faith and love, which are in Christ Jesus.

15.text: Here's a true saying that's worthy of everyone accepting: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, and I'm the worst of them.

16.text: But I got mercy, so that Jesus Christ could show His patience in me, as an example for those who will believe in Him and get eternal life.

17.text: Now to the eternal, immortal, invisible King, to God who's the only wise one, be all the honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

18.text: This charge I give you, son Timothy, based on the prophecies spoken over you, so that you can fight the good fight,

19.text: Hold on to faith and a good conscience, which some have rejected, and because of that, their faith has crashed like a shipwreck,

20.text: Like Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I handed over to Satan so they could learn not to disrespect God.

1.text: So first off, I'm telling y'all to pray for everybody—supplications, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgiving for all people,

2.text: For kings and all those in authority, so we can live a peaceful, quiet life, full of godliness and respect.

3.text: This is good and pleases God, our Savior,

4.text: Who wants everyone to be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth.

5.text: There's only one God, and one Mediator between God and mankind—the Man, Christ Jesus,

6.text: Who gave Himself as a ransom for all, to be shown at the right time.

7.text: That's why I was chosen to be a preacher and apostle—I'm speaking the truth in Christ, no cap—a teacher to the Gentiles in faith and truth.

8.text: I want the men to pray everywhere, lifting up holy hands, without anger or doubting.

9.text: And for the women, I need you to keep it modest—dress appropriately, no need to overdo it with the flashy clothes, expensive jewelry, or braided hair.

10.text: It's about looking like someone who's living out godliness, not someone flexing their appearance. What really matters is the good works that show what's in your heart.

11.text: Let women learn quietly, with full submission—no rush, just take your time and listen,

12.text: And I'm not letting a woman teach or have authority over a man—she should be quiet and not try to take control.

13.text: Adam was made first, then Eve.

14.text: Adam wasn't deceived, but the woman got tricked and fell into sin.

15.text: But don't get it twisted—women will still be saved through childbearing, if they keep living in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.

1.text: This is a real one: If a man wants to be a bishop (a leader in the church), he's desiring a good job.

2.text: A bishop gotta be blameless, the husband of one wife, temperate, sober-minded, good behavior, hospitable, and able to teach.

3.text: Not out here drunk all the time, not violent, not out here chasing money, but gentle, not starting fights, and not greedy for stuff.

4.text: He gotta know how to run his house right, keeping his kids in line with respect and honor.

5.text: 'Cause if a man can't handle his own house, how's he gonna take care of God's church?

6.text: Don't make him a newbie, cause if he's too full of pride, he'll fall into the same trap the devil did.

7.text: He also needs a good reputation outside the church, or he might end up in disgrace and fall into the devil's trap.

8.text: Deacons gotta be respectful, not two-faced, not always drinking, and not chasing money.

9.text: They gotta hold the faith with a pure conscience.

10.text: Let them be tested first, and then let them serve as deacons if they're found blameless.

11.text: Their wives need to be respectful too, no gossiping, self-controlled, and faithful in everything.

12.text: Deacons gotta be the husbands of one wife, running their households and kids well.

13.text: When deacons serve well, they get a good name and boldness in the faith of Jesus Christ.

14.text: I'm writing this to you 'cause I hope to come to you soon,

15.text: But if I get delayed, I want you to know how to behave in God's house, which is the church of the living God—the pillar and foundation of the truth.

16.text: And here's the mystery that's without controversy: God was revealed in the flesh, Justified in the Spirit, Seen by angels, Preached among the Gentiles, Believed on in the world, Received up in glory.

1.text: Now, the Spirit's straight up telling us that in the last days, some folks are gonna fall away from the faith, listening to deceiving spirits and doctrines of demons,

2.text: They gon' be out here lying and pretending, with their conscience burned like it's been touched with a hot iron,

3.text: They gon' be out here saying stuff like don't marry and don't eat certain foods, even though God created those foods to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

4.text: Everything God made is good, and ain't nothing to be turned down if it's received with thanks,

5.text: It's set apart as holy by God's word and prayer.

6.text: If you teach these things to the brothers and sisters, you're gonna be a good servant of Jesus Christ, fed with the words of faith and good teaching that you've been following closely.

7.text: But stay away from nonsense and old stories that don't build you up—train yourself in godliness.

8.text: Physical exercise might help a little, but godliness is good for everything, with promise of a good life here and the one to come.

9.text: This is a true saying, and it's worth accepting.

10.text: We work hard for this, and we get ridiculed for it, but we trust in the living God, who's the Savior of all people, especially those who believe.

11.text: These are the things you need to teach and command.

12.text: Don't let anyone look down on you because you're young, but be an example to the believers in word, in conduct, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

13.text: Until I get there, keep giving attention to reading, encouraging people, and teaching the doctrine.

14.text: Don't neglect the gift that's inside of you, the one given to you through prophecy and the laying on of hands by the elders.

15.text: Think on these things; throw yourself fully into them, so that everyone can see how much you're growing.

16.text: Watch yourself and the teaching—stay committed to both, 'cause by doing this, you'll save yourself and everyone who hears you.

1.text: Don't go rebuking an older man, but encourage him like he's your father, younger men like your brothers,

2.text: Older women like your mothers, and younger women like your sisters—with all purity.

3.text: Honor widows who are really widows.

4.text: But if a widow has kids or grandkids, let them step up first, learn to show respect at home, and take care of their parents. That's good and what God wants.

5.text: The real widow, the one left alone, trusts in God and stays praying and supplicating, day and night.

6.text: But the one out here living for pleasure is spiritually dead while she's still living.

7.text: Teach these things so that they can be blameless.

8.text: But if anyone doesn't take care of their own family—especially their household—they've denied the faith and are worse than an unbeliever.

9.text: Don't let a widow under sixty years old be added to the list, unless she's been the wife of one man,

10.text: And has a good reputation for good works: if she raised children, showed hospitality to strangers, washed the saints' feet, helped the afflicted, and followed every good work.

11.text: But don't take in younger widows, 'cause when they start getting restless, they wanna remarry,

12.text: And that brings condemnation 'cause they left their first faith.

13.text: They get lazy, hopping from house to house, and not just idle but gossips and busybodies, saying stuff they shouldn't.

14.text: So, I want the younger widows to marry, have children, manage their homes, and not give the devil a chance to speak against them.

15.text: Some have already turned away after Satan.

16.text: If any believing man or woman has widows in their family, they should take care of them so the church isn't burdened. The church should only care for true widows.

17.text: Elders who do their job well should be worthy of double honor, especially those working hard in the Word and doctrine.

18.text: The Scripture says: "Don't muzzle an ox while it's working the grain," and "The laborer is worthy of their wages."

19.text: Don't accept an accusation against an elder unless it's confirmed by two or three witnesses.

20.text: If they're sinning, rebuke them in front of everyone, so others will learn to take it seriously.

21.text: I charge you before God, Jesus Christ, and the elect angels to observe these rules without bias or partiality.

22.text: Don't be quick to lay hands on anyone or get involved in other people's sins. Keep yourself pure.

23.text: Don't just drink water—use a little wine for your stomach and your frequent health problems.

24.text: Some people's sins are obvious and they're dealt with before judgment, but others show up later.

25.text: Likewise, some good works are clearly visible, but others can't be hidden.

1.text: All the bondservants under the yoke, let them respect their masters and give them honor, so that God's name and His message don't get disrespected.

2.text: And if your master is a believer, don't look down on them just 'cause they're your brother or sister in Christ. Serve them with even more love, 'cause they're also in the family of believers. Teach these things and keep encouraging people to live right.

3.text: If anyone's teaching something different and isn't sticking to the true gospel—the words of Jesus and the doctrine that leads to godliness,

4.text: They're just full of pride, knowin' nothing, and caught up in arguments and debates, which only lead to envy, strife, insults, and evil suspicions.

5.text: It's just a bunch of useless drama from people with corrupt minds, who don't have the truth. They think godliness is a way to make money, so stay away from them.

6.text: But godliness with contentment? That's true wealth.

7.text: We came into this world with nothing, and we ain't takin' nothing out of it either.

8.text: If we got food and clothes, we should be good and be content.

9.text: But those who're chasing after riches, they fall into temptation and traps, and it leads to a bunch of foolish and dangerous desires that drag people down into destruction.

10.text: The love of money is the root of all kinds of evil—some people have even strayed from the faith because of their greed, and they've hurt themselves with all kinds of pain.

11.text: But you, man of God, run from all that mess. Instead, chase after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, and gentleness.

12.text: Fight the good fight of faith. Lay hold of eternal life, to which you were called and have already confessed in front of many witnesses.

13.text: I urge you in front of God, who gives life to all things, and before Jesus Christ, who confessed the good confession before Pilate,

14.text: Keep this commandment clean and pure until the Lord Jesus comes back,

15.text: He's the one who's gonna be revealed at the right time, the blessed and only King, the King of kings, the Lord of lords,

16.text: Who alone has immortality, living in light no one can touch, whom nobody has seen or can see. To Him be the honor and power forever. Amen.

17.text: Tell those who are rich in this world not to be stuck up or trust in uncertain riches, but in God, who gives us everything to enjoy.

18.text: Let them do good, let them be rich in good works, always ready to give, always willing to share,

19.text: Storing up a solid foundation for the future, so they can lay hold of eternal life.

20.text: Timothy, guard what's been trusted to you. Don't get caught up in all the empty talk and nonsense that's falsely called knowledge—

21.text: Some folks have wandered away from the faith 'cause they got caught up in that mess. Grace be with you. Amen.

1.text: This Paul—apostle of Jesus Christ, not by my own decision, but by God's will—and I got Timothy, our brother, with me. We writin' to the church of God in Corinth, and all God's people in the region of Achaia too.

2.text: Grace and peace to y'all from God our Father and from our Lord Jesus Christ.

3.text: Big ups to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus—the Father who shows mercy and the God who comes through with comfort every time.

4.text: He hold us down in all our struggles, so we can hold others down when they go through it—with the same comfort He gave us.

5.text: Yeah, we suffer a lot just like Christ did—but guess what? That same Christ pours out comfort just as much.

6.text: If we're goin' through it, it's to help y'all see what it means to endure and be saved. And if we're comforted, it's so y'all can be comforted too.

7.text: We ain't waverin' in our hope for y'all. We know if y'all gotta share in the suffering, y'all gon' share in the comfort too.

8.text: We don't want y'all in the dark about what went down in Asia. We was under pressure so heavy, we thought we wouldn't make it.

9.text: Matter fact, it felt like a death sentence just hangin' over us. But that's when we learned to stop trustin' ourselves—and to start trustin' the God who raises the dead.

10.text: He already saved us from death once, and He still savin' us. And we know He ain't done yet.

11.text: Y'all helpin' too—prayin' for us. So when folks thank God, they know He answered a whole lot of prayers.

12.text: If we brag on anything, it's this: our conscience is clean. We carried ourselves with integrity and God's kind of wisdom, not that worldly fake stuff—and especially with y'all.

13.text: We ain't writin' nothin' you can't understand. What you read is what it is. And I'm trustin' that one day you'll understand all of it.

14.text: Some of y'all already get it—how we proud of y'all, and y'all proud of us, especially when Jesus returns.

15.text: That's why I planned to visit y'all first—to bless y'all twice, really.

16.text: I was gon' stop through on my way to Macedonia, then hit y'all again on the way back, and have y'all send me off to Judea.

17.text: But when I made those plans, was I playin'? You think I make moves just off vibes—sayin' "yes" and "no" at the same time?

18.text: Nah, God is faithful, and our word to y'all wasn't all over the place.

19.text: When we preached Jesus Christ—me, Silvanus, and Timothy—it wasn't "maybe yes, maybe no." It was a straight-up yes in Him.

20.text: Every promise God made? Jesus is the "yes" to all of it. And we say "amen" through Him, giving God the glory.

21.text: God is the one who made us solid in Christ. He's the one who anointed us.

22.text: He stamped us with His seal and put His Spirit in our hearts as a down payment—guarantee we His.

23.text: I'm keepin' it real before God—that's why I ain't come back to Corinth yet. I was tryin' to spare y'all.

24.text: Don't get it twisted though—we ain't tryin' to control your faith. We in this together to boost your joy. 'Cause it's by faith that you stand strong.

1.text: I made up my mind—I wasn't about to come back to y'all in sorrow again.

2.text: 'Cause if I come and make y'all sad, who gon' lift me up? The same ones I made sad? That ain't how it should go.

3.text: That's why I wrote y'all first—so when I did show up, I wouldn't be grievin' over folks who should've been bringin' me joy. I was trustin' that my joy and y'all's joy was the same.

4.text: I wrote y'all in pain, with my heart heavy and my eyes full of tears. Not to make you feel bad, but to show how much I really love y'all.

5.text: Now if somebody caused pain, it wasn't just me they hurt—it hit all of y'all too, even if I ain't tryin' to overdo it.

6.text: That punishment y'all gave him? It was enough. He got the message.

7.text: Now it's time to forgive him and show him some love—'cause if y'all keep shuttin' him out, he might drown in that guilt.

8.text: So I'm askin' y'all: show him y'all still love him. Make it clear.

9.text: I wrote you before to see if y'all would actually be obedient in everything.

10.text: Whoever y'all forgave? I forgive too. If I forgave anybody, I did it for y'all, with Christ watchin'.

11.text: 'Cause we ain't tryin' to let Satan get a foothold—we know how he moves.

12.text: When I came to Troas to preach the gospel, God had opened the door wide.

13.text: But I couldn't rest—I was uneasy 'cause I couldn't find my brother Titus. So I left and headed to Macedonia instead.

14.text: But man—thank God, 'cause He always leads us like winners, marchin' in triumph with Christ. And everywhere we go, it's like we carryin' the scent of heaven with us.

15.text: To God, we smell like Christ—whether folks are gettin' saved or not.

16.text: To the ones rejectin' the message, we smell like death. But to the ones leanin' in? We smell like life. And honestly… who even feels worthy to carry that kind of weight?

17.text: But look—we ain't out here hustlin' God's word for profit like some folks. We keep it sincere, speakin' straight from God, knowin' He sees everything we say in Christ.

1.text: So what now? We gotta start braggin' on ourselves again? Or do we need letters of recommendation—to y'all or from y'all—like some folks do?

2.text: Nah. Y'all are the letter. Written right on our hearts. Everybody can read it—your lives speak for themselves.

3.text: It's clear y'all are a letter from Christ, and we just delivered it. But this letter ain't written with ink—it's written by the Spirit of the living God. Not on stone tablets, but on hearts—real flesh, real love, real change.

4.text: We got this confidence in God because of Christ.

5.text: Not because we think we got it all together by ourselves. Nah—our ability comes from God.

6.text: He's the one who made us fit to serve under the new covenant—not by the letter of the law, but by the Spirit. 'Cause the letter? That kills. But the Spirit? She gives life.

7.text: If the old ministry—written on stone and connected to death—came with glory (so much so that folks couldn't even look at Moses' face 'cause it was glowing),

8.text: then how much more glorious is this new ministry led by the Spirit?

9.text: That old law brought condemnation and still had some glory… But this new ministry? The one rooted in righteousness? Way more glorious.

10.text: Honestly, compared to this new glory, that old one don't even shine the same.

11.text: If what was temporary had glory, how much more glory is in what lasts forever?

12.text: Since we got this kind of hope, we speak bold.

13.text: Not like Moses, who had to cover his face 'cause the shine was fading.

14.text: But the folks back then? Their minds were stuck—blinded. And to this day, when they read the old law, it's like they still wearin' that same veil. Only Christ can take it off.

15.text: Even now, when the old ways are read, a veil's still sittin' on their heart.

16.text: But when you turn to the Lord? That veil comes off.

17.text: And the Lord is Spirit—and where the Spirit of the Lord is? There's freedom.

18.text: And now, all of us with the veil gone—we lookin' straight at God's glory, like a reflection in a mirror. And we bein' transformed—from glory to glory, level to level, all through the power of the Spirit.

1.text: So, since God gave us this ministry and showed us mercy—we ain't foldin'. We not givin' up.

2.text: We don't play dirty. We don't move in secret shame. We don't twist Scripture or hustle God's Word. Nah—we keep it 100 and let the truth speak for itself, before God and everybody's conscience.

3.text: Now if this gospel still feel like it's covered up, it's only hid from folks who ain't tryna make it—they perishing.

4.text: The enemy, the so-called god of this world, got they minds blinded. They don't believe, so they can't even see the light—the light that shows the glory of Christ, who's the image of God Himself.

5.text: We ain't preachin' about ourselves—we preachin' Jesus Christ as Lord, and we just here to serve y'all for His sake.

6.text: Same God who said, "Let there be light," back in Genesis? He lit us up too. He put that light in our hearts—so we could shine with the knowledge of God's glory, seen clear in Jesus' face.

7.text: But check this—we carry this treasure in clay jars (that's us). Why? So folks see that the power ain't from us, but straight from God.

8.text: We pressed on every side—but we ain't crushed. We confused sometimes—but we ain't givin' up.

9.text: We get hated on—but we ain't alone. We get knocked down—but we ain't knocked out.

10.text: We carry Jesus' death in our bodies, so that His life can show up in us too.

11.text: Yeah, we live—but we constantly face death for Jesus' sake, so His life can shine through our weak, mortal bodies.

12.text: So while death tryin' to work on us, life's bein' poured into y'all.

13.text: We got that same spirit of faith like the Scripture says: "I believed, and so I spoke." So we believe—and so we speak.

14.text: 'Cause we know this: the same God who raised Jesus from the dead? He gon' raise us up too and bring us into His presence together with y'all.

15.text: Everything we go through? It's for y'all. So that more and more folks receive this grace, and gratitude starts overflowin', giving God even more glory.

16.text: That's why we don't give up. Even though this body breakin' down on the outside, the real us on the inside getting stronger every day.

17.text: These light struggles? They temporary. And they workin' for us an eternal, heavy-weighted glory that can't even compare.

18.text: We not focused on what we can see right now—it's the unseen we lockin' in on. 'Cause what's seen is temporary. But what we can't see? That's eternal.

1.text: Look—we know if this earthly body we livin' in (this tent) gets taken down, we got a real home waitin' on us. A building from God, not made by human hands—eternal and in heaven.

2.text: While we're still in this body, we groan—we long to be covered in that heavenly outfit.

3.text: 'Cause when we put on that eternal body, we won't be out here spiritually naked.

4.text: These earthly bodies got us groanin' under pressure—not 'cause we wanna die, but 'cause we ready for that forever upgrade, where life swallows up death completely.

5.text: And the One who prepped us for all this? God. And He gave us the Holy Spirit as our down payment—a guarantee that He's comin' back for us.

6.text: That's why we stay confident—even though we know that as long as we're here in this body, we ain't fully home with the Lord yet.

7.text: We don't walk by what we see—we walk by faith.

8.text: But trust—we would love to leave this body and finally be at home with the Lord.

9.text: So whether we're here in the body or with Him, we make it our goal to please Him.

10.text: 'Cause everybody—all of us—gon' have to stand before Christ's judgment seat, and give account for what we did while we was livin' in these bodies—good or bad.

11.text: Since we know the weight of standin' before God, we try to persuade folks with love and truth. God sees our hearts, and I hope y'all do too.

12.text: We ain't out here tryna promote ourselves again—we just givin' y'all a reason to speak up for us, especially against folks who brag on looks and not on what's really in the heart.

13.text: If we actin' a little extra, it's for God. If we got our minds right, it's for y'all.

14.text: It's Christ's love that keeps us movin'—'cause we believe this: if Jesus died for everybody, then in Him, we all died too.

15.text: And since He died for us, we ain't supposed to live for ourselves no more—we live for Him. The One who died and rose up for us.

16.text: So from now on, we don't judge people by surface-level stuff. Yeah, we used to look at Christ that way too—but not anymore.

17.text: So if anybody is in Christ, they a whole new creation. Old stuff? Gone. Everything about 'em is made new.

18.text: And all this change? That's God's doing. He brought us back to Himself through Christ—and now He gave us the same job: helping folks get right with God.

19.text: God was in Christ, reconciling the world to Himself—not holdin' their sins against 'em—and now He trusted us with that same message.

20.text: So now we out here as Christ's reps—it's like God talkin' through us. So on behalf of Christ, we beg y'all: get right with God.

21.text: 'Cause God made the One who never sinned become sin for us, so we could become the righteousness of God through Him.

1.text: So as folks workin' right beside God, we beg y'all—don't waste this grace He gave you.

2.text: 'Cause God said: "I heard you at the right time, and I came through on the day of salvation." Listen, now is that time. Today is that day. Don't sleep on it.

3.text: We move carefully so we don't cause offense—don't want nobody blamin' the ministry.

4.text: Instead, we show what real ministry look like: Through patience, Through pressure, When we goin' without, When we stressed,

5.text: When we get beat down, locked up, caught in chaos, workin' nonstop, missin' sleep, fasting for real.

6.text: We move with purity, knowledge, endurance, and kindness—empowered by the Holy Spirit and led by real love.

7.text: We speak truth. We walk in God's power. We stay strapped with righteousness—on both sides.

8.text: Whether folks honor us or hate us, lie on us or lift us up…

9.text: Whether people know our name or act like we invisible… Even when we on death's doorstep—we still alive. We get corrected, but not taken out.

10.text: We be sorrowful, but still got joy. We broke, but makin' others spiritually rich. We don't own nothin'—yet we got everything that matters.

11.text: Yo, Corinth! We been speakin' to y'all straight up. Our hearts wide open.

12.text: We ain't holdin' y'all back—your own affections and hangups are what's keepin' you stuck.

13.text: So I'm talkin' to y'all like my own kids—open your hearts back up to us.

14.text: Don't team up with folks who ain't walkin' with God. That's an unequal yoke. What righteousness got in common with wickedness? What light got to do with darkness?

15.text: What harmony does Christ have with Belial (the enemy)? What can a believer and an unbeliever really share on a spiritual level?

16.text: God's temple got no business messin' with idols. And guess what? You are that temple—the temple of the living God. Just like God said: "I'm gonna live in them. I'm gonna walk with them. I'll be their God, And they'll be My people."

17.text: So the Lord says: "Step out from the crowd. Be different. Be separate. Don't touch what's unclean. And I'll welcome you in."

18.text: God says: "I'll be a Father to y'all, And you'll be My sons and daughters." —Straight from the Lord Almighty.

1.text: Since we got all these promises from God, fam, let's clean ourselves up—inside and out. Let's keep growin' in holiness, outta deep respect for God.

2.text: Y'all—open y'all hearts to us. We ain't done nobody wrong. We didn't corrupt nobody. We ain't take advantage of nobody.

3.text: I'm not tryna make you feel bad—I'm just remindin' you how much y'all mean to us. We got y'all in our hearts, for real. Ride or die.

4.text: I speak bold when I talk to y'all. I even brag about y'all! I'm comforted, even in the middle of all our problems. I got so much joy.

5.text: When we first got to Macedonia, we had no rest. We was pressed on all sides. Outside, it was beef. Inside, we was anxious.

6.text: But God—the One who lifts folks up when they low—He comforted us by sendin' Titus.

7.text: And not just 'cause Titus showed up, but 'cause he came back tellin' us how y'all were missin' us, how you were hurt over what went down, and how fired up y'all were to make it right. That news? Lifted me even higher.

8.text: I know that last letter I sent made y'all feel some kinda way. I ain't gonna lie—I felt a little bad… but not for long.

9.text: I don't regret it now, 'cause that hurt pushed y'all to repent. And that's what matters. You felt sorrow in a way that honored God—and that pain didn't harm y'all, it helped you.

10.text: 'Cause godly sorrow? That leads to real repentance and salvation. You'll never regret that. But worldly sorrow? That just leads to death.

11.text: Just look at what that godly sorrow produced in y'all: You got diligent, You cleared your name, You were mad about the sin, You showed respect, You wanted to do right, You got passionate, And you proved yourselves. Y'all showed y'all were serious.

12.text: So when I wrote that letter, it wasn't just about the one who did wrong, or the one who got hurt. It was really so y'all could see how much we care about y'all, right there in front of God.

13.text: That's why we so comforted now—because y'all got comforted too. And on top of that, we super happy 'cause Titus was refreshed by y'all's love.

14.text: I told him good things about y'all, and y'all ain't let me down. Everything I said to y'all was true, and y'all proved it true to him too.

15.text: Now he love y'all even more, remembering how respectful and obedient y'all were—how y'all welcomed him with honor and humility.

16.text: And now? I'm rejoicing, 'cause I know I can trust y'all in everything.

1.text: Fam, let us tell y'all about the grace God poured out on the churches in Macedonia.

2.text: Even while they were goin' through it—heavy trials and deep poverty—they still had joy and were wild generous.

3.text: I'm tellin' you—they gave what they could, and then some. Nobody had to twist their arm either. They wanted to give.

4.text: Matter fact, they begged us—please let them bless the saints and be part of the ministry.

5.text: And they didn't just give money—they gave themselves to the Lord first. Then to us, just like God wanted.

6.text: So we told Titus, "Yo, you started this work—go ahead and help them finish this gift too."

7.text: And since y'all already got so much—faith, strong speech, wisdom, passion, and love for us—don't forget to excel in giving too.

8.text: I ain't commandin' y'all. But I am checking the realness of your love compared to how others stepped up.

9.text: Y'all know the grace of our Lord Jesus, right? Though He was rich, He became poor for y'all—so through His poverty, y'all could be made rich.

10.text: Here's my take: y'all started this good thing last year—y'all was hype about helpin'. That was beautiful.

11.text: But now it's time to finish it. Match that same energy you had at the start—do what you said you was gonna do.

12.text: 'Cause if you truly willing, God honors that. He looks at what you got—not what you don't.

13.text: Don't get it twisted—I ain't sayin' y'all gotta struggle so somebody else can chill.

14.text: But right now, since y'all got extra, let it cover where they're lackin'. And one day, if you need help, they'll return the favor.

15.text: Just like it says: "The one who gathered a lot didn't have too much, and the one who gathered little didn't come up short."

16.text: Shout out to God for puttin' the same kind of love in Titus' heart for y'all.

17.text: He ain't just follow orders—he was all in. He chose to come see y'all.

18.text: And we sendin' one of the brothers with him too—somebody all the churches know is a real one when it comes to preachin' the gospel.

19.text: He was chosen by the churches to travel with us as we deliver this gift—this ain't just about money. It's about God's glory and y'all's heart.

20.text: We makin' sure nobody got room to throw shade on how we handle this generous gift.

21.text: We takin' care of business with integrity—not just in God's eyes, but so people see it too.

22.text: We also sendin' another brother—he been proven faithful time and time again. But now he's even more excited because he got confidence in y'all.

23.text: And if anybody asks about Titus—just tell 'em he's my partner, grindin' for y'all. And the other bros? They messengers of the churches—they reppin' Christ's glory.

24.text: So show 'em you really about this love life. Let the churches see that our braggin' on y'all wasn't for nothin'.

1.text: Now about blessin' the saints with this offering—I really ain't gotta say too much.

2.text: I already know how ready y'all been. I been braggin' on y'all to the folks in Macedonia, tellin' 'em how Achaia been ready to give for a whole year. Y'all's energy got other folks stirred up to give too.

3.text: But I went ahead and sent the brothers anyway—just so all that braggin' I did ain't end up empty. I want y'all to be ready like I said you would.

4.text: 'Cause if some Macedonians pull up with me and y'all ain't got it together? That'd be mad embarrassing—for y'all and me.

5.text: So I told the crew to go ahead of time and help y'all get the gift ready. You already said you was givin'—so I want it to come from a place of generosity, not like you got forced into it.

6.text: Let me give y'all this truth: whoever plants a little, reaps a little. But if you plant a lot, you gon' reap a lot too.

7.text: So everybody should give what they feel in their heart to give—not outta guilt or pressure—'cause God loves a cheerful giver.

8.text: And trust—God can make all grace overflow toward you. You'll always have enough, and then some, to do every good work.

9.text: Just like it's written: "He gave freely to the poor; His righteousness lasts forever."

10.text: And the same God who gives seed to the sower and bread for food? He gon' bless the seed you sow and multiply it. He gon' grow that harvest of righteousness in your life.

11.text: He'll make sure you got more than enough, so you can keep bein' generous. And all that generosity? Leads to people thankin' God.

12.text: This offering you puttin' together? It's doin' two things: Helpin' out the saints who need it and overflowin' with praise to God.

13.text: Your generosity proves that your faith ain't just talk. Folks gon' glorify God because y'all walkin' out the gospel for real—and y'all sharin' with them and everybody else.

14.text: And they gon' be prayin' for y'all too, thankin' God for the grace they see workin' through you.

15.text: Thanks be to God for His gift—too good for words to even describe.

1.text: Look—it's me, Paul. I'm comin' to y'all humble, just like Christ was—gentle and meek. Yeah, I may seem soft when I'm around y'all, but when I ain't there, I get real bold.

2.text: But I'm askin' y'all—please don't make me have to come in hot. Don't test me to come bold like I plan to be with some folks who act like we out here wildin' in the flesh.

3.text: Yeah, we live in this fleshly body—but the fight we in? Ain't a fleshly one.

4.text: Our weapons ain't physical. They spiritual and powerful, built to tear down strongholds,

5.text: break down false arguments, and destroy any high-minded mess that sets itself up against the knowledge of God. We bring every thought into check, makin' it submit to Christ.

6.text: And trust—we ready to handle disobedience. But we waitin' until y'all fully walkin' in obedience first.

7.text: Y'all stay focused on what things look like on the outside. But if anybody out here think they belong to Christ, they need to remember—we belong to Him too.

8.text: I ain't scared to talk about the authority God gave me. He didn't give it to me to tear y'all down—but to build y'all up. And I ain't ashamed of that.

9.text: I ain't tryna scare you with these letters.

10.text: I know folks be sayin': "His letters hit hard, but in person he weak, and his talk ain't impressive."

11.text: Well, whoever sayin' that better know—what I write when I'm away is what I'll be about when I show up.

12.text: We ain't out here comparin' ourselves to these folks who gas themselves up. That ain't wisdom. They out here makin' themselves the standard, then tryna measure up to they own hype.

13.text: Nah, we stay in our lane—the lane God gave us. And that lane includes y'all.

14.text: We ain't doin' too much—we brought the gospel straight to y'all. That was part of our mission from jump.

15.text: We not claimin' credit for work other folks did. We just hopin' that as your faith grows, our reach grows too—right along with y'all.

16.text: We tryna take this gospel beyond y'all, to places where folks ain't heard it yet. We ain't tryna ride off somebody else's wave.

17.text: Like Scripture says: "If you gon' brag, brag on the Lord."

18.text: 'Cause at the end of the day, it ain't about who hypin' themselves up—it's about who God approves.

1.text: I wish y'all would let me vent a lil' bit—even if it sound foolish. But I know y'all rockin' with me.

2.text: I'm jealous for y'all—with God-level jealousy. I promised y'all to one Man—Christ—and I been tryna keep y'all pure for Him.

3.text: But I'm worried… just like Eve got played by the serpent, some slick talk might be gettin' to your mind and pullin' you away from the simple truth in Christ.

4.text: 'Cause real talk—if somebody comes preachin' another Jesus, or bringin' a different spirit or new gospel than the one y'all first heard—y'all just might go for it.

5.text: Let me be clear—I'm not less than these so-called "super-apostles."

6.text: I might not speak fancy, but I know what I'm talkin' about. And y'all done seen that firsthand.

7.text: Did I mess up by humbling myself so you could be lifted up? I gave y'all the gospel for free.

8.text: I took support from other churches just to serve y'all.

9.text: When I was in need, I didn't burden y'all—folks from Macedonia came through and helped. I made sure I wouldn't be a burden, and I'm still standin' on that.

10.text: As long as I got breath and truth in me, nobody in Achaia gon' shut me up from speakin' on this.

11.text: Why? You think it's 'cause I don't love y'all? God knows I do.

12.text: I'm gon' keep doin' what I'm doin'—so I can shut down these folks who want to look like they movin' like we are.

13.text: They fake apostles, shady workers, dressin' up like they really reppin' Christ.

14.text: And it ain't no surprise—Satan himself be dressin' like an angel of light.

15.text: So of course his people gon' try and act righteous. But in the end? They gon' get what they earned.

16.text: Let me say it again—don't think I'm a fool. But if you do, at least let me flex a lil' bit.

17.text: I'm talkin' real loose here—not on God's behalf—but since everybody else out here braggin', let me get mine off too.

18.text: Y'all love hearin' folks brag in the flesh, so I'mma speak y'all language for a sec.

19.text: Y'all be dealin' with fools like it's cute—'cause y'all think y'all so wise.

20.text: You let folks control you, take from you, lift themselves up, even disrespect you—and y'all eatin' it up.

21.text: And I'm ashamed to say—I ain't actin' like that. But if we talkin' bold, I'll go there too (even if it sound foolish).

22.text: They say they Hebrew? So am I. They Israelites? Me too. They Abraham's kids? Same here.

23.text: They say they serve Christ? I'mma say it like a fool—I done done more: Worked more, Got beat more, Jailed more, Faced death over and over.

24.text: Five times I got whipped—forty lashes minus one.

25.text: Three times beat with rods. One time stoned. Three times shipwrecked. I spent a whole night and day floating in open water.

26.text: I been through it, y'all: Dangerous trips, Robbers, Haters from my own people, Haters from outsiders, City drama, Wilderness traps, Sea storms, Snakes wearin' church clothes (fake believers).

27.text: Tired, grindin', missin' sleep. Hungry, thirsty. Fasting. Cold. Barely clothed.

28.text: And on top of all that? I'm constantly carryin' the weight of every single church I planted.

29.text: When one of y'all weak—I feel that. When somebody fall—I burn with concern.

30.text: If I gotta brag, I'ma brag about what exposes my weakness.

31.text: God—the Father of Jesus Christ, who's blessed forever—knows I ain't lyin'.

32.text: In Damascus, the governor had guards posted tryna catch me.

33.text: But I got outta there—they let me down in a basket through a window in the wall. That's how I escaped.

1.text: Look—I know braggin' don't help, but lemme go ahead and talk about these visions and revelations from the Lord.

2.text: I know a man in Christ (talkin' about myself here)—this was like 14 years ago—don't know if it was a physical experience or spiritual, but God knows—he got caught up to the third heaven.

3.text: Yeah, I said it again—whether it was in the body or not, I don't know—but God knows.

4.text: This man (still me) got caught up into Paradise—heard stuff so deep, it ain't even lawful for a man to repeat it.

5.text: I'll brag on that experience—but me, personally? I'll only boast about my weaknesses.

6.text: I could flex if I wanted to—it'd be true—but I don't wanna hype myself up beyond what y'all have actually seen or heard from me.

7.text: But to keep me from gettin' big-headed from all these crazy revelations, God gave me a thorn in my flesh—a messenger from Satan sent to bother me and keep me grounded.

8.text: I prayed about it—three times—beggin' God to take it away.

9.text: But He told me: "My grace is enough for you. My strength shows up best when you weak." So now I'm like—I'll gladly boast about my struggles, so Christ's power can show up in my life.

10.text: That's why I take joy in hard times, disrespect, lack, hate, and pressure—if it's for Christ, then when I'm weak, I'm really strong.

11.text: I know—I sound crazy braggin' like this. But y'all made me go here. Y'all shoulda been speakin' up for me instead. I may not be nothin' by the world's standards, but I ain't behind none of them "super-apostles."

12.text: Y'all saw the proof of my apostleship—through miracles, signs, and real perseverance.

13.text: Only thing y'all missed out on was me not takin' anything from you—and if that was wrong, then forgive me, I guess.

14.text: Look, this my third time gettin' ready to come visit—and I still won't be a burden. I ain't after your stuff—I'm after y'all. It ain't the kids' job to save up for the parents—it's the parents for the kids.

15.text: And I'll gladly give everything I got for y'all—even if the more I love you, the less y'all love me back.

16.text: But fine, say what you want—I didn't burden y'all. Still, some folks say I was slick with it and trapped y'all.

17.text: But did I take advantage of you through anyone I sent?

18.text: I told Titus to come, and sent someone with him. Did Titus take advantage of y'all? Didn't we both walk the same way, in the same spirit?

19.text: Y'all think we just out here defending ourselves? Nah—we speak before God, in Christ. And everything we've done? It's for y'all's growth.

20.text: But I'm nervous. I'm scared that when I show up, I won't find y'all in a good place—and y'all won't like how I come either. I'm talkin' about: Arguments, Jealousy, Angry outbursts, Selfishness, Gossip, Shadiness, Pride, Drama.

21.text: I don't wanna come and end up grievin'—mournin' over folks who sinned and never turned from it. I'm talkin' about that uncleanness, sexual sin, and straight-up wild behavior that some still ain't repented from.

1.text: Aight—this the third time I'm comin' to y'all. And just like Scripture says: "Every matter should be confirmed by two or three witnesses."

2.text: I already warned y'all before, and now I'm sayin' it again like I'm there now—if I pull up and folks still wildin'? I ain't holdin' back.

3.text: Y'all been lookin' for proof that Christ really speaks through me? Bet. He ain't weak when it comes to y'all—He strong, and that strength shows up in y'all too.

4.text: Yeah, He got crucified in weakness—but now He lives in the power of God. Same way—we weak in Him, but we gon' live in that same power toward y'all.

5.text: Check yourself. See if you really in the faith. Test yourself. Don't you realize Jesus Christ lives inside you? Unless—you ain't passin' the test.

6.text: But I'm trustin' you gon' see that we passed the test, and we ain't fake.

7.text: I'm prayin' to God that y'all do what's right—not so we look good, but so you can walk with integrity—even if folks think we ain't legit.

8.text: We can't do nothin' against the truth—only for the truth.

9.text: And look—we cool with bein' weak if it means y'all strong. That's our prayer: that y'all grow, mature, and be made whole.

10.text: That's why I'm writin' this now, while I'm gone—so I don't have to come in hot when I arrive. 'Cause the authority God gave me? It's for building y'all up, not tearing y'all down.

11.text: Alright family, for real—take care. Grow into who God called you to be. Encourage each other. Stay united. Live in peace. And the God of love and peace? He gon' be with y'all.

12.text: Greet each other with that holy kiss (y'all know what it is—real love, no shade).

13.text: All the saints send their love to y'all.

14.text: And this is my final prayer for you: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with every one of y'all. Amen.

1.text: From the elder: To the chosen lady and her kids—I love y'all for real, and not just me, but everybody who know the truth loves you too.

2.text: 'Cause that same truth lives in us and gon' stay with us forever.

3.text: Grace, mercy, and peace comin' your way—from God the Father and Jesus Christ, the Son. And it's all wrapped in truth and love. 💌

4.text: I was real glad when I saw some of your kids walkin' in the truth, just like the Father told us to.

5.text: Now sis, I ain't givin' you no new word—but the same one we had from the jump: that we love one another.

6.text: And love? It means walkin' in what He told us to do. This the command y'all heard from the beginning: live it out.

7.text: There's a whole bunch of deceivers out here now—folks who won't admit that Jesus came in the flesh. That's how you know it's Antichrist spirit.

8.text: So watch yourselves—don't lose what we been building. Stay on point, so you get your full reward. 🛡️

9.text: Anybody who steps outside Christ's teaching and don't stay in it? They ain't got God. But if you stay in the doctrine of Christ, you got both the Father and the Son.

10.text: If somebody come around you and they ain't bringin' that true doctrine, don't let 'em in your house and don't even greet 'em.

11.text: 'Cause if you do, you takin' part in their mess. You co-signin' evil. 👎🏾

12.text: I got a whole lot more I wanna say, but I ain't tryna write it out. I'm hopin' to pull up and talk to you face to face—so our joy can be complete. 😁

13.text: Your chosen sister's kids send they love too. Amen.

1.text: This Simon Peter talkin'—servant and apostle of Jesus Christ—writin' to the folks who got the same precious faith as us, made right with God through our Savior Jesus Christ.

2.text: May grace and peace hit your life even harder, the more you get to know God and Jesus, our Lord.

3.text: His divine power already hooked us up with everything we need for life and godliness. And all of it flows through knowin' Him—the One who called us with glory and purpose.

4.text: Through that, He gave us promises so big, so valuable, it's wild. And through those promises, we get to tap into God's nature, and dip out the trap of this world's mess—the lust, the corruption, all that.

5.text: And 'cause of all that, make it your full-time job to build on your faith: Start with virtue, Then add knowledge,

6.text: To knowledge, add self-control, To self-control, add perseverance, To perseverance, add godliness,

7.text: To godliness, add brotherly love, And finally—top it off with real love.

8.text: If all that's in you, and growin'? You won't be spiritually dry or empty when it comes to knowin' Jesus Christ.

9.text: But if you missin' that stuff? You blind. You forgot what Jesus already cleaned you from.

10.text: So fam—lock in. Make sure your calling and election stay solid. If you do all this, you won't fall off.

11.text: And when it's all said and done, you gon' walk straight into God's Kingdom with open doors—Jesus waitin' for you with glory.

12.text: That's why I'ma keep remindin' y'all—even if you already know and standin' in the truth.

13.text: As long as I'm still here in this body, I'ma keep stirrin' y'all up. Gotta keep y'all sharp.

14.text: I know I ain't gon' be here much longer—Jesus already showed me how I was gon' go.

15.text: But best believe, I'm makin' sure y'all remember this stuff even after I'm gone. I ain't leavin' y'all empty.

16.text: We ain't follow no made-up fairy tales when we told y'all about Jesus' power and return. We seen His majesty ourselves.

17.text: He got glory and honor from the Father when that voice came from heaven sayin', "This My Son, My Beloved—He got My full approval."

18.text: We heard that voice too—right from the sky—when we was with Him on that holy mountain.

19.text: So now we got the prophetic word confirmed—and y'all would be smart to pay attention to it. It's like a light shinin' in a dark room, until the day fully breaks and the morning star rises in your heart.

20.text: First thing to know: no prophecy in Scripture comes from somebody's personal interpretation.

21.text: Prophecy ain't never been about what a man wanted to say. It's straight from God—spoken through folks who were moved by the Holy Spirit.

1.text: Just like there was false prophets back in the day, there gon' be false teachers now—slidin' in quiet with dangerous lies. Some even gon' deny the same Lord who bought 'em. And trust, they bringin' destruction on they own heads.

2.text: And plenty folks gon' follow they wild ways. Because of them, people gon' trash-talk the truth.

3.text: Outta greed, they gon' manipulate you with slick talk. But just know—judgment been waitin'. Destruction ain't sleepin'. It's on the way.

4.text: Think about it—God ain't even spare the angels that wilded out. He tossed 'em into darkness, chained up 'til judgment time.

5.text: He ain't spare the world before the flood either—but He did save Noah, a real one, who preached righteousness, while the rest drowned in they wickedness.

6.text: Sodom and Gomorrah? Burned down. Turned to ash as a warning for anybody tryna live foul.

7.text: But He saved Lot, a righteous dude who was fed up with the filth he saw every day.

8.text: That man's soul was tormented daily, livin' in the middle of all that mess.

9.text: So trust—God knows how to rescue the godly from trials, and how to hold the wicked for the day of judgment.

10.text: Especially the ones wildin' out in the flesh, full of lust, and disrespectin' authority. They cocky, arrogant, and ain't even scared to run their mouth about things above their rank.

11.text: Meanwhile, even angels—way more powerful—don't talk reckless like that. They stay in position before the Lord.

12.text: But these fake teachers? Like wild animals, made to get caught and taken out. Talkin' down on what they don't understand—and they gon' get wrecked by the same foolishness they love.

13.text: Their reward? The same as all unrighteous folks—disgrace. They party in the daytime like sin is a flex. They messy at your table, playin' fake while smilin' in your face.

14.text: Eyes full of lust, hearts trained in greed, always lookin' for someone unstable to pull down with them. They cursed.

15.text: They dipped from the right path and followed Balaam—who sold out for a check.

16.text: But even Balaam got called out—by his own donkey! The animal had to speak up to stop the prophet from actin' a fool. Imagine that.

17.text: These folks like dry wells—ain't got nothin' to offer. Storm clouds tossed around with no direction. Darkness is their final stop.

18.text: They talk big, loud, and slick—but it's all hollow. They pull in people who just escaped the mess, temptin' 'em back through lust and wild living.

19.text: They talk about freedom, but they stuck themselves—slaves to sin. Whoever controls you? That's your master.

20.text: And if somebody escaped the world through Jesus, but ends up tangled up in that same mess again? The fall back is worse than the first.

21.text: It would've been better if they never knew the truth, than to know it and turn away like it ain't mean nothin'.

22.text: Just like the saying goes: "A dog goin' back to its own vomit," and "a clean pig runnin' straight back to the mud." Nasty, but true.

1.text: Yo, beloved, I'm writin' this second letter to y'all—reminding you to keep your minds pure—just a reminder, plain and simple.

2.text: So you don't forget them words the holy prophets dropped before, or the commands we apostles of the Lord and Savior passed on to y'all.

3.text: First off, know this: in the last days, there gonna be scoffers—folks followin' their own wild desires,

4.text: Who gonna be like, "Where's the promise of His comin'? Since our forefathers slept, everything's been goin' on just the same ever since creation."

5.text: But they straight up forget—by God's word, the heavens got made long ago, and the earth came up outta the water and was set in the water.

6.text: And that same word wiped out the world that used to be, floodin' it all with water.

7.text: But now, the heavens and the earth that we got? They're kept safe by that same word—but they're reserved for fire, 'til the day God comes to judge and doom all the ungodly.

8.text: But listen up, beloved: don't forget one thing—one day with the Lord is like a thousand years, and a thousand years is like one day.

9.text: The Lord ain't slow with His promise—as some might think—but He's patient with us. He ain't willin' anyone to perish; He wants everybody to come to repentance.

10.text: But mark this—the day of the Lord gon' hit like a thief in the night. The heavens gonna vanish with a mighty sound, and the elements will melt away in scorching heat. Every bit of earth and all its works will burn up.

11.text: So, since all these things are gonna vanish, what kind of people should you be? Walk in holy conduct and godliness,

12.text: Always lookin' and hustlin' for the day of God—when the heavens go up in flames and the elements melt away in heat.

13.text: Yet even with all that fire comin', we, by His promise, are lookin' forward to new heavens and a new earth—where righteousness truly dwells.

14.text: So, beloved, as you wait for all these things, be extra diligent to be found by Him in peace—spotless and blameless.

15.text: And remember: the Lord's patience is salvation. Our brother Paul, with the wisdom He got, wrote this out to you,

16.text: Just like in all his letters. He talks about these things—even if some parts are hard to get—and warns that untaught, unstable folks will twist 'em for their own downfall, just like they twist the rest of the Scriptures.

17.text: So y'all, since you know this ahead of time, be careful not to lose your own steadfastness. Don't get led astray by the errors of the wicked.

18.text: Instead, keep growin' in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

19.text: To Him be all the glory now and forever. Amen.

1.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

2.text: Grace and peace to y'all from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

3.text: We gotta thank God all the time for you, brothers and sisters, 'cause it's the right thing to do. Your faith is growing like crazy, and the love y'all have for each other is overflowing.

4.text: We brag on y'all to the other churches of God for your patience and faith through all the stuff you've been going through—your persecutions and struggles.

5.text: All of this shows that God's judgment is right, and it proves that you're worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you're suffering.

6.text: God's gonna handle business and repay with trouble those who are giving you trouble.

7.text: And for you who are troubled, you'll get rest with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels.

8.text: He's coming in flaming fire, taking vengeance on those who don't know God and on those who don't follow the gospel of our Lord Jesus.

9.text: They gonna be punished with everlasting destruction—separated from God's presence and glory.

10.text: When He comes back, He's gonna be glorified in His saints, and all those who believed in Him will admire Him, 'cause the testimony we gave you was real and y'all believed it.

11.text: That's why we're always praying for y'all, asking God to make you worthy of this calling and to fulfill all the good stuff He's planned for you.

12.text: We want Jesus' name to be glorified in you, and for you to be glorified in Him, all because of the grace of God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1.text: So, brothers and sisters, about the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and us getting gathered together to Him, we're asking you,

2.text: Don't let anyone shake you up or get you all worried—whether by spirit, word, or letter, like it's from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.

3.text: Don't let nobody trick you. That day ain't coming unless there's a falling away first, and the man of sin is revealed—the son of destruction,

4.text: Who opposes everything that's called God, or anything that's worshiped, so much so that he sits in the temple of God, showing himself as God.

5.text: Don't y'all remember when I was with you, I told you all this?

6.text: And now you know what's holding him back, so he can be revealed when it's time.

7.text: The mystery of lawlessness is already in motion, but only He who is holding it back will continue to do so until He's outta the way.

8.text: Then the lawless one will be revealed, and the Lord will take him out with the breath of His mouth and destroy him with the brightness of His coming.

9.text: The coming of this lawless one will be powered by Satan, with all kinds of power, signs, and fake miracles,

10.text: And with all kinds of lies and deception to trick those who are perishing, 'cause they didn't receive the love of the truth that would've saved them.

11.text: So, God's gon' send them a strong delusion, and they'll believe the lie,

12.text: So that everyone who didn't believe the truth but enjoyed doing wrong, will be condemned.

13.text: But we gotta thank God always for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, 'cause God chose you from the beginning to be saved through the Holy Spirit's work and belief in the truth,

14.text: And He called you by our gospel, so you could obtain the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

15.text: So, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold tight to the teachings you received, whether through our preaching or by our letter.

16.text: Now, may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself, and our God and Father, who loved us and gave us everlasting comfort and good hope through grace,

17.text: Comfort your hearts and keep you solid in every good word and work.

1.text: Alright, brothers and sisters, pray for us, that the word of the Lord can spread fast and be glorified, just like it's been with you,

2.text: And that we may be delivered from those unreasonable and wicked people, 'cause not everyone's got faith.

3.text: But the Lord is faithful, and He's gonna set you up and protect you from the evil one.

4.text: We confident in the Lord about you, that you're doing and will keep doing the things we've told you to do.

5.text: Now may the Lord guide your hearts into God's love and into Christ's patience.

6.text: But we're telling you straight up, in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ: Stay away from any brother who's walking disorderly, not following the tradition we showed you.

7.text: You already know how you should follow us—we didn't slack off when we were with you;

8.text: We didn't just take food from people for free—we worked hard, night and day, so we wouldn't be a burden to any of you.

9.text: Not because we didn't have the right to, but we wanted to show y'all how to live and be examples to follow.

10.text: Even when we were with you, we told you: If someone don't work, they don't eat.

11.text: We're hearing that some of y'all aren't working, but instead are out here being busybodies.

12.text: So for those people, we're telling them in Jesus' name: get to work quietly, and eat your own food.

13.text: But as for you, brothers and sisters, don't get tired of doing what's right.

14.text: If someone don't obey what we've written in this letter, mark that person and don't hang with them, so they can be ashamed.

15.text: But don't treat them like an enemy—admonish them like a brother.

16.text: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace all the time, in every way. The Lord be with y'all.

17.text: This greeting is from Paul, written with my own hand, that's my signature in every letter.

18.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with y'all. Amen.

1.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by God's will, according to the promise of life that's in Christ Jesus,

2.text: To Timothy, my beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

3.text: I thank God, whom I serve with a pure conscience, just like my forefathers did, and I keep you in my prayers day and night,

4.text: I really wanna see you, remembering your tears, so that I may be filled with joy,

5.text: When I think about the real faith that's in you, the same faith that was first in your grandma Lois and your mama Eunice, and I'm sure it's in you too.

6.text: So I'm reminding you to stir up the gift of God that's inside you, the one I gave you through the laying on of my hands.

7.text: God didn't give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and a sound mind.

8.text: So don't be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, or of me, His prisoner, but share in the suffering for the gospel with me, according to God's power.

9.text: God saved us and called us with a holy calling, not because of anything we did, but because of His own purpose and grace, which He gave us in Christ Jesus before time even began,

10.text: But now it's been revealed through the appearance of our Savior Jesus Christ, who abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel.

11.text: That's the gospel I was called to preach, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

12.text: And because of this, I'm suffering, but I ain't ashamed, 'cause I know who I've believed in, and I'm convinced He can keep everything I've committed to Him until that Day.

13.text: Hold on to the sound words you've heard from me, in faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

14.text: The good thing that was committed to you, keep it safe by the Holy Spirit who lives in us.

15.text: You know that everyone in Asia has turned away from me, including Phygellus and Hermogenes.

16.text: But may the Lord show mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he refreshed me, and wasn't ashamed of my chains.

17.text: When he came to Rome, he searched for me hard, and found me.

18.text: I pray the Lord shows him mercy on that Day—and you know how much he helped me out in Ephesus.

1.text: So, my son, be strong in the grace that's in Christ Jesus.

2.text: And the stuff you heard from me, with all the witnesses around, pass that on to faithful men who will be able to teach others too.

3.text: You gotta endure hardship like a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

4.text: When you're in a fight, don't get caught up in the world's drama. Stay focused so you can please the one who enlisted you as a soldier.

5.text: And if anyone's in a competition, they don't win unless they follow the rules.

6.text: The hard-working farmer gets the first share of the crop.

7.text: Think about what I'm saying, and I pray the Lord gives you understanding in everything.

8.text: Don't forget—Jesus Christ, from the line of David, was raised from the dead according to the gospel I'm preaching,

9.text: For which I'm suffering trouble like a criminal, even to the point of being in chains, but the word of God ain't chained.

10.text: So, I endure all this for the elect, so they can get the salvation that's in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

11.text: Here's a real saying: If we died with Him, We gon' live with Him.

12.text: If we endure, We gon' reign with Him. But if we deny Him, He gon' deny us.

13.text: If we faithless, He stays faithful; He can't deny Himself.

14.text: Remind them of these things, charge them before the Lord, not to be out here arguing over words that don't do anything but mess up the hearers.

15.text: Do your work so you can present yourself approved to God, a worker who ain't ashamed, rightly handling the word of truth.

16.text: But stay away from pointless chatter, 'cause it only leads to more ungodliness.

17.text: And that kind of mess spreads like cancer. Hymenaeus and Philetus are examples of this,

18.text: They've gotten off track with the truth, saying the resurrection has already happened, and they've messed up some folks' faith.

19.text: But the solid foundation of God stands firm with this seal: "The Lord knows who belong to Him," and, "Let everyone who claims the name of Christ turn from sin."

20.text: In a big house, there's all kinds of vessels—gold and silver, but also wood and clay, some for honor and some for dishonor.

21.text: If anyone cleanses themselves from dishonorable stuff, they'll be a vessel for honor, set apart, useful to the Master, ready for every good work.

22.text: So, run from youthful desires, but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, with those who call on the Lord with a pure heart.

23.text: Avoid all that foolish and ignorant arguing—it just causes drama.

24.text: A servant of the Lord shouldn't be out here fighting but should be gentle to everyone, able to teach, patient,

25.text: In humility, correcting those who are against the truth, hoping God will grant them repentance, so they can come to their senses and escape the devil's trap.

26.text: The devil's been using them for his own will, but God wants to set them free.

1.text: Yo, know this: In the last days, hard times are coming,

2.text: People gon' be loving themselves, loving money, boasting, proud, talking down on others, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,

3.text: Unloving, unforgiving, slanderers, no self-control, brutal, haters of good,

4.text: Traitors, headstrong, cocky, lovers of pleasure instead of lovers of God,

5.text: They'll have a form of godliness, but they'll deny the real power of it. Avoid these people!

6.text: These are the ones who sneak into households and take advantage of weak women, weighed down by their sins, led away by all kinds of lust,

7.text: Always learning, but never able to really know the truth.

8.text: Just like Jannes and Jambres resisted Moses, these folks resist the truth too—corrupt minds, disqualified when it comes to the faith,

9.text: But they won't get far, 'cause their foolishness will be exposed to everyone, just like the other false teachers.

10.text: But you've been following my teachings, my way of life, my purpose, my faith, my patience, love, and perseverance,

11.text: You saw all the persecution and suffering I went through at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra—the troubles I faced, and out of all of it, the Lord delivered me.

12.text: Yes, everyone who wants to live godly in Christ Jesus is gon' face persecution.

13.text: But evil men and fake ones? They gon' keep getting worse—deceiving and being deceived.

14.text: But you gotta keep doing what you've learned and are sure about, knowing who you got it from.

15.text: You've known the Holy Scriptures since you was a kid, and those scriptures make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

16.text: All Scripture is inspired by God, and it's good for teaching, rebuking, correcting, and training in righteousness,

17.text: So that the man of God can be complete, ready for every good work.

1.text: I'm charging you before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who gon' judge the living and the dead when He shows up and His kingdom comes:

2.text: Preach the word! Be ready to speak it whether it's the right season or not. Convince, rebuke, encourage—do it all with patience and teachin'.

3.text: The time's comin' when people ain't gon' wanna hear the real gospel. They gon' want things that fit their own desires, and they gon' get people who just scratch their itching ears.

4.text: They'll turn away from the truth and start listenin' to made-up stories.

5.text: But you? Stay watchful in everything, endure the hard times, do the work of an evangelist, and finish your ministry. Keep pushing, no matter what.

6.text: Look, I'm already bein' poured out like a drink offering, and my time to dip outta here is near.

7.text: I fought the good fight, I finished the race, and I kept the faith.

8.text: Now, there's a crown of righteousness waiting for me, and the Lord, the righteous Judge, gon' give it to me on that day. Not just to me, though, but to everyone who loves His appearing.

9.text: Get to me quick, Timothy,

10.text: 'Cause Demas dipped on me, loved the world more than the mission, and he went to Thessalonica. Crescens went to Galatia, Titus went to Dalmatia.

11.text: Only Luke is still here with me. Bring Mark with you—he's useful for ministry.

12.text: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

13.text: Bring the cloak I left with Carpus in Troas when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

14.text: Watch out for Alexander the coppersmith—he caused me a lot of harm. May the Lord pay him back for what he did.

15.text: And you, beware of him, 'cause he fought against our message hard.

16.text: When I went to defend myself the first time, nobody stood with me—they all bounced. Don't hold it against them, though.

17.text: But the Lord stood by me and gave me strength, so the message could be fully preached through me, and all the Gentiles could hear it. I was delivered from the lion's mouth.

18.text: The Lord will keep delivering me from evil and preserve me for His heavenly kingdom. To Him be all the glory forever and ever. Amen!

19.text: Say what's up to Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

20.text: Erastus stayed in Corinth, but Trophimus, I left in Miletus sick.

21.text: Do everything you can to get here before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the believers send their greetings.

22.text: May the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, and may grace be with you all. Amen.

1.text: From the elder— To my dear brother Gaius, the one I truly love in the truth:

2.text: Beloved, I'm prayin' that everything's goin' well with you—that you prosper in every area and stay healthy, just like your soul's already thriving. ✨

3.text: I was real glad when some folks came through and told me you still solid in the truth—livin' it, not just knowin' it.

4.text: Ain't nothin' make me happier than hearin' that my spiritual kids are walkin' in truth. That's the real flex.

5.text: My beloved, you been faithful in how you treat the fam—and even folks you ain't know like that.

6.text: They already testified to your love in front of the whole church. When you help them out on their journey, representin' God right, you doin' a good thing.

7.text: They out here servin' for the sake of the Name—they ain't takin' help from the outside world.

8.text: So we need to support people like that—'cause when we do, we teamin' up with the truth. 💯

9.text: I tried to write to the church, but Diotrephes—the dude who always wanna be "top dog"—he ain't tryna hear from us.

10.text: So when I come through, I'ma bring it up. He been talkin' reckless about us, spreadin' mess. And not only that—he refuses to welcome the brothers, and blocks others from showin' love too. Even kicks folks out the church for it. 🥴

11.text: Beloved, don't follow evil—follow good. If you do good, you from God. If you do evil, you ain't never seen Him.

12.text: Now Demetrius? Solid dude. Everybody speak well of him—even the truth itself backs him up. We vouch for him too, and you know we ain't gotta lie.

13.text: I got a lot more I could write, but I ain't tryna do it all with pen and ink.

14.text: I'm hopin' to pull up soon so we can talk face to face.

15.text: Peace to you. Our people send love. Show love to the crew—call 'em by name. 🫱🏾‍🫲🏽

1.text: Aight Theophilus, lemme break it down. I already told you 'bout all the things Jesus started doin' and teachin',

2.text: up until the day He got snatched back up to heaven—right after He gave the apostles some marching orders through the Holy Spirit.

3.text: And yo, after He went through all that pain, He pulled back up alive, no doubt. Gave 'em hella proof for forty days straight, talkin' 'bout the Kingdom of God nonstop.

4.text: One day while they was all chillin', Jesus told 'em, "Don't leave Jerusalem yet. Wait on the gift my Father promised—the one I told y'all about.

5.text: John dipped folks in water, but y'all? Y'all gon' get dipped in the Holy Spirit real soon."

6.text: So when they linked back up with Jesus, they asked, "Lord, is it time now? You gon' bring the kingdom back to Israel?"

7.text: He said, "That ain't y'all business. Only the Father know when and how.

8.text: But what you do need to know? Y'all bout to get power when the Holy Spirit come through. Then you gon' be My witnesses—startin' in Jerusalem, then Judea, then Samaria, and then all over the world."

9.text: After He said that, boom—He started floatin' up while they was watchin'. A cloud came through and blocked Him from view.

10.text: They was standin' there, eyes glued to the sky, when two men in fresh white fits popped up beside them.
