45.text: The prophets wrote, 'They gon' all be taught by God.' So whoever listens and learns from the Father comes to Me.

46.text: Nobody's seen the Father except the One who came from God. He the only One that seen Him.

47.text: Real talk—anybody who believes in Me already got eternal life.

48.text: I am the bread of life.

49.text: Y'all ancestors ate manna in the wilderness… and they still died.

50.text: But this bread right here come from heaven—and whoever eats it won't die.

51.text: I'm the livin' bread that came down from heaven. If you eat this bread, you gon' live forever. And the bread I'm givin' is My flesh—for the life of the world."

52.text: The Jews started arguin' with each other like, "How He expect us to eat His flesh?"

53.text: Jesus said, "Listen up—unless y'all eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink His blood, y'all don't have no life in you.

54.text: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood got eternal life. And I'll raise 'em up on the last day.

55.text: 'Cause My flesh is real food, and My blood is real drink.

56.text: If you eat My flesh and drink My blood, you stay in Me, and I stay in you.

57.text: Just like the livin' Father sent Me, and I live 'cause of Him, the one who feeds on Me gon' live 'cause of Me.

58.text: This the bread that came down from heaven. It ain't like the manna y'all ancestors ate—'cause they died. But whoever eats this bread gon' live forever."

59.text: He said all this while teachin' in the synagogue in Capernaum.

60.text: When a lotta His disciples heard this, they said, "This is a hard word. Who can even take this in?"

61.text: Jesus already knew in His spirit that they was grumblin', so He said, "This trippin' y'all up?

62.text: What if y'all saw the Son of Man go back up to where He came from?

63.text: The Spirit is what gives life—the flesh don't do nothin'. The words I'm speakin'? They full of Spirit and life.

64.text: But some of y'all still don't believe." (Jesus already knew from the jump who didn't believe and who was gon' betray Him.)

65.text: And He said, "That's why I told y'all—can't nobody come to Me unless the Father gives 'em the green light."

66.text: From then on, a lotta His disciples dipped and didn't walk with Him no more.

67.text: So Jesus turned to the twelve and said, "Y'all wanna bounce too?"

68.text: Simon Peter said, "Lord, where else we gon' go? You got the words of eternal life.

69.text: We believe You, and we know You the Christ, the Son of the livin' God."

70.text: Jesus said, "Didn't I choose all twelve of y'all? But one of y'all is a devil."

71.text: He was talkin' about Judas Iscariot, Simon's son—'cause he was the one who was gon' betray Him, even though he was one of the twelve.

1.text: After that, Jesus was walkin' around Galilee. He wasn't tryna go to Judea 'cause the Jewish leaders was out to kill Him.

2.text: The Jewish Feast of Tabernacles was comin' up.

3.text: So His brothers said, "Man, leave here and go to Judea so Your disciples can see what You doin'.

4.text: Ain't nobody tryna be famous doin' stuff in secret. If You really bout it, show Yourself to the world."

5.text: Even His own brothers ain't believe in Him.

6.text: Jesus said, "My time ain't come yet, but y'all can move whenever. Your time always on go.

7.text: The world don't hate y'all, but it hates Me 'cause I tell the truth about how wicked it is.

8.text: Y'all go ahead to the feast. I ain't goin' just yet—My time ain't fully here."

9.text: After He told 'em that, He stayed back in Galilee.

10.text: But after His brothers left for the feast, He slid up there too—but on the low, not tryna be seen.

11.text: The Jewish leaders was lookin' for Him at the feast like, "Where He at?"

12.text: The crowd was whisperin' all kinds of stuff. Some said, "He a good man." Others said, "Nah, He foolin' people."

13.text: But nobody was sayin' it loud—'cause they was scared of the leaders.

14.text: Halfway through the feast, Jesus showed up at the temple and started teachin'.

15.text: The Jews was shook like, "How He know so much if He ain't never been to school?"

16.text: Jesus said, "What I'm teachin' ain't from Me—it's from the One who sent Me.

17.text: If you really tryin' to do God's will, you'll know whether My words come from Him or if I'm just talkin' for Me.

18.text: Folks who speak for themselves lookin' for their own shine. But the one who speaks for the One who sent Him? That one's real, and he ain't got no lies in him.

19.text: Ain't Moses give y'all the law? But none of y'all even keep it. So why y'all tryna kill Me?"

20.text: The crowd said, "You got a demon. Who tryna kill You?"

21.text: Jesus said, "I did one miracle, and now y'all actin' brand new.

22.text: Y'all circumcise on the Sabbath—Moses gave y'all that tradition (really came from the ancestors though).

23.text: So if y'all can circumcise on the Sabbath and not trip, why you mad that I healed a whole man on the Sabbath?

24.text: Stop judgin' by how stuff looks. Judge with righteous judgment."

25.text: Some folks from Jerusalem said, "Ain't this the dude they been tryna kill?

26.text: But look—He talkin' bold, and nobody sayin' nothin'. Maybe the leaders know He really the Christ?"

27.text: "But wait—we know where He from. When the Christ shows up, ain't nobody supposed to know His origins."

28.text: Jesus cried out in the temple, sayin', "Y'all know Me? Know where I'm from? I ain't come here on My own—God sent Me. And y'all don't even know Him.

29.text: But I do. I came from Him. He's the One who sent Me."

30.text: They tried to grab Him then, but nobody laid hands on Him—His time hadn't come yet.

31.text: A lotta folks in the crowd believed in Him. They said, "When the Christ comes, is He gon' do more miracles than this man?"

32.text: The Pharisees heard the crowd murmurin' like that, so the chief priests and Pharisees sent officers to arrest Him.

33.text: Jesus said, "I'm only gon' be here a lil while longer, then I'm goin' back to the One who sent Me.

34.text: Y'all gon' look for Me, but you ain't gon' find Me. Where I'm goin', you can't come."

35.text: The Jews was like, "Where He talkin' bout goin'? To the scattered Jews in other countries? He gon' teach the Greeks?"

36.text: "What He mean, 'You gon' look for Me and not find Me,' and 'Where I'm at, you can't come'?"

37.text: On the last and biggest day of the feast, Jesus stood up and yelled, "If anybody thirsty, come to Me and drink.

38.text: If you believe in Me, just like the Scriptures say, rivers of livin' water gon' flow outta your heart."

39.text: He was talkin' about the Spirit, which folks who believed in Him would receive. The Holy Spirit hadn't come yet 'cause Jesus hadn't been glorified yet.

40.text: Some folks in the crowd said, "For real, this Man is the Prophet."

41.text: Others said, "This is the Christ!" But some were like, "Hold up—Christ ain't supposed to come from Galilee.

42.text: Don't the Scriptures say He's supposed to come from David's family? From Bethlehem, where David was born?"

43.text: So folks was divided 'cause of Him.

44.text: Some wanted to arrest Him, but nobody laid a hand on Him.

45.text: The officers went back to the chief priests and Pharisees, and they said, "Why ain't y'all bring Him?"

46.text: They said, "Man, nobody ever talked like Him before."

47.text: The Pharisees said, "Y'all fooled too?

48.text: Ain't none of the rulers or Pharisees believed in Him.

49.text: This crowd don't even know the law—they cursed."

50.text: Nicodemus (the one who came to Jesus at night, and was one of them) spoke up:

51.text: "Our law don't judge a man without hearin' him out and findin' out what he did—right?"

52.text: They said, "You from Galilee too? Search the Scriptures—ain't no prophet ever came from Galilee."

53.text: Then everybody went back to they own house.

1.text: Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

2.text: Early the next morning, He came back to the temple. All the people showed up, and He sat down to teach.

3.text: The scribes and Pharisees brought a woman who had got caught in adultery. They made her stand right there in front of everybody.

4.text: They said, "Teacher, this woman got caught in the act—in the act—of adultery.

5.text: Moses' law say we supposed to stone women like this. What You say?"

6.text: They was tryna trap Him—lookin' for somethin' to use against Him. But Jesus bent down and started writin' in the dirt like He didn't even hear 'em.

7.text: They kept pressin' Him, so He stood up and said, "Whoever ain't never sinned—go ahead, throw the first stone."

8.text: Then He bent back down and kept writin' on the ground.

9.text: One by one, they walked away—startin' with the older folks—'cause their conscience started checkin' 'em. Soon it was just Jesus and the woman standin' there.

10.text: Jesus stood up and asked her, "Where they at? Ain't nobody stick around to condemn you?"

11.text: She said, "No one, Lord." Jesus said, "Well I don't condemn you either. Go on now—and don't sin no more."

12.text: Then Jesus spoke again: "I'm the light of the world. If you follow Me, you won't walk in darkness—you'll have the light that gives life."

13.text: The Pharisees said, "You talkin' about Yourself—so Your testimony ain't valid."

14.text: Jesus said, "Even if I am speakin' on My own, it's still true—'cause I know where I came from and where I'm goin'. Y'all don't know either."

15.text: "Y'all judge by outward appearances. I don't judge anybody.

16.text: But even if I did, My judgment would still be right—'cause I ain't judging alone. The Father who sent Me is with Me."

17.text: "Y'all law says two witnesses make it valid.

18.text: Well, I testify about Myself—and My Father who sent Me does too."

19.text: They asked, "Where your Father at?" Jesus said, "Y'all don't know Me or My Father. If you knew Me, you'd know Him too."

20.text: Jesus said all this while teachin' in the treasury area of the temple. But nobody laid hands on Him, 'cause His time hadn't come yet.

21.text: Then Jesus said, "I'm goin' away. Y'all gon' look for Me, but you gon' die in your sins. Where I'm goin', y'all can't come."

22.text: The Jews said, "What He mean—He gon' kill Himself? Talkin' bout, 'Y'all can't come where I'm goin'?"

23.text: Jesus said, "Y'all from below. I'm from above. Y'all belong to this world—I don't.

24.text: That's why I said you gon' die in your sins. If you don't believe I am who I say I am, you will die in your sins."

25.text: They said, "Who are You?" Jesus said, "I been tellin' y'all from the jump.

26.text: I got a lot to say about y'all, and I could judge you right now. But the One who sent Me is real, and I only speak what I heard from Him."

27.text: But they still ain't realize He was talkin' about the Father.

28.text: So Jesus said, "When y'all lift up the Son of Man, then you gon' know I am who I say I am. I don't do nothin' on My own—I speak what the Father taught Me.

29.text: And the One who sent Me is with Me. He ain't left Me out here by Myself—'cause I always do what pleases Him."

30.text: While He was sayin' all that, many people started believin' in Him.

31.text: Jesus said to the Jews who believed Him, "If y'all stick with My word, you really My disciples.

32.text: And you'll know the truth—and the truth gon' set you free."

33.text: They said, "We Abraham's kids. We ain't never been slaves. How you gon' say we'll be made free?"

34.text: Jesus said, "Truth is—whoever sins is a slave to sin.

35.text: And slaves don't stay in the house forever, but the Son do.

36.text: So if the Son sets you free—you really free."

37.text: "I know y'all Abraham's descendants—but you tryna kill Me 'cause My word ain't got no place in you.

38.text: I'm speakin' on what I seen with My Father. But y'all do what you seen with your father."

39.text: They said, "Abraham is our father." Jesus said, "If y'all was really Abraham's kids, you'd act like him.

40.text: But instead you tryin' to kill Me—a man who told you the truth from God. Abraham didn't act like that.

41.text: Y'all doin' what your real father does." They said, "We ain't illegitimate. We got one Father—God."

42.text: Jesus said, "If God was really your Father, you'd love Me—'cause I came from Him. I didn't come on My own—He sent Me.

43.text: Why y'all don't get what I'm sayin'? 'Cause you don't wanna hear it.

44.text: You from your father—the devil. And you wanna do what he does. He been a murderer from the start. He don't stand in truth 'cause there ain't no truth in him. When he lies, he speakin' his native language—he the father of lies.

45.text: But since I'm tellin' the truth, y'all don't believe Me.

46.text: Which one of y'all can prove I sinned? So if I'm speakin' the truth, why won't y'all believe Me?

47.text: The ones who belong to God listen to God's words. That's why y'all don't hear Me—'cause you ain't from God."

48.text: Then the Jews said, "See? We told y'all He a Samaritan with a demon!"

49.text: Jesus said, "I ain't got no demon. I honor My Father—and y'all dishonorin' Me.

50.text: I ain't out here chasin' fame. There's One who handles that—and He judges.

51.text: I'm tellin' y'all the truth—anybody who keeps My word will never see death."

52.text: They said, "Now we know You got a demon! Abraham and the prophets died—but You say whoever follows You won't die?

53.text: You think You greater than Abraham who's dead? And the prophets? Who do You think You are?"

54.text: Jesus said, "If I hype Myself up, it don't mean nothin'. My Father—the One y'all call your God—He the One who gives Me glory.

55.text: But y'all don't even know Him. I know Him. And if I said I didn't, I'd be lyin' like y'all. But I do know Him, and I follow His word.

56.text: Your father Abraham was hyped to see My day. He saw it and got glad."

57.text: They said, "You ain't even fifty years old. How you seen Abraham?"

58.text: Jesus said, "Let Me be real with you—before Abraham was ever born… I AM."

59.text: Then they picked up stones to throw at Him—but Jesus dipped out the temple, slid through the crowd, and bounced.

1.text: As Jesus was passin' by, He saw a man who'd been blind since birth.

2.text: His disciples asked, "Rabbi, who messed up? This man or his parents, that he was born blind?"

3.text: Jesus said, "Ain't nobody sinned—it happened so God's power could be seen through him."

4.text: "We gotta do what the One who sent Me called us to do while it's still daytime. Night's comin' when nobody can work.

5.text: As long as I'm here in the world, I am the light of the world."

6.text: After sayin' that, Jesus spit on the ground, made some mud with it, and rubbed it on the man's eyes.

7.text: Then He told him, "Go wash in the pool of Siloam" (which means "Sent"). The man went, washed up, and came back able to see.

8.text: His neighbors and the folks who used to see him beggin' said, "Hold up—isn't that the same dude who used to sit and beg?"

9.text: Some said, "That's him!" Others said, "Nah, he just look like him." But he said, "It's me. I'm him."

10.text: So they asked, "Then how your eyes get opened?"

11.text: He said, "This dude named Jesus made some clay, rubbed it on my eyes, told me to go to Siloam and wash. I did—and now I can see."

12.text: They said, "Where He at?" He said, "I don't know."

13.text: They took the man who used to be blind to the Pharisees.

14.text: Now, Jesus did this on a Sabbath—yep, the day of rest.

15.text: So the Pharisees asked him again how it happened. He said, "He put clay on my eyes, I washed, and now I see."

16.text: Some of the Pharisees said, "He can't be from God—He breakin' Sabbath rules." But others said, "How can a sinner do miracles like this?" So now they was split.

17.text: They turned back to the man and said, "Well, what you think about Him since He opened your eyes?" He said, "He a prophet."

18.text: But the Jewish leaders ain't believe he had really been blind until they called his parents in.

19.text: They asked them, "Is this your son? The one y'all say was born blind? How he seein' now?"

20.text: His parents said, "Yeah, that's our son, and he was born blind.

21.text: But how he's seein' now—or who made it happen—we don't know. He grown. Ask him."

22.text: They said all that 'cause they was scared. The Jewish leaders had already decided anybody who said Jesus was the Christ was gon' get kicked out the synagogue.

23.text: That's why they said, "He grown—ask him."

24.text: So they went back to the man and said, "Tell the truth and give God the glory. We know that man Jesus is a sinner."

25.text: He said, "Look, I don't know if He a sinner or not. What I do know is: I was blind, and now I see."

26.text: They said, "What did He do to you? How exactly did He open your eyes?"

27.text: He said, "I already told y'all, and you ain't listen. Why you wanna hear it again? Y'all tryna become His disciples too?"

28.text: Then they started talkin' slick and said, "You His disciple—we follow Moses.

29.text: We know God talked to Moses. But this dude? We don't even know where He came from."

30.text: The man said, "That's wild. Y'all don't know where He from, but He opened my eyes.

31.text: We all know God don't hear from folks livin' in sin—but He does hear folks who worship Him and follow His will.

32.text: Ain't nobody in history ever opened the eyes of somebody born blind.

33.text: If He wasn't from God, He couldn't do nothin'."

34.text: They said, "You was born in sin from the jump, and you tryna school us?" Then they threw him out.

35.text: Jesus heard they had kicked him out. When He found him, He asked, "Do you believe in the Son of God?"

36.text: The man said, "Who is He, Lord? I'll believe if You tell me."

37.text: Jesus said, "You lookin' at Him—and He the one talkin' to you."

38.text: The man said, "Lord, I believe!" And he started worshipin' Him.

39.text: Then Jesus said, "I came into this world to bring judgment—so the blind can see, and the ones who think they see get exposed as blind."

40.text: Some Pharisees nearby heard that and said, "Wait—You sayin' we blind too?"

41.text: Jesus said, "If y'all was really blind, you wouldn't be guilty. But since you claim you can see—your guilt still stand."

1.text: "For real, for real—I'm tellin' y'all: anybody who don't come in through the sheep gate, but try to climb in some other way? That person a thief and a robber.

2.text: But the one who enters through the gate? That's the real shepherd.

3.text: The gatekeeper opens the door for him, and the sheep know his voice. He calls 'em by name and leads 'em out.

4.text: After he brings 'em out, he walks in front of 'em, and they follow—'cause they know his voice.

5.text: They won't follow a stranger though. Nah, they'll run the other way 'cause they don't recognize that voice."

6.text: Jesus used this lil parable, but they ain't understand what He was tryna say.

7.text: So Jesus broke it down again: "For real, for real—I'm the gate for the sheep.

8.text: All the folks that came before Me? Thieves and robbers. But My sheep ain't listen to 'em.

9.text: I'm the gate. Anybody who enters through Me gets saved. They'll come in, go out, and find green pastures.

10.text: The thief only come to steal, kill, and destroy. But I came so they can have life—real life, full and abundant.

11.text: I'm the Good Shepherd. And the Good Shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.

12.text: But the hired hand? He ain't the shepherd, and the sheep ain't his. So when he sees a wolf comin', he dip out and leaves the sheep. Then the wolf snatches 'em and scatters 'em.

13.text: The hired hand runs 'cause he only in it for the check. He don't really care about the sheep.

14.text: I'm the Good Shepherd. I know My sheep—and My sheep know Me,

15.text: Just like the Father knows Me and I know Him. And I lay down My life for My sheep.

16.text: I got other sheep that ain't from this pen. I gotta bring them too. They gon' hear My voice, and we gon' be one flock under one Shepherd.

17.text: That's why My Father loves Me—'cause I lay My life down so I can take it back again.

18.text: Nobody takin' it from Me—I lay it down on My own. I got the power to lay it down, and I got the power to pick it back up. That's the assignment I got from My Father."

19.text: When He said all that, the Jews started arguin' again.

20.text: Some said, "He got a demon—He crazy! Why y'all listenin' to Him?"

21.text: Others said, "This ain't how somebody with a demon talks. Can a demon make blind folks see?"

22.text: It was the Festival of Dedication in Jerusalem, and it was winter.

23.text: Jesus was walkin' through the temple, over in Solomon's porch.

24.text: The Jews crowded around Him and said, "How long You gon' keep us guessin'? If You the Christ, just say it straight."

25.text: Jesus said, "I already told y'all, and you ain't believe Me. The works I do in My Father's name—they speak for Me.

26.text: But y'all don't believe 'cause you ain't My sheep.

27.text: My sheep know My voice. I know 'em, and they follow Me.

28.text: I give 'em eternal life—they ain't never gon' perish. Nobody can snatch 'em out My hand.

29.text: My Father gave 'em to Me, and He's greater than everybody. Can't nobody snatch 'em out His hand either.

30.text: Me and the Father—we one."

31.text: The Jews picked up stones again tryna stone Him.

32.text: Jesus said, "I done showed y'all plenty of good works from My Father. Which one of 'em you stonin' Me for?"

33.text: They said, "It ain't 'cause of the good works—we stonin' You for blasphemy. You just a man, but You makin' Yourself God!"

34.text: Jesus said, "Y'all ever read in your law, 'I said y'all are gods'?

35.text: If Scripture called them gods—the ones who got God's word (and Scripture can't be broken)—

36.text: Then how y'all gon' say I'm blaspheming when the Father set Me apart and sent Me here, just 'cause I said I'm the Son of God?

37.text: If I ain't doin' My Father's works, then don't believe Me.

38.text: But if I am, even if y'all don't believe Me—at least believe the works, so y'all can know and understand the Father's in Me, and I'm in Him."

39.text: They tried to arrest Him again, but He slipped out they hands.

40.text: Jesus dipped back across the Jordan to the spot where John had first been baptizin'. He stayed out there.

41.text: A bunch of folks came out to Him and said, "John didn't do no miracles, but everything he said about this Man? It was true."

42.text: And a whole lotta them believed in Him out there.

1.text: There was a man named Lazarus who was real sick. He lived in Bethany, the same town Mary and her sister Martha was from.

2.text: This the same Mary who poured perfume on the Lord and wiped His feet with her hair—her brother Lazarus was the one sick.

3.text: So the sisters sent word to Jesus sayin', "Lord, the one You love is real sick."

4.text: When Jesus heard that, He said, "This sickness ain't gon' end in death—it's gon' show off God's glory and let the Son of God shine through it."

5.text: Jesus loved Martha, her sister, and Lazarus.

6.text: But even after He heard Lazarus was sick, He stayed right where He was for two more days.

7.text: After that, He told the disciples, "Alright, let's head back to Judea."

8.text: The disciples said, "Jesus, last time You was there they tried to stone You—and You tryna go back?"

9.text: Jesus said, "Ain't there twelve hours in the day? If you walk in the daytime, you ain't gon' stumble, 'cause you got light.

10.text: But if you walk at night, you gon' trip up, 'cause you can't see where you goin'."

11.text: Then He told 'em, "Our boy Lazarus sleepin', and I'm goin' to wake him up."

12.text: The disciples said, "Lord, if he sleepin', he'll get better."

13.text: But Jesus was talkin' about death—and they thought He meant like, nap nap.

14.text: So Jesus told 'em straight up, "Lazarus is dead.

15.text: And I'm glad I wasn't there—for y'all's sake—so y'all can really believe. Let's go see him."

16.text: Then Thomas (aka the Twin) said to the others, "Welp, let's go too—might as well die with Him."

17.text: When Jesus pulled up, He found out Lazarus had already been in the grave four whole days.

18.text: Bethany was just a couple miles from Jerusalem,

19.text: And a bunch of Jews had come through to comfort Martha and Mary 'bout their brother.

20.text: Soon as Martha heard Jesus was comin', she ran out to meet Him. Mary stayed in the house.

21.text: Martha said, "Lord, if You had been here, my brother wouldn't've died.

22.text: But even now, I know whatever You ask God, He gon' do it."

23.text: Jesus told her, "Your brother gon' rise again."

24.text: Martha said, "Yeah, I know he gon' rise at the resurrection, on the last day."

25.text: Jesus said, "I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me, even if they die, they still gon' live.

26.text: And anybody who lives and believes in Me—ain't never really gon' die. You believe that?"

27.text: She said, "Yes, Lord—I believe You the Christ, the Son of God, the One we been waitin' on."

28.text: After she said that, she went and told Mary privately, "The Teacher here—He askin' for you."

29.text: Mary got up quick and went to Him.

30.text: Jesus hadn't made it to the house yet—He was still where Martha met Him.

31.text: The folks in the house saw Mary dip out fast, so they followed her, thinkin' she was headin' to the tomb to cry there.

32.text: When Mary saw Jesus, she dropped to His feet and said, "Lord, if You had been here, my brother wouldn't've died."

33.text: When Jesus saw her cryin', and all the folks cryin' too, He got mad in His spirit and was deeply bothered.

34.text: He asked, "Where y'all put him?" They said, "Lord, come see."

35.text: Jesus wept.

36.text: Then the people said, "Dang, He really loved him."

37.text: But some of them said, "Hold up—ain't this the same Man that opened blind eyes? Couldn't He have kept Lazarus from dyin'?"

38.text: Jesus, still lowkey mad, came to the tomb—it was a cave with a big ol' stone over the entrance.

39.text: Jesus said, "Roll the stone away." Martha said, "Lord, he been in there four days—he prolly stank by now."

40.text: Jesus said, "Didn't I tell you? If you believe, you gon' see God's glory."

41.text: So they moved the stone. Jesus looked up and said, "Father, thank You for hearin' Me.

42.text: I know You always hear Me, but I'm sayin' this out loud for all these folks standin' here—so they'll believe You sent Me."

43.text: Then He shouted, "Lazarus! Come on out!"

44.text: And Lazarus came walkin' out, still wrapped up in grave clothes and a cloth over his face. Jesus said, "Unwrap him. Let that man go."

45.text: A lot of the Jews who saw what Jesus did started believin' in Him.

46.text: But some of 'em ran back to the Pharisees and told on Him.

47.text: So the chief priests and Pharisees had a meeting. They said, "What we gon' do? This Man out here doin' all kinds of miracles.

48.text: If we let Him keep goin', everybody gon' believe in Him—and then Rome gon' come shut all this down and take everything."

49.text: Caiaphas, the high priest that year, said, "Y'all don't know what y'all talkin' 'bout.

50.text: Ain't it better for one man to die for the people, than for the whole nation to get wiped out?"

51.text: He ain't even realize he was prophesyin'—since he was high priest, he was speakin' what God had already planned: that Jesus would die for the nation.

52.text: And not just for them, but for all God's scattered children—to bring 'em together under one.

53.text: From that day on, they was seriously tryna kill Him.

54.text: So Jesus stopped movin' around publicly. He dipped out near the wilderness to a town called Ephraim and stayed there with the disciples.

55.text: The Passover was comin' up, and a lotta folks went to Jerusalem early to get themselves spiritually ready.

56.text: They kept lookin' for Jesus, whisperin' in the temple, "You think He gon' show up to the feast?"

57.text: The chief priests and Pharisees had already put out the word: "If anybody sees Him, let us know—so we can arrest Him."

1.text: Six days before Passover, Jesus pulled up in Bethany—that's where Lazarus stayed, the one Jesus brought back from the dead.

2.text: They threw a dinner for Him there. Martha was servin', and Lazarus was chillin' at the table with Jesus.

3.text: Then Mary came through with some expensive spikenard oil—like, real pricey. She anointed Jesus' feet and wiped 'em with her hair. Whole house was smellin' like that oil.

4.text: But Judas Iscariot—yeah, that one, the one who was gon' betray Him—said,

5.text: "Why didn't she sell that oil for like 300 denarii and give it to the poor?"

6.text: He ain't say that 'cause he cared 'bout the poor. Nah—he was a thief. He kept the money bag and used to help himself to it.

7.text: Jesus said, "Leave her alone. She savin' this moment for My burial.

8.text: Y'all always gon' have the poor with you, but y'all not always gon' have Me."

9.text: A bunch of Jews heard Jesus was in town, and they came through—not just for Him, but to see Lazarus too, the man He raised.

10.text: The chief priests started plottin' on Lazarus now too.

11.text: 'Cause of him, a whole lotta folks had started believin' in Jesus.

12.text: Next day, the crowd that came for the feast heard Jesus was on His way to Jerusalem.

13.text: They grabbed palm branches and ran out to meet Him, shoutin': "Hosanna! Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord—the King of Israel!"

14.text: Jesus found a young donkey and sat on it, just like the Scriptures said:

15.text: "Don't trip, daughter of Zion. Your King comin'—riding on a young donkey."

16.text: His disciples ain't catch the meaning of all this at first. But after Jesus got glorified, they looked back and was like, "Ohhh that's what that was about!"

17.text: The folks who were there when Jesus raised Lazarus from the grave—they was tellin' everybody what they saw.

18.text: That's why the crowd came out—they heard about that miracle.

19.text: The Pharisees was heated. They said, "Look, we ain't gettin' nowhere. The whole world chasin' after Him now."

20.text: Some Greeks came to worship during the feast.

21.text: They found Philip (he from Bethsaida) and said, "Sir, we tryna see Jesus."

22.text: Philip told Andrew, and together they went and told Jesus.

23.text: Jesus said, "It's time. The Son of Man 'bout to be glorified.

24.text: Listen up—unless a grain of wheat falls in the dirt and dies, it stays solo. But if it dies? It multiplies.

25.text: If you too in love with your life, you gon' lose it. But if you willing to let it go for Me, you gon' gain eternal life.

26.text: If you serve Me, follow Me. Wherever I'm at, that's where My servant should be. And if you serve Me, My Father gon' honor you."

27.text: "Man… My soul is feelin' real heavy. But what I'ma say? 'Father, save Me from this?' Nah—this the whole reason I came.

28.text: Father, glorify Your name." Then a voice came from heaven: "I done glorified it, and I'ma glorify it again."

29.text: The crowd that heard it was like, "Did it just thunder?" Others said, "Nah, that was an angel talkin' to Him."

30.text: Jesus said, "That voice wasn't for Me—it was for y'all.

31.text: The time done come for the world to get judged. The devil—yeah, the ruler of this world—'bout to get kicked out.

32.text: And when I get lifted up from the earth, I'm drawin' everybody to Myself."

33.text: (He said this to let them know how He was gon' die.)

34.text: The people said, "Hold up—we thought the Messiah supposed to live forever. What you mean 'lifted up'? Who is this Son of Man?"

35.text: Jesus said, "Y'all got the light just a little while longer. Walk in the light now, before darkness catch you slippin'. If you walk in the dark, you don't know where you goin'.

36.text: While you got the light, believe in the light, so y'all can become children of light." After He said that, Jesus dipped off and hid from them.

37.text: Even with all the miracles Jesus did, they still didn't believe.

38.text: Just like Isaiah said: "Lord, who believed our message? Who saw the Lord's power revealed?"

39.text: And they couldn't believe—'cause Isaiah also said:

40.text: "He blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, So they wouldn't see, Wouldn't understand, Wouldn't turn to Me, And get healed."

41.text: Isaiah said that 'cause he saw Jesus' glory and spoke 'bout Him.

42.text: Even some of the leaders believed—but they kept it low. They ain't confess it, 'cause they ain't wanna get kicked out the synagogue.

43.text: They cared more 'bout what folks thought than what God thought.

44.text: Jesus cried out, "If you believe in Me, you really believe in the One who sent Me.

45.text: When you look at Me, you see the One who sent Me.

46.text: I came into the world as light, so whoever believes in Me don't gotta stay in the dark.

47.text: If somebody hears Me and don't believe, I ain't here to judge 'em—I came to save the world.

48.text: But if you reject Me and don't take in My words, the word itself gon' judge you on the last day.

49.text: I ain't speakin' on My own—I'm sayin' what the Father told Me to say.

50.text: And I know His command leads to eternal life. So whatever I say—it's exactly what He told Me to say."

1.text: Right before Passover, Jesus knew His time was almost up. He was 'bout to leave this world and go back to the Father. He had mad love for His people, and He ain't stop lovin' them—not even at the end.

2.text: They had just finished eatin'. The devil had already dropped that idea into Judas' heart—to betray Jesus.

3.text: Jesus knew the Father put everything in His hands. He knew He came from God and was goin' back to God.

4.text: So He got up from dinner, took off His outer clothes, grabbed a towel, and wrapped it around Himself.

5.text: Then He poured water in a bowl and started washin' His disciples' feet—wipin' 'em with the towel He was wearin'.

6.text: He got to Simon Peter. Peter said, "Lord, You really finna wash my feet?"

7.text: Jesus said, "You don't get it now, but you will later."

8.text: Peter said, "Nah, You ain't never washin' my feet." Jesus said, "If I don't wash you, then you not rockin' with Me. No part of this."

9.text: Peter was like, "Well in that case, Lord, go 'head and wash my hands and head too!"

10.text: Jesus told him, "If you already had a bath, you just need your feet done. You already clean—but not all of y'all."

11.text: He knew who was gon' betray Him. That's why He said, "Not all y'all clean."

12.text: After He washed their feet, He got dressed again and sat down. He said, "Y'all know what I just did for y'all?"

13.text: "You call Me 'Teacher' and 'Lord,' and you right—I am that.

14.text: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, washed your feet, y'all should wash each other's feet too.

15.text: I gave y'all a whole example—do like I did.

16.text: Listen close: ain't no servant greater than the one who sent 'em. Ain't no messenger above the one who sent the message.

17.text: If you know this, you blessed if you do it."

18.text: "Now look—I ain't talkin' 'bout everybody. I know who I chose. But Scripture gotta play out: 'The one who ate bread with Me done turned on Me.'

19.text: I'm tellin' y'all now before it happen, so when it does, y'all know I am who I said I am.

20.text: Truth is, whoever welcomes the one I send, welcomes Me. And if you welcome Me, you welcoming the One who sent Me."

21.text: After that, Jesus got real heavy in His spirit. He said, "I'm tellin' y'all the truth—one of y'all 'bout to betray Me."

22.text: The disciples started lookin' at each other, confused, tryin' to figure out who He talkin' 'bout.

23.text: One of the disciples—Jesus really loved him—was leanin' on Jesus' chest.

24.text: Simon Peter motioned to him, like, "Ask Him who He talkin' 'bout."

25.text: So that disciple leaned in and said, "Lord, who is it?"

26.text: Jesus said, "The one I'm gon' give this dipped piece of bread to." Then He dipped the bread and handed it to Judas Iscariot.

27.text: Soon as Judas took the bread, Satan entered him. Jesus said, "What you 'bout to do, go do it quick."

28.text: Nobody else at the table had a clue what Jesus meant by that.

29.text: Some thought, since Judas kept the money bag, Jesus was tellin' him to go buy stuff for the feast or give to the poor.

30.text: Soon as Judas took the bread, he bounced. And it was night.

31.text: After Judas left, Jesus said, "Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God gettin' His glory through Him.

32.text: If God's gettin' glory through Him, then God gon' glorify Him too—and He ain't waitin' to do it."

33.text: "Lil' children, I'ma be with y'all just a lil' longer. You gon' look for Me, but like I told the Jews, 'Where I'm goin', you can't come.' Same goes for y'all right now.

34.text: I'm givin' y'all a new commandment—love each other. Just like I loved y'all, that's how you should love one another.

35.text: That's how everybody gon' know you My people—if you got love for each other."

36.text: Simon Peter asked, "Lord, where You goin'?" Jesus said, "Where I'm headed, you can't come now—but you'll follow later."

37.text: Peter said, "Why not now, Lord? I'll die for You!"

38.text: Jesus said, "Oh you would? For real? I'm tellin' you straight up—the rooster ain't even gon' crow before you deny Me three times."

1.text: Don't let your heart be heavy. You believe in God? Cool. Believe in Me too.

2.text: In My Father's house, there's plenty rooms—more than enough for everybody. If it wasn't like that, I woulda told y'all. I'm goin' ahead to get the spot ready for you.

3.text: And if I go get things set up, best believe I'ma come back and scoop y'all up, so we can be together.

4.text: Y'all already know where I'm headed—and you know the way there too.

5.text: Thomas said, "Lord, we don't even know where You goin'. How we supposed to know the way?"

6.text: Jesus said, "I am the way, the truth, and the life. Ain't nobody gettin' to the Father unless they come through Me."

7.text: "If y'all really knew Me, you'd know My Father too. From now on, y'all know Him—and you done seen Him."

8.text: Philip said, "Lord, just show us the Father. That'll be enough."

9.text: Jesus said, "Forreal, Philip? I been here with y'all all this time, and you still don't know Me? If you seen Me, you seen the Father. So why you askin' Me to show Him to you?"

10.text: "Don't you believe I'm in the Father, and the Father in Me? The words I speak ain't just from Me—they from the Father, doin' His thing through Me."

11.text: "Believe Me when I say I'm in the Father and He in Me. Or at least believe 'cause of the works you seen."

12.text: "I'm tellin' y'all the truth: whoever believes in Me will do the stuff I been doin'—and even greater—'cause I'm goin' to the Father."

13.text: "And whatever you ask in My name, I'ma do it, so the Father can get the glory through the Son."

14.text: "If y'all ask anything in My name, I'ma handle it."

15.text: "If you love Me, show it by doin' what I say."

16.text: "And I'ma ask the Father to send y'all another Helper, somebody who gon' stick with you forever."

17.text: "That's the Spirit of truth. The world can't receive Him—they can't see Him or recognize Him. But you know Him, 'cause He stay with y'all, and soon He'll be in you."

18.text: "I'm not leavin' y'all hangin'. I'ma come back for you."

19.text: "In a minute, the world won't see Me no more. But y'all gon' see Me. Because I'm alive, y'all gon' live too."

20.text: "That day, y'all gon' realize—I'm in the Father, y'all in Me, and I'm in y'all."

21.text: "The one who knows My commands and lives by 'em? That's the one who really love Me. And My Father gon' love them, and I'ma love them too—and show up in their life, clear as day."

22.text: Judas (not Iscariot) asked, "Lord, how You gon' show up to us, but not to the world?"

23.text: Jesus said, "If anybody love Me, they gon' keep My word. And My Father gon' love 'em too. We gon' pull up and make ourselves at home in their heart."

24.text: "But the one who don't love Me? They ain't tryna hear My words. And what I'm sayin' ain't just from Me—it's from the Father who sent Me."

25.text: "I been tellin' y'all all this while I'm still here with you."

26.text: "But the Helper—the Holy Spirit—the Father gon' send Him in My name. He gon' teach you everything and help you remember all I done told y'all."

27.text: "I'm leavin' you peace. My peace—not like the world give. Don't let your heart be troubled or scared."

28.text: "Y'all heard Me say, 'I'm leavin' but I'ma come back.' If you really loved Me, you'd be happy for Me, 'cause I'm goin' to the Father—and He greater than Me."

29.text: "I'm tellin' y'all now, before it happen, so when it does, y'all'll believe."

30.text: "I ain't got much more time to talk. The enemy—the ruler of this world—is comin'. But he ain't got nothin' on Me."

31.text: "I'ma do what the Father told Me, so the world knows I love Him. Now come on—let's go."

1.text: "I'm the real vine, and My Father the one takin' care of the garden."

2.text: "Every branch on Me that ain't producin' nothin'? He snip it off. And the ones that do bear fruit? He still trimmin' 'em—so they can grow even more."

3.text: "Y'all already clean 'cause of the word I done spoke over you."

4.text: "Stay connected to Me, and I'ma stay connected to you. A branch can't do nothin' on its own—it gotta stay on the vine. Same with y'all—you can't bear no fruit unless you stay in Me."

5.text: "I'm the vine, y'all the branches. If you stay in Me, and I'm in you, you gon' bear mad fruit. But without Me? You can't do nothin'."

6.text: "Anybody who don't stay in Me is like a dry branch—cut off, tossed out, and burned up."

7.text: "But if you stay rooted in Me, and My words stay in you, go 'head and ask for what you want—it'll be done."

8.text: "When you bear a lotta fruit, that's when My Father get the glory—and that's how folks know y'all My disciples."

9.text: "Just like the Father love Me, I love y'all too. Stay right there in My love."

10.text: "Keep My commandments, and you'll stay in My love—just like I kept My Father's and stayed in His."

11.text: "I told y'all all this so My joy can be in you—and so your joy can be full to the brim."

12.text: "Here's My command: love each other the way I loved y'all."

13.text: "Ain't no love bigger than this—somebody layin' down they life for they friends."

14.text: "Y'all My friends if you do what I say."

15.text: "I don't call y'all servants no more. A servant don't know what the boss doin'. But I call y'all friends, 'cause I told y'all everything My Father told Me."

16.text: "Y'all ain't choose Me—I chose you. I picked y'all and set you up to go out here and bear fruit. Fruit that lasts. And whatever you ask the Father in My name? He got you."

17.text: "This what I'm tellin' y'all again—love each other."

18.text: "If the world hatin' on you, just know they hated Me first."

19.text: "If you belonged to the world, it'd love you like one of its own. But nah—I chose you out the world. That's why they hatin'."

20.text: "Remember what I told y'all: a servant ain't greater than the master. They came for Me? They gon' come for y'all too. If they kept My word, some'll keep yours too."

21.text: "They gon' do all this mess to y'all 'cause of My name—'cause they don't even know the One who sent Me."

22.text: "If I ain't come and told 'em the truth, they'd have an excuse. But now? They know better."

23.text: "If they hate Me, they hatin' My Father too."

24.text: "I did things nobody else ever done. They seen it. They know—but they still hate Me and My Father."

25.text: "But all this went down so Scripture would come true: 'They hated Me without no reason.'"

26.text: "But when the Helper come—the one I'ma send y'all from the Father, the Spirit of truth—He gon' speak up for Me."

27.text: "And y'all gon' bear witness too—'cause y'all been rockin' with Me since day one."

1.text: "I'm tellin' y'all all this so you don't trip or fall off."

2.text: "They gon' kick you out the synagogues, no lie. And it's gon' get so wild that folks who killin' y'all gon' really think they doin' God a favor."

3.text: "They doin' all this 'cause they don't know Me or the Father. Straight up."

4.text: "But I'm lettin' y'all know ahead of time—so when it pop off, you remember I said it. I ain't say nothin' earlier 'cause I was still here with you."

5.text: "But now I'm headin' back to the One who sent Me—and not one of y'all askin' Me, 'Where You goin'?'"

6.text: "Y'all just heartbroken after what I said. I feel that."

7.text: "But let Me keep it real: it's actually better for y'all that I dip. 'Cause if I don't go, the Helper won't come through. But if I leave? I'ma send Him right to you."

8.text: "And when He show up, He gon' call the world out—on sin, on righteousness, and on judgment."

9.text: "On sin? 'Cause they don't believe in Me."

10.text: "On righteousness? 'Cause I'm goin' to the Father, and y'all won't see Me no more."

11.text: "On judgment? 'Cause the enemy—the ruler of this world—already caught that L."

12.text: "I got so much more to tell y'all, but y'all ain't ready yet."

13.text: "But when the Spirit of truth pull up, He gon' guide you into all truth. He ain't speakin' on His own either—He only sayin' what He hear. And He gon' let y'all know what's comin'."

14.text: "He gon' shine the light on Me—'cause He gon' take what's Mine and hand it to y'all."

15.text: "Everything the Father got? That's Mine. That's why I said He takin' what's Mine and makin' it known to y'all."

16.text: "In a lil' bit, you ain't gon' see Me no more. But then, not too long after, you will see Me again. 'Cause I'm goin' to the Father."

17.text: So the disciples start whisperin' like, "What He mean 'a lil' while'? And why He say 'goin' to the Father' like that?"

18.text: "We don't get it, man. What's He talkin' about?"

19.text: Jesus peeped their confusion and said, "Y'all wonderin' what I meant by 'a lil' while'? Lemme break it down."

20.text: "Y'all gon' cry and mourn while the world celebratin'. But don't trip—your sorrow gon' flip into joy."

21.text: "It's like a woman in labor—she hurtin' bad, but soon as that baby drop? She don't even think about the pain no more 'cause of the joy."

22.text: "That's y'all right now—sad. But I'ma see you again, and your heart gon' light up. And can't nobody snatch that joy away from you."

23.text: "On that day, you ain't even gotta ask Me nothin'. Whatever y'all ask the Father in My name? He gon' do it."

24.text: "Up 'til now, y'all ain't asked nothin' in My name. Start askin'—so y'all can receive, and your joy be on full."

25.text: "I been speakin' in parables, but soon I'ma keep it all the way plain with y'all about the Father."

26.text: "And in that day, y'all gon' pray in My name. I ain't sayin' I gotta beg the Father for you—"

27.text: "'Cause the Father Himself love y'all. Why? 'Cause y'all loved Me and believed I came from Him."

28.text: "I came from the Father into this world. Now I'm bout to leave the world and go back to Him."

29.text: The disciples were like, "Okay! Now You talkin' plain—no more riddles."

30.text: "We get it now. You know everything. You ain't gotta wait on nobody to ask questions. That's why we believe You came from God."

31.text: Jesus was like, "Y'all believe now, huh?"

32.text: "Well, check this—the time comin' (matter fact, it's here now) when y'all gon' scatter. Everybody goin' they own way, leavin' Me solo. But I ain't alone—My Father with Me."

33.text: "I told y'all all this so you can have peace in Me. Out here in the world, it's gon' be rough. But keep your head up—I done beat the world already."

1.text: Jesus looked up to heaven and said, "Aight, Father, the time here now. Go 'head and shine on Your Son, so I can shine right back on You."

2.text: "You done gave Me the power over everybody, and I'ma use it to bless the ones You gave Me—with eternal life."

3.text: "And real eternal life? It's knowin' You, the one true God, and knowin' Me, Jesus the Christ, who You sent."

4.text: "I held it down for You on earth. I finished what You gave Me to do."

5.text: "So now, Father, bring Me back into that same glory I had with You before the world even existed."

6.text: "I made Your name known to the ones You pulled out the world and gave to Me. They was Yours, and You passed them to Me, and they been holdin' on to Your word."

7.text: "Now they know for sure everything You gave Me came straight from You."

8.text: "I gave 'em the words You gave Me, and they received it. They believe I came from You. They locked in."

9.text: "I'm prayin' for them—not for the world, but for them, the ones You gave Me. They Yours."

10.text: "Everything I got is Yours, and everything You got is Mine. And they makin' Me look good out here."

11.text: "I'm bout to bounce from the world, but they still gon' be here. Father, hold 'em down in Your name—the name You gave Me—so they can be one, just like Us."

12.text: "When I was with 'em, I kept 'em safe in Your name. Ain't none of 'em got lost—except for that one, the son of destruction—so Scripture could be fulfilled."

13.text: "But now I'm comin' back to You. I'm sayin' this out loud while I'm still here so they can have My joy deep in they hearts."

14.text: "I gave 'em Your word, and the world hated 'em for it—'cause they not of this world, just like I ain't."

15.text: "I ain't askin' You to take 'em out the world. Just keep 'em safe from the evil one."

16.text: "They not of this world, same way I ain't of it."

17.text: "Make 'em holy through the truth. Your word is truth."

18.text: "Just like You sent Me into the world, I'm sendin' them too."

19.text: "And I'm settin' Myself apart for them, so they can be made holy too, through the truth."

20.text: "I ain't just prayin' for them right now—I'm also prayin' for everybody who gon' believe in Me through what they say."

21.text: "I want all of 'em to be one, just like You and Me are one—Me in You, You in Me. So they can be one with Us, and the world finally believe You sent Me."

22.text: "The same glory You gave Me? I gave it to them—so they can be one, just like Us."

23.text: "I'm in them, You in Me—so they can be made complete as one. Then the world gon' know You sent Me, and that You love them like You love Me."

24.text: "Father, I want them ones You gave Me to be with Me where I'm at. I want them to see My glory—the glory You gave Me 'cause You loved Me before the world even started."

25.text: "Righteous Father, the world don't know You, but I do. And these ones here? They know You sent Me."

26.text: "I let 'em know who You are—and I'ma keep doin' it—so the same love You got for Me can live in them. And I'ma be in them too."

1.text: After Jesus finished prayin', He dipped out wit' His disciples, crossed the Kidron brook, and went into a garden spot He used to chill at with them.

2.text: Judas—yeah, the one who snitched—knew 'bout that spot too, 'cause Jesus had been meetin' there with His people.

3.text: So Judas pulled up, rollin' deep with soldiers and Temple guards from the chief priests and Pharisees. They came through strapped—lanterns, torches, weapons and all.

4.text: Jesus, knowin' exactly what was about to pop off, stepped forward and asked, "Who y'all lookin' for?"

5.text: They said, "Jesus from Nazareth." Jesus said, "That's Me." Judas—the backstabber—was right there wit' them.

6.text: When Jesus said, "That's Me," they fell back and hit the ground.

7.text: So He asked again, "Who y'all lookin' for?" They said, "Jesus from Nazareth."

8.text: Jesus said, "I done told y'all already—it's Me. So if I'm who you want, let My people go."

9.text: That way, what He had said before would come true: "I ain't lost none of the ones You gave Me."

10.text: Then Simon Peter pulled out a sword and sliced off the right ear of the high priest's servant. That dude's name was Malchus.

11.text: Jesus told Peter, "Put that sword up. You think I ain't gon' take this cup My Father gave Me?"

12.text: Then the crew—the soldiers, their leader, and the Jewish officials—grabbed Jesus, tied Him up,

13.text: and dragged Him to Annas first. He was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.

14.text: Caiaphas the one who told the Jews, "It's better if one man dies for everybody."

15.text: Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple. That one had some clout—he knew the high priest—so he got into the courtyard with Jesus.

16.text: Peter was still outside. The other disciple talked to the girl at the door and got Peter in.

17.text: The girl said, "You not one of His people too, are you?" Peter said, "Nah, I'm not."

18.text: It was cold, so the servants and guards had a fire going. Peter was there too, tryin' to warm up with them.

19.text: Then the high priest started grillin' Jesus about His disciples and His message.

20.text: Jesus said, "I been speakin' out in the open—synagogues, Temple, you name it. I ain't keep nothin' on the low."

21.text: "Why you askin' Me? Ask the folks who heard Me—they know what I said."

22.text: One of the guards slapped Jesus and said, "That how you talk to the high priest?"

23.text: Jesus said, "If I said somethin' wrong, say what it was. But if I didn't, why you hit Me?"

24.text: Then Annas sent Jesus—still tied up—to Caiaphas the high priest.

25.text: Meanwhile, Peter was still outside tryin' to keep warm. They said to him, "You ain't one of His people too, are you?" He said, "I'm not."

26.text: Then one of the high priest's servants—kin to the dude Peter cut—said, "Didn't I see you in the garden with Him?"

27.text: Peter denied it again. And right then, a rooster crowed.

28.text: They took Jesus from Caiaphas to the governor's HQ—it was still early. The Jews didn't go inside 'cause they didn't wanna mess up their Passover rituals.

29.text: So Pilate came outside and said, "What y'all accusin' this Man of?"

30.text: They said, "If He wasn't doin' wrong, we wouldn't've brought Him to you."

31.text: Pilate said, "Y'all handle it by your own law." They said, "We can't execute nobody."

32.text: That was so Jesus' own words about how He'd die would come true.

33.text: Pilate went back inside, called Jesus in, and said, "You the King of the Jews?"

34.text: Jesus said, "You askin' that for yourself, or did somebody put that in your ear?"

35.text: Pilate said, "Bruh, I ain't Jewish. Your people and your religious leaders handed you over. What you do?"

36.text: Jesus said, "My kingdom ain't from here. If it was, My people would've been throwin' hands to keep Me from gettin' arrested. But nah, that ain't what this is."

37.text: Pilate said, "So you a king then?" Jesus said, "You said it. I came here to speak truth. Everybody who's bout that truth hears Me."

38.text: Pilate said, "What even is truth?" Then he walked back out and told the Jews, "I don't see no reason to charge this dude.

39.text: But it's y'all's custom for me to let somebody go at Passover. You want me to let the 'King of the Jews' go?"

40.text: They yelled, "Nah, not Him! Give us Barabbas!" Barabbas was a straight-up robber.

1.text: Then Pilate had Jesus whipped—straight up scourged Him.

2.text: The soldiers twisted up a crown made of thorns and jammed it on His head. Then they threw a purple robe on Him.

3.text: They kept mockin' Him like, "Hail, King of the Jews!" And they smacked Him up too.

4.text: Pilate came back out and said, "Look, I'm bringin' Him out to y'all to show I don't see nothin' wrong with Him."

5.text: Then Jesus stepped out, wearin' the crown of thorns and that purple robe. Pilate said, "Behold the Man!"

6.text: When the chief priests and guards saw Him, they yelled, "Crucify Him! Crucify Him!" Pilate said, "Y'all do it. I ain't find no fault in Him."

7.text: The Jews replied, "We got a law, and by that law He gotta die, 'cause He said He God's Son."

8.text: When Pilate heard that, he got even more shook.

9.text: He went back inside and asked Jesus, "Where you really from?" But Jesus didn't say nothin'.

10.text: Pilate said, "You not gon' talk to me? Don't you know I got power to crucify you or let you go?"

11.text: Jesus said, "You wouldn't have no power over Me unless it was given from above. The one who handed Me over got the bigger sin."

12.text: From then on Pilate tried to let Him go, but the Jews shouted, "If you let Him go, you not down with Caesar. Anybody callin' themself a king is goin' against Caesar!"

13.text: When Pilate heard that, he brought Jesus out and sat on the judge's seat at a place called The Pavement—Gabbatha in Hebrew.

14.text: It was the day before Passover, around noon. Pilate said, "Behold your King!"

15.text: But they shouted back, "Get Him outta here! Crucify Him!" Pilate asked, "Should I crucify y'all's King?" The chief priests said, "We ain't got no king but Caesar!"

16.text: So Pilate handed Jesus over to be crucified. They took Jesus and led Him away.

17.text: Jesus carried His own cross to a place called The Skull—Golgotha in Hebrew.

18.text: That's where they crucified Him, with two others—one on each side and Jesus in the middle.

19.text: Pilate had a sign made and nailed it on the cross. It read: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

20.text: A lotta folks read that sign, since the spot was close to the city. It was written in Hebrew, Greek, and Latin.

21.text: Then the chief priests told Pilate, "Don't write 'The King of the Jews.' Say, 'He said He was King of the Jews.'"

22.text: Pilate said, "What I wrote is what I wrote."

23.text: When the soldiers crucified Jesus, they took His clothes and split 'em four ways, one part for each soldier. The tunic was seamless, woven all in one piece.

24.text: They said, "Let's not rip it—let's roll dice for it." That fulfilled what Scripture said: 'They divided My clothes and threw lots for My robe.' So that's what they did.

25.text: Jesus' mama was standin' by the cross, along with her sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

26.text: Jesus saw His mama there, and the disciple He loved nearby. He said to His mama, "Woman, here's your son."

27.text: Then He said to the disciple, "Here's your mama." From then on, that disciple took her into his home.

28.text: After that, knowin' everything was now done to fulfill the Scriptures, Jesus said, "I'm thirsty."

29.text: There was a jar of sour wine there, so they soaked a sponge in it, stuck it on some hyssop, and put it to His mouth.

30.text: When Jesus took the wine, He said, "It's finished." Then He bowed His head and let go of His spirit.

31.text: Since it was Preparation Day and they didn't want the bodies up there during the Sabbath (and this one was a big deal), the Jews asked Pilate to break their legs and take the bodies down.

32.text: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first man and then the other who was crucified next to Jesus.

33.text: But when they got to Jesus and saw He was already dead, they didn't break His legs.

34.text: Instead, one of the soldiers stabbed His side with a spear—and out came blood and water.

35.text: The one who saw it gave his testimony, and it's real. He tellin' the truth so y'all can believe.

36.text: All this happened to fulfill Scripture: 'Not one of His bones will be broken.'

37.text: Another verse says: 'They'll look at the One they pierced.'

38.text: Later, Joseph from Arimathea—who followed Jesus on the low 'cause he was scared of the Jews—asked Pilate if he could take Jesus' body. Pilate said yes, so he took it.

39.text: Nicodemus came too—yeah, the one who visited Jesus at night—bringin' about 100 pounds of myrrh and aloes.

40.text: They wrapped Jesus' body with the spices in linen strips—just like the Jewish burial customs.

41.text: The place where He was crucified had a garden, and in that garden was a new tomb nobody had used yet.

42.text: So they laid Jesus there, since it was the Jewish Prep Day and the tomb was close by.

1.text: Early Sunday mornin', while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene pulled up to the tomb and saw that the stone had been rolled away.

2.text: She ran straight to Simon Peter and the other disciple Jesus loved and said, "They done took the Lord out the tomb, and we don't know where they put Him!"

3.text: So Peter and the other disciple took off, headed for the tomb.

4.text: They ran together, but the other disciple outran Peter and got there first.

5.text: He leaned down and peeked in—saw the linen cloths sittin' there—but he ain't go inside.

6.text: Then Simon Peter caught up, went straight into the tomb, and saw the linen cloths too.

7.text: He also saw the cloth that had been on Jesus' head. It wasn't with the other linen but folded up nice and neat in a separate spot.

8.text: Then the other disciple, the one who got there first, finally stepped in. He saw—and he believed.

9.text: They still ain't fully understand the Scripture yet, that Jesus had to rise from the dead.

10.text: So the disciples went back to they homes.

11.text: But Mary stayed posted outside the tomb, cryin'. As she wept, she leaned down and looked inside.

12.text: She saw two angels in white, one sittin' at the head and one at the foot where Jesus' body had been.

13.text: They asked her, "Ma'am, why you cryin'?" She said, "They took my Lord, and I don't know where they put Him."

14.text: Right after she said that, she turned around and saw Jesus standin' there—but she ain't realize it was Him.

15.text: Jesus said, "Why you cryin'? Who you lookin' for?" She thought He was the gardener and said, "Sir, if you moved Him, just tell me where and I'll go get Him."

16.text: Jesus said, "Mary." She turned and said, "Rabboni!" (That means Teacher.)

17.text: Jesus told her, "Don't hold on to Me, 'cause I haven't gone up to the Father yet. But go tell My brothers: 'I'm goin' up to My Father and y'all's Father, My God and y'all's God.'"

18.text: Mary Magdalene ran back and told the disciples, "I seen the Lord!" and she told 'em everything He said.

19.text: That evening, on the first day of the week, the disciples were hid behind locked doors 'cause they was scared of the Jews. Jesus just pulled up in the middle of 'em and said, "Peace y'all."

20.text: Then He showed them His hands and His side. When they saw it was really the Lord, they got hype.

21.text: Jesus said again, "Peace, fam. Just like the Father sent Me, I'm sendin' y'all."

22.text: Then He breathed on them and said, "Catch this: Receive the Holy Spirit.

23.text: If y'all forgive somebody's sins, they forgiven. But if y'all hold on to it, it's held."

24.text: Now Thomas (aka the Twin), one of the twelve, wasn't there when Jesus showed up.

25.text: So the rest told him, "Yo, we seen the Lord!" But Thomas said, "Unless I see the nail prints in His hands and touch 'em, and put my hand in His side—I ain't buyin' it."

26.text: Eight days later, the disciples were together again—Thomas with them this time. Even though the doors was locked, Jesus came through and stood right there. He said, "Peace, fam."

27.text: Then He told Thomas, "Go head—touch My hands. Reach here and feel My side. Stop doubting and believe."

28.text: Thomas said, "My Lord and my God!"

29.text: Jesus said, "You believe 'cause you seen Me? Blessed are the ones who ain't seen Me but still believe."

30.text: Jesus did way more signs in front of the disciples than what's in this book.

31.text: But these right here was written so y'all can believe that Jesus is the Christ, God's Son—and by believin', you'll have life in His name.

1.text: After all that, Jesus popped up again to the disciples by the Sea of Tiberias, and here's how it went down:

2.text: Simon Peter, Thomas (the one they call the Twin), Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the Zebedee brothers, and two other disciples were all chillin' together.

3.text: Simon Peter said, "I'm goin' fishin'." They said, "Bet, we rollin' too." So they hit the boat, but all night long—they ain't catch a thing.

4.text: Come sunrise, Jesus was standin' on the shore, but the crew ain't realize it was Him.

5.text: Jesus called out, "Y'all got anything to eat?" They said, "Nah."

6.text: He said, "Throw the net on the right side of the boat—you'll find some." So they did, and boom—the net was heavy with fish, too many to pull in.

7.text: Then the disciple Jesus loved said to Peter, "Yo—it's the Lord!" When Peter heard that, he threw on his outer robe and jumped into the water like he ain't care 'bout nothin' else.

8.text: The rest of the crew came in the small boat, draggin' that net full of fish. They was only like a football field away from shore.

9.text: When they got to land, they saw a charcoal fire burnin', with fish cookin' and some bread layin' out.

10.text: Jesus said, "Go on and bring some of them fish y'all just caught."

11.text: Simon Peter dragged that net up on shore, full of big fish—153 to be exact. And even with all that, the net ain't rip.

12.text: Jesus said, "Come eat breakfast." Ain't nobody dared ask, "Who are You?" 'cause deep down, they knew it was the Lord.

13.text: Jesus came through, took the bread, and passed it out—did the same with the fish.

14.text: That was the third time Jesus showed up to the disciples after He came back from the dead.

15.text: After breakfast, Jesus asked Simon Peter, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you love Me more than these?" Peter said, "Yeah, Lord. You know I love You." Jesus said, "Then feed My lambs."

16.text: Jesus asked again, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you love Me?" Peter said, "Yes, Lord, You know I love You." Jesus said, "Take care of My sheep."

17.text: A third time, Jesus asked, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you love Me?" That hit Peter hard. He was hurt Jesus asked a third time. He said, "Lord, You know everything. You know I love You." Jesus said, "Feed My sheep.

18.text: For real, for real—I'm tellin' you: when you was young, you dressed yourself and went wherever you wanted. But when you get old, you gon' stretch out your hands, and somebody else gon' dress you and take you somewhere you don't wanna go."

19.text: Jesus said that to hint at what kind of death Peter would die to honor God. Then He told him, "Follow Me."

20.text: Peter turned around and saw the disciple Jesus loved followin'—the same one who leaned back on Jesus during dinner and asked, "Lord, who's gon' betray You?"

21.text: Peter looked at that disciple and said, "Lord, what about him?"

22.text: Jesus said, "If I want him to stick around till I come back, what's that got to do with you? You—follow Me."

23.text: So the word started spreadin' that this disciple wouldn't die. But Jesus ain't say that—He just said, "If I want him to stay till I return, what's that to you?"

24.text: This the disciple who's tellin' y'all all this, and who wrote it down. And we know his word solid.

25.text: Jesus did so much more too—if they wrote it all down, shoot, I don't think the whole world could hold all the books.

1.text: This Jude talkin'—I'm a servant of Jesus Christ and James' brother. I'm writin' to all y'all who been called, made holy by God the Father, and kept covered in Jesus.

2.text: May mercy, peace, and love multiply all over your life. 🕊️

3.text: Look, fam—I wanted to write you about the good news we all share. But I had to switch it up and urge y'all to fight for the faith. The same faith that was once and for all handed down to God's people.

4.text: 'Cause some folks snuck in sideways—folks who been marked for judgment a long time ago. Ungodly people who twist grace into wild livin', and straight up deny Jesus, our one true Lord.

5.text: Let me remind you, even though you already know this: The Lord saved His people outta Egypt… but then turned around and destroyed the ones who ain't believe.

6.text: And the angels who stepped outta line, left their God-given post? He got them locked in darkness, chained up 'til Judgment Day.

7.text: Same with Sodom and Gomorrah—they gave themselves over to wild sexual sin and strange flesh. They're sittin' as the example now—payin' for it in eternal fire. 🔥

8.text: Just like them, these fake dreamers out here defilin' their bodies, disrespectin' authority, and talkin' crazy about things they don't even understand.

9.text: Even Michael the archangel ain't get reckless like that. When he argued with the devil about Moses' body, he ain't come with slander. He just said, "The Lord rebuke you." That's power with restraint.

10.text: But these folks? They run they mouths 'bout what they don't know, act off instincts like animals—and end up destroyin' themselves.

11.text: Woe to them! They walkin' like Cain (jealous and murderous), chasin' money like Balaam, and fallin' into rebellion like Korah. It's gon' end bad.

12.text: They like stains on your church dinners—eatin' with no shame, only out for themselves. They clouds with no rain, trees with no fruit—dead and uprooted. Late fall vibes. No harvest. 🍂

13.text: They wild like ocean waves, bringin' shame up like sea foam. They stars that lost they course—destined for eternal darkness. 💨

14.text: Enoch—seventh from Adam—already prophesied about them: "The Lord's comin' with thousands of His holy ones,

15.text: To bring judgment to the ungodly for all the messy, rebellious, disrespectful stuff they've done and said."

16.text: These folks stay grumblin' and complainin', walkin' by lust, not the Spirit. They mouth off with fancy words, flatterin' people to get ahead. Fake with a purpose.

17.text: But you, beloved—remember what the apostles of Jesus said:

18.text: "In the last days, mockers gon' come. Folk led by they own ungodly cravings."

19.text: They sensual. They divisive. And they ain't got the Spirit. Period.

20.text: But you? Build yourself up in the most holy faith. Pray in the Spirit.

21.text: Keep yourself in God's love. Wait for the mercy of Jesus—it's gon' bring you eternal life. 🕯️

22.text: Some folks need compassion—show it.

23.text: Others? Snatch 'em out the fire. Save them, but stay clear of the sin attached to 'em—hate the dirt, not the soul. 🧤🔥

24.text: Now unto the One who can keep you from fallin', And present you clean, in joy, before His glorious presence—

25.text: To the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord: Glory, honor, power, and rule—now and forever. Amen. 👑

1.text: Aight, so a bunch of folks already tried to write out what went down with everything that got fulfilled among us.

2.text: They got they info straight from the ones who saw it firsthand and been preachin' the word from jump.

3.text: I figured I'd do the same, since I been peepin' all this from the very start—I wanted to lay it out real proper for you, Theophilus.

4.text: So you can be sure about what you was taught and know it ain't no guesswork.

5.text: Back when Herod was king of Judea, there was this priest named Zacharias from the Abijah crew. His wife, Elizabeth, came from Aaron's bloodline too.

6.text: Both of 'em was solid folks—righteous in God's eyes, doin' all He asked, keepin' His rules, no funny business.

7.text: But they ain't have no kids, 'cause Elizabeth couldn't have none, and they was both gettin' up there in age.

8.text: One day, while Zacharias was on duty, servin' God like priests do,

9.text: It was his turn to go in the temple and burn incense, just like the tradition said.

10.text: A whole crowd was outside prayin' while he was doin' the incense thing.

11.text: Outta nowhere, an angel of the Lord showed up—posted on the right side of the incense altar.

12.text: Zacharias saw him and got shook—straight-up terrified.

13.text: But the angel said, "Chill, Zacharias. God heard your prayer. Your wife Elizabeth gon' have a son, and you gon' name him John.

14.text: He gon' bring you mad joy, and a lotta folks gon' celebrate when he's born.

15.text: This boy gon' be major in God's eyes. He ain't gon' drink no wine or strong liquor, and he gon' be full of the Holy Spirit even in the womb.

16.text: He gon' turn a whole lotta Israelites back to the Lord their God.

17.text: He gon' go ahead of the Lord, movin' like Elijah with power—gettin' fathers to reconnect with they kids, and rebellious folks to wise up—preppin' people for the Lord."

18.text: Zacharias said, "How I'm supposed to believe that? I'm old, and my wife ain't no spring chicken either."

19.text: The angel clapped back, "I'm Gabriel, fam. I stand in God's presence. He sent me to drop this good news to you.

20.text: But since you ain't believe me, you ain't gon' be able to talk till all this goes down—'cause what I said gon' happen at the right time."

21.text: Meanwhile, the people outside was waitin' on Zacharias like, "Why he takin' so long in there?"

22.text: When he finally came out, he couldn't talk. They realized he must've seen a vision, 'cause he was makin' hand signs and couldn't say a word.

23.text: Once his time workin' at the temple was up, he dipped back home.

24.text: Not long after, Elizabeth got pregnant. She laid low for five months.

25.text: She said, "Look what the Lord did for me. He saw me out here strugglin' and took away my shame."

26.text: Six months later, God sent Gabriel to a town in Galilee called Nazareth.

27.text: He came to a virgin named Mary. She was engaged to Joseph, a man from King David's bloodline.

28.text: Gabriel pulled up and said, "What's up, favored girl? The Lord's rockin' with you. You real blessed."

29.text: Mary got shook and was tryna figure out what this wild greeting even meant.

30.text: Gabriel said, "Don't be scared, Mary. You got God's favor for real.

31.text: You about to get pregnant and have a Son. Name Him Jesus.

32.text: He gon' be great—folks gon' call Him the Son of the Most High. God gon' give Him David's throne.

33.text: He gon' reign over Jacob's people forever, and His kingdom? It ain't never gon' end."

34.text: Mary said, "How that work? I ain't never been with no man."

35.text: Gabriel said, "The Holy Spirit gon' come over you, and God's power gon' cover you. That's why the child you havin' gon' be called the Son of God.

36.text: And check this—your cousin Elizabeth? She pregnant too, even in her old age. She six months in now—yeah, the same one folks said couldn't have no kids.

37.text: 'Cause with God? Ain't nothin' impossible."

38.text: Mary said, "I'm down, Lord. Let it happen just like you said." And with that, the angel bounced.

39.text: Right after that, Mary got up and dipped out quick to the hill country in Judea.

40.text: She pulled up at Zacharias's crib and greeted Elizabeth.

41.text: Soon as Elizabeth heard Mary say hey, the baby in her belly jumped—and Elizabeth got filled up with the Holy Spirit.

42.text: She let out a loud shout and said, "Girl, you blessed for real! And the baby you carryin'? Blessed too!

43.text: But hold up—why I get this honor, that the mama of my Lord pulled up to see me?

44.text: 'Cause the second I heard your voice, my baby started dancin' inside me, full of joy.

45.text: You real blessed 'cause you believed what God said—and everything He promised you? It's comin' true."

46.text: Then Mary said, "My soul stay liftin' up the Lord.

47.text: My spirit is turnt up in God, my Savior.

48.text: He saw me when I was lowly and overlooked. From now on, everybody gon' call me blessed.

49.text: The Mighty One did somethin' major for me. His name holy for real.

50.text: He keeps showin' mercy to the ones that fear Him—generation after generation.

51.text: He showed out with His power—He scattered all them proud folks who thought they was somethin'.

52.text: He knocked rulers off they thrones, but lifted up the ones who was down bad.

53.text: He fed the hungry with the good stuff, but sent the rich home empty-handed.

54.text: He helped His people, Israel, just like He said He would.

55.text: He kept His promise to our ancestors—to Abraham and all his people forever."

56.text: Mary stayed with Elizabeth for about three months, then headed back to her own spot.

57.text: When it was time for Elizabeth to have her baby, she gave birth to a son.

58.text: Her neighbors and family heard how good the Lord had been to her, and they celebrated with her.

59.text: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the baby. Folks was like, "Let's name him after his daddy—Zacharias."

60.text: But Elizabeth shut that down real quick: "Nah, his name gon' be John."

61.text: They was confused like, "Ain't nobody in your family named that."

62.text: So they turned to Zacharias, tryin' to get his take—askin' him what the baby's name should be.

63.text: He asked for a tablet and wrote: "His name is John." Everybody was shocked.

64.text: Right then, Zacharias could talk again—his mouth opened up, and he started praisin' God.

65.text: Everybody around there got shook. Word spread all over the hills of Judea about what went down.

66.text: Folks who heard about it kept it in their hearts, sayin', "What kinda child is this boy gon' be?" 'Cause clearly, God's hand was all over him.

67.text: Then Zacharias, filled with the Holy Spirit, started prophesyin', sayin':

68.text: "Bless the Lord, the God of Israel—He came through and saved His people.

69.text: He raised up a strong Savior from David's family line.

70.text: Just like He promised through His prophets from way back.

71.text: He savin' us from our enemies—from everybody that hate on us.

72.text: Showin' mercy like He told our ancestors, rememberin' that holy promise.

73.text: The oath He made to Abraham, our father:

74.text: That we'd be rescued from our enemies, so we could serve Him without fear.

75.text: Holy and righteous, standin' before Him every day of our lives.

76.text: And you, little one—you gon' be called the prophet of the Most High. You gon' go ahead of the Lord, makin' the way ready for Him.

77.text: You gon' teach His people how to be saved—how their sins can get wiped clean.

78.text: All 'cause our God is full of tender mercy. Heaven's light is breakin' in.

79.text: That light gon' shine on folks stuck in darkness and death's shadow. He gon' lead our steps right into peace."

80.text: The boy grew up strong in the Spirit, and he stayed out in the wilderness 'til the day he stepped out to show Israel who he was.

1.text: Back in the day, Caesar Augustus sent out a message sayin' everybody in the empire had to get registered.

2.text: This was the first census when Quirinius was runnin' Syria.

3.text: So everybody went to their hometown to sign up.

4.text: Joseph left Galilee, from the town of Nazareth, and headed down to Judea—to Bethlehem, David's hometown—'cause that's where his people came from.

5.text: He went to get registered with Mary, the one he was promised to, and she was pregnant.

6.text: While they was there, her time came to give birth.

7.text: She had her firstborn Son, wrapped Him up in cloth, and laid Him in a manger, 'cause there wasn't no room for them at the inn.

8.text: That same night, some shepherds was out in the fields nearby, watchin' over they sheep.

9.text: All of a sudden, an angel of the Lord showed up, and God's glory lit the whole place up—they was shook.

10.text: But the angel said, "Don't be scared. I got good news that's gon' bring joy to everybody.

11.text: Today, in David's city, a Savior been born for y'all—He the Messiah, the Lord.

12.text: Here's how you'll know it's Him: You'll find a baby wrapped up and layin' in a manger."

13.text: Then outta nowhere, a whole crew of heavenly angels popped up, praisin' God and sayin',
