18.text: Then a ruler came up and asked Him, 'Good Teacher, what I gotta do to get eternal life?'

19.text: Jesus said, 'Why you callin' Me good? Ain't nobody truly good except God alone.'

20.text: 'You know the commandments—don't cheat, don't kill, don't steal, don't lie on nobody, and honor your folks.'

21.text: The man said, 'I been doin' all that since I was young.'

22.text: Jesus heard him and said, 'One thing you still missin'. Sell what you got, give that money to the poor—you'll have treasure in heaven. Then come follow Me.'

23.text: When he heard that, he got real sad 'cause he had stacks. He was real rich.

24.text: Jesus saw that and said, 'Man, it's hard for rich folks to get in the kingdom of God.'

25.text: 'It's easier for a camel to squeeze through a needle's eye than for a rich man to step into God's kingdom.'

26.text: Folks heard that and said, 'Well then, who *can* be saved?'

27.text: Jesus said, 'What's impossible for people is possible with God.'

28.text: Then Peter said, 'Look, we left everything to follow You.'

29.text: Jesus replied, 'Believe Me, ain't nobody that gave up house, parents, siblings, wife, or kids for God's kingdom—'

30.text: 'Who won't get way more in this life, and eternal life in the next one.'

31.text: Then He pulled the Twelve aside and said, 'Look, we headed to Jerusalem. Everything the prophets wrote 'bout the Son of Man gon' go down.'

32.text: 'He gon' be handed over to the outsiders. They gon' clown Him, disrespect Him, and spit on Him.'

33.text: 'They gon' beat Him and kill Him. But on the third day, He gon' rise.'

34.text: But the disciples ain't get it. It was like the meaning was hidden—they ain't understand what He meant.

35.text: As Jesus was gettin' close to Jericho, a blind man was sittin' by the road, beggin'.

36.text: He heard a crowd passin' by and asked what was goin' on.

37.text: They told him, 'Jesus of Nazareth is passin' through.'

38.text: So he started shoutin', 'Jesus! Son of David! Have mercy on me!'

39.text: The folks up front told him to hush, but he just yelled louder, 'SON OF DAVID, HAVE MERCY ON ME!'

40.text: Jesus stopped and told 'em to bring the man over. When he got close, Jesus asked him—

41.text: 'What you want Me to do for you?' He said, 'Lord, I just wanna see again.'

42.text: Jesus said, 'Aight then—receive your sight. Your faith done made you whole.'

43.text: And just like that, the man could see. He followed Jesus, praisin' God. And everybody who saw it gave God the glory too.

1.text: Jesus rolled through Jericho, just passin' through.

2.text: There was this dude named Zacchaeus. He was a big boss in the tax game — and he had money.

3.text: He was tryna see who Jesus was, but the crowd was too thick, and he was mad short.

4.text: So he ran up ahead and climbed up a sycamore tree, just to catch a glimpse of Jesus as He walked by.

5.text: When Jesus got to that spot, He looked up and said, "Zacchaeus! Come on down quick, I'm stayin' at your crib today."

6.text: Zacchaeus didn't waste no time — he hopped down and welcomed Him with joy.

7.text: But folks was hatin'. They was like, "Wow… He really gon' eat with a sinner?"

8.text: Zacchaeus stood up and told the Lord, "Look, Lord — I'm givin' half my stuff to the poor. And if I scammed anybody, I'ma pay 'em back four times over."

9.text: Jesus said, "Salvation done pulled up to this house today. This man one of Abraham's kids too."

10.text: "The Son of Man came to look for the lost and bring 'em back home."

11.text: While folks was listenin', Jesus dropped another parable — they thought God's kingdom was about to show up any minute.

12.text: He said, "A nobleman went off to a far land to get crowned king and come back.

13.text: Before he dipped, he called ten of his workers, gave 'em each a mina, and said, 'Run it up 'til I get back.'

14.text: But the folks back home hated him. They even sent a squad after him like, 'We don't want this man ruling us.'

15.text: When he came back as king, he called them same workers to see what they did with his money.

16.text: The first one came up like, 'Boss, your one mina made ten more!'

17.text: The king said, 'Bet! You did your thing with a lil' bit, now you run ten cities.'

18.text: Then the second one said, 'Boss, I flipped your one mina into five.'

19.text: He told him, 'You got five cities then.'

20.text: Then another came and said, 'Here's your mina. I wrapped it up in a handkerchief and kept it.'

21.text: 'I was shook, 'cause you a hard man. You collect where you ain't deposit, and you harvest where you ain't even sowed.'

22.text: The king said, 'I'ma judge you off your own words. You knew I don't play.

23.text: So why ain't you at least put it in the bank? I coulda got interest when I came back!'

24.text: Then he told the folks standin' around, 'Take that mina from him and give it to the one with ten.'

25.text: They were like, 'But he already got ten!'

26.text: He said, 'Yeah, and the ones that got, gon' get more. But if you ain't got nothin', even what little you got gon' get snatched.'

27.text: 'Now bring all them haters who didn't want me as king — line 'em up and get rid of 'em right here in front of me.'"

28.text: After that, Jesus kept it pushin' toward Jerusalem.

29.text: When He got close to Bethphage and Bethany, near Mount Olives, He sent two disciples ahead.

30.text: He told 'em, "Go into that village across from y'all. Soon as you walk in, you'll see a young donkey tied up that ain't never been rode. Untie it and bring it to Me.

31.text: If somebody asks what y'all doin', just say, 'The Lord need it.'"

32.text: They went out and found everything exactly how Jesus said it would be.

33.text: As they was untyin' the donkey, the owners said, "Why y'all takin' our donkey?"

34.text: They said, "The Lord need it."

35.text: So they brought it back to Jesus, threw their coats on it, and helped Him up on it.

36.text: As Jesus rode, folks laid their coats down on the road in front of Him.

37.text: When He got close to the Mount of Olives, the whole crowd of disciples started turnin' up, shoutin' praise to God for all the wild miracles they had seen:

38.text: "Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven and glory way up high!"

39.text: Some Pharisees in the crowd said, "Teacher, tell your people to chill."

40.text: But Jesus was like, "If they get quiet, these rocks gon' start shoutin'!"

41.text: As He got closer and saw the city, He started cryin'.

42.text: He said, "If only you knew, especially today, what coulda brought you peace. But now your eyes too blind to see it.

43.text: The time's comin' when your enemies gon' trap you in — they gon' circle you, close in from every side,

44.text: and tear you and your kids down to the ground. Not one stone gon' be left standing. 'Cause you ain't realize when God showed up for you."

45.text: Jesus pulled up to the temple and started flippin' tables — kickin' out the folks buyin' and sellin'.

46.text: He told 'em, "It's written, 'My house is a place of prayer.' But y'all turned it into a straight-up trap house."

47.text: He kept teachin' in the temple every day. But the priests, the religious leaders, and the big names was tryna find a way to kill Him.

48.text: They couldn't touch Him though, 'cause the people was glued to every word He said.

1.text: One day while Jesus was up in the temple, teachin' the people and preachin' the Good News, the chief priests, scribes, and elders pulled up on Him.

2.text: They said, "Aight, tell us—who gave you the right to do all this? Who told you you could move like this?"

3.text: Jesus said, "Lemme ask y'all somethin' first. You answer Me, then I'll answer you."

4.text: "That baptism John was doin'—was that straight from heaven or some man-made stuff?"

5.text: They started whisperin' to each other, "If we say it came from heaven, He gon' ask, 'So why ain't y'all believe him then?'"

6.text: "But if we say it was from man, the people might stone us, 'cause they all swear John was a real prophet."

7.text: So they played it safe and said, "We don't know where it came from."

8.text: Jesus said, "Cool then. Since y'all don't wanna answer Me, I ain't tellin' y'all where I get my authority either."

9.text: Then Jesus started tellin' the people a story. He said, "A man planted a vineyard, rented it out to some folks, and dipped out to another country for a long while."

10.text: "When it was time to get some fruit, he sent a servant to collect what's his. But the renters beat that man up and sent him back with nothin'."

11.text: "So he sent another one. They beat him down too, treated him dirty, and sent him away empty-handed."

12.text: "Then a third one got sent—and they did him even worse. Beat him up and straight tossed him out."

13.text: "So the owner said, 'What now? I'ma send my son, the one I love. Maybe they'll respect him.'"

14.text: "But when they saw the son comin', they said, 'Yo, that's the heir! Let's kill him so we can snatch what's his!'"

15.text: "They dragged him out the vineyard and killed him. Now tell me—what y'all think the owner gon' do?"

16.text: "He gon' show up, destroy those wicked folks, and hand the vineyard over to some new folks." When the crowd heard that, they said, "Nah, that can't be!"

17.text: But Jesus looked at them and said, "Then what that verse mean that say: 'The stone the builders threw out Done turned into the cornerstone'?"

18.text: "If you trip over that stone, you gon' break. But if that stone fall on you? You gettin' crushed."

19.text: Right then, the religious leaders wanted to lay hands on Jesus, but they was scared of the crowd. They knew that story was a shot at them.

20.text: They kept watchin' Him and sent some fake righteous folks to trap Him up, tryin' to get Him caught up with the governor.

21.text: They asked, "Teacher, we know you solid, and you teach straight truth. You don't play favorites, and you always speak on what God really want. So here's our question…"

22.text: "Is it legal for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"

23.text: Jesus peeped their game and said, "Why y'all tryna play Me?"

24.text: "Show me a denarius. Whose face and name on that coin?" They said, "Caesar's."

25.text: He told 'em, "Then give Caesar what's his, and give God what's His."

26.text: They couldn't trap Him on that one. Matter fact, they was shook by how slick He answered. So they shut up real quick.

27.text: Then some Sadducees came up. These the ones who don't believe in no resurrection.

28.text: They said, "Teacher, Moses told us that if a man die and leave no kids, his brother should marry the widow and raise up children for him."

29.text: "So there was this family—seven brothers. The first one married a woman, then died with no kids."

30.text: "Then the second brother married her, but he died too, no kids."

31.text: "Same with the third… and all the way down. All seven married her, and none left any kids."

32.text: "Then the woman died too."

33.text: "So in the resurrection, whose wife she gon' be? All seven had her."

34.text: Jesus said, "People in this world get married and stuff."

35.text: "But in the resurrection? The ones worthy of that new life don't marry or get married."

36.text: "They don't die no more either. They like the angels and are God's children now, since they part of the resurrection."

37.text: "And Moses even showed the resurrection is real—remember that burning bush? He called the Lord 'the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.'"

38.text: "He ain't the God of the dead, but of the livin'. Everybody live to Him."

39.text: Some scribes spoke up like, "Teacher, that was solid."

40.text: After that, they ain't even try to question Him no more.

41.text: Then Jesus asked, "How they say Christ is David's son?"

42.text: "David himself said in the Psalms: 'The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right hand,"

43.text: "Till I put your enemies under your feet.'"

44.text: "If David called Him 'Lord,' how's He his son?"

45.text: Then Jesus turned to His disciples with the whole crowd listenin' and said,

46.text: "Y'all better watch out for them scribes. They love walkin' round in fancy clothes, want folks to greet 'em big in public, and always tryna snatch the best seats."

47.text: "They rob widows and act holy with them long prayers. But trust Me—they gon' get hit with the worst judgment."

1.text: Jesus looked up and saw the rich folks droppin' their money off at the treasury.

2.text: Then He saw this one poor widow come through and toss in two little coins.

3.text: He said, "Listen up—I'm tellin' y'all the truth: this poor widow gave more than all of them."

4.text: "They gave outta their extra, but she gave all she had, even though she barely had nothin'. That was her whole livelihood."

5.text: Some folks started talkin' about how fly the temple looked, all decked out in stones and big-time donations.

6.text: Jesus said, "Y'all see all this? The time comin' when not one of these stones gon' be left sittin' on top of another. It's all comin' down."

7.text: They asked Him, "Teacher, when all this supposed to happen? And what signs should we look for so we know it's about to go down?"

8.text: Jesus said, "Y'all better stay sharp so nobody runs game on you. A lotta folks gon' come sayin' they Me, or sayin', 'The time's here!' Don't chase after them."

9.text: "And when y'all hear about wars and chaos, don't panic. That stuff gotta happen first, but that ain't the end yet."

10.text: Then He said, "Nation gon' rise up against nation, and kingdom against kingdom."

11.text: "There'll be big earthquakes all over, famines, diseases, and some wild signs from the sky."

12.text: "But before all that, they gon' snatch y'all up and come for you. They'll lock y'all up, drag you to court, and bring you before kings and bosses—all 'cause of My name."

13.text: "But that's gon' be y'all's moment to speak up. Use that time to testify."

14.text: "Don't stress about what you gon' say beforehand."

15.text: "I'ma give y'all the words and the wisdom, and your haters won't be able to argue with you or shut you down."

16.text: "Even your folks—parents, siblings, cousins, and so-called friends—gon' turn on you. Some of y'all might even get killed."

17.text: "Everybody gon' hate on you 'cause you roll with Me."

18.text: "But not even one hair from your head gon' be lost."

19.text: "If y'all hold it down and stay steady, you'll keep your soul intact."

20.text: "When you see Jerusalem surrounded by soldiers, just know—it's about to get real. That's the sign it's about to be destroyed."

21.text: "If you in Judea, run for the hills. If you in the city, dip out. And if you outside, don't even try to go back in."

22.text: "These are payback days, so everything the scriptures said gotta happen."

23.text: "But woe to the pregnant women and nursing moms in those days! It's gon' be heavy out here—mad stress and anger fallin' on this people."

24.text: "They gon' die by the sword, and the rest gon' get snatched and dragged off to other nations. And Jerusalem? Gentiles gon' trample it till their time is up."

25.text: "You gon' see wild signs in the sun, moon, and stars. Down here, nations gon' be trippin', confused and scared, with the oceans actin' up."

26.text: "Folks' hearts gon' fail 'em 'cause of fear and what's comin' down on the world. Even the heavens gon' be shakin'."

27.text: "Then they gon' see the Son of Man showin' up in a cloud, flexin' with power and glory."

28.text: "When you see all this startin' to happen, stand up tall and lift your head. Your rescue is comin'."

29.text: Then Jesus dropped a parable: "Look at the fig tree—and all the other trees too."

30.text: "When they start buddin', y'all already know summer's around the corner."

31.text: "Same thing here—when you see all this go down, know the kingdom of God is pullin' up."

32.text: "For real, I'm tellin' y'all, this generation won't pass before all this happens."

33.text: "The sky and earth might pass away, but My words? They ain't goin' nowhere."

34.text: "Y'all better watch yourselves. Don't get caught up partyin', drinkin', or stressin' over life's problems. Don't let that Day catch you slippin'."

35.text: "It's gon' drop on everybody across the whole earth, like a trap."

36.text: "So stay woke. Keep prayin' all the time, askin' that you can dodge all that's comin' and still be able to stand before the Son of Man."

37.text: Every day, Jesus was teachin' in the temple. But at night, He'd head out and chill on Mount Olivet.

38.text: And every mornin', the people pulled up early to the temple just to hear Him speak.

1.text: The Feast of Unleavened Bread was comin' up—the one they call Passover.

2.text: The chief priests and the scribes was tryna figure out how to kill Jesus, but they was scared of the crowd.

3.text: Then Satan slid in on Judas—yep, the one called Iscariot—one of the Twelve.

4.text: Judas went and linked up with the chief priests and temple guards, tryin' to work out how he could set Jesus up for them.

5.text: They were hype about it, and promised to break him off with some money.

6.text: So Judas agreed, and started lookin' for the right moment to hand Jesus over—when the crowd wasn't around.

7.text: Then the day came when they had to kill the Passover lamb—Feast of Unleavened Bread.

8.text: Jesus told Peter and John, "Go on and get the Passover meal ready for us to eat."

9.text: They asked, "Where you want us to do it?"

10.text: He said, "Soon as y'all get in the city, a man carryin' a water jug gon' meet y'all. Follow him to the house he go into."

11.text: "Then ask the man of the house, 'The Teacher wanna know where the guest room at, so He can eat Passover with His disciples.'"

12.text: "He gon' show y'all a big upstairs room already set up. That's where y'all need to get it ready."

13.text: So they left, and it went down exactly how Jesus said. They got everything set for Passover.

14.text: When the time came, Jesus sat down with the Twelve.

15.text: He told them, "I been waitin' to eat this Passover meal with y'all before I go through this suffering."

16.text: "I'm tellin' y'all now—I ain't eatin' this meal again till it get fulfilled in God's kingdom."

17.text: Then He took a cup, gave thanks, and said, "Pass this around to each other."

18.text: "I won't be drinkin' wine again till God's kingdom come."

19.text: Then He took some bread, gave thanks, broke it, and passed it to them sayin', "This My body, given up for y'all. Eat it to remember Me."

20.text: After supper, He took another cup and said, "This cup right here is the new deal—My blood bein' poured out for y'all."

21.text: "But look, the one who's gon' betray Me? His hand on this table with Mine."

22.text: "The Son of Man gotta go like it's been written. But still—woe to the one who betray Him!"

23.text: Then they all started whisperin' and wonderin', "Who would even do somethin' like that?"

24.text: Then they started arguin' about who among them was the top dawg.

25.text: Jesus said, "Look, kings out here be actin' like bosses, and the big shots get called 'benefactors.'"

26.text: "But that ain't how y'all gon' move. The greatest one among y'all should act like the youngest. And the one in charge? Be the one servin'."

27.text: "Who's bigger? The one eatin' at the table or the one servin' food? Ain't it the one at the table? But I'm here servin'—right in front of y'all."

28.text: "Y'all been rockin' with Me through all My struggles."

29.text: "So I'ma bless y'all with a kingdom, just like My Father blessed Me."

30.text: "Y'all gon' eat and drink at My table in the kingdom, sittin' on thrones, judgin' the twelve tribes of Israel."

31.text: Then Jesus said, "Simon, Simon—listen. Satan been askin' for you, tryna shake you up like wheat in a sifter."

32.text: "But I prayed for you—that your faith won't fall apart. And when you bounce back, go strengthen your brothers."

33.text: Peter said, "Lord, I'm down for You! I'll go to jail or even die with You!"

34.text: Jesus said, "Boy, I'm tellin' you straight up—before that rooster crows today, you gon' deny three times that you even know Me."

35.text: Then Jesus asked, "Back when I sent y'all out without a money bag, backpack, or sandals—did y'all lack anything?" They said, "Nah, we ain't miss nothin'."

36.text: Then Jesus said, "But now, if you got a money bag, better bring it. Same with a travel bag. And if you ain't got a sword, sell your jacket and buy one."

37.text: "'Cause I'm tellin' y'all, what's written 'bout Me gotta come true: 'He was counted among the rebels.' What's about to go down with Me—it's comin' to a close."

38.text: They said, "Lord, look—we got two swords right here." And Jesus said, "Aight, that's enough."

39.text: Jesus left out and went to the Mount of Olives like He usually did. His disciples followed Him.

40.text: When they got there, He told them, "Y'all pray so you don't fall into temptation."

41.text: He went off a lil' ways from them—just a stone's throw—and dropped to His knees and prayed.

42.text: He said, "Father, if You willin', take this cup from Me. But still—not what I want, but what You want."

43.text: Then an angel from heaven came through and gave Him strength.

44.text: And He was in deep agony, prayin' even harder. His sweat was fallin' like big drops of blood hittin' the ground.

45.text: When He got up from prayin', He went back to the disciples and saw them knocked out—sleepin' from sorrow.

46.text: He said, "Why y'all sleepin'? Get up and pray, so you don't fall into temptation."

47.text: While He was still talkin', here come a crowd. And at the front was Judas—yeah, one of the Twelve—comin' up to kiss Jesus.

48.text: But Jesus said, "For real, Judas? You betrayin' the Son of Man with a kiss?"

49.text: When the disciples saw what was 'bout to go down, they asked, "Lord, should we pull out the swords?"

50.text: And one of them sliced the high priest's servant and took off his right ear.

51.text: But Jesus said, "Nah, let it be." Then He touched the man's ear and healed him.

52.text: Jesus turned to the chief priests, temple guards, and elders who came to snatch Him, and said, "Y'all came at Me like I'm some kind of thug—with swords and clubs?"

53.text: "I been with y'all every day in the temple, and y'all ain't touch Me. But this here? This y'all's hour. This darkness? That's y'all's lane."

54.text: They grabbed Jesus and took Him to the high priest's house. Peter followed—but he stayed at a distance.

55.text: Folks had started a fire in the courtyard and were sittin' around it. Peter sat with them.

56.text: A servant girl looked hard at him and said, "He was with Jesus too."

57.text: But Peter denied it: "Girl, I don't even know Him."

58.text: A little later, somebody else saw him and said, "You one of them." Peter said, "Man, I am not!"

59.text: After about an hour, another dude said, "Look, he gotta be one of them—he from Galilee too."

60.text: Peter said, "Man, I don't know what you talkin' about!" And while he was still talkin', the rooster crowed.

61.text: Jesus turned and looked straight at Peter. Then Peter remembered what Jesus had told him: "Before the rooster crows, you gon' deny Me three times."

62.text: Peter dipped out and cried his eyes out.

63.text: The men holdin' Jesus started clownin' Him and beatin' on Him.

64.text: They blindfolded Him, smacked Him up, and said, "Prophesy! Tell us who hit You!"

65.text: And they kept talkin' reckless, blasphemous stuff to Him.

66.text: When the sun came up, the elders, chief priests, and scribes all got together. They brought Jesus to their council and said,

67.text: "If You the Messiah, tell us." Jesus said, "If I told y'all, y'all wouldn't believe Me."

68.text: "And if I asked y'all a question, y'all wouldn't answer or let Me go."

69.text: "But from now on, the Son of Man gon' be sittin' at God's right hand, holdin' all power."

70.text: Then they all said, "So You the Son of God?" And Jesus said, "Y'all said it."

71.text: They said, "We don't need no more witnesses—we heard it with our own ears!"

1.text: Then the whole crowd got up and took Jesus to Pilate.

2.text: They started snitchin', sayin', "This man out here messin' up the people, tellin' folks not to pay taxes to Caesar and claimin' He the Messiah—a whole King."

3.text: Pilate asked Him, "You the King of the Jews?" Jesus said, "You said it."

4.text: Pilate turned to the priests and the crowd and said, "I don't see nothin' wrong with this man."

5.text: But they turned up even more: "He stirrin' up everybody! Teachin' all over Judea—started in Galilee and now He here!"

6.text: When Pilate heard "Galilee," he asked if Jesus was from there.

7.text: And when he found out Jesus was under Herod's rule, he sent Him over to Herod, who happened to be in town too.

8.text: Herod was hyped to see Jesus. He'd been tryna meet Him for a minute, hopin' to see a miracle.

9.text: He hit Jesus with a bunch of questions, but Jesus ain't say a word.

10.text: The priests and scribes kept hollerin' accusations at Him.

11.text: Then Herod and his crew clowned Jesus, dressed Him up in a fancy robe, mocked Him, and sent Him back to Pilate.

12.text: That day, Herod and Pilate went from beefin' to bein' boys—they became cool off Jesus' situation.

13.text: Pilate called everybody back together—priests, leaders, and the people.

14.text: He said, "Y'all brought this man to me, sayin' He was stirrin' up trouble. But I looked into it, and He ain't done nothin' wrong."

15.text: "Herod ain't find nothin' either—He ain't done nothin' to deserve death."

16.text: "So I'ma just rough Him up a bit and let Him go."

17.text: (Pilate had to release somebody during the feast.)

18.text: But they all shouted, "Nah! Get rid of Him! Give us Barabbas!"

19.text: Barabbas had been locked up for starting riots in the city—and for murder.

20.text: Pilate tried again, wantin' to let Jesus go.

21.text: But they screamed louder: "Crucify Him! Crucify Him!"

22.text: A third time, Pilate said, "Why? What'd He do? He ain't done nothin' to deserve death! I'ma just punish Him and let Him go."

23.text: But they wasn't havin' it. They kept yellin' for Him to be crucified—and the priests backed 'em up.

24.text: So Pilate gave in and gave the order they wanted.

25.text: He let Barabbas go—the dude locked up for murder and rebellion—and handed Jesus over to be crucified.

26.text: As they led Jesus away, they grabbed a man named Simon from Cyrene, who was comin' in from the country, and made him carry Jesus' cross.

27.text: A crowd followed, including women cryin' and mournin'.

28.text: Jesus turned and said, "Daughters of Jerusalem, don't cry for Me. Cry for y'all selves and your kids."

29.text: "The time comin' when folks gon' say, 'Blessed are the women who ain't had no kids.'"

30.text: "They gon' say to the mountains, 'Fall on us,' and to the hills, 'Hide us.'"

31.text: "If they do this when the tree still green, what's gon' happen when it's dry?"

32.text: Two other men, criminals, were being taken out with Him to be executed.

33.text: When they got to a place called Calvary, they crucified Jesus there, with the criminals—one on His right, one on His left.

34.text: Jesus said, "Father, forgive them. They don't even know what they doin'." And they rolled dice for His clothes.

35.text: The people just stood there watchin'. The leaders mocked Him, sayin', "He saved others—let Him save Himself if He really God's chosen."

36.text: The soldiers joined in, givin' Him sour wine.

37.text: They said, "If You the King of the Jews, save Yourself."

38.text: There was a sign above Him that said: "THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS."

39.text: One of the criminals hangin' there mocked Him: "Ain't You the Messiah? Save Yourself and us!"

40.text: But the other one snapped back, "You don't fear God? You about to die too!"

41.text: "We gettin' what we deserve. But this man ain't done nothin' wrong."

42.text: Then he said to Jesus, "Lord, remember me when You get to Your kingdom."

43.text: Jesus said, "Today, you gon' be with Me in Paradise."

44.text: Around noon, everything went dark across the land 'til about 3 PM.

45.text: The sun just stopped shinin', and the temple curtain tore straight down the middle.

46.text: Jesus shouted, "Father, into Your hands I give My spirit!" And after He said that, He took His last breath.

47.text: The Roman soldier saw it all and said, "This really was a righteous man!"

48.text: Everybody who came to watch saw what happened, beat their chests in grief, and went home.

49.text: But Jesus' people—His crew and the women who had followed Him from Galilee—stood at a distance, watchin' it all go down.

50.text: A man named Joseph showed up. He was on the council—a good dude who stood for what's right.

51.text: He hadn't agreed with what the others did. He was from Arimathea and was waitin' on God's kingdom too.

52.text: He went to Pilate and asked for Jesus' body.

53.text: He took the body down, wrapped it in linen, and placed it in a tomb cut out the rock—nobody had ever used it before.

54.text: It was the Preparation Day, and the Sabbath was comin' in quick.

55.text: The women who came with Jesus from Galilee followed behind and saw the tomb and how the body was laid.

56.text: Then they went home and got spices and oils ready. But they chilled on the Sabbath like the commandment said.

1.text: Real early Sunday morning, the women came through with the spices they had prepared.

2.text: But when they got to the tomb, that stone was already rolled out the way.

3.text: They went inside, but Jesus' body was gone.

4.text: While they was tryna figure out what happened, two men popped up rockin' fit-for-heaven drip—shinin' bright.

5.text: The women got shook, bowed down, but the men said, "Why y'all lookin' for the livin' in a graveyard?"

6.text: "He ain't here—He got up! Don't y'all remember what He said back in Galilee?"

7.text: "'The Son of Man gotta get handed over to sinful folks, get crucified, and rise up on the third day.'"

8.text: Then they remembered exactly what He had told them.

9.text: They booked it back from the tomb and told the eleven and everybody else what went down.

10.text: The ones who pulled up were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary (James' mama), and some other sisters too.

11.text: But the men thought they was trippin'—talkin' wild—and didn't believe 'em.

12.text: Peter, though, took off runnin' to the tomb. He peeked in, saw the linen cloths layin' there, and left lookin' shook, tryin' to piece it all together.

13.text: That same day, two of Jesus' crew were walkin' to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles out from Jerusalem.

14.text: They was talkin' back and forth about everything that just went down.

15.text: While they was goin' back and forth, Jesus Himself rolled up and started walkin' with 'em.

16.text: But they ain't recognize Him—they was too caught up.

17.text: Jesus said, "What y'all talkin' 'bout that got y'all lookin' so down?"

18.text: One of them, Cleopas, said, "You new in town or somethin'? You don't know what just happened?"

19.text: Jesus played along like, "What happened?" They said, "The stuff about Jesus from Nazareth—He was a prophet, powerful in what He said and what He did, straight from God."

20.text: "But the priests and leaders handed Him over, and He got sentenced to death and crucified."

21.text: "We thought He was the one who'd free Israel. But now it's been three days since He died."

22.text: "And some women from our squad had us shook—they hit the tomb early…"

23.text: "They didn't find His body but said they saw angels who told 'em He was alive."

24.text: "Some of us went to check, and yep—it was just like the women said. But nobody saw Him."

25.text: Then Jesus said, "Y'all slow to catch on and believe what the prophets said!"

26.text: "Wasn't it necessary for the Christ to go through all that and then step into glory?"

27.text: And starting with Moses and all the Prophets, He broke it all down to them—how the Scriptures was all pointin' to Him.

28.text: They got close to the village, and Jesus acted like He was gonna keep goin'.

29.text: But they was like, "Nah, stay with us. It's gettin' late." So He came in with them.

30.text: When they sat down to eat, He took the bread, blessed it, broke it, and passed it out.

31.text: And BAM—their eyes opened and they realized it was Him! Then just like that, He vanished.

32.text: They said, "Bruh! Didn't our hearts burn when He was talkin' on the road and breakin' down Scripture?"

33.text: So they got up right then, ran back to Jerusalem, and found the eleven and the others.

34.text: The crew was like, "The Lord really is alive—He showed up to Simon!"

35.text: Then the two told their story from the road—and how they realized it was Jesus when He broke the bread.

36.text: While they was still talkin', Jesus Himself pulled up in the room and said, "Peace, y'all."

37.text: They was shook—thought they was seein' a ghost.

38.text: Jesus said, "Why y'all trippin'? What's got y'all doubting?"

39.text: "Look at My hands and feet—it's really Me. Touch Me. Ghosts don't have skin and bones like this."

40.text: Then He showed 'em His hands and feet.

41.text: They still couldn't believe it—not 'cause they doubted, but 'cause it was too good to be true. So Jesus said, "Y'all got any food?"

42.text: They gave Him some broiled fish and honeycomb.

43.text: He ate it right there in front of 'em.

44.text: Then He said, "Remember what I told y'all back when I was still walkin' with you—that everything in Moses' Law, the Prophets, and Psalms about Me had to happen?"

45.text: Then He opened their minds so they could understand the Scriptures.

46.text: He said, "Look, the Bible already said it—the Christ had to suffer, rise up on the third day…"

47.text: "And that repentance and forgiveness would be preached in His name to all nations, startin' right here in Jerusalem."

48.text: "Y'all are the ones who saw it go down—you My witnesses."

49.text: "Now hold tight in Jerusalem 'til y'all get that promise from the Father—the power from on high."

50.text: Then He took them out near Bethany, raised His hands, and blessed them.

51.text: While He was blessin' 'em, He started floatin'—taken up to heaven.

52.text: They dropped to worship, then went back to Jerusalem turnt up with joy.

53.text: And every day, they stayed at the temple, praisin' and blessin' God. Amen.

1.text: This how the story start—the good news bout Jesus Christ, God's Son.

2.text: Just like the prophets said: "I'm sendin' My messenger ahead of You, he gon' clear the way."

3.text: A voice cryin' out in the wild sayin': "Get ready for the Lord to come through. Straighten out His path."

4.text: So John showed up in the wild, dunkin' folks in the Jordan River, tellin' 'em to repent so they could get their sins wiped clean.

5.text: Everybody from Judea and Jerusalem came through, confessin' their mess and gettin' baptized.

6.text: John was rockin' camel hair with a leather belt, and his meals? Locusts and wild honey.

7.text: He was preachin', sayin', "Somebody stronger than me comin' up after this. I ain't even worthy to lace His sandals.

8.text: I baptize y'all with water, but He gon' baptize y'all with the Holy Ghost."

9.text: Around that time, Jesus came from Nazareth up in Galilee, and John baptized Him in the Jordan.

10.text: Soon as Jesus came up out that water, the sky cracked open and the Spirit came down like a dove.

11.text: Then a voice from heaven said, "You My Son. I love You. I'm proud of You."

12.text: Right after that, the Spirit led Jesus into the wilderness.

13.text: He stayed out there forty days, gettin' tested by Satan. He was chillin' with wild animals, and angels came through to look after Him.

14.text: After John got locked up, Jesus hit Galilee preachin' the gospel from God.

15.text: He said, "The time is now. God's Kingdom pullin' up. Turn from your old ways and believe this good news."

16.text: Jesus was walkin' by the Sea of Galilee and saw Simon and Andrew tossin' nets—they was fishin'.

17.text: He told 'em, "Come roll with Me, and I'll show y'all how to fish for people."

18.text: They dropped their nets with the quickness and followed Him.

19.text: A little further down, He saw James and John (Zebedee's sons) in the boat fixin' nets.

20.text: He called them too, and they left their daddy and the workers right there and followed Jesus.

21.text: They all rolled into Capernaum, and on the Sabbath, Jesus hit the synagogue and started teachin'.

22.text: Folks were shook by how He taught—like He really knew what He was talkin' about, not like the regular religious teachers.

23.text: Then this man with a dirty spirit popped off right there,

24.text: sayin', "What you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? You here to destroy us? I know who You are—God's Holy One!"

25.text: Jesus checked that spirit quick: "Shut up and get outta him."

26.text: The demon made the man spazz out and screamed loud, then bounced.

27.text: Everybody was wildin' like, "Yo! Who is this dude? Even demons listen to Him?"

28.text: Word spread all over Galilee fast.

29.text: Soon as they left the synagogue, they went to Simon and Andrew's crib, with James and John.

30.text: Simon's mother-in-law had a fever, and they told Jesus.

31.text: He grabbed her hand, helped her up—and boom, fever gone. She got up and started serving.

32.text: That night, after sunset, folks brought everybody sick and demon-possessed to Jesus.

33.text: The whole city was posted at the door.

34.text: Jesus healed all kinds of diseases and cast out a bunch of demons. He wouldn't let 'em talk though—they already knew who He was.

35.text: Before the sun came up, Jesus dipped to a quiet spot and prayed.

36.text: Simon and the crew went lookin' for Him.

37.text: When they found Him, they said, "Everybody lookin' for You!"

38.text: Jesus said, "Let's hit up the next towns. That's why I came—to preach everywhere."

39.text: And that's what He did—preachin' in synagogues and castin' out demons across Galilee.

40.text: A man with leprosy came beggin' Jesus on his knees, "If You want to, You can heal me."

41.text: Jesus felt that. He touched him and said, "I want to. Be healed."

42.text: Right then, the leprosy bounced. The man was clean.

43.text: Jesus told him sternly, "Don't tell nobody.

44.text: Go show the priest and make the offering Moses talked about as proof you clean."

45.text: But the man was too hyped—he ran and told everybody. Because of that, Jesus couldn't move around openly. He stayed out in quiet spots, but people still pulled up from all over.

1.text: A few days later, Jesus pulled up in Capernaum again, and folks found out He was in the house.

2.text: People came runnin'—so many that the place was packed, even outside the door. Jesus was in there preachin' the word.

3.text: Then these four dudes came through carryin' they paralyzed homeboy on a mat.

4.text: They couldn't get through the crowd, so they climbed up, tore open the roof, and lowered him down right in front of Jesus.

5.text: Jesus peeped their faith and said to the man, "Son, your sins forgiven."

6.text: Some of the teachers of the law was sittin' there, thinkin' to themselves,

7.text: "Who this man think He is? Only God can forgive sins."

8.text: Jesus, knowin' what they was thinkin' deep down, said, "Why y'all trippin' in your hearts?

9.text: What's easier—to say 'your sins are forgiven' or 'get up and walk'?

10.text: But just so y'all know the Son of Man got authority down here to forgive sin…" He turned to the man and said,

11.text: "Get up, take your mat, and go home."

12.text: And just like that, dude stood up, grabbed his mat, and walked out in front of everybody. Folks was stunned—like "We ain't never seen nothin' like this!"

13.text: Jesus went back out by the water, and crowds gathered again. He kept teachin'.

14.text: He saw Levi (also known as Matthew), chillin' at the tax booth. Jesus said, "Follow Me," and Levi got up and followed.

15.text: Later on, Jesus was eatin' dinner at Levi's house. A bunch of tax collectors and folks labeled "sinners" was there too. They liked rollin' with Jesus.

16.text: But when the religious folks saw Him eatin' with them, they asked the disciples, "Why He hangin' with folks like that?"

17.text: Jesus heard and clapped back: "Healthy folks don't need a doctor—sick folks do. I didn't come for the so-called righteous, but for the ones who know they need help."

18.text: Some folks came up—John's disciples and the Pharisees' crew—and said, "Why your disciples ain't fasting like we do?"

19.text: Jesus told 'em, "You don't fast at a wedding while the groom's still there, right? Nah, you celebrate.

20.text: But once the groom gone, then yeah—they'll fast."

21.text: "Look—nobody patches old clothes with brand new cloth, or the rip just gets worse.

22.text: Same with wine—new wine don't go in old wineskins. It'll bust 'em wide open. New wine gotta go in fresh skins."

23.text: One Sabbath day, Jesus and His boys was walkin' through some grainfields. They started pickin' off grain as they walked.

24.text: Pharisees popped off like, "Yo! Why they breakin' Sabbath law?"

25.text: Jesus hit 'em with a throwback: "Y'all forgot what David did when he and his people was hungry?

26.text: He went in God's house, took the holy bread—meant only for priests—and fed his crew."

27.text: Then He dropped the mic: "The Sabbath was made for man, not the other way around.

28.text: So yeah—the Son of Man is Lord, even of the Sabbath."

1.text: Jesus slid back into the synagogue, and there was a man in there with a messed-up hand.

2.text: The haters was watchin' Him close, tryna catch Him slippin' if He healed on the Sabbath, so they could come for Him.

3.text: Jesus looked at the man and said, "Come stand up here in front of everybody."

4.text: Then He looked at the crowd and asked, "Y'all tell me—is it right to do good or evil on the Sabbath? Save a life or let somebody die?" But they ain't say nothin'.

5.text: Jesus looked around, mad and hurt at how cold-hearted they were. Then He told the man, "Stretch your hand out." And when the man did, his hand was fully healed—just like the other one.

6.text: The Pharisees dipped out and linked up with the Herodians right then, plottin' on how to take Jesus out.

7.text: Jesus and His crew headed out toward the lake, and a crowd followed—folks from Galilee, Judea,

8.text: Jerusalem, Idumea, the east side of the Jordan, even Tyre and Sidon. Word had spread about what He was doin', so they all pulled up.

9.text: Jesus told His disciples to keep a boat nearby, just in case the crowd got too wild and pressed in on Him.

10.text: He had healed so many folks that everybody with somethin' wrong was tryna touch Him.

11.text: Even unclean spirits would fall out when they saw Him, yellin', "You the Son of God!"

12.text: But Jesus would shut 'em down quick, tellin' them not to say who He was.

13.text: Jesus went up the mountain and called the ones He wanted. They came.

14.text: He chose twelve of them to roll with Him and to be sent out to preach,

15.text: and to have power to heal and cast out demons.

16.text: He picked Simon and called him Peter,

17.text: James and John (Zebedee's sons), and He nicknamed them Boanerges, which means "Sons of Thunder."

18.text: Then Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James (son of Alphaeus), Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot,

19.text: and Judas Iscariot—the same one who ended up betrayin' Him. Then they went inside a house.

20.text: The crowd came back together, deep again, to the point Jesus and them couldn't even eat.

21.text: When His family heard what was goin' on, they tried to go get Him, sayin', "He done lost His mind."

22.text: Some scribes came down from Jerusalem and said, "He got Beelzebub in Him. That's how He castin' out demons—by the prince of demons."

23.text: Jesus called them over and told 'em stories: "How Satan gon' cast out Satan?

24.text: If a kingdom beefin' with itself, it ain't gon' last.

25.text: Same thing with a house divided—it falls apart.

26.text: So if Satan is fightin' himself, he already done.

27.text: Nobody breaks into a strong man's house and takes his stuff unless he ties that man up first. Then he can rob him clean."

28.text: "Listen close—every sin, every wild word people say, can be forgiven.

29.text: But if you disrespect the Holy Spirit? That's different. That's a forever sin. No forgiveness for that—just judgment."

30.text: He said that 'cause they kept sayin' He had an unclean spirit.

31.text: Then Jesus' mama and brothers showed up, standin' outside, callin' for Him.

32.text: The crowd told Him, "Hey, your family outside askin' for you."

33.text: But Jesus said, "Who y'all think my real family is?"

34.text: He looked around at the folks sittin' with Him and said, "Here go my real family."

35.text: "Anybody doin' God's will? That's my brother, my sister, and my mama."

1.text: Jesus started teachin' again by the lake. A huge crowd pulled up, so He got in a boat and sat out on the water, while everybody stood on land listenin'.

2.text: He dropped a lotta wisdom using parables. And this is how He kicked it off:

3.text: "Listen up! A farmer went out to plant some seeds.

4.text: As he threw them out, some landed on the roadside. Birds came through quick and ate it up.

5.text: Some hit rocky ground, where there wasn't much dirt. They popped up fast, since the soil wasn't deep.

6.text: But the sun came out, and since they ain't have no roots, they dried up quick.

7.text: Other seeds landed where thorns were growin'. The thorns choked 'em out—no harvest.

8.text: But some landed on good soil. Those seeds grew, multiplied, and brought back thirty, sixty, even a hundred times more than what was planted."

9.text: Then He said, "If you got ears, listen close."

10.text: Later on, when it was just Him and the Twelve, they asked about the parables.

11.text: He told them, "Y'all been given the inside scoop on the Kingdom of God. But to everybody else, I gotta speak in code.

12.text: So that, 'They see it, but they don't get it, They hear it, but it don't click— Otherwise, they'd turn around, And get forgiven.'"

13.text: Then He said, "Y'all don't understand this one? How you gon' catch the rest?

14.text: The farmer is plantin' the word.

15.text: The ones on the path? That's folks who hear it, but Satan snatch it before it sinks in.

16.text: The rocky ground? That's folks who get hype real fast,

17.text: but they shallow. Soon as life gets hard or people come for them over the word, they fall off.

18.text: The ones planted in the thorns? They hear it too,

19.text: but life stress, money lies, and all that shiny stuff choke it out—no fruit, no change.

20.text: But the good soil? That's folks who hear the word, hold on to it, and let it grow—some see 30x, 60x, or 100x returns."

21.text: He said, "You don't light a lamp and hide it under the bed, right? Nah, you put it up where it shine.

22.text: 'Cause whatever's in the dark gon' come to light.

23.text: If you got ears, then use 'em."

24.text: Then He added, "Pay attention to what you listen to. However you measure others, that same energy comin' back to you—with interest.

25.text: Whoever got somethin' gon' get even more. But the one slackin'? Even that little bit gon' be snatched."

26.text: He said, "The Kingdom of God is like this: A man plants seeds, goes to sleep, wakes up—day in, day out—

27.text: and the seeds grow on their own. He don't even know how.

28.text: The earth just does what it do: first the blade, then the head, then the full grain.

29.text: And when the crop ready, he grabs the sickle—it's harvest time."

30.text: Then He asked, "What can we compare the Kingdom to? How we gon' paint this picture?

31.text: It's like a mustard seed. Smallest thing you ever seen when it's planted,

32.text: but when it grow? It turn into the biggest plant out there—branches so big even birds chill in its shade."

33.text: Jesus kept teachin' like this, droppin' parables that the crowd could handle.

34.text: He ain't teach without a parable. But when He got His crew alone, He broke it all down.

35.text: That same day, when night hit, He told them, "Let's head across to the other side."

36.text: They left the crowd, and the disciples took Him just like He was in the boat. A few other boats followed too.

37.text: Then outta nowhere, a huge storm hit—waves slammin' into the boat. Water was floodin' in.

38.text: Meanwhile, Jesus was chillin' in the back, sleep on a pillow. They woke Him up like, "Teacher! You don't care we about to drown?"

39.text: He stood up, told the wind, "Chill out!" and told the waves, "Be still!" Everything got quiet. Calm like never before.

40.text: Then He looked at them and said, "Why y'all so shook? Where's your faith?"

41.text: They were shook for real now. Whisperin' to each other, "Who is this man? Even the wind and the waves do what He say!"

1.text: Jesus and them pulled up on the other side of the lake, in the area of the Gadarenes.

2.text: Soon as He stepped out the boat, this man with an unclean spirit came runnin' from the graveyard to meet Him.

3.text: Dude was livin' out there in the tombs. Nobody could hold him down—not even with chains.

4.text: They tried shackles and chains before, but he kept snappin' out of 'em like it was nothin'. Nobody could calm him down.

5.text: All day and night, he'd be out in the hills or in the tombs, screamin' and cuttin' himself with stones.

6.text: When he saw Jesus from a distance, he ran up and bowed down before Him.

7.text: He shouted real loud, "What do You want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You, don't torture me!"

8.text: (That's 'cause Jesus had already said, "Come outta that man, unclean spirit!")

9.text: Then Jesus asked, "What's your name?" The spirit answered, "My name is Legion, 'cause we deep."

10.text: And the demons begged Jesus not to send them out the area.

11.text: There was a huge herd of pigs eatin' nearby on the hillside.

12.text: The demons said, "Let us go into those pigs!"

13.text: Jesus gave the word, and boom—those spirits jumped in the pigs. Around 2,000 pigs ran wild down the hill straight into the lake and drowned.

14.text: The pig herders took off runnin' and told everybody in town and the countryside. Folks came to see what went down.

15.text: When they got there, they saw the man who used to be possessed sittin' there dressed, calm, and sane. And folks got shook.

16.text: The ones who saw it firsthand told the story about the man and what happened to the pigs.

17.text: Then the people started beggin' Jesus to leave they area.

18.text: As Jesus got in the boat, the man who had been delivered tried to go with Him.

19.text: But Jesus told him, "Nah, go back home to your people. Tell 'em all the good things the Lord did for you, and how He looked out with compassion."

20.text: So the man went through the whole region of Decapolis tellin' everybody what Jesus did for him. Folks were amazed.

21.text: Jesus went back across the lake, and a big crowd gathered by the water.

22.text: One of the synagogue leaders, Jairus, showed up. Soon as he saw Jesus, he dropped to his knees.

23.text: He begged Him, "My daughter's dyin'. Please come lay hands on her so she can live."

24.text: Jesus rolled with him, and the crowd was thick around them.

25.text: A woman who had been dealin' with a nonstop blood flow for twelve years was there too.

26.text: She'd been through it—sufferin' under doctors, spent all her money, and only got worse.

27.text: But when she heard about Jesus, she slid through the crowd and touched His clothes from behind.

28.text: She thought, "If I could just touch His clothes, I know I'll be healed."

29.text: And just like that, the bleeding stopped. She felt it—her body was healed for real.

30.text: Jesus felt the power leave Him and turned around, askin', "Who touched my clothes?"

31.text: The disciples was like, "Bruh, you see this crowd pressin' in, and you askin' who touched you?"

32.text: But He kept lookin' around tryin' to spot who did it.

33.text: The woman stepped up, nervous and shaky, and fell at His feet tellin' the whole truth.

34.text: Jesus told her, "Daughter, your faith healed you. Go in peace, and be free from your suffering."

35.text: While He was still speakin', folks came from Jairus' house sayin', "Your daughter's dead. Don't bother the Teacher anymore."

36.text: But Jesus didn't trip. He looked at Jairus and said, "Don't be scared. Just believe."

37.text: He only let Peter, James, and John roll with Him from there.

38.text: When they got to the house, it was chaos—folks cryin', screamin', carryin' on.

39.text: Jesus walked in like, "Why all the drama? The girl ain't dead, she just sleepin'."

40.text: They laughed at Him. But He made 'em all step outside. Then He took the girl's mom, dad, and the three disciples in the room with Him.

41.text: He grabbed the girl's hand and said, "Talitha, cumi," which means, "Little girl, I'm tellin' you—get up!"

42.text: Instantly, the twelve-year-old girl got up and started walkin' around. Everybody there was shook and amazed.

43.text: Jesus told them, "Keep this on the low," and then said, "Get her somethin' to eat."

1.text: Jesus left that place and went back to His hometown. His disciples rolled with Him.

2.text: When Sabbath came, He started teachin' in the synagogue. Folks heard Him and was shocked like, "Where He get all this from? How He talkin' this wise? And how He doin' all these miracles with His hands?"

3.text: "Ain't this the carpenter? Mary's son? James, Joses, Judas, and Simon's brother? Ain't His sisters right here with us?" They got offended—mad uncomfortable with who He was.

4.text: But Jesus told 'em, "A prophet get respect everywhere except in his own hometown, with his own people, and even in his own house."

5.text: He couldn't do no big miracles there, just laid hands on a few sick folks and healed them.

6.text: He was amazed at how little faith they had. So He kept it movin', goin' around to other villages teachin'.

7.text: Jesus called up the Twelve and sent 'em out two by two. Gave them authority to cast out evil spirits.

8.text: He told 'em, "Don't take nothin' for the road—just a staff. No food, no bag, no coins in your pockets."

9.text: "Wear sandals, but don't pack extra clothes."

10.text: "Wherever y'all stay, stay there 'til you leave that town."

11.text: "If folks don't welcome y'all or listen, shake the dust off your feet when you bounce. That's your sign against them. I'm tellin' you—it'll be easier for Sodom and Gomorrah on judgment day than for that town."

12.text: So they went out preachin', tellin' folks to turn back to God.

13.text: They cast out a bunch of demons, anointed sick people with oil, and healed 'em.

14.text: Word about Jesus got out, and King Herod heard about Him. Herod said, "That must be John the Baptist raised from the dead. That's why He got power like that."

15.text: Some folks was sayin', "Nah, it's Elijah." Others said, "He one of the prophets from back in the day."

16.text: But Herod kept sayin', "Nope, that's John—the one I had beheaded. He back."

17.text: See, Herod had locked John up 'cause of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife—whom he had married.

18.text: John had told Herod, "It ain't right for you to be with your brother's wife."

19.text: Herodias had beef and wanted John dead, but she couldn't pull it off.

20.text: Herod actually respected John. He knew John was righteous and holy. He kept him safe. When he listened to John, he got real conflicted, but he liked hearin' him speak.

21.text: One day on Herod's birthday, he threw a party for his big shots and leaders.

22.text: Herodias's daughter came in and danced. She had everybody—including Herod—impressed. So the king told her, "Ask me anything you want—I got you."

23.text: He even swore, "I'll give you whatever you want, up to half my kingdom."

24.text: She ran to her mama and asked, "What should I ask for?" Her mama said, "The head of John the Baptist."

25.text: The girl rushed back to the king and said, "I want John the Baptist's head—on a platter. Right now."

26.text: Herod felt sick about it. But 'cause of his promise—and everybody watchin'—he ain't wanna go back on his word.

27.text: So he sent the executioner to the prison. Dude chopped off John's head,

28.text: brought it back on a platter, and gave it to the girl. Then she gave it to her mama.

29.text: When John's disciples heard what happened, they came, got his body, and laid it in a tomb.

30.text: The apostles came back to Jesus and told Him everything they'd done and taught.

31.text: He said, "Come on, let's dip to a quiet place and rest." Folks had been runnin' up all day—they ain't even had time to eat.

32.text: So they got in a boat and left for a quiet spot by themselves.

33.text: But people saw them leave and ran from all the towns to meet them. They got there before Jesus and His crew did.

34.text: When Jesus got out the boat, He saw the huge crowd and felt for them—they was like sheep with no shepherd. So He started teachin' them a bunch.

35.text: It was gettin' late. The disciples came up like, "We out in the sticks and it's already late."

36.text: "Send the folks away so they can go buy food in the nearby towns."

37.text: But Jesus said, "Nah, y'all feed them." They said, "You want us to spend 200 silver coins on bread for everybody?"

38.text: Jesus said, "How many loaves y'all got? Go check." They came back sayin', "Five loaves and two fish."

39.text: He told everybody to sit down in groups on the green grass.

40.text: So they sat down in sections—some in hundreds, some in fifties.

41.text: Jesus took the five loaves and two fish, looked up to heaven, blessed the food, broke the loaves, and handed them to the disciples to pass out. He split the fish too, and made sure everybody got some.

42.text: Everybody ate till they was full.

43.text: Then they picked up twelve baskets full of leftovers.

44.text: Over 5,000 men ate that meal.

45.text: Right after that, Jesus told His disciples to get in the boat and head to Bethsaida. He stayed back to send the crowd away.

46.text: After the crowd left, He went up a mountain to pray.

47.text: That evening, the boat was in the middle of the lake, and Jesus was still on land.

48.text: He saw them strugglin' to row 'cause the wind was wild. Around 3 a.m., He walked out to them—on the water! He was about to pass them.

49.text: But they saw Him walkin' on the sea and thought He was a ghost. They screamed.

50.text: They all saw Him and was shook. But He said, "Chill out. It's Me. Don't be scared."

51.text: He climbed in the boat, and the wind calmed down. They was shook, mind blown.

52.text: They ain't get the miracle with the loaves—'cause their hearts was still hard.

53.text: When they crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret and docked the boat.

54.text: Soon as they got off, people recognized Jesus.

55.text: Folks ran all through the area, bringing sick people on mats to wherever they heard Jesus was.

56.text: Wherever He went—villages, towns, or countryside—people brought the sick out to the streets. They begged just to touch His cloak. And whoever touched Him? Got healed.

1.text: Some Pharisees and a few scribes pulled up from Jerusalem to check Jesus.

2.text: They saw some of His disciples eating without washing their hands the "right way," and they had a problem with it.

3.text: See, the Pharisees and all the other Jews don't eat unless they wash their hands real specific, followin' what their elders passed down.

4.text: They won't eat after hittin' the market unless they wash up first. They even wash cups, jugs, pots, and couches like it's part of worship.

5.text: So the Pharisees and scribes asked Jesus, "Why Your crew don't follow the elders' traditions? They out here eatin' without even washing up."

6.text: Jesus said, "Isaiah was talkin' about y'all when he called folks hypocrites: 'These people honor Me with their words, but their hearts? They way off.'

7.text: They worship Me for nothin', just teachin' man-made rules like they God's word."

8.text: "Y'all be ditchin' God's commands just to keep your little traditions. Washing pitchers and cups like that's gon' save you."

9.text: "You real slick with it—always tossin' God's law to the side so you can protect your customs."

10.text: "Moses said, 'Honor your mama and daddy,' and, 'If you curse 'em, you dead.'

11.text: But y'all say, 'If a man tells his parents, "What I was gon' do for you is now Corban—a gift to God,"

12.text: then he ain't gotta do nothin' for them.' Like, what?

13.text: You makin' God's Word useless just to hold onto these man-made hand-me-down rules. And this ain't the only thing y'all be doin'."

14.text: Then Jesus turned to the crowd and said, "Y'all listen up and get this:

15.text: Ain't nothin' from outside a person that can make them dirty spiritually. It's what come out they mouth, out they heart—that's the real mess."

16.text: "If you got ears, hear what I'm sayin'."

17.text: When they got inside the house, away from the crowd, the disciples was like, "Umm, so about that parable…"

18.text: Jesus looked at them like, "Y'all don't get it either? Whatever goes in your mouth don't touch your heart—it just hit your stomach and slide out. That ain't what messes you up."

19.text: (And just like that, Jesus made all foods clean.)

20.text: He kept goin': "It's what come outta folks that defiles them.

21.text: From deep inside—out the heart—come evil thoughts, cheating, sex outside God's plan, murder,

22.text: stealing, greed, wickedness, lying, wild living, jealousy, slander, pride, and dumb decisions.

23.text: All that mess come from within, and that's what makes somebody dirty."

24.text: After that, Jesus dipped out to Tyre and Sidon. He tried to keep a low profile, but word got out.

25.text: A woman with a daughter who had a demon in her came through, dropped to His feet.

26.text: She wasn't Jewish—she was Syro-Phoenician. But she was beggin' Jesus to cast the demon out her child.

27.text: Jesus said, "Let the children eat first. It ain't right to take their food and toss it to dogs."

28.text: She fired back, "Yeah, but even the dogs get the crumbs that fall off the kids' table."

29.text: Jesus said, "Whew, sis! That kind of faith? Go 'head. That demon gone."

30.text: She ran back home and found her daughter chillin' on the bed, demon-free.

31.text: Jesus left Tyre and Sidon and went back around to the Sea of Galilee, through the region of Decapolis.

32.text: Some folks brought Him a man who couldn't hear and barely talked. They was beggin' Jesus to lay hands on him.

33.text: Jesus took the man away from the crowd, put His fingers in the guy's ears, then spit and touched his tongue.

34.text: Lookin' up to heaven, Jesus sighed and said, "Ephphatha," which means, "Be opened."

35.text: Instantly the man could hear, and his tongue loosened up. He started speakin' clear.

36.text: Jesus told them not to tell nobody, but they couldn't hold it in. The more He told them, the more they ran tellin' everybody.

37.text: Folks was shook in the best way. "This man do everything right! He makin' the deaf hear and the mute talk!"

1.text: Back in those days, a big crowd had gathered, and folks was hungry. Jesus called His crew together and said,

2.text: "Man, I feel for these people. They been rollin' with Me three whole days and ain't had nothin' to eat.

3.text: If I send 'em home now, stomachs empty, they gon' pass out on the way. Some of 'em came from way out."

4.text: The disciples were like, "How we supposed to feed this many people out here in the middle of nowhere?"

5.text: Jesus said, "How many loaves y'all got?" They said, "Seven."

6.text: So Jesus told the crowd to sit down. He grabbed the bread, gave thanks, broke it up, and gave it to the disciples to pass around.

7.text: They had a few little fish too, so He blessed those and had 'em serve that as well.

8.text: Everybody ate till they were full. Then they picked up seven big baskets of leftovers.

9.text: Around four thousand people got fed. Then Jesus sent them home.

10.text: He and His crew hopped in the boat and headed for Dalmanutha.

11.text: The Pharisees pulled up like haters, tryna test Him. "Show us a sign from heaven!" they said.

12.text: Jesus sighed deep—like real deep—and said, "Why y'all always need a sign? I promise y'all ain't gettin' one."

13.text: Then He left 'em behind and went back across the water.

14.text: Meanwhile, the disciples realized they forgot to bring bread—only had one loaf in the boat.

15.text: Jesus told them, "Look… watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and Herod."

16.text: They looked at each other like, "See? It's 'cause we ain't bring bread."

17.text: Jesus caught on real quick: "Y'all serious right now? Still don't get it? Heart still hard?

18.text: You got eyes but can't see? Ears but can't hear? Don't y'all remember what just happened?"

19.text: "When I broke the five loaves for the 5,000, how many baskets y'all pick up?" They said, "Twelve."

20.text: "And when I fed the 4,000 with seven loaves?" They said, "Seven baskets."

21.text: "So how y'all still don't get it?"

22.text: They pulled up in Bethsaida. Some folks brought a blind man to Jesus, beggin' for a touch.

23.text: Jesus took the man by the hand and walked him outta town. Then He spit on the man's eyes and laid hands on him. "You see anything?"

24.text: The man looked up and said, "I see people… they look like trees walkin'."

25.text: Jesus laid hands on him again, and this time? He saw everything clearly.

26.text: Jesus said, "Go home. Don't even stop in town or tell nobody."

27.text: Then Jesus and the crew headed to the towns around Caesarea Philippi. On the road He asked, "Who people say I am?"

28.text: They said, "Some say John the Baptist. Others think you Elijah. Some say you just one of the prophets."

29.text: He asked, "But what about y'all? Who do you say I am?" Peter said, "You the Christ."

30.text: Jesus told them, "Don't tell nobody."

31.text: Then He started tellin' them straight up: "The Son of Man's gon' suffer, be rejected by the elders and top priests, get killed, and rise after three days."

32.text: He said it plain. But Peter pulled Him aside and started rebuking Him.

33.text: Jesus turned around, looked at the disciples, and said to Peter, "Get behind Me, Satan. You ain't focused on God's business—just human stuff."

34.text: Then He called everybody together, not just the Twelve. "If you wanna follow Me, deny yourself, pick up your cross, and let's go.

35.text: If you tryna save your own life, you gon' lose it. But if you lose your life for Me and this message? You gon' find it.

36.text: What good is it to win the whole world but lose your soul?

37.text: What could you trade for your soul anyway?

38.text: If you ashamed of Me and My words in this fake and sinful generation, the Son of Man gon' be ashamed of you when He show up in His Father's glory with the holy angels."

1.text: Jesus said, "Let Me tell y'all something real: some of y'all right here ain't gon' die 'til you see the Kingdom show up in full power."

2.text: Six days later, Jesus took Peter, James, and John up on a high mountain. Just them. Then boom—He changed right in front of their eyes.

3.text: His clothes started shinin' bright, whiter than any bleach could ever get 'em.

4.text: Outta nowhere, Elijah and Moses popped up, choppin' it up with Jesus.

5.text: Peter, nervous and not really knowing what to say, was like, "Rabbi, it's good we here. Let's build three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, one for Elijah."

6.text: He was shook, talkin' off nerves.

7.text: Then a cloud pulled up, and a voice came out it: "This right here is My Son, who I love. Y'all better listen to Him!"

8.text: And just like that, Moses and Elijah vanished. Only Jesus was left with them.

9.text: On the way down the mountain, Jesus told them, "Don't tell nobody what y'all saw until the Son of Man rises from the dead."

10.text: They kept quiet but kept wonderin', "What He mean 'rise from the dead'?"

11.text: Then they asked, "Why the teachers say Elijah gotta come first?"

12.text: Jesus said, "Yeah, Elijah comes first to fix things. But why y'all think it's written that the Son of Man gotta suffer and get rejected?

13.text: Elijah already came. And they did him dirty, just like the scriptures said."

14.text: When they came back down, a big crowd had formed, and some scribes were arguin' with the other disciples.

15.text: Soon as folks saw Jesus, they were amazed and ran over.

16.text: Jesus was like, "What y'all talkin' about?"

17.text: A man spoke up: "Teacher, I brought my son—he got a mute spirit.

18.text: It throws him down, makes him foam at the mouth, grind his teeth, lock up. I asked Your disciples to help, but they couldn't."

19.text: Jesus sighed, "Man, this faithless generation… how long I gotta deal with y'all? Bring him here."

20.text: They brought the boy. As soon as the spirit saw Jesus, it threw the boy into a fit—he hit the ground rollin', foamin' up.

21.text: Jesus asked his dad, "How long this been goin' on?" He said, "Since he was a kid.

22.text: Sometimes the spirit try to kill him—throwin' him in fire or water. But if You can do anything, please help us."

23.text: Jesus said, "If I can? Everything's possible if you believe."

24.text: The father cried out, "I believe! But help me where I still got doubts!"

25.text: Jesus saw the crowd growing, so He rebuked the spirit: "You deaf and mute demon, I command you, come out and don't come back!"

26.text: The spirit screamed, convulsed the boy hard, then left. The boy looked dead—folks thought he was gone.

27.text: But Jesus grabbed his hand, lifted him up, and he stood up whole.

28.text: Later on, the disciples asked Jesus privately, "Why couldn't we cast it out?"

29.text: He said, "This one only comes out by prayer and fasting."

30.text: They left and passed through Galilee, but Jesus kept it lowkey.

31.text: He told His disciples, "The Son of Man gon' be betrayed, killed, and rise after three days."

32.text: They didn't get it… and were too scared to ask.

33.text: In Capernaum, Jesus asked, "What was y'all arguin' about on the road?"

34.text: They stayed quiet—'cause they'd been debating who was the GOAT among them.

35.text: Jesus sat down like a real teacher and said, "If you wanna be first, be last. Be a servant to everybody."

36.text: Then He grabbed a little kid, put him in front of them, and said,

37.text: "Whoever welcomes a child like this in My name welcomes Me—and not just Me, but the One who sent Me."

38.text: John said, "Teacher, we saw someone casting out demons in Your name. We tried to shut him down 'cause he ain't one of us."

39.text: Jesus said, "Don't do that. If he using My name to do good, he ain't gon' turn and speak evil of Me.

40.text: If they ain't against us, they with us.

41.text: Anybody who give y'all a drink just because you belong to Me? They ain't gon' lose their reward."

42.text: "But if you cause one of these little believers to stumble? It'd be better for you to get tossed in the sea with a millstone chained to your neck."

43.text: "If your hand makes you sin, cut it off. Better to go to Heaven with one hand than to end up in hell with two.

44.text: Where the fire never quits and the worms don't die.

45.text: Same with your foot. If it makes you stumble, cut it off.

46.text: Where the fire never quits and the worms don't die.

47.text: If your eye keeps dragging you into sin, pluck it out. Better to step into God's Kingdom with one eye than land in hellfire with both.

48.text: That place where the worms don't die and the flames don't quit."

49.text: "Everybody gon' get seasoned with fire—some refinement, some testing.

50.text: Salt is good, but if you lose your flavor, how you gon' get it back? Be seasoned—stay salty in a righteous way. And live in peace with each other."

1.text: Jesus left that spot and went down to Judea, across the Jordan. Folks crowded around again, and like always, He started teachin' them.

2.text: Then here come the Pharisees tryna trap Him, askin', "Is it cool for a man to divorce his wife?"

3.text: Jesus hit back, "What did Moses say?"

4.text: They said, "Moses said we could write divorce papers and send her away."

5.text: Jesus was like, "Yeah, but that was 'cause y'all hearts hard. That ain't how God wanted it from the jump.

6.text: Since creation, God made 'em male and female.

7.text: That's why a man leaves his momma and daddy and gets locked in with his wife,

8.text: And the two become one body. Not two no more, but one.

9.text: So what God put together, don't let nobody tear apart."

10.text: Later, the disciples brought it back up at the house.

11.text: Jesus said, "If a man divorces his wife and marries somebody else, he cheatin' on her.

12.text: Same thing for a woman divorcing her man and gettin' remarried—it's adultery."

13.text: People started bringin' kids to Jesus so He could bless them, but the disciples tried to shut it down.

14.text: Jesus wasn't havin' it. He got tight and said, "Let these babies come to Me! Don't stop 'em. The Kingdom belongs to folks who come like this.

15.text: If you don't receive the Kingdom like a lil child, you ain't gettin' in."

16.text: Then He picked them kids up, laid hands on 'em, and blessed them.

17.text: As Jesus was leavin', this man came runnin', dropped to his knees and asked, "Good Teacher, what I gotta do to get eternal life?"

18.text: Jesus said, "Why you callin' Me good? Ain't nobody good but God.

19.text: You know the rules—don't cheat, don't kill, don't steal, don't lie, don't scam, respect your parents."

20.text: The man said, "Been doin' that since I was a kid."

21.text: Jesus looked at him with love and said, "One thing missing—go sell all your stuff, give the money to the poor, then come follow Me. You'll have treasure in heaven."

22.text: The man's whole mood dropped. He left sad, 'cause he had a lot of stuff.

23.text: Jesus looked around and said, "It's hard for rich folks to enter the Kingdom."

24.text: The disciples were shook. Jesus said again, "It's hard for folks who trust money to make it into God's Kingdom.

25.text: It's easier for a camel to squeeze through a needle's eye than a rich man to enter."

26.text: They were really shook now: "Then who can anybody be saved?"

27.text: Jesus said, "With people? It ain't happenin'. But with God? Everything possible."

28.text: Peter jumped in: "We gave up everything to follow You!"

29.text: Jesus said, "Anybody who gave up home, family, land for Me and the gospel gon' get way more—not just later, but now too. It'll come with struggle though.

30.text: And eternal life in the next one.

31.text: But don't get it twisted—some folks who look first now? Gon' be last later. And some last now? Gon' be first."

32.text: On the road to Jerusalem, Jesus was walkin' ahead. The disciples were amazed, but lowkey scared.

33.text: He pulled them aside and said, "We goin' up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man gon' get betrayed, sentenced to death, handed over to outsiders.

34.text: They gon' clown Him, spit on Him, beat Him, and kill Him. But three days later? He gettin' up."

35.text: Then James and John came bold, like, "Jesus, do us a favor."

36.text: Jesus was like, "What y'all want?"

37.text: They said, "Let us sit next to You in glory—one on the right, one on the left."

38.text: Jesus said, "Y'all don't even know what you askin'. Can you drink the cup I'ma drink? Can you handle the baptism I'ma go through?"

39.text: They said, "We got it."

40.text: Jesus said, "Okay, y'all will go through some stuff like Me. But where folks sit? That ain't mine to give. That's already been set."

41.text: When the other ten heard what James and John were askin'? Oh they were heated.

42.text: Jesus pulled 'em all in and said, "Look, the world loves to flex power. But y'all? That's not how it's gon' be.

43.text: If you wanna be great, serve.

44.text: If you wanna be first, be everybody's servant.

45.text: Even I ain't come to be served, but to serve—and to give My life to set people free."

46.text: They rolled into Jericho. As they headed out, a big crowd followed. Bartimaeus, a blind man, was beggin' by the road.

47.text: When he heard Jesus was near, he started shoutin', "Jesus! Son of David! Have mercy on me!"

48.text: Folks tried to shut him up, but he got louder: "SON OF DAVID, HAVE MERCY ON ME!"

49.text: Jesus stopped and said, "Call him."

50.text: So they told Bartimaeus, "Cheer up! He callin' you."

51.text: He threw off his cloak, jumped up, and ran to Jesus.

52.text: Jesus asked, "What you want Me to do for you?"

53.text: Bartimaeus said, "Rabbi, I wanna see again."

54.text: Jesus said, "Go ahead—your faith made you well."

55.text: Right then and there, Bartimaeus got his sight… and followed Jesus down the road.

1.text: When they got close to Jerusalem, near Bethphage and Bethany by the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent out two of His disciples.

2.text: He told them, "Go to the village across from here. As soon as you walk in, you gon' see a young donkey tied up that ain't nobody ever rode. Untie it and bring it back.

3.text: And if somebody asks you, 'Why y'all takin' that?' just say, 'The Lord need it,' and they'll let it go."

4.text: So they dipped and found the colt tied up outside on the street, just like Jesus said. They started untyin' it.

5.text: Some folks standing nearby said, "What y'all doin' with that colt?"

6.text: They said exactly what Jesus told 'em to say—and the folks let them go.

7.text: They brought the colt back to Jesus, threw their coats on it, and Jesus sat on it.

8.text: A bunch of people laid their coats down on the road. Others were cuttin' palm branches off trees and laying them down too.

9.text: And the crowd—front and back—started shoutin': "Hosanna! Blessed is the One who comes in the name of the Lord!

10.text: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David, Comin' through in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!"

11.text: Jesus rolled into Jerusalem and walked up in the temple. He looked around at everything, but since it was late, He dipped back out to Bethany with the twelve.

12.text: The next day, they leavin' Bethany and Jesus got hungry.

13.text: He saw a fig tree from a distance with leaves and thought maybe it had somethin'. But when He got there, it was just leaves—wasn't even fig season.

14.text: Jesus said to the tree, "Ain't nobody eatin' from you ever again." His disciples heard it.

15.text: When they got to Jerusalem, Jesus went into the temple and started wildin'—He flipped tables, kicked out the folks buyin' and sellin', and knocked over the dove-sellers' booths.

16.text: He wouldn't even let folks walk through the temple carryin' stuff.

17.text: Then He said, "Ain't it written, 'My house gon' be a house of prayer for all people'? But y'all turned it into a den of thieves."

18.text: The religious leaders heard about it and started plotting to kill Him. They were scared 'cause the people were blown away by how He taught.

19.text: That evening, Jesus left the city.

20.text: The next morning, they passed by that same fig tree, and it was dried up from the roots.
