19.text: 'Cause out the heart come evil thoughts, murder, cheating, sex outside of God's will, theft, lies, and blasphemy.

20.text: That's what defiles you. Eating with unwashed hands ain't the problem."

21.text: Jesus left and went up to Tyre and Sidon.

22.text: A Canaanite woman from the area ran up cryin', "Lord, Son of David! Please help! My daughter possessed by a demon real bad."

23.text: Jesus ain't say a word. His disciples were like, "Can You send her away? She's loud and beggin' nonstop."

24.text: Jesus said, "I was sent for the lost sheep of Israel—My people."

25.text: But she came closer, bowed down, and said, "Lord, help me."

26.text: Jesus said, "It ain't right to take the kids' bread and toss it to the dogs."

27.text: She said, "True… but even the dogs eat the crumbs from the table."

28.text: Jesus lit up and said, "Woman, your faith is somethin' else! It's done—just like you asked." And her daughter got healed right then.

29.text: Jesus moved along by the Sea of Galilee, went up on a mountain, and sat down.

30.text: Big crowds came, bringin' the lame, blind, mute, disabled, and all kinds of sick folks. They dropped them at Jesus' feet—and He healed them.

31.text: People couldn't believe it. Mute folks speakin'. Crippled folks whole again. Lame folks walkin'. Blind folks seein'. And they gave all the glory to the God of Israel.

32.text: Jesus told His disciples, "I'm feelin' for this crowd. They've been with Me three days and they got nothin' left to eat. I can't send them off hungry—they might pass out on the way."

33.text: The disciples said, "Jesus… where we supposed to get enough food for all these folks out here in the middle of nowhere?"

34.text: Jesus said, "How many loaves we got?" They said, "Seven, and a few little fish."

35.text: Jesus told the crowd to sit down on the ground.

36.text: He took the loaves and fish, gave thanks, broke 'em, and handed 'em to His disciples to pass out.

37.text: Everybody ate and got full. Then they picked up seven big baskets of leftovers.

38.text: That day He fed four thousand men—not even countin' all the women and kids.

39.text: After that, Jesus told the crowd to head out. Then He got in a boat and went to the region of Magdala.

1.text: The Pharisees and Sadducees rolled up on Jesus, tryna test Him. They said, "Show us somethin' from heaven—give us a sign."

2.text: Jesus said, "Y'all real quick to call the weather, right? In the evening you say, 'Sky red, it's gon' be nice tomorrow.'

3.text: And in the morning, 'Sky red and cloudy—rain's comin.' Y'all can read the sky, but can't even read the signs of the times.

4.text: Y'all a wicked, unfaithful generation. Always lookin' for signs. The only sign you gon' get is the sign of Jonah." And He dipped on 'em.

5.text: Later on, when they got to the other side, the disciples realized—they forgot to bring bread.

6.text: Jesus told them, "Watch out. Be careful of the leaven from the Pharisees and Sadducees."

7.text: They started whisperin', "He sayin' that 'cause we ain't got no bread."

8.text: Jesus knew what they was thinkin' and said, "Y'all got little faith. Why y'all stressin' about bread?

9.text: Don't y'all remember when I fed five thousand with five loaves? How many baskets y'all picked up?

10.text: Or the four thousand with seven loaves? How many baskets then?

11.text: So how y'all still think I'm talkin' 'bout actual bread? I'm sayin' be careful of the teaching from them Pharisees and Sadducees."

12.text: Then they got it—He wasn't talkin' food. He was talkin' 'bout that fake doctrine they be spreadin'.

13.text: When Jesus got to Caesarea Philippi, He asked His crew, "Who folks say I am?"

14.text: They said, "Some think You John the Baptist, some Elijah, some Jeremiah or one of the prophets."

15.text: He said, "Aight, but who you say I am?"

16.text: Peter spoke up: "You the Christ. The Son of the livin' God."

17.text: Jesus said, "Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah! Ain't no human tell you that—My Father in heaven dropped that revelation.

18.text: And I'm tellin' you, you Peter, and on this rock I'ma build My Church. Hell itself ain't strong enough to stop it.

19.text: I'ma give you the keys to the kingdom. Whatever you lock down on earth gon' be locked in heaven. Whatever you open up on earth gon' be opened in heaven."

20.text: Then He told them, "Don't tell nobody I'm the Christ. Not yet."

21.text: From that point on, Jesus started lettin' them know: "I gotta go to Jerusalem. I'm gon' suffer under the elders, priests, and scribes. They gon' kill Me. But on the third day? I'm risin' up."

22.text: Peter pulled Him aside like, "Lord nah! That can't happen to You!"

23.text: Jesus turned to Peter like, "Get behind Me, Satan! You in My way. You thinkin' like a man—not with God's mindset."

24.text: Then Jesus told the crew, "If you wanna roll with Me, deny yourself. Carry your cross and follow Me.

25.text: Try to save your life? You gon' lose it. But lose it for Me? That's how you find real life.

26.text: What good is gainin' the whole world if you lose your soul in the process? What could you even trade for your soul?

27.text: The Son of Man gon' come through in glory, rollin' with the angels. And He gon' pay everybody back based on what they done.

28.text: Let Me tell you this—some of y'all standin' here right now won't die before you see the Son of Man comin' into His Kingdom."

1.text: Six days later, Jesus took Peter, James, and John (his brother), and they went up on a high mountain—just the four of them.

2.text: While they was up there, Jesus changed right in front of them—His face started shinin' like the sun, and His clothes was bright white like light itself.

3.text: Then outta nowhere, Moses and Elijah showed up, choppin' it up with Jesus.

4.text: Peter jumped in, "Lord, this is perfect! If You want, I'll build three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."

5.text: But while Peter was still talkin', a bright cloud came over them, and a voice boomed from it: "This My Son, the One I love. I'm pleased with Him. Listen to Him!"

6.text: When the disciples heard that, they hit the ground face-first—they was shook.

7.text: But Jesus walked over, touched 'em and said, "Y'all get up. Don't be scared."

8.text: They looked up, and Moses and Elijah was gone—only Jesus was still there.

9.text: As they came down the mountain, Jesus said, "Don't tell nobody what you saw 'til after I rise from the dead."

10.text: The disciples asked Him, "Why do the scribes say Elijah gotta come first?"

11.text: Jesus said, "They right—Elijah is supposed to come and get things back in order.

12.text: But I'm tellin' y'all, Elijah already came, and folks ain't even recognize him. They did him dirty. Same thing gon' happen to the Son of Man."

13.text: Then the disciples realized He was talkin' about John the Baptist.

14.text: When they came back down to the crowd, a man came kneelin' and beggin':

15.text: "Lord, please help my son. He got seizures real bad. Sometimes he fall into fire or water.

16.text: I tried bringin' him to Your disciples, but they couldn't heal him."

17.text: Jesus said, "This generation got no faith and is twisted up… How long I gotta deal with y'all? Bring the boy here."

18.text: Jesus spoke to the demon, rebuked it, and it came out. The boy was healed right then.

19.text: Later, the disciples asked Him in private, "Why couldn't we cast it out?"

20.text: Jesus said, "Because y'all didn't believe enough. I'm tellin' you—for real—for real, if you got faith the size of a mustard seed, you could tell a mountain to move and it would. Nothin' would be impossible.

21.text: But this type of demon? It don't leave unless you fast and pray."

22.text: While they was stayin' in Galilee, Jesus told them, "The Son of Man bout to be handed over.

23.text: They gon' kill Me, but on the third day, I'm gettin' up." The disciples were heartbroken.

24.text: When they got to Capernaum, the temple tax collectors pulled up on Peter like, "Yo, don't your Teacher pay the tax?"

25.text: Peter said, "Yeah, He do." But when he walked into the house, Jesus already knew what was up. He asked, "Let me ask you this, Simon—do kings charge their own sons taxes, or just other people?"

26.text: Peter said, "Other folks." Jesus said, "Exactly. So technically, the sons don't gotta pay.

27.text: But to keep the peace, go fishin'. First fish you catch? Open its mouth—you gon' find some money in there. Take that and pay the tax for both of us."

1.text: The disciples came up like, "Jesus, who really the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?"

2.text: Jesus pulled a little kid over and sat them right in the middle of the group.

3.text: He said, "For real, unless y'all change and become like this lil one, you ain't even gettin' in the kingdom.

4.text: Whoever humble themself like this child—that's who the greatest out here.

5.text: And anybody who welcomes a child like this in My name? You welcoming Me too."

6.text: "If you cause one of these lil ones who believe in Me to mess up? You'd be better off with a stone tied to your neck and tossed in the ocean.

7.text: This world full of temptation and traps—yeah, that's gonna happen. But woe to the one bringin' it.

8.text: If your hand or your foot makin' you sin, cut it off. It's better to roll into eternal life with one arm or leg than to be whole and thrown in the fire.

9.text: Same with your eye—if it's trippin', pluck it out. One eye in heaven beat two in hell."

10.text: "Don't look down on these little ones. I'm tellin' you—they got angels in heaven who stay facin' My Father.

11.text: I came to save the ones who got lost.

12.text: Imagine you got 100 sheep, and one wander off. Ain't you gon' leave the 99 and go lookin' for that one?

13.text: And when you find it? You rejoicin' over that one more than the 99 that stayed put.

14.text: That's how your Father in heaven is—He don't want none of these lil ones to get lost."

15.text: "If your brother or sister wrong you, go talk to them one-on-one. If they listen, boom—you got your sibling back.

16.text: If they don't, bring one or two folks with you, so the truth got witnesses.

17.text: If they still ain't listenin', bring it to the whole church. And if they won't hear the church? Treat 'em like an outsider or tax man.

18.text: I'm sayin' to y'all—whatever y'all lock down on earth is locked in heaven, and whatever y'all free on earth is free in heaven.

19.text: If two of y'all agree on somethin' and ask My Father? He gon' do it.

20.text: 'Cause when two or three gather in My name? I'm right there in the middle."

21.text: Peter said, "Lord, how many times I gotta forgive my brother when he mess up? Seven times?"

22.text: Jesus said, "Nah, not seven—seventy times seven. Keep forgivin'.

23.text: The kingdom of heaven is like a king settlin' accounts.

24.text: One servant owed him 10,000 bags of silver. That man couldn't pay,

25.text: so the king said, 'Sell him, his wife, kids—everything—so I can get some of it back.'

26.text: The servant dropped to his knees: 'Please, be patient! I'll pay it back!'

27.text: The king had compassion, let him go, and canceled the whole debt.

28.text: But that same servant turned around, found a dude who owed him just 100 coins, and choked him: 'Run me my money!'

29.text: The other servant begged, 'Please, give me some time.'

30.text: But he said no and had him locked up 'til he paid.

31.text: When the other workers saw it, they were hurt, and told the king what happened.

32.text: The king called him back like, 'You evil servant! I forgave you that big debt 'cause you begged me.

33.text: Shouldn't you have showed mercy to your coworker like I did you?'

34.text: Then the king got heated, and handed him over to be punished until he paid it all.

35.text: And My Father in heaven gon' do the same to y'all, if you don't forgive your brother or sister from the heart."

1.text: After Jesus finished teachin', He left Galilee and headed down to Judea, across the Jordan.

2.text: Big crowds followed Him, and He healed the sick like He always do.

3.text: Some Pharisees pulled up, tryin' to trap Him: "So Jesus, is it cool for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?"

4.text: Jesus said, "Y'all don't read Scripture? God made them male and female from jump.

5.text: And He said, 'A man gon' leave his parents and be joined to his wife. The two become one body.'

6.text: So they ain't two no more—they one. What God put together, can't no man tear apart."

7.text: They said, "Then why Moses say we could hand out divorce papers and let her go?"

8.text: Jesus replied, "That was Moses makin' space 'cause y'all hearts was hard. But that ain't how it was supposed to be from the beginning.

9.text: I'm tellin' you now—anybody who divorces his wife except for cheatin' and marries somebody else, that's adultery. Same if you marry a woman who's been divorced like that."

10.text: The disciples was like, "Whew. If that's how marriage is, maybe we just shouldn't marry at all."

11.text: Jesus said, "That ain't for everybody to handle. Only folks who been graced to live like that.

12.text: Some people born without the ability, some been made that way by others, and some chose it for the Kingdom. If you can handle it, handle it."

13.text: Then some folks brought their lil kids to Jesus so He could bless and pray over them. But the disciples tried to shut it down.

14.text: Jesus said, "Uh uh. Let the kids come. Don't stop 'em. The Kingdom belongs to people like this."

15.text: Then He laid hands on the kids and kept it movin'.

16.text: A young man ran up: "Good Teacher, what I gotta do to get eternal life?"

17.text: Jesus said, "Why you callin' Me good? Only God is truly good. But if you tryna live forever, keep the commandments."

18.text: The young man said, "Which ones?" Jesus replied, "Don't kill. Don't cheat. Don't steal. Don't lie.

19.text: Respect your parents. Love your neighbor like you love yourself."

20.text: The guy said, "I've done all that since I was young. What am I still missin'?"

21.text: Jesus said, "If you wanna be whole for real, go sell everything you got and give the money to the poor. Then come follow Me—you'll have treasure in heaven."

22.text: But the man walked away sad, 'cause he had a lot of money and didn't wanna let it go.

23.text: Jesus looked at His crew and said, "I'm tellin' y'all straight up—it's hard for rich folks to make it into the Kingdom.

24.text: Matter fact, it's easier for a camel to squeeze through a needle's eye than for a rich person to enter God's Kingdom."

25.text: The disciples looked around like, "Well dang, who can be saved then?"

26.text: Jesus looked right at them: "With people? Impossible. But with God? All things possible."

27.text: Peter said, "Lord, we left everything to follow You. So what's gon' be ours?"

28.text: Jesus said, "Y'all who been ridin' with Me—when the new world come and I'm sittin' on My throne, y'all gon' sit on thrones too, judgin' the twelve tribes of Israel.

29.text: And anybody who left their house, siblings, parents, spouse, kids, or land for Me? They gon' get it back a hundred times over and get eternal life.

30.text: But just know—folks who seem first now? They gon' be last. And the ones y'all overlook now? They gon' be first."

1.text: Jesus said, "The Kingdom of Heaven like this man who owned some land. Dude woke up early, went out lookin' for folks to work his vineyard.

2.text: He found some workers, agreed to pay 'em a denarius for the day, and sent 'em out to the field.

3.text: Around 9AM, he went back to the marketplace and saw some folks just chillin', not doin' nothin'.

4.text: He said, 'Aight, y'all go work too. I'ma pay what's fair.' So they dipped.

5.text: He came back around noon, and again around 3PM, and told more folks the same thing.

6.text: Then around 5PM—real late in the day—he pulled up again. Saw some folks still standin' around like, "Ain't nobody picked us yet."

7.text: He said, 'Go ahead and work in the vineyard too. I got you.'

8.text: Come clock-out time, the boss said to his manager, 'Call everybody up. Pay the ones who started last first.'

9.text: So the folks who only worked one hour stepped up—and boom—they each got a whole denarius.

10.text: When the ones who started early saw that, they thought they'd get more. But nah, they got the same amount.

11.text: They started grumblin', mad like,

12.text: 'Hold up! These last folks only worked an hour, and you gave them what we got? We been out here in the heat all day!'

13.text: But the boss told one of them, 'Fam, I ain't cheat you. Didn't we agree on a denarius?

14.text: Take your money and go. I chose to give the last man the same as you.

15.text: Ain't it my money? Can't I do what I want with it? Or you mad 'cause I'm generous?'

16.text: That's why I'm tellin' y'all—the last gon' be first, and the first gon' be last. Plenty folks get the call, but not everybody makes the cut."

17.text: As they headed toward Jerusalem, Jesus pulled the twelve aside for a real talk.

18.text: He said, "Look—we goin' up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man (that's Me) gon' get betrayed to the religious leaders. They gon' sentence Me to death,

19.text: and hand Me over to the Romans. They gon' mock Me, beat Me, and crucify Me. But on the third day—I'm gettin' up."

20.text: Then the mama of James and John (Zebedee's sons) pulled up on Jesus with her boys, kneelin' and tryin' to put in a request.

21.text: Jesus asked, "What you want?" She said, "Promise me my sons can sit right beside You in Your kingdom—one on the left, one on the right."

22.text: Jesus said, "You don't even know what you askin'. Can y'all drink the cup I'm about to drink? Can you go through what I'm 'bout to go through?" They said, "Yeah, we got it."

23.text: Jesus said, "Oh, you will drink from my cup, but those seats? That ain't up to Me. That's for the ones God already got lined up."

24.text: The other ten disciples heard about this and got heated.

25.text: So Jesus sat 'em all down and said, "Look—out there, folks in power love to boss people around. That ain't how we roll.

26.text: If you wanna be great in this Kingdom? Serve.

27.text: Wanna be first? Be the one who waits on everybody.

28.text: Even I, the Son of Man, didn't come to be served—I came to serve and to give My life to save many."

29.text: As they left Jericho, a big crowd followed Jesus.

30.text: Two blind men were sittin' by the road, and when they heard Jesus was passin' by, they shouted, "Son of David! Have mercy on us!"

31.text: The crowd tried to shut them up, but they yelled even louder, "Have mercy on us, Son of David!"

32.text: Jesus stopped in His tracks, called 'em over, and asked, "What y'all want Me to do for you?"

33.text: They said, "Lord, we tryna see again."

34.text: Jesus felt it in His heart, touched their eyes, and boom—they could see. And they ain't hesitate—they got up and followed Him.

1.text: When Jesus and the crew got close to Jerusalem, near Bethphage at the Mount of Olives, He sent two of His disciples ahead.

2.text: He told them, "Go into the village in front of y'all. Right when you get there, you gon' see a donkey tied up and a young colt with her. Untie them and bring them to Me.

3.text: If anybody say anything to y'all, just say, 'The Lord need them,' and they gon' let you take them."

4.text: This whole thing went down so what the prophet said would come true:

5.text: "Tell Zion's daughter, 'Look, your King comin' to you. He ain't pullin' up flashy—He ridin' humble on a donkey, a young one.'"

6.text: So the disciples went and did just like Jesus told them.

7.text: They brought the donkey and the colt, laid their coats on 'em, and Jesus got up on top of them.

8.text: A big crowd started layin' they coats on the road, and others were cuttin' down branches from trees and puttin' 'em down too.

9.text: The folks in front and behind Jesus was shoutin' out, "Hosanna to the Son of David! Bless the One who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!"

10.text: When He rolled into Jerusalem, the whole city got shook. Folks was like, "Who is this?"

11.text: And the crowd said, "That's Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee."

12.text: Jesus went straight into the temple and started clearing it out—He flipped over the tables of the money folks and the seats of the bird-sellers.

13.text: He said, "Scripture say, 'My house shall be a house of prayer,' but y'all done turned it into a trap house for thieves."

14.text: Then the blind and the lame came to Him at the temple, and He healed them right there.

15.text: But the religious leaders—the priests and scribes—saw all the dope things He was doing, and heard the kids yellin', "Hosanna to the Son of David!" and they got tight about it.

16.text: They said to Jesus, "You hear what these kids sayin'?" Jesus said, "Yeah. Ain't y'all ever read, 'Outta the mouth of babies and little ones comes real praise'?"

17.text: After that, He left and went to Bethany and spent the night there.

18.text: The next morning, Jesus was hungry on the way back to the city.

19.text: He saw a fig tree on the side of the road and walked up to it, but it ain't have nothin' but leaves. So He said, "You ain't gon' grow no fruit ever again." And boom—the tree dried up just like that.

20.text: The disciples saw it happen and was like, "Whoa! How that tree die so fast?"

21.text: Jesus said, "If y'all got faith and don't doubt, y'all can do this too—and even tell a mountain, 'Move over there,' and it'll do it.

22.text: Whatever you ask in prayer, believe you gon' get it, and it'll come."

23.text: Jesus came back to the temple, and while He was teaching, the top priests and elders rolled up on Him and said, "Who told you you could do all this? Who gave you that kind of authority?"

24.text: Jesus said, "Lemme ask y'all one thing first. If y'all answer me, then I'll tell you who gave Me authority.

25.text: John's baptism—did it come from heaven or from people?" They huddled up and whispered, "If we say heaven, He gon' ask why we ain't believe John.

26.text: But if we say it was just from people, the crowd might turn on us—they all think John was a real prophet."

27.text: So they told Jesus, "We don't know." And Jesus said, "Well then, I ain't tellin' y'all either."

28.text: "Now y'all tell Me this. A man had two sons. He went to the first one and said, 'Son, go work in the vineyard today.'

29.text: The son said, 'Nah, I ain't goin.' But later he felt bad and went anyway.

30.text: Then the man told his second son the same thing, and he said, 'Yes sir, I'm on it,' but he ain't go.

31.text: Which one actually did what his daddy wanted?" They said, "The first." Jesus replied, "Exactly. That's why tax collectors and prostitutes gettin' into God's kingdom before y'all.

32.text: John came through showin' y'all the righteous way, and y'all ain't believe him. But the tax men and the women in the streets did. And even when y'all saw that, you ain't change your minds and believe."

33.text: "Here's another one for y'all. A landowner planted a vineyard. He put a fence around it, dug a winepress, built a tower, and rented it out to some farmers. Then he dipped out to another place.

34.text: When harvest time came, he sent his workers to collect his part of the crop.

35.text: But the renters beat one, killed another, and stoned the third.

36.text: So the landowner sent more workers—more than the first time—and they did the same thing to them.

37.text: Finally, he sent his own son, thinking, 'They gon' respect my boy.'

38.text: But when they saw the son, they said, 'This the heir! Let's kill him and get everything for ourselves.'

39.text: So they grabbed him, threw him out the vineyard, and murdered him."

40.text: "Now when the owner of the vineyard shows up, what y'all think he gon' do?"

41.text: They said, "He gon' destroy them dudes for sure, and lease the vineyard to others who gon' give him his share at harvest."

42.text: Jesus said, "Y'all ever read the Scriptures? 'The stone the builders rejected Became the main cornerstone. That was God's doing, And it's mind-blowing to see.'"

43.text: "That's why I'm telling y'all—the kingdom of God gon' be taken from you and handed over to folks who gon' actually do something with it.

44.text: And anybody who stumbles over that stone gon' get broken. And if it falls on somebody—it's gon' crush them completely."

45.text: When the priests and Pharisees heard this story, they knew He was talkin' about them.

46.text: They wanted to grab Him right then—but they were scared of the crowd, 'cause everybody thought Jesus was a real prophet.

1.text: Jesus kept talkin' in parables and said,

2.text: "The kingdom of heaven like a king who threw a big wedding for his son.

3.text: He sent his people to go get the invited guests, but they ain't wanna come.

4.text: So he sent more folks, sayin', 'Tell the ones invited, "Dinner ready! I done cooked the ox and the best meat. Everything set—come on to the wedding!"'

5.text: But they blew it off. One went to work on his farm, another went to handle his business.

6.text: The rest straight up jumped the messengers, disrespected them, and killed them.

7.text: The king heard about it and got heated. He sent his army, got rid of them murderers, and set their city on fire.

8.text: Then he told his people, 'The wedding ready, but the invited ones ain't worthy.

9.text: So go out into the streets and bring in everybody you see.'

10.text: So the servants went out, grabbed whoever they could find—good or bad—and the wedding hall got packed.

11.text: But when the king came in to check the guests, he spotted one dude not dressed for the occasion.

12.text: He said, 'Bruh, how you get in here with no wedding clothes?' Dude ain't say nothin'.

13.text: So the king told the servants, 'Tie him up and throw him into the dark, where folk cry and grind their teeth.'

14.text: A lotta folks get called, but only a few get picked."

15.text: Then the Pharisees linked up to try and trip Jesus up with His own words.

16.text: They sent their people, along with some of Herod's crew, and said, "Teacher, we know You keep it real and speak truth from God. You ain't pressed about folks' opinions either.

17.text: So tell us, is it right to pay taxes to Caesar or nah?"

18.text: But Jesus peeped their game and said, "Why y'all playin' with Me, you hypocrites?

19.text: Show Me the coin used for taxes."

20.text: He said, "Whose face and name on this?"

21.text: They said, "Caesar's."

22.text: Jesus said, "Then give Caesar what's his—and give God what's God's."

23.text: That same day, some Sadducees—who don't believe in the resurrection—came with a question.

24.text: "Teacher," they said, "Moses said if a man dies with no kids, his brother gotta marry the widow and raise up kids for him.

25.text: So there was seven brothers. First one married, died with no kids, left his wife to his brother.

26.text: Same with the second, and the third, all the way to the seventh.

27.text: Then the woman died too.

28.text: So in the resurrection, whose wife she gonna be, since all seven had her?"

29.text: Jesus said, "Y'all wrong 'cause you don't know Scripture or God's power.

30.text: In the resurrection, folks don't marry—they like the angels in heaven.

31.text: And as for the dead bein' raised—ain't you read what God said?

32.text: 'I am the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.' He ain't God of the dead—He the God of the living."

33.text: The crowd was blown away by that answer.

34.text: When the Pharisees heard Jesus had shut the Sadducees down, they huddled up.

35.text: One of them—a lawyer—tried to test Jesus with a question.

36.text: "Teacher, which commandment the biggest in the law?"

37.text: Jesus said, "'Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and mind.'

38.text: That's the first and biggest one.

39.text: But the second one right there with it: 'Love your neighbor like you love yourself.'

40.text: Everything in the Law and the Prophets hang on these two."

41.text: While the Pharisees were still hangin' around, Jesus hit them with a question.

42.text: "What y'all think about the Christ—whose Son is He?"

43.text: He said, "Then how come David, speakin' by the Spirit, calls Him 'Lord'? He said:

44.text: 'The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit at My right hand, Till I make Your enemies Your footstool."'

45.text: So if David call Him 'Lord,' how's He his son?"

46.text: Nobody had a comeback. From that day on, they ain't dare ask Jesus no more questions.

1.text: Then Jesus started speakin' to the crowd and His disciples.

2.text: He said, "The scribes and Pharisees sittin' up in Moses' seat like they runnin' things.

3.text: So yeah, do what they say when it line up with the Word—but don't be actin' like them, 'cause they be talkin' big but don't live none of it.

4.text: They pile heavy rules on folks' backs, stuff hard to carry, but they ain't liftin' a finger to help.

5.text: Everything they do is just for show. They rockin' extra big scripture boxes on they clothes and stretchin' the hems like that make 'em holy.

6.text: They love the VIP seats at parties and front-row pews at church.

7.text: They live for attention in the streets and love when folks call 'em 'Rabbi.'

8.text: But don't let nobody call you 'Rabbi,' 'cause y'all got one real Teacher—the Messiah—and all y'all fam.

9.text: Don't be callin' folks 'Father' down here, 'cause you got one true Father in heaven.

10.text: And don't be tryin' to flex titles like 'Teacher'—you got one, and that's Christ.

11.text: The greatest one in the crew? That's the one servin' everybody else.

12.text: If you stay humble, you'll get lifted. But if you always tryna lift yourself up, you gon' get brought down."

13.text: "Woe to y'all fake scribes and Pharisees—straight hypocrites! You blockin' folks from gettin' to the kingdom. You ain't goin' in, and you stoppin' others from goin' in too.

14.text: Woe to y'all who scam widows outta they homes and then try to cover it with long, fake prayers. Y'all gon' catch a heavier judgment.

15.text: Woe again! Y'all cross land and sea just to get one convert, and when you finally do, you turn 'em into twice the devil you are.

16.text: Woe to y'all blind guides, talkin' 'bout, 'If you swear by the temple, that don't count, but if you swear by the gold inside it, you locked in.'

17.text: Man, y'all foolish and blind! What's greater—the gold or the temple that made the gold holy?

18.text: Same thing with the altar—you say swearin' by the gift on it means somethin', but the altar itself don't?

19.text: Y'all wild. What's more important—the gift or the altar that makes it holy?

20.text: If you swear by the altar, you swear by everything on it.

21.text: Swear by the temple? That's swearin' by the One who live there.

22.text: Swear by heaven? You swearin' on God's throne—and on God, period."

23.text: "Woe to y'all again—tithin' on your herbs like mint, anise, and cumin, but forgettin' justice, mercy, and real faith. Y'all shoulda did all that, without forgettin' the important stuff.

24.text: Y'all blind guides, straining out a little gnat but swallowin' a whole camel.

25.text: Woe! Y'all clean the outside of the cup, but inside y'all full of greed and mess.

26.text: Blind Pharisee—clean the inside first, then the outside gon' follow.

27.text: Woe again! Y'all like painted tombs—lookin' good on the outside, but inside y'all full of bones and dead man vibes.

28.text: Y'all look righteous, but y'all hearts full of hypocrisy and sin."

29.text: "Woe again! Y'all build tombs for the prophets and dress 'em up like you honor 'em,

30.text: sayin', 'If we'd been around back then, we wouldn't have killed God's messengers.'

31.text: But by sayin' that, you confessin' y'all sons of the same folks who did kill 'em.

32.text: Go 'head then—fill up the cup of guilt your ancestors started.

33.text: Snakes! Offspring of vipers! How y'all think you gon' escape hell's judgment?

34.text: I'ma send prophets, wise folks, and teachers—and y'all gon' kill, crucify, and beat some of 'em down in church, chasin' them city to city.

35.text: Because of that, all the righteous blood ever spilled—starting from Abel all the way to Zechariah, son of Berechiah, who y'all killed in the temple—is comin' down on this generation.

36.text: I'm tellin' y'all now: all this gon' hit y'all soon."

37.text: "O Jerusalem, Jerusalem… killin' prophets and stonin' the ones sent to save you. I been tryna gather y'all like a mama hen with her chicks, but y'all wasn't havin' it.

38.text: Look at your house—left empty, abandoned.

39.text: I'm tellin' you now, you won't see Me again till you say, 'Blessed is the One who comes in the name of the Lord.'"

1.text: Jesus walked out the temple, and His disciples was showin' off how fine the buildings looked.

2.text: But Jesus told 'em, "Y'all see all this? I'm tellin' you straight—ain't gon' be one stone left on top another. It's all gon' come crashin' down."

3.text: Later on, Jesus was chillin' on the Mount of Olives when the disciples came to Him on the low and asked, "So when all this gon' happen? What the sign that You comin' back and the world wrappin' up?"

4.text: Jesus said, "Look, don't let nobody play y'all.

5.text: Folks gon' come actin' like they Me, sayin' they the Christ, and gon' fool a lotta people.

6.text: You gon' hear 'bout wars and threats of wars. Don't panic though—this gotta happen, but that ain't the end yet.

7.text: Nations gon' beef with each other, kingdoms gon' clash. There gon' be famines, plagues, and earthquakes all over.

8.text: That's just the warm-up though—the start of the pain.

9.text: Then they gon' hand y'all over to be mistreated, even killed. Everybody gon' hate y'all just 'cause y'all reppin' Me.

10.text: Folks gon' fall off, betray each other, and turn cold with hate.

11.text: Fake prophets gon' rise up and fool folks.

12.text: And since everybody wildin' out and doin' dirt, love gon' grow cold.

13.text: But the one who hold on to the end? They gon' be saved.

14.text: And this good news about the Kingdom? It's gon' get preached all across the world for everybody to hear—and then the end gon' come."

15.text: "So when y'all see that nasty, messed-up thing Daniel talked about standin' in the holy spot—pay attention!

16.text: If you in Judea, run for the hills.

17.text: If you on the roof, don't go back in for nothin'.

18.text: If you in the field, don't go back to grab your coat.

19.text: Woe to the pregnant ladies and new mamas in those days!

20.text: Pray your escape ain't in winter or on the Sabbath.

21.text: 'Cause it's gon' be a time of trouble the world ain't never seen before—and won't ever see again.

22.text: If God ain't cut them days short, nobody would survive. But for His chosen ones' sake, He gon' cut it short.

23.text: So if somebody say, 'Look! The Christ over here!' or 'He over there!'—don't believe it.

24.text: Fake messiahs and prophets gon' show up, doin' wild signs and wonders, tryin' to fool even the real ones if they could.

25.text: I'm tellin' y'all now so y'all ain't caught slippin'.

26.text: So if they tell y'all, 'He out in the desert,' don't go. 'He hidin' in some secret spot,' don't believe that either.

27.text: 'Cause when I come back, it's gon' hit like lightning—boom, from the east to the west, real obvious.

28.text: Wherever there's a dead body, that's where the vultures gon' circle. Same with My return—it's gon' be clear."

29.text: "Right after that time of trouble, the sun gon' go dark, the moon won't shine, the stars gon' fall, and the heavens gon' shake.

30.text: Then everybody gon' see the sign of the Son of Man up in the sky. All the folks on earth gon' cry out when they see Me comin' on the clouds, powerful and shinin' in glory.

31.text: And I'ma send My angels with a loud trumpet blast, and they gon' gather My people from everywhere—north, south, east, west, all across heaven."

32.text: "Peep the fig tree: when you see it sproutin' leaves, you know summer close.

33.text: Same way, when you see all this goin' down, know that it's right at the door.

34.text: I'm tellin' you the truth—this generation ain't gon' pass till all this goes down.

35.text: Heaven and earth might pass away, but My words? They locked in forever."

36.text: "Nobody knows the day or hour—not the angels, not even Me—only the Father.

37.text: Just like in Noah's day, that's how it's gon' be when the Son of Man comes.

38.text: Folks was eatin', drinkin', gettin' married—livin' life—right up until Noah stepped in that ark.

39.text: They ain't know what hit 'em till the flood came and swept 'em all away. That's exactly how it's gon' be.

40.text: Two dudes gon' be in the field—one gone, the other stay.

41.text: Two women grindin' grain—one gone, the other left.

42.text: So stay woke! You don't know what time your Lord gon' pull up.

43.text: If the homeowner knew what time the thief was comin', he wouldn't have let his house get hit.

44.text: Be ready! The Son of Man gon' show up when you least expect it."

45.text: "So who's the wise and faithful servant the Master put in charge to look after the house and make sure folks eat on time?

46.text: Blessed is that one who still on they job when the Master shows up.

47.text: For real, He gon' put that one over all His stuff.

48.text: But say that servant wild out and say, 'My Master takin' too long,'

49.text: then starts beatin' the others and partyin' with the drunk crew—

50.text: That Master gon' show up on a day he ain't expectin' and at a time he ain't ready for.

51.text: He gon' cut him off, throw him with the hypocrites. And there? It's gon' be nothin' but cryin' and teeth-grindin'."

1.text: "The Kingdom of Heaven like this: ten young women grab they lamps and go out waitin' for the groom.

2.text: Five of 'em was wise. The other five? Straight foolish.

3.text: The silly ones brought they lamps but ain't bring no extra oil.

4.text: But the wise ones came ready—they had they lamps AND extra oil on deck.

5.text: The groom was takin' forever, so they all got sleepy and knocked out.

6.text: Around midnight, somebody yelled, 'Ayy! The groom comin'! Go meet him!'

7.text: All the girls jumped up and got they lamps lit.

8.text: The silly ones said to the wise, 'Let us get some of y'all oil—our lamps goin' out!'

9.text: The wise girls said, 'Uh uh. We ain't got enough for everybody. Go to the store and buy your own.'

10.text: While they was gone tryna buy oil, the groom came. The ones who were ready went in with him to the wedding, and the door got shut.

11.text: Later, the others came knockin', talkin' 'bout, 'Lord, Lord, open up!'

12.text: But he said, 'I'm tellin' you the truth—I don't even know y'all.'

13.text: So stay woke, 'cause you don't know the day or the hour when the Son of Man showin' up."

14.text: "It's like a man who was headin' outta town. He called his servants and handed over his money.

15.text: One got five bags of silver, another got two, and one got just one—each based on what he could handle. Then the boss dipped.

16.text: The one with five bags went to work and made five more.

17.text: The one with two doubled his up too.

18.text: But the one with one bag? He got scared, dug a hole, and hid the money.

19.text: A long time later, the boss came back and wanted his money checked.

20.text: The five-bag man said, 'Boss, you gave me five—I got five more!'

21.text: The boss said, 'Good job, my dude! You was faithful over a few things—I'ma put you over a lot. Come celebrate with me!'

22.text: The two-bag servant came up like, 'Boss, I flipped your two and got two more!'

23.text: The boss said, 'That's what I'm talkin' about! You did good too—come on in and enjoy this joy!'

24.text: Then the one with one bag stepped up. 'Boss, I know you tough. You take what you ain't plant and collect what you ain't scatter.

25.text: So I got scared and buried your money. Here go your one bag back.'

26.text: But the boss said, 'You lazy and wicked! If you knew how I move, you shoulda at least put my money in the bank so I could get interest.

27.text: Gimme that one bag.

28.text: Matter fact, give it to the one with ten bags.

29.text: Folks who handle they business get more. But folks who waste? Even what they got gon' get snatched.

30.text: And throw that sorry servant in the dark where folk cry and grind they teeth.'"

31.text: "When the Son of Man come in all His glory, with His angels, He gon' sit on His throne.

32.text: Everybody—every nation—gon' be in front of Him, and He gon' separate folks like a shepherd split sheep from goats.

33.text: Sheep on the right. Goats on the left.

34.text: Then the King gon' say to the folks on the right, 'Y'all blessed! Come on and get the Kingdom I been settin' up for you since day one.

35.text: I was hungry, and y'all fed Me. Thirsty, and y'all gave Me a drink. I was new around here, and y'all welcomed Me.

36.text: I ain't have clothes, and y'all covered Me. I was sick, and y'all checked on Me. I was locked up, and y'all visited Me.'

37.text: Then the righteous folks gon' say, 'Lord, when did we see You hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or locked up and take care of You?'

38.text: When did we see You a stranger and welcome You, or naked and give You clothes?

39.text: When did we see You sick or in prison and come to You?'

40.text: And the King gon' say, 'If you did it for the least of these—My people—you did it for Me.'

41.text: But then He gon' turn to the left and say, 'Get outta here, y'all cursed! Go to that eternal fire built for the devil and his crew!

42.text: I was hungry—you ain't feed Me. Thirsty—you ain't give Me nothin'.

43.text: I was a stranger—you ain't take Me in. Naked—you ain't cover Me. Sick and in jail—you ain't visit Me.'

44.text: And they gon' say, 'Lord, when did we see You like that and not help?'

45.text: He gon' say, 'If you ain't do it for the least of these, you ain't do it for Me.'

46.text: And them folks gon' go off into eternal punishment. But the righteous? Eternal life."

1.text: When Jesus finished sayin' all that, He told His crew,

2.text: "Y'all know Passover comin' in two days, right? That's when the Son of Man—Me—gon' be handed over and crucified."

3.text: Meanwhile, the high priests, teachers of the law, and elders met up at the high priest's spot—Caiaphas house—

4.text: tryin' to figure out how to set Jesus up slick and kill Him.

5.text: But they was like, "Let's not do it during the festival tho, or the people gon' wild out."

6.text: Jesus was chillin' in Bethany at Simon the leper's crib.

7.text: A woman pulled up with a fancy jar full of expensive oil. Sis broke it open and poured it all on His head while He was sittin' at the table.

8.text: The disciples saw that and got tight. They said, "Why she wastin' that?!

9.text: That oil coulda been sold for big money to help the poor."

10.text: But Jesus shut it down. "Why y'all stressin' her? She did somethin' real good for Me.

11.text: The poor gon' always be around, but I won't.

12.text: She poured that oil on Me to get My body ready for burial.

13.text: Believe Me, anywhere the gospel get preached, folks gon' remember her for this."

14.text: Then Judas Iscariot—one of the Twelve—went to the chief priests.

15.text: He said, "What y'all gon' give me if I hand Him over?" They paid him 30 silver coins.

16.text: From then on, Judas was lookin' for his moment to betray Jesus.

17.text: On the first day of the Feast of No-Bread (Unleavened Bread), the disciples came to Jesus like, "Where we fixin' to set up the Passover meal?"

18.text: Jesus told 'em, "Go into the city, find a certain man, and say, 'The Teacher said His time is almost up, and He comin' to eat the Passover at your place with His crew.'"

19.text: So they did exactly what Jesus told 'em and got everything ready.

20.text: That night, Jesus sat down with the Twelve.

21.text: While they was eatin', He hit 'em with: "I'm tellin' y'all straight—one of y'all gon' betray Me."

22.text: They was heartbroken, and each one asked, "Lord… it ain't me, is it?"

23.text: Jesus said, "It's the one who dipped his hand in the dish with Me.

24.text: The Son of Man gon' do what the Scriptures said, but woe to the one who sellin' Me out. It woulda been better if he was never born."

25.text: Then Judas—the one plottin'—asked, "Rabbi… is it me?" Jesus hit him with, "You said it, not me."

26.text: While they was still eatin', Jesus picked up some bread, prayed over it, broke it, and passed it out. "Take this and eat—it's My body."

27.text: Then He grabbed the cup, gave thanks, and passed it too. "Drink up, all y'all.

28.text: This My blood, part of the new promise—poured out for many to forgive sins.

29.text: I ain't drinkin' wine again till we sippin' new in My Father's Kingdom."

30.text: After singin' a song, they dipped out to the Mount of Olives.

31.text: Jesus told 'em, "Tonight, all y'all gon' fall back 'cause of Me. The Scriptures say: 'I'ma strike the Shepherd, and the sheep gon' scatter.'

32.text: But after I rise, I'm meetin' y'all in Galilee."

33.text: Peter was like, "Even if everybody else fold, I ain't goin' out like that!"

34.text: Jesus replied, "Listen close—tonight, before the rooster even crows, you gon' deny Me three times."

35.text: Peter said, "I'll die before I deny You!" And all the other disciples co-signed like, "Us too!"

36.text: Then Jesus took His disciples to a spot called Gethsemane. He told 'em, "Y'all wait here while I go pray over there."

37.text: He took Peter, James, and John with Him, and He started feelin' heavy—real sorrowful, like the weight of the world was sittin' on His chest.

38.text: He told them, "My soul is crushed right now, like I'm 'bout to die. Stay here and keep watch with Me."

39.text: Then He walked a little further, dropped to His knees, face in the dirt, and prayed: "Father, if there's any other way, let this cup pass from Me. But not My will—Yours."

40.text: When He came back, the disciples were knocked out. He said to Peter, "Dang, bruh—you couldn't stay up with Me for one hour?

41.text: Watch and pray, so you don't fall off. The spirit tryin', but the flesh? Weak."

42.text: He dipped again and prayed, "Father, if this the only way, then let it be. I'm wit' it—Your will."

43.text: Came back—they still sleep. Heavy eyes.

44.text: So He went a third time, same prayer.

45.text: Then He came back like, "Y'all still snoozin'? Wake up. The time is now—the Son of Man 'bout to be betrayed.

46.text: Get up. Let's go. My betrayer right around the corner."

47.text: While He was talkin', here come Judas with a mob—swords, clubs, the whole crew sent by the chief priests and elders.

48.text: Judas had told them, "The one I kiss? That's Him. Grab Him."

49.text: He walked up to Jesus all fake—"What's up, Rabbi"—and kissed Him.

50.text: Jesus said, "Go 'head, do what you came to do, friend." Then they grabbed Jesus.

51.text: One of Jesus' people (we know it was Peter) pulled out his sword and sliced a dude's ear off—the servant of the high priest.

52.text: But Jesus told him, "Put that away! If you live by the sword, you gon' die by it.

53.text: You think I can't call My Father and have a whole army of angels show up right now?

54.text: But the Scriptures gotta play out."

55.text: Jesus turned to the mob and said, "Y'all came at Me like I'm some criminal? Swords and clubs? I been in the temple daily teachin', and y'all ain't touch Me.

56.text: But this all had to happen—Scripture said so." And just like that, all His boys dipped. Left Him hangin'.

57.text: The crew that grabbed Jesus dragged Him to Caiaphas, the high priest. The religious leaders were there, already plottin'.

58.text: Peter followed from a distance, slid into the courtyard, and tried to act like he wasn't with Him. Just watchin' to see what would go down.

59.text: The priests and elders tried to stack false charges to kill Jesus, but couldn't get their lies straight.

60.text: Even with a bunch of folks lyin', nothin' stuck. Finally, two stepped up:

61.text: "This Man said He could destroy God's temple and build it back in three days."

62.text: High priest stood up and said, "You ain't got nothin' to say? What about what these men accusin' You of?"

63.text: Jesus stayed silent. Then the high priest pulled the legal card: "I put You under oath. Are You the Christ, the Son of God?"

64.text: Jesus said, "You said it. But let Me tell you—soon you gon' see the Son of Man sittin' next to Power, comin' on the clouds."

65.text: High priest lost it—ripped his robe. "Blasphemy! What else we need? Y'all heard it!"

67.text: Then they spit on Him, punched Him, slapped Him up,

68.text: talkin' reckless: "Oh, you a prophet? Then tell us who hit You!"

69.text: Meanwhile, Peter sittin' outside tryin' to lay low. A servant girl peeped him: "Weren't you with Jesus from Galilee?"

70.text: Peter was like, "Nah, I don't know what you talkin' 'bout."

71.text: He slid out to the gate. Another girl saw him and told the crowd, "He was with Jesus too."

72.text: Peter swore, "I don't know that Man!"

73.text: A few minutes later, some folks came up like, "Yeah, you one of them. We can hear it in your voice."

74.text: Peter lost it—started cursin' and swearin': "I said I don't KNOW that Man!" Right then… rooster crowed.

75.text: Peter remembered Jesus' words: "Before the rooster crows, you'll deny Me three times." And Peter broke down—ran off cryin' hard.

1.text: As soon as the sun came up, the chief priests and elders came up with a whole plot to kill Jesus.

2.text: They tied Him up, marched Him off, and handed Him over to the Roman governor—Pontius Pilate.

3.text: When Judas, the one who snitched, saw that Jesus was really 'bout to die, he started feelin' the weight. He ran it back—tried to return that 30-piece of silver, sayin', "I messed up. I sold out innocent blood."

4.text: But they hit him with, "That ain't our problem. You deal with that."

5.text: So he tossed that silver down in the temple, dipped out… and took his own life.

6.text: The priests picked up the silver like, "We can't put blood money in the offering."

7.text: So they used it to buy a potter's field—a place to bury folks who ain't got nobody.

8.text: That's why folks still call it the "Field of Blood" to this day.

9.text: That prophecy from Jeremiah? Fulfilled right there.

10.text: "And they used that silver to buy the potter's field—just like the Lord told me to do."

11.text: Jesus stood in front of Pilate, who asked, "You the King of the Jews?" Jesus said, "You said it."

12.text: While the priests and elders were throwin' shade and false charges, Jesus said nothing.

13.text: Pilate was like, "You ain't gon' say nothin'? They throwin' all this at you."

14.text: Still—Jesus didn't say a word. Pilate was lowkey shook.

15.text: Now it was a custom for Pilate to release one prisoner during the feast.

16.text: They had a wild dude locked up named Barabbas.

17.text: Pilate asked the crowd, "Y'all want Jesus or Barabbas?"

18.text: (He knew they was just jealous of Jesus.)

19.text: While he was sittin' in the judge's chair, Pilate's wife sent word: "Don't touch that righteous man! I had nightmares 'cause of Him."

20.text: But the priests stirred the crowd—told 'em, "Ask for Barabbas. Get rid of Jesus."

21.text: So Pilate asked again, "Who y'all want?" They yelled, "Barabbas!"

22.text: He said, "Then what y'all want me to do with Jesus?" They yelled, "CRUCIFY HIM!"

23.text: "But what did He even DO?!" They shouted even louder, "CRUCIFY HIM!"

24.text: Pilate saw it was gettin' outta hand, so he washed his hands in front of 'em: "I'm done. This ain't on me. Y'all handle it."

25.text: The crowd said, "His blood be on us and our kids."

26.text: So he let Barabbas go and had Jesus beat… then handed Him over to be crucified.

27.text: The Roman soldiers took Jesus inside, pulled the whole squad up.

28.text: They stripped Him, threw a scarlet robe on Him,

29.text: made a crown outta thorns and shoved it on His head, gave Him a fake scepter, bowed fake like, "Hail, King of the Jews!"

30.text: Then they spit on Him, snatched the reed, and beat Him with it.

31.text: After all that mockin', they put His real clothes back on and dragged Him out to be crucified.

32.text: On the way, they grabbed a man named Simon from Cyrene and made him carry Jesus' cross.

33.text: They reached a spot called Golgotha—means "Skull Place."

34.text: They tried to give Him wine mixed with bitter stuff, but once He tasted it, He wouldn't drink.

35.text: They nailed Him to the cross, divided up His clothes, and gambled for them—just like the Scriptures said.

36.text: Then they just sat there… watchin' Him suffer.

37.text: Over His head they posted the charge: "THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS."

38.text: Two thieves were crucified with Him, one on each side.

39.text: Folks walkin' by were talkin' slick, shakin' their heads.

40.text: "Didn't You say You'd rebuild the temple in 3 days? Save Yourself then! Come off that cross if You the Son of God!"

41.text: The priests and teachers joined in:

42.text: "He saved others, can't save Himself. If You really the King, come down now—we'll believe You then."

43.text: "He trusted God. Let's see if God comes through."

44.text: Even the thieves next to Him were clownin' Him.

45.text: Around noon, darkness hit the land. Stayed dark 'til 3 p.m.

46.text: Then Jesus cried out loud, "Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani?" Which means: "My God, My God, why You leave Me hangin'?"

47.text: Some thought He was callin' Elijah.

48.text: Somebody ran and gave Him sour wine on a sponge.

49.text: Others said, "Leave Him alone. Let's see if Elijah comes."

50.text: Then Jesus let out one more loud cry… and gave up His spirit.

51.text: Right then, the temple curtain tore in two—from top to bottom. The earth shook. Rocks cracked.

52.text: Tombs opened up, and saints who had died rose up!

53.text: After Jesus' resurrection, they went into the city and showed up to people!

54.text: The soldier at the cross saw it all and said, "Man… this really was the Son of God."

55.text: A group of women had followed Jesus from Galilee—watched it all go down from a distance.

56.text: Mary Magdalene was there, along with Mary (mother of James and Joses), and the mother of Zebedee's sons.

57.text: That night, a rich dude named Joseph from Arimathea—who was down with Jesus—

58.text: asked Pilate for the body. Pilate agreed.

59.text: Joseph wrapped Jesus in clean linen,

60.text: laid Him in his brand-new tomb, rolled a stone over the entrance, and dipped.

61.text: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary stayed, posted up across from the tomb.

62.text: The next day, the religious leaders ran back to Pilate.

63.text: "Sir, we remember that deceiver said He'd rise after 3 days.

64.text: We need that tomb locked down tight, or else His crew gon' steal the body and fake a resurrection."

65.text: Pilate said, "Fine. Take some guards. Make it as secure as possible."

66.text: So they sealed the tomb… and posted up security.

1.text: Early Sunday mornin', right after the Sabbath, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary pulled up to the tomb.

2.text: All of a sudden, the ground started shakin'—a whole earthquake! An angel straight dropped down from heaven, rolled the stone back, and just sat on it chillin'.

3.text: Dude was shinin' like lightning, clothes white as snow.

4.text: The guards? Shook. Froze up like they were dead.

5.text: The angel looked at the women and said, "Don't be scared. I know y'all lookin' for Jesus, the One they crucified.

6.text: He ain't here—He done got up, just like He said He would. Come see where He was layin'.

7.text: Now go! Quick! Tell His boys He alive and already headed to Galilee. You gon' see Him there. I done told y'all!"

8.text: The women ran up outta there—heart poundin', eyes wide—but filled with so much joy. They ran to tell the disciples the news.

9.text: On the way, Jesus popped up on them like, "Y'all rejoice now!" They dropped to His feet and started worshippin' Him.

10.text: He said, "Don't be scared. Go tell My brothers to meet Me in Galilee. I'll see them there."

11.text: While the women were movin', some of the guards ran to the city to spill everything to the religious leaders.

12.text: The priests and elders held a hush-hush meeting and came up with a bribe plan.

13.text: They handed the soldiers a fat bag of money and said, "Tell folks His disciples came in the night and stole the body while y'all were asleep.

14.text: If the governor hears about it, we'll cover for y'all. Don't trip."

15.text: So the guards took the cash and stuck to the script. And that's the story folks been passin' around ever since.

16.text: Meanwhile, the eleven disciples headed up to that mountain in Galilee—just like Jesus told 'em.

17.text: When they saw Him, they fell down in worship… though a few still had doubts in their hearts.

18.text: Then Jesus stepped up and said, "All power in heaven and on earth? That's Mine now.

19.text: So go—make disciples everywhere, all nations. Baptize them in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.

20.text: Teach 'em everything I taught y'all. And don't forget—I'm with y'all. Always. Even to the very end."

1.text: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy, our brother, To Philemon, our beloved friend and fellow worker,

2.text: To the beloved Apphia, Archippus, our fellow soldier, and to the church in your house:

3.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

4.text: I thank God and always mention you in my prayers,

5.text: I've been hearing about your love and faith, how you show it towards the Lord Jesus and towards all the saints,

6.text: That your sharing of your faith might become powerful by recognizing all the good things in you, in Christ Jesus.

7.text: We're overjoyed and comforted by your love, because you've refreshed the hearts of the saints, brother.

8.text: Even though I could be bold in Christ and tell you what to do,

9.text: For the sake of love, I'd rather ask you instead—me, Paul, the old man, and now also a prisoner for Jesus Christ—

10.text: I'm asking you for my son, Onesimus, whom I became a father to while locked up,

11.text: Who was once useless to you, but now he's useful to both you and me.

12.text: I'm sending him back to you, but really, he's like my own heart.

13.text: I wanted to keep him here with me so he could help me while I'm in these chains for the gospel,

14.text: But I didn't want to do anything without your consent, so your good deed wouldn't be forced, but done willingly.

15.text: Maybe he left you for a while just so you could receive him back forever,

16.text: Not just as a servant, but more than that—a beloved brother. Especially to me, but how much more to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

17.text: So, if you count me as a partner, receive him as you would me.

18.text: But if he's done you wrong or owes you anything, charge it to me.

19.text: I, Paul, am writing this with my own hand—I'll pay it back, not to mention, you owe me your own self, too.

20.text: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord; refresh my heart in the Lord.

21.text: I'm confident you'll obey me, and I know you'll even do more than what I ask.

22.text: And while you're at it, prepare a guest room for me, 'cause I'm trusting that through your prayers, I'll be granted to come see you.

23.text: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends his greetings,

24.text: As do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

25.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

1.text: Paul and Timothy, bondservants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are in Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

2.text: Grace and peace to y'all from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

3.text: I thank my God every time I think of y'all,

4.text: Always, in every prayer, I'm making requests for you all with joy,

5.text: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now,

6.text: Being confident of this: that He who started a good work in you will finish it until the day of Christ Jesus.

7.text: It's right for me to think this way about all of you, 'cause I got y'all in my heart. Even though I'm in chains, and defending and confirming the gospel, you're all partakers of this grace with me.

8.text: For God is my witness, how much I long for all of you with the affection of Jesus Christ.

9.text: And this is what I pray: that your love may keep growing more and more, with knowledge and discernment,

10.text: So you can approve the things that are excellent, and be sincere and without offense until the day of Christ,

11.text: Filled with the fruits of righteousness that come through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

12.text: Now, I want y'all to know, that everything that's happened to me has actually helped spread the gospel,

13.text: So much so, that it's become clear to the whole palace guard, and to everyone else, that my chains are for Christ,

14.text: And most of the believers in the Lord, having seen my chains, have become more confident and are preaching the word without fear.

15.text: Some are preaching Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others are doing it out of goodwill.

16.text: The ones doing it out of rivalry are doing it for selfish reasons, thinking they're adding trouble to my chains,

17.text: But the ones doing it out of love know that I'm here for the defense of the gospel.

18.text: So, what's the deal? As long as Christ is preached, whether it's out of a fake act or real love, I'm good with it. I rejoice, and I'll keep rejoicing.

19.text: For I know this will turn out for my deliverance because of your prayers and the help of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

20.text: According to my earnest expectation and hope, that I won't be ashamed, but with boldness—just like always—Christ will be magnified in my body, whether I live or die.

21.text: For me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

22.text: But if I keep living, that'll mean more fruit from my labor; yet, honestly, I don't know which to choose.

23.text: I'm stuck between the two: I wanna go be with Christ, 'cause that's way better,

24.text: But to stay here is more needed for you.

25.text: I'm confident that I'm gonna stay and keep helping y'all grow in your faith,

26.text: So y'all can rejoice even more when I get back to you in Christ.

27.text: Only let your conduct be worthy of the gospel of Christ, so that whether I come to see you or stay away, I'll hear about your affairs—that you stand firm in one spirit, striving together with one mind for the faith of the gospel,

28.text: And don't be intimidated by your enemies—when they're scared, that's a sign of their defeat, but for you, it's a sign of your salvation, and that comes from God.

29.text: For to you, it's been granted not just to believe in Christ, but also to suffer for His sake,

30.text: Having the same struggle you saw in me, and now hear about in me.

1.text: So, if there's any encouragement in Christ, if there's any comfort in love, if there's any fellowship in the Spirit, if there's any affection and mercy,

2.text: Then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being united, and thinking the same way.

3.text: Don't do stuff out of selfish ambition or pride, but in humility, consider others better than yourself.

4.text: Don't just look out for your own interests, but for the interests of others too.

5.text: Let this mindset be in you, the same as it was in Christ Jesus,

6.text: Who, being in the form of God, didn't think it was stealing to be equal with God,

7.text: But He emptied Himself, took on the form of a servant, and came in the likeness of man.

8.text: And when He showed up as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to the point of death, even the death on the cross.

9.text: Therefore, God has highly exalted Him and given Him the name that's above every name,

10.text: That at the name of Jesus, every knee should bow—whether in heaven, on earth, or under the earth,

11.text: And every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

12.text: So, my beloved, as you've always obeyed, not only when I was around, but even more now that I'm not, Work out your own salvation with fear and trembling;

13.text: 'Cause it's God who's working in you, helping you to want what's right and to do what pleases Him.

14.text: Do everything without complaining or arguing,

15.text: So that you'll be blameless and innocent, children of God without fault in this crooked and messed-up generation,

16.text: Among whom you shine as lights in the world, holding onto the word of life, So that when Christ comes back, I'll have reason to rejoice, knowing I didn't waste my time or labor.

17.text: And if I'm being poured out as a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I'm glad and I rejoice with you all.

18.text: And y'all should be glad and rejoice with me too.

19.text: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, so that I can be encouraged when I know how you're doing.

20.text: I don't have anyone else like him, who will genuinely care for your situation,

21.text: 'Cause everyone else is focused on their own stuff, not the things that matter to Christ Jesus.

22.text: But you know his proven character—he served with me like a son with his father, in spreading the gospel.

23.text: So, I'm hoping to send him as soon as I see how things go with me.

24.text: But I trust the Lord that I'll come to you myself soon too.

25.text: I thought it was necessary to send Epaphroditus back to you—my brother, my coworker, my soldier—he's your messenger and the one who helped me in my need,

26.text: Since he was missing y'all and was worried that you heard he was sick.

27.text: He was sick almost to the point of death, but God showed mercy on him—and not just on him, but on me too, so I wouldn't have sorrow on top of sorrow.

28.text: So, I'm sending him back to you even more eagerly, so when you see him again, you can rejoice, and I'll be a little less sorrowful.

29.text: Receive him with joy in the Lord, and hold men like him in high regard,

30.text: 'Cause he came close to death for the work of Christ, not worrying about his own life, to make up for what was lacking in your service to me.

1.text: Finally, my people, rejoice in the Lord. For me to write the same thing to you ain't no big deal, but for you, it's safe.

2.text: Watch out for them dogs, watch out for them evil workers, watch out for the ones who be cutting themselves!

3.text: We the real deal—circumcised in the Spirit, worshiping God, rejoicing in Christ Jesus, and not putting any trust in the flesh.

4.text: But if anyone thinks they got reason to boast in the flesh, I got even more reason:

5.text: Circumcised on the eighth day, from the tribe of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; as far as the law goes, I was a Pharisee;

6.text: I had so much zeal, I was out here persecuting the church; and when it came to the righteousness from the law, I was blameless.

7.text: But all that stuff I thought was gain? I count it as loss for Christ.

8.text: Actually, I count everything as loss compared to the greatness of knowing Christ Jesus, my Lord. I lost everything for Him, and I count it as trash, so I can gain Christ.

9.text: And be found in Him, not with my own righteousness that comes from the law, but with the righteousness that comes through faith in Christ—the righteousness that's from God, by faith.

10.text: I wanna know Him, and I want to experience the power of His resurrection, and share in His sufferings, becoming like Him in His death,

11.text: If by any means, I can reach the resurrection from the dead.

12.text: I'm not saying I've already reached it, or that I'm already perfect, but I press on to grab what Christ Jesus grabbed me for.

13.text: Brothers and sisters, I don't count myself as having gotten there yet, but one thing I do: I forget what's behind and I'm reaching for what's ahead.

14.text: I press toward the goal for the prize of the high call of God in Christ Jesus.

15.text: So, if you're mature, let's think like this; and if you disagree with me on anything, God will show you what's right.

16.text: But until then, let's walk the same way we've been walking, thinking the same thing.

17.text: Brothers and sisters, follow my example, and look at those who walk the way we walk, 'cause we gave you a pattern to follow.

18.text: There's a lot of people out here walking the wrong way, and I've told y'all before, and I'm even crying about it now. They're enemies of the cross of Christ,

19.text: Their end is destruction, their god is their belly, and they're out here glorifying their shame—focused on earthly things.

20.text: But our citizenship is in heaven, and we're waiting for the Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

21.text: Who will transform our lowly bodies, so that they can be like His glorious body, by the power He has to make everything submit to Himself.

1.text: Therefore, my beloved and longed-for brothers and sisters, my joy and crown, so stand firm in the Lord, beloved.

2.text: I'm begging Euodia and Syntyche to get on the same page in the Lord.

3.text: And I urge you, true companion, help these women who worked with me in the gospel, with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the Book of Life.

4.text: Rejoice in the Lord always. Again, I say, rejoice!

5.text: Let your gentleness be known to everyone. The Lord is near.

6.text: Don't worry about anything, but in everything, through prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving, let your requests be known to God,

7.text: And the peace of God, which passes all understanding, will guard your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

8.text: Finally, my people, whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable—if there's any excellence or anything worthy of praise—think on these things.

9.text: The things you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, do them, and the God of peace will be with you.

10.text: I'm so happy in the Lord that now, at last, your care for me has blossomed again. You were always concerned, but you didn't have the chance before.

11.text: Not that I'm in need—I've learned to be content in whatever state I'm in.

12.text: I know what it's like to be low, and I know what it's like to have plenty. I've learned how to be full and how to be hungry, how to have more than enough and how to need.

13.text: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

14.text: But you did well by sharing in my struggles.

15.text: You Philippians know that in the beginning of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, no church helped me with giving and receiving but you only.

16.text: Even when I was in Thessalonica, y'all sent me help more than once.

17.text: Not that I'm chasing the gift, but I'm chasing the fruit that's growing in your account.

18.text: I've got everything I need and more. I'm full, having received from Epaphroditus what you sent me, a sweet-smelling gift, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.

19.text: And my God will meet all your needs according to His riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

20.text: Now to our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.

21.text: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers and sisters here with me send their greetings to you.

22.text: All the saints send their greetings, especially those from Caesar's household.

23.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

1.text: This right here is the revelation of Jesus Christ—the one God gave Him to show His servants what's 'bout to go down soon. Jesus sent it through an angel to His boy John.

2.text: John testified to everything he saw—God's word and what Jesus revealed. He kept it 100 the whole way.

3.text: Blessings to the one who reads this out loud, and to everybody who hears it and actually does what it says. Time ain't just near—it's knockin'.

4.text: From John—To the seven churches out in Asia: Grace and peace to y'all from the One who is, who was, and who's still comin', and from the seven Spirits posted up before His throne,

5.text: And from Jesus Christ—the faithful witness, the first to rise from the dead and never die again, and the true Ruler over every king on this earth. To Him who loved us and washed our sins clean with His own blood—

6.text: And made us kings and priests to God the Father—To Him be glory and authority forever. Amen. 👑

7.text: Look, He comin' with the clouds! Every eye gon' see Him—even the ones who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the world gon' mourn when they see Him. Yeah. Let it be. Amen.

8.text: "I am the Alpha and the Omega," says the Lord—the Beginning and the End. "I'm the One who is, who was, and who's comin' back. I'm the Almighty." 🔥

9.text: It's me, John—y'all brother and teammate in the struggles, the Kingdom, and the patience of Jesus. I was exiled on the island of Patmos 'cause I stayed faithful to God's word and kept speakin' on Jesus.

10.text: One Sunday, I got caught up in the Spirit. And I heard a loud voice behind me—sounded like a trumpet blast—

11.text: Sayin', "I'm the Alpha and Omega—the First and the Last. Write what you see in a book and send it to the seven churches: Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamos, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea."

12.text: I turned to see who was talkin' to me. And when I turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,

13.text: And right in the middle was Somebody who looked like the Son of Man—rockin' a long robe and a golden sash across His chest.

14.text: His hair was white like wool—bright like snow—and His eyes were flames of fire.

15.text: His feet? Looked like polished bronze fresh out the furnace. His voice? Like a thousand waterfalls. 🌊

16.text: In His right hand, He held seven stars. Out His mouth came a sharp double-edged sword. And His face? Shinin' like the full-force sun.

17.text: When I saw Him, I dropped like I was dead. But He touched me with His right hand and said, "Don't be scared. I'm the First and the Last.

18.text: I'm the One who's alive. I was dead, but look—I'm alive forever now. Amen. And I hold the keys to death and the grave." 🔑

19.text: "So write down what you've seen, what's happenin' now, and what's gon' happen next."

20.text: "Here's the mystery: The seven stars in My right hand? They the angels (or messengers) of the seven churches. And the seven lampstands? That's the seven churches."

1.text: Write this to the angel of the church in Ephesus: This the One holdin' all seven stars in His right hand, walkin' in the middle of the seven golden lampstands—He got somethin' to say:

2.text: "I see your grind—your works, your hard labor, and your patience. I know you don't play when it comes to evil folks. You tested them fake apostles and called out the lies.

3.text: You stayed strong, didn't give up, and kept workin' for My name.

4.text: But I got somethin' against you: you fell off from your first love.

5.text: So check where you slipped. Repent. Get back to what you used to do, or I'm takin' your lampstand away—quick—unless you change.

6.text: One thing I do respect: you can't stand the Nicolaitan crew, and neither can I."

7.text: "Anybody who got ears? Listen up. Whoever overcomes—I'll let you eat from the Tree of Life in God's paradise." 🌴

8.text: To the angel of the church in Smyrna, write: This from the First and the Last—the One who died and came back to life:

9.text: "I know your works. I see your suffering and poverty—though you really rich in spirit. I know the ones talkin' like they Jews but ain't—just frontin'. They a synagogue of Satan.

10.text: Don't be scared of what's comin'. The devil about to test some of y'all by throwin' you in jail. You gon' face heat for ten days. Stay faithful—even if it kills you—and I'll crown you with life."

11.text: "If you got ears, hear what the Spirit is sayin'. Whoever overcomes ain't got nothin' to fear from the second death." 👑

12.text: To the angel of the church in Pergamos, write: This from the One who got the sharp double-edged sword:

13.text: "I know your works. I see where you live—that's Satan's neighborhood. Still, you held on to My name, and didn't switch up when Antipas, My faithful witness, got killed right where y'all at."

14.text: "But I do got a few things against you: Some of y'all messin' with the teachings of Balaam—lead people into sin, idol food, and sexual immorality.

15.text: And then there's some holdin' to the Nicolaitan teachings too, which I hate."

16.text: "Repent—or I'm pullin' up quick, and I ain't talkin'. I'm swingin' with the sword of My mouth."

17.text: "Whoever got ears—listen. Whoever overcomes? I got hidden manna for 'em and a white stone with a name on it—one that only they know." 🍞💎

18.text: To the angel of the church in Thyatira, write: This is from the Son of God—eyes like fire, feet like fine brass:

19.text: "I see your works. Your love, faith, service, and patience. Matter fact, you doin' more now than when you started."

20.text: "But I got beef with you—you lettin' that woman Jezebel run the show. She call herself a prophet, but she teachin' My people to get caught up in sex sin and idolatry."

21.text: "I gave her time to repent. She ain't take it."

22.text: "Now I'ma throw her in a sickbed. And the folks sleepin' with her? They headed for heavy trouble unless they repent."

23.text: "Her kids? I'ma strike 'em down. And the whole church gon' know—I'm the One who reads hearts and minds. And everybody gon' get what they deserve."

24.text: "But for the rest of y'all in Thyatira who ain't messed with that mess, who ain't studied 'Satan's deep secrets'—I won't put more on you.

25.text: Just hold tight to what you got—till I come."

26.text: "Whoever overcomes and keeps grindin' in My works to the end? I'ma give them authority over nations.

27.text: They gon' rule with iron like I do—breakin' pride like pottery."

28.text: "And I'll give 'em the morning star." 🌟

29.text: "If you got ears? Listen to what the Spirit's sayin' to the churches."

1.text: To the angel of the church in Sardis, write: This is from the One who got the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars. He say: "I know what y'all do. You got a name like you alive… but you spiritually dead."

2.text: "Wake up! Strengthen what little remains, 'cause it's about to die too. I checked your work and it ain't hittin' like it's supposed to—not perfect in God's sight."

3.text: "Remember what you heard. Go back to it. Hold tight and repent. If you don't wake up, I'm comin' for you like a thief in the night—you won't even see Me comin'."

4.text: "But some of y'all in Sardis kept your garments clean. Y'all gon' walk with Me in white 'cause you stayed worthy."

5.text: "Whoever overcomes will be dressed in white. And I won't erase their name from the Book of Life. I'll say their name out loud before My Father and all the angels." 🕊️

6.text: "If you got ears, hear what the Spirit sayin' to the churches."

7.text: To the angel of the church in Philly, write: This is from the One who's holy and true—the One who got the key of David. When He opens a door, can't nobody shut it. And when He shut it, it's shut for good. 🔐
