10.text: They laugh at kings, don't respect no prince. Every fortress look like child's play to them—they just stack dirt and take it.

11.text: Then they get cocky, switch up, and go too far. They wrong for it, but still give credit to they fake gods like that's who made it happen.

12.text: Ain't You the everlasting God, Lord? My holy one? We ain't supposed to die like this. Lord, You the one who picked them for judgment. You our Rock. You supposed to check them.

13.text: Your eyes too pure to look at evil, so how You lettin' treacherous folks get away with this? Why You sittin' quiet while the wicked eat up folks more righteous than them?

14.text: You got people lookin' like fish in the sea, like little bugs with nobody to guide 'em.

15.text: These enemies scoopin' everybody up with they nets, pullin' in whole crowds like it's nothin'. And they celebratin'—they hype about it.

16.text: They treat they nets like gods now, burnin' incense and throwin' offerings, 'cause that net got 'em fed real good, got 'em livin' large.

17.text: So what now? They just gon' keep emptyin' that net, keep killin' off nations without even feelin' bad?

1.text: I'ma stay posted at my spot, Watchin' and waitin', up on the lookout tower, Tryna see what the Lord gon' say to me, And how I'm supposed to respond when He checks me.

2.text: Then the Lord hit me with the word: "Write down this vision real clear. Put it on tablets so anybody readin' it can take off runnin' with it.

3.text: This vision got an appointment—it ain't late, it's just not time yet. But when it hits, it's gon' speak loud and won't lie. It might feel like it's takin' forever, but hold tight— It's comin' for sure, no doubt about it."

4.text: "Look at the one who's puffed up— his soul all twisted inside. But the one who's righteous? They gon' live by faith, not by flex."

5.text: That man wildin' with wine, Full of pride, always runnin' the streets. He greedy like the grave—never satisfied. Snatchin' up nations, stackin' folks like trophies.

6.text: But don't think folks ain't gon' talk about him— They gon' roast him with parables and punchlines: 'Woe to the one who stacks what ain't his— How long you think you gon' get away with that? You out here drownin' in debt.'

7.text: Ain't your lenders gon' wake up and say "Run it back"? Ain't your enemies gon' flip the script and rob you this time?

8.text: You tore up many nations—now the leftovers gon' tear you up, 'Cause of all the blood you spilled And all the violence you brought to the land, the cities, and the people in 'em.

9.text: Woe to the one who tryna get rich on dirty money, Tryna build a high nest so the drama can't reach him.

10.text: You played yourself—put your fam in shame, Wiped out whole communities, sinned against your own soul.

11.text: Even the bricks in your wall gon' cry out, And the wooden beams gon' testify against you.

12.text: Woe to the one who builds whole cities on bloodshed, Who lay foundations with injustice.

13.text: Don't you know the Lord of Heaven's Armies ain't in that? You workin' yourself to the bone to build bonfires for nothin'.

14.text: But the earth? It's gon' be full of the knowledge of God's glory— Just like the oceans full of water.

15.text: Woe to the one who gets folks drunk, Just so he can peep their shame— Tryna catch folks slippin'.

16.text: You full of shame, not glory. You drinkin'? Go 'head and drink up that same cup— The one God gon' hand you. That shame comin' right back at you, heavy.

17.text: You wrecked Lebanon, now it's gon' come back on you. You scared animals and slaughtered people, Tore up cities and brought violence on everything.

18.text: What's the point of your little idol statue? You made it, now you trust it? That thing can't teach you nothin'—it's a lie. Just wood and metal with no breath in it.

19.text: Woe to you who talkin' to wood like it's alive— Tellin' stone to "wake up." It might be dressed in gold and silver, But it's dead. It ain't got no life in it.

20.text: But the Lord? He sittin' in His holy temple. So the whole earth? Y'all better hush and be still before Him.

1.text: A prayer from the prophet Habakkuk, written with passion and rhythm.

2.text: Lord, I heard what You said—had me shook. Do what You do again in our time, Lord—bring it back! Show Yourself in these years we livin' in. Even when You bring that heat… don't forget to show mercy.

3.text: God showed up from Teman, The Holy One came from Mount Paran. Selah His glory lit up the sky, And the whole earth was filled with His praise.

4.text: His brightness hit like lightning. Power beaming from His hands— That's where His strength was sittin', low-key but ready.

5.text: Disease ran out in front of Him, Plagues followed behind like they knew who was boss.

6.text: He stopped and sized up the whole earth. Just one look had the nations shook. Ancient mountains scattered like dust, Old hills dropped low— His ways been solid from way back.

7.text: I saw Cushan's tents trembling, The people of Midian's curtains shakin' like they caught a chill.

8.text: Lord, was You mad at the rivers? Was the sea gettin' on Your nerves? You rode in on Your horses, Pulled up in Your chariots ready to save.

9.text: Your bow was locked and loaded, You made Your arrows speak with power. Selah You split the land wide open with rivers.

10.text: The mountains saw You and started trembling. Waters overflowed, waves raged. The deep sea hollered out, Lifted up its hands like it knew who was in charge.

11.text: The sun and moon stood still, froze in place, While Your arrows flashed and Your spear blazed through.

12.text: You marched across the land with anger in Your step, Crushed whole nations in Your fury.

13.text: You came to save Your people—yes, Your chosen ones. You struck down the leader of the wicked, Exposed him from top to bottom. Selah

14.text: You used their own weapons on 'em, Took out their village leaders. They came in like a storm tryna wipe me out, Laughin' like it was sweet, feastin' on the helpless.

15.text: You walked right through the sea with Your horses, Stirred up the waters like it was nothin'.

16.text: When I heard all this, my whole body shook. My lips trembled, my bones felt like they was meltin'. I was weak—but I waited in faith, Waitin' for the day of trouble to hit the enemy camp.

17.text: Even if the fig trees don't bloom, No grapes on the vine, Even if the olive harvest fails, And the fields don't produce no food, Even if the sheep vanish from the pen, And the cattle stalls stay empty—

18.text: I'ma still rejoice in the Lord. I'ma turn up in the God who saves me.

19.text: The Lord God is my strength. He gives me feet like a deer, So I can walk high, steady, and strong.

1.text: In the second year of King Darius, in the sixth month, on the first day, God dropped a word on Haggai for Zerubbabel (Shealtiel's son, the governor of Judah) and Joshua (Jehozadak's son, the high priest).

2.text: "The Lord of Heaven's Armies said: These folks out here keep sayin', 'It ain't time to rebuild the Lord's house yet.'"

3.text: Then God spoke again through Haggai:

4.text: "So let me get this straight—y'all got time to live comfy in your fancy houses, but My house still sittin' in ruins?"

5.text: Listen up—this what the Lord of Hosts says: "Check yourself. Look at how you've been livin'."

6.text: "Y'all plantin' seeds but barely harvestin'. You eat, but you still hungry. You drink, but it don't quench your thirst. You get dressed, but still cold. You work hard for your money, But it's like puttin' it in a purse with holes in it."

7.text: The Lord of Hosts says it again: "Check yourself. Look at what you do."

8.text: "Go up to the mountains, bring back wood, and rebuild My house. Do that, and I'll be pleased—I'll be glorified," says the Lord.

9.text: "Y'all expected big results, but it all came up short. Even when you did bring stuff home, I blew it away. Wanna know why?" says the Lord of Hosts. "'Cause My house is still tore down, while y'all stay runnin' to take care of your own."

10.text: "That's why the skies hold back the rain and the ground won't grow nothin'."

11.text: "I'm the one who called that drought—on the land, the hills, the grain, the wine, the oil, on everything the earth produces. Even the people and animals feel it. I shut it all down—your hustle included."

12.text: Then Zerubbabel and Joshua, along with everybody left in Judah, actually listened to God and to Haggai, His prophet. When they realized God really sent this word, they got shook and humbled themselves.

13.text: Then Haggai gave 'em another word from the Lord: "I'm right here with y'all," says the Lord.

14.text: So God stirred up Zerubbabel, Joshua, and all the people. He lit a fire in their spirit—and they got to work on the house of the Lord of Hosts, their God.

15.text: This all went down on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, during the second year of King Darius.

1.text: In the seventh month, on the 21st day, God gave Haggai another word.

2.text: He told him, "Go talk to Zerubbabel (Shealtiel's son, governor of Judah), Joshua (Jehozadak's son, the high priest), and the rest of the people. Say this to 'em:

3.text: 'Who here remembers how the old temple used to look? Ain't this new one lookin' kinda… underwhelming compared to that?'

4.text: But God says, 'Zerubbabel, don't let that discourage you—be strong. Joshua, you too—be strong. And all y'all, the people of the land—be strong and get to work. I'm with you,' says the Lord of Hosts.

5.text: 'My Spirit is still with y'all just like I promised back when I brought y'all outta Egypt. So don't be scared!'

6.text: "This what the Lord of Hosts says: 'In just a little while, I'm gon' shake things up—heaven, earth, sea, and dry land.

7.text: I'm gon' shake up all the nations, and they gon' bring in what's most precious. And this temple? I'ma fill it with My glory,' says the Lord of Hosts.

8.text: 'Silver? Mine. Gold? Mine.

9.text: And the glory of this new house? It's gon' outshine the old one. And in this place, I'm givin' peace,' says the Lord of Hosts."

10.text: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, God came back with another word to Haggai:

11.text: "Ask the priests this:

12.text: 'If somebody's carrying holy meat in the fold of their robe and that robe touches some bread or stew or wine or oil—does that food become holy too?'" The priests answered, "Nah, it don't."

13.text: Then Haggai said, "What if somebody touches a dead body and then touches the food—does that food become unclean?" The priests said, "Yeah, it becomes unclean."

14.text: Then Haggai hit 'em with the truth: "That's exactly what y'all been like," says the Lord. "Y'all and everything y'all been doing—unclean. Even your offerings—unclean."

15.text: "Now pay attention to what happens from this day forward. Back when y'all hadn't laid even one stone for the temple,

16.text: y'all kept coming up short. You expected twenty measures—you got ten. You pressed for fifty baths of wine—you got twenty.

17.text: I sent blight, mildew, and hail to shut your hustle down. But still, y'all ain't turned back to Me," says the Lord.

18.text: "But from today on—the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, the day the foundation got laid—I want y'all to take note.

19.text: The seeds ain't even come up yet—vine, fig, pomegranate, olive—ain't none of it produced. But from this day on, I'm gon' bless you."

20.text: That same day, God gave Haggai another word:

21.text: "Tell Zerubbabel, the governor of Judah:

22.text: 'I'm about to shake up heaven and earth. I'm toppling thrones and smashing kingdoms.

23.text: I'm tearing down the enemy's war machines—their chariots, their horses, and their riders. They gon' turn on each other with swords.'

24.text: 'And on that day,' says the Lord of Hosts, 'I'm choosin' you, Zerubbabel. I'm makin' you My signet ring—My chosen one,' says the Lord of Hosts."

1.text: This the word the Lord gave to Hosea, son of Beeri, back when Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah was runnin' Judah, and Jeroboam—Joash's son—was king over Israel.

2.text: When God first started speakin' through Hosea, He told him straight up: "Go get you a wife who belong to the streets—and have some kids by her too. This whole land been actin' wild, cheatin' on Me spiritually, turnin' their back on Me like I ain't the One who brought them up."

3.text: So Hosea did what God said—he married Gomer, daughter of Diblaim. She got pregnant and gave him a son.

4.text: Then God told Hosea, "Name that boy Jezreel, 'cause I'm 'bout to make the house of Jehu pay for all that bloodshed that went down in Jezreel. I'm 'bout to shut down the whole kingdom of Israel."

5.text: "On that day, I'ma break Israel's strength right in the Valley of Jezreel."

6.text: Gomer got pregnant again and had a baby girl. God said, "Name her Lo-Ruhamah—'cause I ain't showin' no more mercy to Israel. I'm done with 'em. I'm really finna wipe 'em out."

7.text: "But Judah? I'ma still show them love. I'ma save 'em—not with no army, no bows, swords, or horses—but with My own hand. They gon' know it was Me, the Lord their God."

8.text: After Lo-Ruhamah got weaned, Gomer had another son.

9.text: God said, "Name this one Lo-Ammi—'cause y'all ain't My people no more, and I ain't your God."

10.text: But hold up—it ain't over. Even though they ain't actin' like My people now, one day the children of Israel gon' be uncountable, like sand at the beach. You can't measure that. "In that same place where folks said, 'Y'all ain't God's people,' they gon' turn around and say, 'Y'all are children of the livin' God!'"

11.text: Then Judah and Israel gon' link up again—united. They gon' pick one leader over 'em, and rise up outta that land. And when they do? Oh, it's gon' be a big day—Jezreel's day, but this time in victory.

1.text: Tell your brothers, "Y'all my people," And tell your sisters, "God showin' mercy."

2.text: Call out ya mama—yeah, drag her if you got to. She ain't actin' like my wife, and I ain't gon' act like her husband. Tell her to stop wildin' and put away that ho-ish behavior.

3.text: If she don't, I'ma strip her bare—naked like she just got born, Leave her out here dry and thirsty, like a desert wasteland.

4.text: I ain't gon' feel bad for her kids either, 'Cause they came from all that wild livin'.

5.text: Their mama been out here actin' foul—real reckless. She out here sayin', "I'ma chase the ones who spoil me— They give me bread, water, wool, linen, oil, and my drinks too."

6.text: So I'ma block her path with thorns, Put up a wall so she can't find her way.

7.text: She gon' run after them lovers, But she won't catch 'em. She gon' look, but won't find nothin'. Then she gon' come to her senses like, "Let me go back to my first man—he treated me better than this."

8.text: She ain't even realize it was Me— I'm the one who gave her the grain, the wine, the oil, Multiplied her silver and gold— But she used all that to worship Baal. Smh.

9.text: So now I'ma come take back everything— My grain when it's time to eat, My wine when it's time to drink, My wool and linen that was coverin' her shame.

10.text: I'ma expose her dirt in front of everybody she tryin' to impress, And ain't nobody gon' be able to save her from Me.

11.text: All that laughin', all them celebrations—done. No more holidays, new moons, Sabbaths, or feast days. Cut off.

12.text: I'ma destroy them vines and fig trees she thought her lovers paid for. I'ma let it all go wild, let the animals eat it up.

13.text: She gon' pay for all the days she worshipped them fake gods, Burnin' incense, wearin' jewelry, and chasin' lovers— But forgot about Me," says the Lord.

14.text: "But look, I ain't done with her. I'ma bring her out to the wilderness, Speak gently to her heart.

15.text: I'ma give her back her vineyards, Turn the Valley of Trouble into a doorway of hope. She gon' sing again—like she did back in the day, When I brought her outta Egypt.

16.text: On that day," says the Lord, "You gon' call Me 'Husband,' not just 'Master.'

17.text: I'ma erase the name of them Baals from your mouth— You won't even remember their names no more.

18.text: That day, I'ma make peace with nature for y'all— The animals, the birds, the crawlin' things. I'ma break the bow and sword—no more war. You gon' lay down in safety.

19.text: I'ma marry you forever— In righteousness, justice, love, and mercy.

20.text: I'ma lock it in with faithfulness. And you? You gon' finally know Me for real.

21.text: When that day comes," says the Lord, "I'ma answer the sky, and the sky gon' answer the earth.

22.text: The earth gon' respond with grain, wine, and oil. And they gon' bless Jezreel."

23.text: I'ma plant her in the land for Myself. I'ma show mercy to the one I said I wouldn't. And to the one I said, 'You not mine'? I'ma say, 'You mine now.' And they gon' say, 'You my God.'

1.text: Then the Lord said to me, "Go again—love that woman who still out here messin' around, sleepin' with somebody else. Love her anyway, just like I love Israel, even though they steady runnin' to other gods and crushin' on them pagan snacks—raisin cakes and all."

2.text: So I went and bought her back. Paid fifteen silver coins and a lil' over a bushel of barley to get her.

3.text: And I told her, "You stay right here with me. No more wildin', no more jumpin' from man to man. You gon' be mine, and I'ma be yours. We locked in."

4.text: 'Cause Israel? They gon' be without a king, without leadership, without sacrifices, without their spiritual props—no pillars, no priest garments, none of that.

5.text: But after all that time, they gon' come back. They gon' start lookin' for the Lord again, and for David's kingly line. They gon' finally have that deep respect for the Lord—and realize how good He really is, especially in the end times.

1.text: Listen up, y'all—Israel, hear what the Lord gotta say. He bringin' charges against everybody in the land. Ain't no truth out here, no kindness, Ain't nobody even tryin' to know God.

2.text: Folks out here swearin' falsely, lyin', killin', stealin', Cheatin' left and right— No self-control at all. It's just blood on top of blood.

3.text: That's why the land hurtin'. Everybody in it wastin' away— Even the animals in the field, the birds in the sky, Shoot, even the fish in the sea disappearin'.

4.text: Don't nobody try to check nobody else, 'Cause y'all just like the folks who argue with the priest— Like, who you tryna school?

5.text: That's why y'all gon' fall flat in broad daylight, And even the so-called prophets gon' stumble in the dark. God said, "I'ma take your mama out too."

6.text: My people bein' destroyed 'cause they don't know nothin'. Y'all rejected knowledge, so I'ma reject you from reppin' Me as priests. Y'all forgot about My law? Bet—I'ma forget your kids too.

7.text: The more y'all multiplied, The more y'all sinned against Me. So I'ma turn your "shine" into shame.

8.text: They out here eatin' off the sins of the people, Cravin' evil like it's a full-course meal.

9.text: What the people do, the priests do too. So I'ma check both of 'em—punish 'em for how they livin', Pay 'em back for all they done.

10.text: They gon' eat but never be full. They gon' cheat but never grow or thrive. Why? 'Cause they stopped listenin' to Me.

11.text: Adultery, wine, and that strong drink got they hearts in a chokehold.

12.text: My people out here askin' wooden statues for advice, Lookin' to a stick for answers. That cheatin' spirit got them all twisted, They done turned they back on God.

13.text: They makin' sacrifices on mountaintops, Burnin' incense under shady trees—oaks, poplars, and terebinths— Just 'cause the spot feel nice. That's why their daughters out here actin' wild, And their new brides out here steppin' out.

14.text: I ain't even gon' punish the daughters or the brides, 'Cause the men doin' the same thing— Hittin' up temple prostitutes and offerin' sacrifices with 'em. A people with no understanding? Gon' get stomped out.

15.text: Israel, if you gon' act triflin', fine— But Judah? Don't follow behind them. Don't go to Gilgal, don't head to Beth Aven, And don't be swearing fake oaths like, "As the Lord lives" when y'all ain't livin' right.

16.text: Israel stubborn as a hard-headed calf. God gon' let them wander off like a lonely lamb in the wild.

17.text: Ephraim done locked in with idols. Leave him be.

18.text: They drunk on rebellion, Caught up in cheatin' nonstop. The leaders? They love mess. They love what's dirty.

19.text: Now the wind done swept them up, And they gon' be put to shame because of all them fake sacrifices.

1.text: Listen up, priests! Pay attention, house of Israel! And you too, king's crew—better open your ears. This judgment right here? It's for y'all. Y'all been setting traps in Mizpah, Spreading nets over Tabor like y'all huntin' people.

2.text: These rebels? Deep in the mess—killin' and wildin'. But I'm checkin' every last one of 'em.

3.text: I know Ephraim like the back of My hand, And Israel? You can't hide from Me. Ephraim out here cheatin', And Israel? Y'all dirty now.

4.text: They don't even try to come back to Me. That cheatin' spirit got a hold on 'em, And they don't really know who I am.

5.text: Israel too proud—and it shows. So both Israel and Ephraim gon' trip over they own sin. And guess what? Judah fallin' right with 'em.

6.text: They gon' show up with all they sheep and cattle, Tryna seek Me like it's business as usual. But I'm gone. I done dipped on 'em.

7.text: They played Me foul, Raised up kids that don't even know Me. Now this New Moon festival they love so much? It's gon' swallow them and everything they got.

8.text: Blow the ram's horn in Gibeah! Sound the trumpet in Ramah! Shout out loud at Beth Aven— "Benjamin, you better look over your shoulder!"

9.text: Ephraim gon' be laid out on judgment day. And I'ma make sure every tribe in Israel know—I meant what I said.

10.text: Judah's leaders movin' boundary lines like crooks. So I'ma pour My anger on 'em like floodwaters.

11.text: Ephraim gettin' crushed—judged hard— Why? 'Cause he chose to follow man's rules over God's.

12.text: So now, I'ma be like a moth to Ephraim—eatin' away slow, And like rot in Judah's bones—decay from the inside.

13.text: Ephraim saw he was sick. Judah felt the pain too. But instead of comin' to Me, They ran to Assyria, tried to holler at King Jareb. But he ain't got the cure. He can't fix this wound.

14.text: I'ma be like a lion to Ephraim, And like a young lion to Judah. I'ma snatch 'em up, tear 'em down, and dip— Ain't nobody comin' to rescue.

15.text: I'ma go back to My place and wait, 'Til they finally admit what they did wrong. Then they gon' come lookin' for Me, Hurtin' and desperate, cryin' out for real.

1.text: Come on, y'all—let's get back to the Lord. Yeah, He cut us, but He the same One who can heal. He hit us hard, but He also the One who can patch us up.

2.text: After two days, He gon' revive us. On the third day? He gon' raise us up, So we can live right in front of Him again.

3.text: Let's get to know Him—really know Him. Let's chase after that knowledge of the Lord. He steady like the sunrise, And He gon' come to us like rain— That spring rain, that fall rain, all of it. Just right.

4.text: "Ephraim, what I'm supposed to do with you? And you too, Judah? Y'all love don't last. It's like fog in the morning— There for a second, then gone. Like dew that disappears.

5.text: That's why I had to cut y'all down with the prophets, Slice y'all up with My words. My judgment hit like lightning in the sky.

6.text: I don't want no empty sacrifices— I want mercy. I want y'all to know Me, Not just burn stuff on an altar.

7.text: But just like Adam, they broke the covenant. Right there, they acted shady toward Me.

8.text: Gilead? Full of evil— Bloodstains everywhere.

9.text: And the priests? They ain't no better. They roll like gangs, waitin' to ambush folks on the road to Shechem. Straight-up scandalous.

10.text: I done seen some wild stuff in Israel's house. Ephraim out here wildin' in spiritual adultery. Israel stay unclean.

11.text: And Judah? Don't think you off the hook. You got a harvest comin' too— When I bring My people back home from captivity."

1.text: Every time I tried to heal Israel, Boom—Ephraim's dirt came out. Samaria's wickedness got exposed. They out here scamming folks, Thieves creepin' in the house, And gangs robbin' folks outside.

2.text: They don't even think in they hearts, "Yo, God see all this mess." But I do. Their own actions surround them like a trap— They right in My face.

3.text: They got kings smilin' over their evil, And princes laughin' at all their lies.

4.text: They all out here cheatin'—every last one. Burnin' hot like an oven. Like a baker who don't touch the fire after kneading the dough, Just lettin' it rise, lettin' it build up.

5.text: On the king's day, The princes got him turnt up off wine, Actin' a fool with the rest of the clowns.

6.text: Their hearts stay preheated like an oven— Schemin' in silence. The baker sleepin' at night, But come morning, the fire blowin' up like flames.

7.text: All of them burnin' up with heat, Takin' out their own judges. All their kings keep fallin', And still—nobody callin' on Me.

8.text: Ephraim out here blendin' in with everybody else— He like a pancake that never got flipped—burnt on one side, raw on the other.

9.text: Outsiders been drainin' his strength, But he too clueless to even notice. He got gray hairs poppin' up all over, But he still actin' brand new, like he ain't see it.

10.text: Israel's pride standin' right there on his face, But still won't come back to Me. Won't even look My way.

11.text: Ephraim act like a silly dove—no common sense at all. One minute he cryin' out to Egypt, Next thing he runnin' to Assyria.

12.text: But wherever he fly, I'ma throw My net over him— Bring him down like a bird fallin' from the sky. I'ma check him real good, Just like I warned y'all in church.

13.text: Woe to them—they ran away from Me! Destruction comin' 'cause they broke My trust. I saved them, but they still out here lyin' on Me.

14.text: They cryin' on they beds at night, But it ain't real. They ain't talkin' to Me with their hearts. They just gatherin' up food and drink, Still tryna rebel.

15.text: I'm the one who trained them, gave them strength, But all they do is plot evil against Me.

16.text: They try to come back, But it ain't to Me—it ain't to the Most High. They like a busted bow that can't even shoot straight. Their leaders gon' die by the sword 'Cause of all the foul things they been sayin'. And Egypt? Gon' clown them hard for it.

1.text: Blow that trumpet loud! The enemy comin' like an eagle swoopin' down on God's house— Why? 'Cause they broke My covenant And straight-up rebelled against My law.

2.text: Israel gon' cry out, "God! We know You!" But they ain't actin' like it.

3.text: They rejected what's good, So now the enemy right behind 'em, ready to pounce.

4.text: They picked kings without askin' Me. They made princes I ain't even co-sign. Then they took their silver and gold, Built up their own idols— And that's what's gon' destroy them.

5.text: That golden calf in Samaria? Nope. Rejected. God mad for real. How long y'all gon' keep actin' like y'all innocent?

6.text: That idol came from Israel— A man made that thing. It ain't God. That fake calf in Samaria? It's gettin' smashed to pieces.

7.text: They out here plantin' wind, But they gon' harvest a whole tornado. Ain't no crops comin' from their foolishness. And even if somethin' did grow, Foreigners gon' eat it all up.

8.text: Israel done got swallowed whole— Now they out here livin' among the nations Like some raggedy bowl nobody wanna use.

9.text: They ran off to Assyria, Actin' like a wild donkey out here by itself. Ephraim out here buyin' love—hiring nations like escorts.

10.text: But even though they out here payin' other nations, I'ma gather 'em back Myself. And they gon' feel that sorrow, 'Cause now they gotta answer to kings who ain't playin'.

11.text: Ephraim built too many altars for sin, And now they just stuck sinning more and more.

12.text: I wrote My laws clear as day, Big blessings, real guidance— But they looked at it like it was foreign, like it ain't even apply to them.

13.text: They bringin' Me sacrifices, Burnin' the meat and eatin' it like I'm impressed— But I ain't acceptin' none of it. Now I'ma remember all their wrongs, And I'ma punish 'em. They gon' end up back in Egypt.

14.text: Israel forgot who made 'em. They out here buildin' fake temples, And Judah? Stackin' up fortified cities. But I'ma send fire on all they cities— Them palaces? Burnt down. Period.

1.text: Don't be out here celebratin', Israel— Not like the other nations. You been out here cheatin' on God, Lovin' up on every threshin' floor like you for sale.

2.text: But guess what? That threshin' floor and winepress ain't gon' feed you no more. That new wine? She dried up.

3.text: Y'all ain't stayin' in God's land. Ephraim goin' back to Egypt, And they gon' end up eatin' unclean food in Assyria.

4.text: Don't even think about offerin' no wine to God— He ain't acceptin' none of that. Y'all sacrifices? Trash. They like funeral bread—makes anybody who touch it unclean. That bread just for your own survival, It ain't comin' into God's house.

5.text: So what y'all gon' do on God's feast day? On that special day He set aside?

6.text: Y'all already scattered 'cause the land destroyed. Egypt gon' scoop y'all up, Memphis gon' handle the burials. Nettles gon' take over your silver, Thorns takin' up space in your tents.

7.text: The time for payback is here—punishment time. Israel see it now. The prophet look crazy, The spiritual man sound insane— All 'cause your sin too heavy and your hate run deep.

8.text: Ephraim's watchman used to roll with God, But now even the prophet got traps set— Foulness done made its way into the temple too.

9.text: These folks are straight corrupt, Like back in the days of Gibeah. God ain't forgot none of it— And He gon' punish every bit.

10.text: God said: "I found y'all like grapes in the wild—rare and sweet. Y'all ancestors were like early figs—first harvest goodness. But then y'all ran off to Baal Peor, Linked up with that mess, And turned into what you worshipped—pure filth.

11.text: Ephraim's glory gone like a bird that flew off— No babies, no pregnancy, no nothin'.

12.text: And even if they do raise kids, I'ma snatch 'em away till none left. It's gon' be ugly when I walk away from 'em."

13.text: Ephraim used to be like Tyre—planted nice, lookin' blessed. But now? They bringin' their kids straight to the killers.

14.text: Lord, give 'em what they askin' for… What should You give? Give 'em wombs that miscarry, Breasts that don't feed.

15.text: Everything wrong with them started in Gilgal— That's where I started hatin' on their behavior. 'Cause of all that evil, I'ma kick them out My house. Ain't lovin' them no more. Their leaders? Straight rebellious.

16.text: Ephraim already hit—root dried up. They can't grow no fruit. And even if they somehow have kids, I'ma take the ones they hold dearest.

17.text: My God gon' throw them out, 'Cause they ain't listen. They gon' end up wanderin' all over the world, Lost among the nations.

1.text: Israel been actin' like a vine that only feeds itself. The more fruit they had, the more altars they built— The more they prospered, the more they dressed up them fake worship spots.

2.text: But their heart divided—two-faced. Now they guilty for real. God gon' smash their altars And tear down them sacred pillars.

3.text: Now they sittin' around sayin', "We ain't got no king— Guess we ain't fear the Lord. And even if we had a king, What he really gon' do for us?"

4.text: All they do is run they mouths, Make fake promises, break covenants. That's why judgment spreadin' like poison plants Growin' in the fields.

5.text: Samaria scared over that golden calf at Beth Aven. The people mournin' for it, The priests screamin' over their idol— 'Cause its glory is gone.

6.text: That same idol? Shipped off to Assyria as a little gift to King Jareb. Ephraim gon' feel deep shame, And Israel? Embarrassed over their own dumb decisions.

7.text: Samaria's king? Cut off like a twig floatin' downstream—powerless.

8.text: Them high places in Aven, where they sinned? Gone. Destroyed. Thorns and weeds takin' over the altars. And the people gon' be cryin' out, "Mountains, fall on us! Hills, cover us!"

9.text: "Israel, y'all been messin' up since Gibeah— And y'all never changed. That fight in Gibeah didn't fix nothin'. Still out here actin' lawless.

10.text: But when I'm ready? I'ma check 'em Myself. I'ma call the nations against 'em— And tie them up for all they double-sins."

11.text: Ephraim used to be like a trained cow Lovin' to stomp out the grain—real comfortable. But I put a yoke on that pretty neck. Ephraim gon' pull the plow now. Judah? You plow too. Jacob? Time to break up that hard ground.

12.text: Sow righteousness—plant what's right. You'll harvest mercy. Break up that hard heart—it's time to seek the Lord, 'Til He show up and rain down righteousness.

13.text: But y'all? Y'all been plantin' wickedness, So all you reap is sin. You eatin' the fruit of lies 'Cause you trusted your own game plan And thought your army was enough.

14.text: That's why chaos about to break out in your streets. All your strongholds? About to get raided like when Shalman tore up Beth Arbel— Mamas and babies caught up in the violence.

15.text: That's what's comin' for you, Bethel, 'Cause y'all been straight evil. At sunrise? Israel's king gon' be completely wiped out.

1.text: When Israel was just a kid, I loved him. I called My son outta Egypt—brought him out with My own hand.

2.text: But the more I called 'em, The more they ran off. They sacrificed to them Baals, Burned incense to carved-up idols.

3.text: I'm the one who taught Ephraim how to walk, Held them up by the arms—steadyin' them. But they ain't even realize it was Me who healed 'em.

4.text: I led them with kindness, Pulled them close with cords of love. I took the yoke off their neck like a good master. I even bent down and fed 'em.

5.text: They not goin' back to Egypt, But Assyria gon' rule over 'em— Why? 'Cause they hard-headed and refuse to turn around.

6.text: The sword comin' to they cities, Gon' cut down their neighborhoods, Gon' eat up everything— All 'cause they listenin' to bad advice.

7.text: My people stuck in reverse, Always backslidin'. They call My name, sure— But they don't lift Me up. Not really.

8.text: Ephraim… how can I let you go? Israel… how can I hand you over? You want Me to treat you like Admah? Like Zeboiim? Man, My heart hurt just thinkin' about it— My compassion kickin' in heavy.

9.text: I ain't gon' go off in rage like that. I ain't gon' wipe y'all out. 'Cause I'm God—not man. I'm the Holy One right here among y'all, And I ain't showin' up to terrify.

10.text: They gon' follow after Me again. I'ma roar like a lion— And when I do, My kids gon' come runnin' back, Tremblin' from the west.

11.text: They gon' return shaky like birds from Egypt, Like doves flyin' in from Assyria. And I'ma let 'em come home again," Says the Lord.

12.text: Ephraim been circlin' Me with lies, Israel been slick with the deceit. But Judah still walkin' with Me— Still rollin' with the Holy One who keep it real.

1.text: Ephraim out here chasin' the wind— Runnin' after that east wind like it's gon' fill him up. Every day he addin' more lies, more destruction. He makin' shady deals with Assyria, And shippin' oil off to Egypt.

2.text: And the Lord got smoke with Judah too. God gon' check Jacob for how he been movin', Gon' pay him back for all the dirt he done.

3.text: Jacob grabbed his brother's heel in the womb— And when he got older, he wrestled with God.

4.text: Yep, he struggled with the Angel—and came out on top. He cried, begged for mercy. He found God at Bethel, And that's where God spoke to us.

5.text: That same God is the Lord of Heaven's Armies— That's the name that still got weight.

6.text: So you? With God's help, turn back. Do right—show mercy, walk in justice. And keep waitin' on God like your life depend on it.

7.text: Ephraim actin' like a slick Canaanite— Keepin' dirty scales in his hands, Lovin' to cheat and oppress folks.

8.text: He out here sayin', "I'm rich now. Got wealth on my own. Ain't nobody gon' find sin on me, I'm good." (But he delusional.)

9.text: But God like, "I'm the same Lord who brought you outta Egypt. And I'ma make you live in tents again— Just like y'all did during the feasts, back in the day."

10.text: "I been speakin' through My prophets, Givin' y'all visions on visions, Breakin' things down through symbols and stories."

11.text: But Gilead still full of idols— Empty nonsense. They still sacrificin' bulls in Gilgal, But them altars? Gon' be turned into piles of rubble in the fields.

12.text: Remember Jacob? He ran off to Syria, Worked just to get a wife— Tended sheep just to marry her.

13.text: Same way, it was through a prophet That the Lord brought Israel outta Egypt, And kept 'em safe through the prophet's word.

14.text: But Ephraim made God mad—real mad. So now God gon' leave his bloodguilt on him, And return all that shame right back to his doorstep.

1.text: Ephraim used to speak with fear and respect—he was that dude in Israel. But once he started worshippin' Baal? That's when his downfall started.

2.text: And now? The sin don't stop. They makin' silver statues, craftin' idols by hand, Showin' off their skills—but it's all fake. They even tell folks, "Go ahead, kiss them calf idols if you worshippin'!"

3.text: But they gon' vanish like morning clouds, Disappear like early dew. They gon' blow away like husks off the threshin' floor, Or drift like smoke out a chimney. Gone.

4.text: "But I been your God since Egypt. You ain't supposed to know nobody else but Me. Ain't no other Savior but Me."

5.text: "I was there for you in the wilderness, When everything around you was dry and dead."

6.text: "But soon as you got comfortable, Full from the pasture I gave you, You got cocky. And then? You forgot about Me."

7.text: "So now I'ma come at you like a lion, Layin' low like a leopard in the cut."

8.text: "I'ma attack like a bear that lost her babies— Rip your chest wide open. I'ma eat y'all like a lion, And let wild animals finish what's left."

9.text: "Israel, you brought this on yourself. You destroyed. But I'm still the only One who can help you."

10.text: "I'm your real King. Where them other ones at? Them fake kings y'all begged for—can they save your cities? Where them judges y'all trusted?"

11.text: "I gave you a king when I was mad, And took him away when My anger hit."

12.text: "Ephraim's sin been stored up—like a tab that's past due. And I ain't forgot."

13.text: "He gon' feel pain like a woman in labor. But he so foolish, He won't even come out the womb when it's time— Like he don't know when to be born."

14.text: "But I'ma still redeem them from death. I'ma pull 'em back from the grave. Death, I'm comin' for you like a disease. Grave, I'm 'bout to shut you down. But don't expect no pity—none."

15.text: "Ephraim might be fruitful now, But the east wind—My wind—is comin' from the desert. It's gon' dry up his spring, Kill his fountain, And wipe out all his treasures."

16.text: Samaria? Guilty. She rebelled hard against her God. Now they gon' die by the sword. Babies gon' be dashed, And pregnant women gon' be ripped open.

1.text: Israel, come on back to the Lord your God. You trippin' and fallin' 'cause of your own mess.

2.text: Bring some real words with you—don't come empty. Say this when you come back to Him: "God, please take away all this sin. Show us grace. We bringin' you our praise instead of burnt offerings."

3.text: "Assyria can't save us. We not ridin' in on war horses. And we done callin' these man-made things 'gods.' Only You, Lord, show mercy to the ones with no father."

4.text: God say, "I'ma heal them from all that backslidin'. I'ma love them real and free— 'Cause My anger ain't on them no more."

5.text: "I'ma be like dew to Israel— Fresh, soft, and life-givin'. He gon' grow like a lily, And plant his roots deep like the trees in Lebanon."

6.text: "His branches gon' stretch wide, Lookin' strong and beautiful like an olive tree. His presence gon' smell sweet—like Lebanon in bloom."

7.text: "People gon' chill in his shade, Come back and find life again— Like grain risin' up, Like vines growin' strong. And the whole place gon' smell like fine wine."

8.text: Ephraim gon' say, "Man, what I need idols for now?" God say, "I been listenin'. I been watchin'. I'm like a green tree that stay fresh year-round— If you see fruit in your life, know it came from Me."

9.text: Who really wise out here? Let 'em get this. Who got sense? Pay attention. 'Cause the Lord's ways are right— If you righteous, you walkin' in 'em. But if you stay tryna cut corners? You gon' keep trippin over what's real.

1.text: This the vision Isaiah, son of Amoz, saw—bout Judah and Jerusalem—while Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah was king.

2.text: "Listen up, heavens! Pay attention, earth! God talkin': I raised these kids up right, and they still turned they back on Me."

3.text: "Even the ox know who feedin' it. The donkey know where home at. But My people? Israel act like they got no clue who I am."

4.text: "Man, y'all a whole sinful nation. Just heavy with mess. Y'all full of wrongdoers—corrupt kids who wildin' out. Y'all done dipped on the Lord and disrespected the Holy One of Israel. Straight up turned your backs."

5.text: "Why keep gettin' beat down? Y'all just gon' keep wildin'? From the head to the toe, y'all sick. Brain foggy, heart weak."

6.text: "Ain't nothin' healthy left—just wounds, bruises, and open sores. Ain't nobody tryna clean it, bandage it up, or even show care."

7.text: "Your land? Wasted. Cities? Burnt down. Strangers eatin' off your plate right in your face. Everything lookin' like a war zone."

8.text: "Zion, My daughter, sittin' like a little shack in a vineyard, like a lonely hut in a cucumber field, like a city under siege."

9.text: "If the Lord of hosts ain't left a small remnant, we'd be out here like Sodom and Gomorrah—done for."

10.text: "Listen to the Word of the Lord, you 'leaders of Sodom.' Pay attention, folks of Gomorrah. This for y'all."

11.text: "All them sacrifices y'all bringin'? I ain't impressed," says the Lord. "I don't need no more burnt rams or fatty calves. That blood from bulls, lambs, goats? Miss Me with it."

12.text: "Y'all keep showin' up in My house, but who told you to come stomp through My courts like that?"

13.text: "Stop bringin' Me these empty gifts. That incense? Stinks. Your new moons, Sabbaths, church events—I ain't messin' with none of it when y'all still livin' foul."

14.text: "Your celebrations? I hate 'em. They drain Me. I'm tired of watchin' y'all fake it."

15.text: "Y'all throw your hands up to pray? I'm turnin' My eyes. Pray all you want—I ain't hearin' you. Y'all hands got blood on 'em."

16.text: "Wash up. Get clean. Drop all that evil in front of Me. Cut it out."

17.text: "Learn how to do right. Go after justice. Check the oppressor. Speak up for orphans. Fight for the widows."

18.text: "Come here, let's talk it out," says the Lord. "Y'all sins look red like blood? I can make 'em white like snow. Crimson red? I'll make it white like wool."

19.text: "If y'all down to listen and obey, you'll eat good in this land."

20.text: "But if y'all act hard-headed and rebel? That sword comin' for you. And that's on God—I said what I said."

21.text: "Look at this city that used to be faithful. Now it's out here actin' like a prostitute. Used to be full of justice, but now? Just killers."

22.text: "Your silver? Trash now. Your wine? Watered down."

23.text: "Your leaders? Rebels hangin' with thieves. All they want is a bribe. They chasin' clout. They don't care about orphans. Widows ain't even on they radar."

24.text: "So the Lord, the Lord of hosts, Israel's Mighty One, say this: 'Bet. I'ma handle My enemies. Time to clean house.'"

25.text: "I'ma pull up on y'all Myself. Burn away all the fake. Scrub you down from top to bottom."

26.text: "I'ma bring back real judges, like we used to have. Real counselors. Then they gon' call you the Righteous City again—the Faithful Spot."

27.text: "Zion gon' get saved through justice. The folks who turn back? Righteousness got them covered."

28.text: "But folks still wildin'? Them transgressors and sinners? They all gettin' taken out. Ain't no salvation for the ones that ditch the Lord."

29.text: "Y'all gon' be ashamed of them sacred trees y'all was chasin' after. Embarrassed of them wild gardens y'all was feelin'."

30.text: "Y'all gon' be like a dead tree in autumn. A dried-up garden with no water."

31.text: "The strong folks? Like dry kindling. All their work? Just sparks. When they catch fire together, ain't nobody comin' to put it out."

1.text: This that word Isaiah, son of Amoz, saw about Judah and Jerusalem.

2.text: In the last days, God's house gon' be sittin' high—higher than every mountain, lifted above all the hills. And folks from everywhere? They gon' be runnin' to it.

3.text: Whole crowds gon' be sayin', "Let's roll up to God's mountain, to the house of Jacob's God. He gon' teach us how to live right, and we gon' walk that path." 'Cause the law? It's comin' outta Zion. And the Word of the Lord? Straight from Jerusalem.

4.text: He gon' be the Judge over all nations. He gon' call folks out. And guess what? They gon' turn they swords into plows and their spears into garden tools. Ain't nobody gon' be fightin' no more. Ain't even gon' study war no more.

5.text: Come on, people of Jacob—let's walk in God's light, not in the dark.

6.text: But Lord, You turned from Your people, the house of Jacob, 'cause they out here doin' East side rituals, talkin' like Philistine psychics, and mixin' with folks who don't know You.

7.text: They land flooded with silver and gold—money for days. Got horses and chariots too, stacked up with no end.

8.text: They also got idols on idols—worshippin' what they made with they own hands, like they own lil' gods.

9.text: Folks bowin' low to these man-made things, humblin' theyself before nonsense. Don't forgive 'em, Lord—they know better.

10.text: Run and hide in the rocks, lay low in the dirt—'cause when God shows up in power, folks gon' be terrified. His glory too much to handle.

11.text: All that pride? Gon' get knocked down. All that big ego? Humbled. On that day, only the Lord gon' be lifted up.

12.text: The Lord of hosts got a day marked for every prideful, puffed-up thing. If it's lifted, He bringin' it low.

13.text: From the tall cedars in Lebanon to the mighty oaks in Bashan—if it standin' tall, He choppin' it down.

14.text: All them high mountains and lifted hills? They comin' down too.

15.text: Every tall tower, every wall folks think make 'em safe? Gone.

16.text: Every ship from Tarshish, every fancy boat and sleek vessel? He clearin' it out.

17.text: Man's pride gettin' dropped. Arrogance? Canceled. That day only got one spotlight—God's.

18.text: All them idols? He trashin' every last one.

19.text: Folks gon' run into caves and hide in holes in the ground, tryin' to escape the terror of the Lord and the weight of His glory when He steps in and shakes the whole earth.

20.text: On that day, folks gon' throw out their gold and silver idols—tossin' 'em to moles and bats. That's how worthless they'll look.

21.text: They gon' duck into rocky cliffs and craggy cracks, tryna hide from the Lord's presence when He rise up and rock the earth for real.

22.text: So cut ties with these folks who think they all that—just humans with breath in they nose. Why they got y'all pressed anyway?

1.text: Look, the Lord—yeah, the Lord of Heaven's Armies—He takin' back everything from Judah and Jerusalem: no more food in the pantry, no water in the jug.

2.text: All the strong men gone. Soldiers? Outta here. Judges, prophets, fortune-tellers, elders? All of 'em snatched.

3.text: No captains, no respected OGs, no counselors, no skilled builders, no magic men. It's a full wipeout.

4.text: "I'ma let these little kids run things—babies gon' be actin' like they in charge."

5.text: Folks gon' be out here oppressin' each other—every man for himself. Kids talkin' reckless to grown folks, low-lifes dissin' the ones who earned respect.

6.text: One brother gon' grab another like, "Yo, you got a decent fit on—go ahead and lead us. This place a mess, but you can fix it, right?"

7.text: But the dude gon' be like, "Man, I ain't got no solutions. My crib broke too—no food, no fits. Don't look at me to run nothin'."

8.text: Jerusalem trippin', Judah already face-planted—'cause they mouthin' off and livin' straight against the Lord. They wildin' in God's face like He don't see.

9.text: You can see the guilt all on they faces. They not even ashamed—flexin' sin like it's a badge. Just like Sodom. Woe to them—they brought this mess on theyselves.

10.text: Tell the righteous folks: they gon' be alright. They gon' eat the fruit of the good they planted.

11.text: But the wicked? It's gon' be all bad. What they put out, they 'bout to get back.

12.text: My people got kids bossin' them around, and women runnin' the show. The ones leadin' y'all? They drivin' y'all straight into a ditch.

13.text: But the Lord steppin' up now. He about to make His case and lay down judgment.

14.text: The Lord 'bout to call out the elders and leaders, like, "Y'all out here eatin' up My vineyard! You got stolen goods from the poor stashed in your houses."

15.text: "Why y'all crushin' My people? Why you grindin' the faces of the poor into the dirt?" That's from the Lord, the God of Angel Armies.

16.text: Then the Lord said: "These daughters of Zion out here actin' all high and mighty—chin up, eyes flirtin', switchin' down the block with bells on they ankles like they runway ready."

17.text: "So I'ma hit the top of they heads with a scab, and expose what they think they hidin'."

18.text: "That day, I'm takin' all the extra off 'em: them jinglin' anklets, them scarves, them moon-shaped bling."

19.text: "Them earrings, them bracelets, the veils—gone."

20.text: "Headwraps, ankle chains, fancy belts, perfume boxes, charms? Gone."

21.text: "Rings? Nose jewels? Snatched."

22.text: "Designer fits, capes, and purses? Say goodbye."

23.text: "All them mirrors, silk linens, turbans, and robes? Gone with the wind."

24.text: "Instead of smellin' sweet, y'all gon' stink. Instead of luxury belts, ropes. Instead of fresh hair, bald heads. Instead of fine robes, burlap. Instead of beauty, brands like cattle."

25.text: "Y'all men gon' die in war, and the strong ones gon' drop by the sword."

26.text: "The city gates gon' cry out. And the women left behind? Gonna be sittin' on the ground, empty, broken, and alone."

1.text: In that day, seven women gon' run up on one man like, "We ain't askin' for your money or your name—just let us claim you so we don't walk around ashamed and single out here."

2.text: But hold up—on that same day, the branch of the Lord gon' shine bright and beautiful. What He grows in the land gon' be full of pride and joy for the ones still standin' in Israel.

3.text: Anybody still breathin' in Zion, anybody still holdin' it down in Jerusalem? They gon' be called holy—names written in the book of life like, "Yeah, they made it."

4.text: When the Lord finally scrubs all that dirt off the daughters of Zion, when He rinses out the bloodstains from Jerusalem, He gon' do it with a spirit of justice and a fire that cleans everything up.

5.text: Then God gon' set it off—cover every house on Mount Zion with a cloud and smoke in the daytime, and light it up with a pillar of fire at night. His glory gon' sit like a divine canopy over it all.

6.text: And under that glory? You gon' have shade from the heat, shelter from storms, and a whole safe space when the rain starts fallin'.

1.text: Lemme sing a lil somethin' for my Beloved—about His vineyard, a song from the heart: My Beloved had a vineyard, planted on a good, fertile hill.

2.text: He put in work—dug it up, cleared the stones, planted top-tier vines. Built a tower in it too, and a winepress ready to go. He was expectin' sweet grapes… but it gave Him wild, bitter ones.

3.text: "So now, people of Jerusalem and Judah, y'all judge this with Me: Me vs. My vineyard."

4.text: "What more could I have done for My vineyard? I did everything. So why, when I expected good fruit, did I get this wild mess?"

5.text: "Lemme tell y'all what I'm 'bout to do: I'm takin' down the fence—it's gon' get trampled. I'm removin' the protection—it's gon' burn."

6.text: "I'm lettin' it go to waste. No more pruning, no more care. Thorns and weeds gon' take over. I'm even tellin' the clouds—don't rain on it no more."

7.text: This vineyard? That's Israel. The folks of Judah? That was His favorite planting. He looked for justice—got bloodshed. He looked for righteousness—heard cries for help instead.

8.text: Woe to the folks buyin' up house after house, field after field—till nobody got room left. Y'all buildin' like you own the whole land.

9.text: I heard the Lord say it straight: "These big, pretty houses? Empty. No one livin' in 'em."

10.text: "Ten acres of vineyard gon' barely give you one bucket of juice. You plant a whole load of seed and get back crumbs."

11.text: Woe to the ones up early just to chase liquor, and stay lit all night off wine.

12.text: Harps, strings, tambourines, flutes, and drinks at every party—but they ignore God's work and don't even peep what He's doin' behind the scenes.

13.text: That's why My people in bondage—no knowledge. The ones who were supposed to be honorable? Starvin'. The crowd? Thirsty and dry.

14.text: So Sheol (the grave) just stretched its mouth wide. The proud, the partiers, the showy ones—all gon' get swallowed up.

15.text: Folks gon' be humbled, brought low, real quick. All them proud eyes? Dropped down.

16.text: But the Lord of Heaven's Armies gon' be lifted up in justice. The Holy God gon' be honored in righteousness.

17.text: Then lambs gon' graze like it's nothin', and strangers gon' eat in the ruins of the rich.

18.text: Woe to them who drag sin around like it's nothin'—pullin' it behind 'em like a cart full of lies.

19.text: They be sayin', "Tell God to hurry up and show us somethin'. Let Him prove Himself if He real."

20.text: Woe to the ones callin' evil good and good evil—flippin' light into darkness and sweet into bitter. Y'all got it backwards.

21.text: Woe to the folks who think they so smart, wise in their own minds.

22.text: Woe to them drink champs—mighty when it come to wine, skilled at mixin' strong drinks,

23.text: Who let the wicked off the hook for a bribe, and take justice away from the innocent.

24.text: That's why, like dry grass catchin' fire, they gon' burn. Their roots rotten, flowers turn to dust—'cause they rejected the Word of the Lord and threw shade at the Holy One of Israel.

25.text: So God mad now—for real. He done raised His hand and struck 'em down. Mountains shook. Bodies layin' in the streets like trash. And even with all that? God still not done. His hand still up.

26.text: He gon' raise a banner to signal nations from far away—callin' 'em with a whistle. And they gon' come fast, no delay.

27.text: They ain't tired, they ain't stumbling. Ain't nobody sleepin'. Belts tight, sandals strong.

28.text: Their arrows sharp, bows pulled back. Their horses movin' like fire on pavement. Wheels spinnin' like storms.

29.text: They gon' roar like lions, snatch up prey, and nobody gon' be able to stop 'em.

30.text: That day, the roar gon' sound like the sea. You look out at the land? Just darkness and pain. Even the light? Covered up by storm clouds.

1.text: The year King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord—seated high up on His throne, lifted above it all. His robe was so long, it filled the whole temple.

2.text: Above Him were these heavenly beings called seraphim—each one had six wings. Two wings covered their face, two covered their feet, and with the other two, they flew.

3.text: And they was callin' back and forth: "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of Heaven's Armies! The whole earth full of His glory!"

4.text: As they shouted, the doorposts shook, and the whole temple filled up with smoke.

5.text: I said, "Oh no—it's over for me. I'm messed up! My mouth ain't clean, and I live around people whose mouths dirty too. And now I done seen the King—the Lord of hosts—with my own eyes!"

6.text: Then one of the seraphim flew over to me, holdin' a hot coal with tongs, straight from the altar.

7.text: He touched my mouth with it and said, "Look, this coal touched your lips—your guilt gone, your sins cleaned up."

8.text: Then I heard God's voice: "Who should I send? Who gon' go out for Us?" And I said, "I'm right here—send me!"

9.text: He said, "Aight. Go tell these people: 'Keep listenin'… but you still won't get it. Keep lookin'… but y'all still blind.'"

10.text: "Make they hearts heavy, ears plugged, eyes shut. So they don't see, don't hear, don't understand—not with their heart, not with their soul. 'Cause if they really did, they'd turn back and I'd heal 'em."

11.text: Then I said, "Lord… how long I gotta do this?" And He said, "Until all the cities empty, The houses vacant, And the whole land ruined.

12.text: The Lord gon' send people far out, And the land gon' be full of abandoned places."

13.text: "But even then… a tenth will remain. And even they gon' get hit again. Like when a terebinth or oak tree gets chopped down— But the stump still stands. That stump? That's the holy seed."

1.text: Back when Ahaz (son of Jotham, son of Uzziah) was king of Judah, Rezin (king of Syria) and Pekah (son of Remaliah, king of Israel) pulled up to make war on Jerusalem—but they couldn't break through.

2.text: Word got back to the royal fam: "Syria linking up with Ephraim!" That news shook Ahaz and the whole crew—they were shook like trees in the wind.

3.text: Then the Lord told Isaiah, "Take your boy Shear-Jashub and go meet Ahaz by the water system near the upper pool, by the road to the laundry spot.

4.text: Tell him this: 'Stay calm. Chill. Don't trip, don't panic. Them two clowns—Rezin and Remaliah's boy? They just burnt-out fire sticks.

5.text: Yeah, they plannin' evil against you—Syria, Ephraim, and that other dude talkin' bout,

6.text: "Let's invade Judah, shake things up, and crown some random dude, Tabel's son, to rule it."'

7.text: But the Lord God says, "Nah. That ain't gon' happen. That plot won't stick."

8.text: "Syria's capital is Damascus, and Rezin runnin' that. Ephraim? In 65 years, they gon' be done—no more people, no more power.

9.text: Samaria's the head of Ephraim, and Remaliah's son runnin' that. But if you don't believe what I say, Ahaz, you ain't gon' stand firm. Period."

10.text: Then the Lord told Ahaz again,

11.text: "Go 'head, ask Me for a sign—deep as the grave or high up in the sky. Whatever you want."

12.text: But Ahaz was like, "Nah, I ain't tryna test God like that."

13.text: Isaiah clapped back, "Y'all House of David really out here wearin' people out—and now you gon' try God too?

14.text: Bet. The Lord Himself gon' give y'all a sign anyway: Look, a virgin gon' get pregnant and have a Son. His name? Immanuel—'God with us.'

15.text: He gon' eat curds and honey, and He'll know how to say no to wrong and yes to good.

16.text: But before He old enough to make choices, both those kings you scared of? Their land gon' be empty."

17.text: "But hear this too—God bringin' the king of Assyria down on y'all, your people, and your whole fam. Ain't been times this rough since Israel split from Judah."

18.text: That day, the Lord gon' whistle for flies from Egypt and bees from Assyria—and they all comin'.

19.text: They gon' settle in valleys, cracks in rocks, thorn bushes, and fields.

20.text: And on that same day, God gon' shave y'all clean—head, legs, even the beard—using Assyria like a hired razor.

21.text: Back then, folks gon' be so broke, one man just keep a young cow and two sheep alive.

22.text: And that little bit of milk they produce? That's gon' be survival food. Everybody left eatin' curds and honey.

23.text: Places that used to have vineyards worth stacks? Overrun with thorns and weeds now.

24.text: Folks gon' walk in with bows and arrows—'cause the whole land look like a wilderness now.

25.text: Even the good farmland too dangerous to farm—covered in briars. So it'll just be a space for oxen and sheep to roam.

1.text: Then the Lord told me, "Grab a big scroll and write this loud and clear: Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz."

2.text: He said, "I'm bringin' in two solid witnesses—Uriah the priest and Zechariah, Jeberechiah's son—to make it official."

3.text: So I went to my wife, the prophetess, and she got pregnant and had a son. Then God said, "Name him Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz (Quick to plunder, swift to spoil).

4.text: Before that boy even learns how to say 'Mama' or 'Dada,' Damascus and Samaria's riches gon' be snatched up by the king of Assyria."

5.text: Then God spoke to me again and said:

6.text: "Since these folks rejected the gentle waters of Shiloah, and instead celebrated Rezin and Remaliah's son,

7.text: I'm bringin' in the big flood—Assyria and all its pride. That river gon' rise, overflow its banks…

8.text: …and flood through Judah. It's gon' rise so high, it'll come up to your neck. The wings of that empire gon' spread across your whole land, O Immanuel."

9.text: "Y'all better brace yourselves, nations. Y'all gon' break. Go ahead and suit up—still gon' break. Go ahead and plan—still won't work. Speak on it if you want—but it won't stand. Why? 'Cause God is with us."

10.text: Plot all you want. It won't land.

11.text: The Lord pressed this on me heavy, sayin': "Don't live how they live. Don't follow their ways."

12.text: "Stop callin' everything a conspiracy just 'cause the crowd do. Don't be spooked like they are.

13.text: Fear Me. Respect Me. That's the only fear you need."

14.text: "I'll be a safe place to some… but to others? I'll trip 'em up. I'll be a rock that offends both Israel and Judah. A trap for the ones in Jerusalem."

15.text: "They gon' stumble, fall, and break. Get caught up and captured."

16.text: Lock this prophecy down. Pass the message on to My people.

17.text: I'ma wait on the Lord—even if He hidin' His face from Jacob right now. I'm still puttin' my hope in Him.

18.text: Look, it's me and the kids the Lord gave me—we're walkin' billboards for signs and wonders in Israel. From the Lord of Heaven's Armies, who lives up on Mount Zion.

19.text: And when folks start tellin' you, "Go talk to mediums and fortune-tellers—listen to the whispers and mumbles," don't fall for that. Ain't y'all supposed to be seekin' God? Why y'all askin' the dead for advice on life?

20.text: Go back to the law. Go back to the truth. If they ain't speakin' God's word, it's 'cause they walkin' in darkness. Ain't no light in 'em.

21.text: They gon' wander around stressed and hungry. And when the hunger hits hard, they gon' get mad—curse they king and even curse God, lookin' up like, "Why this happenin'?"

22.text: Then they'll look down and all they'll see is despair—darkness, sorrow, anguish. No light in sight. Just deep, deep darkness.

1.text: But hold up—the darkness ain't forever. That gloom over Galilee? It won't last. Yeah, God humbled Zebulun and Naphtali for a minute, but He 'bout to bless that same region by the sea, across the Jordan, in the land of outsiders.

2.text: The people walkin' in the dark? They done seen a big, bold light. Folks sittin' in the shadow of death? That light just hit 'em.

3.text: You grew the nation, God, and the joy exploded! They celebratin' like it's harvest season or like they just split the bag after a big win.

4.text: You broke their chains—snapped the yoke off their necks, crushed the oppressor's rod, just like You did back when You showed out in Midian.

5.text: Every boot from the battlefield, every bloody uniform, gon' get tossed in the fire—burned for good.

6.text: 'Cause a Child been born to us. A Son got given. He carryin' the whole government on His back. And His name gon' be: Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

7.text: His rule and His peace? No limits. He takin' the throne of David and holdin' it down forever—with real justice and judgment. This ain't temporary. And God's passion? That's what's makin' it happen.

8.text: The Lord sent a word to Jacob—and boom, it landed right on Israel.

9.text: Everybody gon' know—Ephraim and all the folks in Samaria—that pride talk they been runnin':

10.text: "Yeah, the bricks fell, but we comin' back stronger. We usin' cut stone now. The trees got knocked down? Cool—we plantin' cedars next."

11.text: So God said, "Bet." He stirred up Rezin's enemies against him—He turnin' the heat up.

12.text: Syrians attack from the front, Philistines from the back. Israel gettin' chewed up with no mercy. But even after all this? God's anger ain't cooled off. His hand still stretched out.

13.text: And the people still ain't turnin' to God, the One who strikin' 'em. They not even seekin' Him.

14.text: So He cuttin' off the head and the tail—top to bottom—in one day.

15.text: The head? That's the elders and big shots. The tail? That's them fake prophets spreadin' lies.

16.text: These so-called leaders leadin' folks off a cliff. And everybody followin' 'em? Headed for destruction.

17.text: That's why God ain't showin' no joy in their young men. Ain't feelin' no mercy for the fatherless or the widows—'cause everybody out here wildin'. Hypocrites, evildoers, talkin' nonsense. But even with that? His anger still burnin'. His hand still stretched out.

18.text: Wickedness out here blazin' like wildfire—burnin' through bushes, forests, everything in sight. The smoke risin' up heavy.

19.text: God's wrath settin' the whole land on fire. People turnin' into fuel. Ain't nobody showin' love—not even to they own kin.

20.text: They reachin' to the right—still hungry. Munchin' to the left—still empty. It's so bad, folks gon' be eatin' the flesh of their own arms.

21.text: Manasseh goin' at Ephraim. Ephraim goin' at Manasseh. And both together gunnin' for Judah. But through all this mess? God's anger ain't turned away—His hand still stretched out.

1.text: Woe to the ones writin' up crooked laws—legal traps just to keep the poor down.

2.text: They robbin' folks of justice, takin' from the broke, preyin' on widows, snatchin' from orphans like it's a game.

3.text: What y'all gon' do when judgment day hits? When destruction shows up from way out? Who you gon' run to for help? Where's all that clout gon' go?

4.text: Without Me, you gon' be layin' with the prisoners—or fallin' with the dead. But even still… God's anger ain't turned away. His hand still stretched out.

5.text: Woe to Assyria, that stick I been usin' to swing My anger—the rod in My hand bringin' heat.

6.text: I sent him to go check a godless nation, to take what's theirs, crush 'em like dirt in the streets.

7.text: But he wasn't even thinkin' 'bout Me—he just wanted to wreck nations, take over like a boss.

8.text: "Aren't all my officers like kings?" he brags.

9.text: "Didn't I handle Calno like Carchemish? Hamath like Arpad? Samaria just like Damascus?"

10.text: "I conquered nations full of idols, even worse than Jerusalem or Samaria!"

11.text: "If I crushed Samaria and her idols, Jerusalem next—easy work."

12.text: But once God done using Assyria to clean house in Zion, He gon' turn around and deal with Assyria's arrogant heart and prideful face.

13.text: 'Cause Assyria been sayin': "I did this with my own strength, my own smarts. I moved borders, stole riches, crushed cities like a real one."

14.text: "I snatched wealth like bird eggs—nobody said nothin'. Not even a flap or chirp."

15.text: But hold up—does the axe brag over the one swingin' it? The saw boast over the one holdin' it? That stick just a stick, it ain't movin' on its own.

16.text: So God 'bout to humble Assyria's big shots—make 'em skinny, take the shine off, and light a fire under their pride.

17.text: Israel's God gon' be that flame—burnin' up all their mess in one day.

18.text: That fire gon' eat their fancy forests and crops—burnin' soul and body. They gon' fade like a sick man wastin' away.

19.text: What's left of their army? So few, a kid could count 'em.

20.text: On that day, the ones left in Israel—the survivors from Jacob's crew—they ain't gon' lean on their enemy no more. They gon' lean on the Lord for real this time.

21.text: The remnant comin' back home—to the Mighty God.

22.text: Israel might be as many as the sand of the sea, but only a remnant comin' back. Judgment is comin' in waves—but it'll be soaked in righteousness.

23.text: God not playin'. He gon' bring it to a close—quick, complete, and just—in the whole land.

24.text: So God says: "My people in Zion, don't be scared of Assyria. Yeah, they swingin' a rod at you like Egypt did,

25.text: but it's just for a moment. My anger gon' pass, and then I'ma handle them."

26.text: Just like I crushed Midian at Oreb, or split the sea in Egypt—I'ma do it again.

27.text: That day, the burden gon' lift off your shoulders. The yoke around your neck? Snapped. Because of the anointing.

28.text: Look, they marchin'—already at Aiath, passin' through Migron, settin' up at Michmash.

29.text: Comin' down the ridge, posted up in Geba. Ramah shakin', Gibeah gone ghost.

30.text: Gallim cryin' loud. Laish can hear it. Anathoth stressed out.

31.text: Madmenah on the run. Folks in Gebim hidin' out.

32.text: By the time they reach Nob, they gon' be shakin' fists at Jerusalem like they runnin' the block.

33.text: But the Lord—yeah, the Lord of Hosts—He steppin' in to chop down the tall ones. All that pride? Gettin' axed.

34.text: He slicin' through forests like a lumberjack. Even mighty Lebanon? Fallin' before the Mighty One.

1.text: Outta Jesse's family tree, a new branch gon' rise up. Fresh growth from old roots—He the One.

2.text: God's Spirit gon' rest on Him. He walkin' in full power: Spirit of wisdom, Spirit of understanding, Spirit of guidance and strength, Spirit of knowledge and deep reverence for the Lord.

3.text: He love the fear of the Lord—ain't moved by what He sees or hears. He don't judge on looks or gossip.

4.text: He gon' ride for the poor with full righteousness. He gon' bring justice for the meek—fair and solid. He gon' speak truth so hard, it shake the earth. His breath? That's enough to shut wicked folks down.

5.text: Righteousness gon' be wrapped around His waist like a belt. Faithfulness? Tied to Him like a sash.

6.text: Wolves gon' chill with lambs. Leopards nappin' with goats. Calves, lions, and baby cows out here hangin'—and a little child leadin' the crew.

7.text: Cows and bears out here grazin' together, their babies layin' side by side. Lions eatin' straw like oxen—no more bloodshed.

8.text: Babies playin' near cobra dens. Toddlers reachin' into snake holes—no fear.

9.text: Ain't nobody hurtin' nobody on God's holy mountain. Why? 'Cause the whole earth gon' be soaked in the knowledge of God like water over the sea.

10.text: On that day, the Root of Jesse gon' stand tall—like a banner to the nations. Even the Gentiles gon' look to Him. His presence? Glorious.

11.text: And when that day hits, God gon' reach out again—second time—pullin' back the remnant of His people from everywhere: Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Cush, Elam, Shinar, Hamath—even from the islands out in the sea.

12.text: He liftin' that banner again—callin' the scattered ones home. He bringin' the outcasts of Israel, and Judah's exiles, from the four corners of the globe.

13.text: All that beef between Ephraim and Judah? Done. No more jealousy, no more drama.

14.text: They gon' ride together—fly down on the Philistines, take back what's theirs from the east, and put hands on Edom and Moab. Even Ammon gon' fall in line.

15.text: God gon' dry up that sea tongue in Egypt—strike the river with His wind, break it into seven paths so folks can cross dry like it's Exodus 2.0.

16.text: A whole highway gon' open for the remnant from Assyria—just like when He brought Israel up outta Egypt the first time.

1.text: On that day, you gon' say: "Lord, I gotta praise You. Yeah, You was mad at me, But now You done pulled that anger back, and gave me comfort instead."

2.text: "Look, God is my salvation. I ain't scared no more—I trust Him. 'Cause Yah, the Lord, is my strength and my song. He done became my whole salvation."

3.text: So with pure joy, we out here drawin' up water from the deep wells of salvation—overflowin'.

4.text: That day, folks gon' be shoutin': "Give God His praise! Call on His name! Tell the world what He did—don't keep it to yourself! Let everybody know His name is high and lifted!"

5.text: "Sing to the Lord! He been doin' great things! And the whole earth know about it."

6.text: "Turn the volume up, Zion! Cry out and shout! 'Cause the Holy One of Israel? He right there, livin' in the middle of y'all!"

1.text: This the heavy word Isaiah, son of Amoz, got about Babylon.

2.text: "Put up the banner on a high hill. Shout it loud. Wave your hand so the troops know it's go time—let 'em march straight into the fancy gates.

3.text: I done summoned My chosen ones, My real ones—powerful folk who ride for Me, and who ain't afraid of My fire. They gon' handle business."

4.text: Listen—it's loud out in them mountains. Nations gathered. Armies mobbin'. God pullin' His whole squad together for battle.

5.text: They comin' from way out—long distance. From the ends of the sky. It's the Lord and His weapons, bringin' smoke to wipe the land clean.

6.text: Start cryin' now—'cause the Day of the Lord? It right around the corner. And it ain't pretty—it's destruction comin' from the Almighty Himself.

7.text: Folk gon' be weak, hands fallin' limp. Every man's heart? Melted.

8.text: Panic everywhere. They gon' hurt like a woman in labor—scared, confused, facin' each other with fire in they eyes.

9.text: That Day of the Lord comin' hard—wrathful, full of fury. The land gon' be empty. The sinners? Wiped out.

10.text: Even the skies gon' go dark. Stars stop shinin'. Sun won't rise right. The moon ain't bringin' no light either.

11.text: God said, "I'm comin' for the whole world's evil. All the wickedness? It's gettin' dealt with. I'm stoppin' the arrogant in their tracks, and I'm knockin' down every proud and ruthless person."

12.text: "People gon' be so rare, they worth more than gold—like real Ophir gold type rare."

13.text: "I'm shakin' the skies. The whole earth gon' tremble, 'cause the Lord of Armies mad mad. When that anger drops—it's over."

14.text: Folks gon' run like hunted deer. Scattered sheep. Everybody runnin' to their own tribe, tryin' to get home.

15.text: If they catch you? You gettin' stabbed. If you captured? You ain't makin' it.

16.text: Babies gon' be killed in front of their parents. Homes robbed. Wives violated. It's ugly.

17.text: God said, "Look, I'm raisin' up the Medes against y'all. And they don't want your silver or gold—can't bribe 'em."

18.text: "They bowin' down nobody. Young men? Killed without hesitation. Babies? No mercy. Women? No compassion."

19.text: Babylon—you was the pride of nations. Chaldeans' crown jewel. But you gon' fall just like Sodom and Gomorrah when God set it off.

20.text: Ain't nobody livin' there again. Ever. No generations, no nomads settin' up tents, no shepherds keepin' sheep there.

21.text: Just wild creatures takin' over. Houses filled with owls. Ostriches movin' in. Wild goats doin' they thing.

22.text: Hyenas gon' be howlin' in the old palaces. Jackals chillin' in what used to be luxury. It's over for Babylon. Her clock tickin'. Time almost up. God said what He said.

1.text: God still got love for Jacob. He chose Israel, and He not changin' up. He settin' them back in their land, and even outsiders gon' want in—stickin' close to the house of Jacob.

2.text: Other nations gon' help bring them back home. And Israel? They gon' flip the script—rulin' over the ones who used to rule them. The oppressed now got the crown.

3.text: When the Lord finally gives you rest from all that pain, fear, and slavery…

4.text: You gon' start speakin' on the fall of Babylon's king like: "So it's over now? The bully shut up? The gold city finally gone?"

5.text: "God snapped the rod that the wicked held. That stick of control? Broken."

6.text: "He used to strike down nations, nonstop anger—now he gettin' stomped, and nobody stoppin' it."

7.text: "The whole world breathin' again. Peace everywhere. Songs breakin' out."

8.text: "Even the trees—cypress and cedar—out here rejoicin'. Talkin' 'bout, 'Since you fell, nobody came to chop us down.'"

9.text: "Hell itself been anticipatin' your arrival. The dead gettin' hype. All them past kings gettin' up off they thrones like, 'Oh, so you here now?'"

10.text: "They all starin' at you like, 'Dang… you weak now, too? Just like us?'"

11.text: "Your pride brought low to the grave. No more music, no more luxury—just worms under you, maggots coverin' you."

12.text: "How you fall like that, Lucifer? Son of the morning? You was up high, now you laid out. You used to weaken nations, now look at you."

13.text: "You had big dreams: 'I'ma rise to heaven, I'ma sit above God's stars, I'ma sit up top with the gods, I'ma be just like the Most High.'"

14.text: "You was tryna level up past the clouds, thinkin' you was untouchable."

15.text: "But nah. You headed straight to the pit—deep, dark, no exits."

16.text: "Folks gon' walk by lookin' like, 'This the one who shook the earth? Who wrecked kingdoms?"

17.text: "He turned the world to rubble, destroyed cities, and never opened the jails. Kept everybody locked up."

18.text: "Other kings at least get buried with honor.

19.text: "But you? Thrown outta your grave like trash. Like a bloody shirt from a soldier cut down. Tossed aside like a body nobody wanna touch."

20.text: "You don't get a king's funeral—'cause you destroyed your people and your land. Your fam line? Wiped clean. Nobody gon' mention y'all again."

21.text: "Prepare for their sons to be taken out too. Don't let that wicked legacy rise up and build cities again. Shut it all down."

22.text: God said, "I'm risin' up against Babylon. I'ma wipe out their name, their people, their future—all of it."

23.text: "I'ma turn that place into a swampy wasteland, full of wild animals. I'ma sweep it away like trash."

24.text: The Lord of Armies made a promise: "If I said it, it's gon' happen. Ain't no rewrites."

25.text: "I'ma crush Assyria in My land—step on 'em in My mountains. And that burden on My people? Gone."

26.text: "This ain't just about one country. This is My plan for the whole world.

27.text: "Who can stop Me? Who got the strength to push back My hand?"

28.text: This message came the year King Ahaz died:

29.text: "Philistia, don't get cocky just 'cause the one who hit you is gone. His replacement worse. Out the roots of that snake comes a venomous serpent. And his child? A fiery flying one."

30.text: "But My poor people? They gon' eat. They gon' rest. But your roots? I'ma starve 'em. Your remnant? Gone."
