10.text: Or the fool tellin' his daddy, "Why you birth me?" Or his mama, "What you even bring me here for?"

11.text: This what the Lord—the Holy One of Israel—say: "You wanna ask Me what's next for My kids? Wanna question My plans with My own hands?"

12.text: "I made this earth. Created folks to live on it. Spread the heavens out with My own hands. Every star out there? I gave orders."

13.text: "I raised up Cyrus on the right path. I'll make sure he walk it right. He gon' rebuild My city. Let My people go free. No ransom. No bribes." That's what the Lord of armies said.

14.text: The Lord said: "Egypt's riches, Cush's goods, the tall folk from Seba—they gon' come to you. Chains on 'em. Bowing down. Sayin', 'God with you, for real. Ain't no other God.'"

15.text: For real, Lord, You stay movin' in silence. O God of Israel, our Savior!

16.text: Idol-makers? Embarrassed and confused. All of 'em gon' be shamed.

17.text: But Israel? The Lord got y'all. Saved forever. No shame. No disgrace. Ever again.

18.text: The Lord, Creator of heaven and earth—He made it, formed it, set it up to be lived in—He said: "I'm the Lord. Ain't no one else."

19.text: "I ain't whisper in some shadow corner. I ain't tell Jacob, 'Seek Me' for nothin'. I speak truth. I say what's right."

20.text: Gather up, y'all who escaped from the nations. Them other folks? Still carryin' wooden statues. Still prayin' to gods that can't even save 'em.

21.text: Let 'em come with their best argument. Bring they facts. Who called this from the beginning? Who told it way back then? Ain't it Me—the Lord? Ain't no other God out there. Just Me. The Just One. The Savior.

22.text: "Look to Me and be saved, all y'all—from the far ends of the earth. I'm God. Ain't no one else."

23.text: "I swore by Myself, and I don't take it back—every knee gon' bow to Me. Every tongue gon' confess."

24.text: They gon' say, 'Only in the Lord is righteousness and strength.' People gon' come to Him. But everybody beefin' with Him? They gon' be embarrassed.

25.text: But in the Lord, the whole fam of Israel gon' be made right. And they gon' shine in His glory.

1.text: Bel done bowed down. Nebo bent over. Them so-called gods sittin' heavy on oxen and cattle—they ain't helpin' nobody. They just extra weight.

2.text: Both them idols crouched down together. They couldn't save nobody. They couldn't even save themselves from bein' dragged off into exile.

3.text: "Listen up, house of Jacob, all y'all still left in Israel—I been holdin' you down since birth, carried you straight out the womb."

4.text: "Even when you get old and gray, I'm still gon' be Him. Still carryin' you. I made you. I got you. I'll keep carryin' you. I'll rescue you."

5.text: "So tell Me this—Who y'all gon' compare Me to? Who y'all put next to Me like we the same?"

6.text: "Y'all tossin' gold out your bags, weighin' silver out, hiring somebody to shape it into a so-called god—then bowin' down like it did somethin'."

7.text: "You gotta lift it up yourself, carry it, set it in place—and it don't even move. You cry out to it, and it just sit there. It can't talk. It can't help. It can't save."

8.text: "Y'all need to think back. Man up. Wake up, y'all rebellious folks."

9.text: "Remember what I already did. I'm God—ain't nobody else. I'm God—and ain't nobody like Me."

10.text: "I be callin' the end from the beginning, talkin' about stuff before it even pop off. Whatever I say gon' happen, period. What I want? It's gettin' done."

11.text: "I'll call a wild bird out the east, a man from far away to do what I planned. I said it. I meant it. It's gon' happen."

12.text: "Y'all hardheaded ones, who still far from livin' right—listen."

13.text: "My righteousness comin' close. It ain't far. My salvation ain't holdin' back. I'm settin' up deliverance in Zion, and Israel gon' shine in My glory."

1.text: Come down and sit in that dust, Babylon. You ain't sittin' on no throne now, princess. Go ahead and sit on the ground, Chaldean girl—ain't nobody callin' you soft and fancy no more.

2.text: Pick up them millstones, grind some flour. Take off that veil. Roll up that skirt. Get them legs in the river. You walkin' now.

3.text: Yo nakedness gon' be out here, Yo shame gon' be front and center. I'm takin' vengeance. Ain't no negotiations.

4.text: (Our Redeemer—He the Lord of Armies. That's His name. The Holy One of Israel.)

5.text: Sit down and shut up. Fade into the shadows, Chaldean daughter. You ain't "The Lady of Kingdoms" no more.

6.text: I was mad at My people, So I let you handle 'em for a minute—But you took it too far. You ain't show no mercy, Not even to the old folks. You went hard.

7.text: You got cocky. Said, "I'm gon' be queen forever." You ain't think about consequences. You ain't plan for the end.

8.text: So now, hear this—You who livin' lavish, all comfy in yo bubble, Sayin' in your heart, "Ain't nobody like me. I'll never be a widow or lose my kids."

9.text: Guess what? Both them things comin' for you. And not next year—same day. Loss gon' hit you full force. Why? All them spells, All them rituals you been playin' with.

10.text: You been leanin' on yo evil ways, Tellin' yourself, "Ain't nobody watchin'." You got smart with it—too smart. But your wisdom twisted you up. You steady tellin' yourself, "I'm that girl. Ain't nobody else."

11.text: But evil comin'—and you won't even see it comin'. Disaster gon' hit—And you won't know how to dodge it. Ruin gon' fall in your lap, And you won't be ready.

12.text: Go ahead. Try them spells again. All them tricks you been doin' since you was young. Maybe they'll work this time. Maybe.

13.text: You tired from tryin' everything under the sun. Call them astrologers. Call them stargazers. Call them folks readin' the moon. Tell 'em to save you—We'll wait.

14.text: They gon' burn like straw. That fire gon' eat them up. They can't even save themselves, Let alone you. That fire ain't for warmin' hands. Ain't no cozy firepit—it's destruction.

15.text: That's how it's gon' be for all them folks you been rockin' with since way back. Your merchants? Gone. Everybody gon' dip to their corner, And you? Ain't nobody comin' to save you.

1.text: Listen up, house of Jacob—Y'all who say y'all reppin' Israel, Who claim you from Judah's roots, Swearin' by the Lord's name, Droppin' God's name like you livin' right—But you not real with it.

2.text: You act like you part of the holy city, You lean on the name of the God of Israel, But let's be real—The Lord of Armies ain't fooled.

3.text: I told y'all what was gon' happen way back. I said it, then I made it pop off. I ain't waste no time.

4.text: I knew y'all hardheaded. Stiff-necked like you got iron in your spine. Forehead hard like bronze.

5.text: That's why I told you before it happened—So you wouldn't turn around and say, "My little idol did that." Nah. That was Me.

6.text: You heard all this—So what you gon' say now? I'm droppin' new stuff on you now, Fresh revelations you ain't never heard before.

7.text: It's brand new, not recycled. I ain't give it to you before, So don't act like, "Oh yeah, I already knew that."

8.text: No you didn't. Your ears been shut. You ain't been listenin'. I already knew you were shady—Been wildin' since the womb.

9.text: But for the sake of My name, I'm holdin' back My anger. For My own glory, I'm not cuttin' y'all off just yet.

10.text: I've been refin' you—Not like silver in a clean shop, But like throwin' you into fire—Hard times been shapin' you.

11.text: I'm doin' this for Me. Ain't gon' let My name get played. I don't share My shine with nobody else.

12.text: Listen, Jacob. Listen, Israel—My chosen one: I'm Him. The First. The Last. Still here.

13.text: My hand built this whole planet, Stretched out the sky with My right hand. When I call, they stand up and salute.

14.text: Y'all, come together and hear this—Ain't nobody else told you this before. The Lord got love for this one I raised up. He gon' wreck Babylon And bring down the Chaldeans.

15.text: I called him. I brought him. And he gon' succeed 'cause I said so.

16.text: Get close. Hear Me clear: I ain't been speakin' in secret. Since day one, I been here. And now, the Lord God and His Spirit sent Me.

17.text: This what your Redeemer says—The Holy One of Israel: "I'm the Lord your God, Teachin' you how to win, Guidin' you in the right direction."

18.text: If only you had listened… Your peace would be flowin' like a river, Your righteousness rollin' like ocean waves.

19.text: Your descendants would've been like sand on the beach, Uncountable blessings. No one would've erased your name from My presence.

20.text: Get outta Babylon! Dip from the Chaldeans! Sing about it loud! Shout it 'til the ends of the earth: "The Lord came through for Jacob!"

21.text: When He led 'em through dry places, They ain't go thirsty. He cracked rocks and made water pour out. Straight up miracle moves.

22.text: But for the wicked? Ain't no peace for them. That's on God.

1.text: Listen up, y'all on the coasts. You folks far off—pay attention. God been had Me marked from the womb, Called My name while I was still in my mama's belly.

2.text: He made My mouth sharp like a sword, But kept Me tucked under His hand. Polished Me like a fine arrow—Then placed Me in His quiver for the right moment.

3.text: He said to Me, "You My Servant, Israel. I'm gon' shine through you."

4.text: But I said, "Man, I been grindin' for nothin'. All this work feel wasted. Still, My reward is safe with the Lord. My purpose? God still got that handled."

5.text: Now the Lord—the one who shaped Me from the womb—He speakin': He made Me to bring Jacob back, To gather Israel close again. And even if they don't see it yet, God sees Me, and He say I'm glorious. He My strength.

6.text: And He said, "Just bringin' Israel back? That ain't even enough. I'm sendin' You as a light to the nations, So My salvation can reach all the way to the ends of the earth."

7.text: The Lord, Israel's Redeemer, The Holy One—the One people been disrespectin'—Says this to the One they wrote off: Kings gon' stand up when they see You. Even princes gon' bow down. Why? 'Cause God ain't never been fake. He picked You.

8.text: The Lord says, "When the time was right, I heard You. On the day of salvation, I showed up. I'm gon' hold You down, Make You the covenant, Restore what's broken, And give back what looked lost.

9.text: You gon' tell the locked-up ones, 'You free now.' And those in the dark, 'Step into the light.' They'll eat even along empty roads, Find green in high places.

10.text: No more hunger. No thirst. No sun blazin' down on them. I'm gon' lead 'em gently, Take 'em to springs of water like a good shepherd.

11.text: Every mountain that was in the way? I'll turn it into a road. My highways? They'll rise above it all.

12.text: Look—they comin' from everywhere: North, west, even far-off lands like Sinim."

13.text: Rejoice, heavens! Earth, go 'head and sing! Mountains, lift up your voice! 'Cause the Lord comforted His people—And He ain't forgot the ones hurtin'.

14.text: But Zion was like, "God forgot about me." "He done left me."

15.text: But God said: "Can a mama forget the baby she nursed? Even if she did, I ain't forget you.

16.text: Look—I got your name tatted on My hands. Your walls? I'm watchin' them constantly.

17.text: Your kids comin' back fast, And the ones who tore you down? They leavin'.

18.text: Open your eyes and look around! All of them comin' home to you. As sure as I live," says the Lord, "You gon' wear them like jewelry—Like a bride dressin' up."

19.text: All that ruined land you thought was too empty? Now it's gon' be too small to hold all your people. The ones who crushed you? Nowhere in sight.

20.text: Your new children gon' say, "This spot too tight—we need more room!"

21.text: And you gon' say, "Where all these kids come from? I lost everything. I was exiled, alone, abandoned. Who raised these? I ain't even know they existed."

22.text: The Lord God says: "I'ma raise My hand and send a signal to the nations. They gon' bring your sons in their arms, Carry your daughters on their shoulders.

23.text: Kings gon' serve you like foster daddies. Queens gon' nurse your babies. They'll bow to you face-down, And lick the dust off your feet. Then you'll know—I'm the Lord. And the ones who wait on Me? They won't ever be disappointed."

24.text: Can the strong be robbed of what they hold? Can prisoners just walk free from the powerful?

25.text: But the Lord says, "Yes, even the mighty gon' lose their grip. I'm takin' back what's Mine. I'll fight the ones fightin' you. And I'ma save your babies."

26.text: Your oppressors gon' eat their own lies and defeat. They gon' drown in their own mess. And everybody gon' know—I, the Lord, am your Savior, Your Redeemer, The Mighty One of Jacob.

1.text: The Lord said: "So where that divorce paper at? The one sayin' I left y'all mama? Or who I owe money to that made Me sell y'all off? Truth is—it was your own sin that sold you out. Your wrongdoings the reason your mama got put away."

2.text: "When I came knockin', why nobody answered? When I called, why y'all act like you ain't hear Me? You think My arm too short to save you? You think I ain't got power? Look—I snap and dry up oceans. I shut rivers down 'til they turn to dust. Fish rotin' out here 'cause there ain't no water. That's Me."

3.text: "I throw black over the sky like it's cloth, I wrap the heavens in mourning like it's sackcloth."

4.text: "God gave Me a tongue that knows what's up, So I can drop a word right when somebody need it most. He wakes Me up every morning, Opens My ears like a student ready to learn."

5.text: "The Lord opened My ears—And I ain't fight it. I ain't dip out or run."

6.text: "I let folks beat My back. They snatched out My beard. They spit on Me. But I ain't cover My face or flinch."

7.text: "Why? 'Cause the Lord got Me. I ain't gon' be embarrassed. My face set like stone. I know I ain't gon' end up lookin' foolish."

8.text: "God right by Me—He the one who call Me right. So who tryna argue? Let's go—stand next to Me then. Who hatin'? Step up."

9.text: "The Lord gon' help Me. Ain't nobody else got the right to cancel Me. Them haters? They gon' fade like old clothes. Moths gon' eat 'em up."

10.text: "Who out here really reverences God? Who out here really listens to His Servant? If you walkin' in the dark, no light in sight—Don't quit. Trust in the name of the Lord. Lean on your God."

11.text: "But hey—You out here tryna light your own fires? Runnin' around with your own little sparks? Go 'head then—walk in your own glow. But here's what you gon' get from Me: You gon' lie down in pain."

1.text: Listen up, y'all who chasin' after what's right, Y'all who really tryna seek the Lord—Look back to where you came from. The rock that birthed you. The pit you was pulled up outta.

2.text: Think 'bout Abraham—your pops. And Sarah, the one who brought y'all forth. God called him when he ain't have nobody, Then turned around and blessed him heavy.

3.text: The Lord gon' comfort Zion for real. He gon' show up in all them dry, busted spots. That wilderness? It's gon' feel like Eden. The desert? Like God's own garden. Joy and laughter gon' echo through that place. Thanksgiving and music everywhere.

4.text: "Listen up, My people—Tune in, y'all who carry My name. My justice 'bout to go global, A light that everybody gon' see."

5.text: "I'm comin' through with righteousness. Salvation already on the move. My arms gon' handle these nations. And folks way out on them coastlands? They waitin' on Me. They trustin' in Me."

6.text: "Lift your eyes up. Look to the skies. Then peep the ground under your feet. This world? It gon' fade like smoke. People gon' drop like old clothes. But My salvation? It's eternal. My righteousness don't get canceled."

7.text: "If you really know what's right, If My Word live in your heart—Don't be scared of people's side-eyes. Don't flinch at they disrespect."

8.text: "They just fabric—moths eat fabric. But My righteousness? That's forever. My salvation? That's for generations on generations."

9.text: Wake up, Lord! Throw on Your strength like a fit! Just like You did back in the day. Ain't You the same One who shut Rahab down, And took out that sea serpent?

10.text: Ain't You the one who split the sea open So Your people could cross through it on dry land?

11.text: Them ones You saved gon' come home singin', They'll roll up to Zion with joy that don't expire. Sorrow? Gone. Tears? Gone. Only gladness gon' remain.

12.text: "It's Me—it's really Me—who comforts you. So why you so shook over another human, Somebody who gon' die just like grass? Why you forgot who made the sky and laid the Earth? You been scared every day, Worried about some oppressor."

13.text: "But where that oppressor now? Where all that rage they had?"

14.text: The one who been locked up? They 'bout to be free. They ain't gon' die in no hole. They gon' eat, live, and walk out.

15.text: "I'm the Lord your God. I cracked open that sea. I run the waves. That's Me—The Lord of Armies."

16.text: "I gave you My Word—put it in your mouth. Covered you with My hand for protection. Why? So I could replant the heavens, Lay the foundation again, And tell Zion, 'You My people.'"

17.text: Wake up! Get up, Jerusalem! You been sippin' straight from God's fury. You drank the whole cup—every bitter drop.

18.text: Ain't nobody left to guide you. None of your sons reachin' out for you. They all out here, but can't help.

19.text: Two things hit you hard: Destruction and famine. Sword and desolation. Who got the comfort for that?

20.text: Your sons out cold in the streets, Like deer caught in a trap. They full of the Lord's anger—That divine rebuke hit heavy.

21.text: So please, hear this now, You who been through it. You who feel drunk—but it ain't wine.

22.text: God's sayin'—"I'm your Lord. Your God. I fight for you. I'm takin' that cup of pain out your hand. You ain't gon' sip from My wrath no more."

23.text: "But the ones who walked on you? The ones who told you to lay down So they could step over you? They gettin' that cup now. You ain't the sidewalk no more."

1.text: Wake up, wake up, Zion! Throw on your strength like armor! Put on somethin' beautiful, Jerusalem, God's holy city ain't for the unclean no more—They ain't got access no more.

2.text: Dust yourself off. Rise up! Sit like a queen, Jerusalem. Break off them chains from your neck, You God's daughter—ain't no slave no more.

3.text: This what God say: "Y'all gave yourselves away for free, But I'm 'bout to buy y'all back—and it ain't costin' no cash."

4.text: God speakin': "My people went down to Egypt back in the day, Just tryna live. Then Assyria came outta nowhere, Oppressin' without reason."

5.text: "So now what's this I'm seein'? My people just bein' taken, no payment, no cause. These rulers got 'em cryin', And folks out here disrespectin' My name every day."

6.text: "But trust—My people gon' know My name. When that day hit, they gon' know for sure: 'I'm the One. I said it. I showed up.'"

7.text: How beautiful it is—Them feet comin' over the hills Bringin' good news. Talkin' peace. Spreadin' joy. Proclaimin' salvation. Tellin' Zion: "Yo God in charge!"

8.text: The watchmen gon' be singin' loud, All in sync—same voice. They gon' see the Lord do His thing And bring Zion back.

9.text: So let them ruins turn up—Sing out, Jerusalem! God done comforted His people, He done pulled up to redeem the city.

10.text: God done rolled up His sleeve, Showed the whole world He mean business. Every nation—every end of the Earth—Gon' witness the salvation of our God.

11.text: Go on, get outta there! Don't touch none of that dirty stuff. Y'all carrying the Lord's holy things—Be clean when you walk out.

12.text: And don't be runnin' like somebody scared. Ain't no panic. God got you. He up front, leadin' the way. And He got your back too—The God of Israel your rear guard.

13.text: "Look now—My Servant gon' move with wisdom. He gon' be lifted up, honored, praised."

14.text: Folks was shook when they saw Him—He ain't even look like a regular man. What He went through disfigured Him. He carried it all.

15.text: But He gon' sprinkle the nations—Bringin' cleansing. Even kings gon' shut up in awe. What they ain't never heard, they 'bout to see. What they ain't never imagined, it gon' hit them hard.

1.text: Who even gon' believe this right here? Who really seein' the strength of the Lord showin' up?

2.text: He came up like a young shoot, Like somethin' tryin' to grow outta dry ground. Ain't nothin' about Him that turned heads—No swag, no looks that made folks wanna choose Him.

3.text: He got hated on and pushed to the side, A man who knew pain like it was his roommate. We ain't even wanna look His way. He got disrespected, and we didn't think nothin' of Him.

4.text: But real talk? He carried our pain. He held our sadness on His back. But we thought He was bein' punished by God, Like He had it comin'.

5.text: Nah—He was hurt 'cause of our mess. He got bruised for the junk we did. He took the beatin' that made peace possible for us. And by His wounds, we got healed.

6.text: We all strayed off like lost sheep, Every single one of us doin' our own thing. But God dropped the weight of all our wrongs Right on Him.

7.text: He got mistreated, but He ain't say nothin'. Didn't even open His mouth. Like a lamb bein' walked to the butcher—Silent. Like a sheep gettin' shaved—Still didn't say a word.

8.text: They snatched Him up, locked Him down, passed judgment. Ain't nobody stood up for Him. They ended His life before it really started. He got struck down for what we did wrong.

9.text: They buried Him like a criminal—But He ended up restin' with the rich. Why? 'Cause He never did nobody dirty. Ain't no lies ever come out His mouth.

10.text: And somehow, God let it happen. He let Him go through it all. He offered His life for sin—But He gon' see His people, He gon' live on, And God's plan gon' win through Him.

11.text: After all that pain, He gon' look back and be satisfied. 'Cause through Him, many gon' be made right—All 'cause He carried the weight of their sins.

12.text: So now He gon' get a piece with the greats, Gon' share the victory with the strong—'Cause He gave His all, Took that death, Stood with the guilty, Carried the sin of many, And spoke up for the ones who didn't deserve it.

1.text: Go 'head and sing, sis—even if you ain't had no kids! Shout loud like you just gave birth, 'Cause the ones who felt left out Gon' have more than the ones who had it all together. That's what the Lord said.

2.text: Make room, baby! Stretch out your tent, Don't hold back. Add some square footage, Reinforce yo' stakes.

3.text: 'Cause you gon' spread out on both sides. Your people gon' take over nations, And them empty cities? You gon' fill 'em up.

4.text: Don't be scared—ain't no shame in your story no more. Forget the old wounds, Let go of the pain from your past, God ain't bringin' that back up.

5.text: Your Maker is now your man—The Lord of Heaven's Armies got you. Your Redeemer? The Holy One of Israel. He runnin' the whole earth.

6.text: God called you back like a husband callin' his young wife After leavin' her for a second, Feelin' her heartbreak.

7.text: I might've stepped back for a quick minute, But My mercy? That thing comin' in waves.

8.text: Yeah, I hid My face for a second in anger, But My love? That's gon' last forever. I'm comin' back for you with grace.

9.text: Just like I swore to Noah That the flood wouldn't hit again—I'm swearin' now I ain't gon' stay mad at you Or keep checkin' you.

10.text: Mountains might crumble, Hills might disappear, But My love ain't leavin' you. That peace I promised? Still locked in. That's on God.

11.text: You been hurt, tossed around, feelin' left out—But watch Me flip it. I'm gon' build you up with gems, Lay your foundation with sapphires.

12.text: Your towers gon' shine with rubies, Gates gon' sparkle like crystal, Every wall? Priceless.

13.text: And your babies? They gon' learn straight from the Lord. Peace? Overflowin'.

14.text: You gon' be rooted in righteousness. Oppression can't touch you. Fear? Nah. Terror? It can't even reach you.

15.text: Folks might try to come for you—But I ain't send 'em. And when they do? They gon' fall tryin'.

16.text: I made the blacksmith who blows them flames And creates weapons. I even made the one who tries to destroy.

17.text: But listen: No weapon formed against you gon' win. Any tongue tryna drag your name in court? You gon' shut it down. That's your inheritance as My servant. And your righteousness? Straight from Me. That's what the Lord said.

1.text: Aye! If you thirsty, come get some water. You broke? No problem—come eat anyway. Grab some wine and milk—no cash needed, no price tag attached.

2.text: Why you spendin' your money on junk that don't feed you? Why work so hard for stuff that don't satisfy? Listen up—eat what's good, And let your soul feast on real abundance.

3.text: Lean in, fam. Come close and really hear Me. Your soul gon' live, for real. I'm signin' an eternal deal with you—The same faithful love I showed David.

4.text: I made him a witness to the people, A true leader and commander in charge.

5.text: And guess what? You gon' call nations you don't even know, And folks who never heard of you? They gon' come runnin'. Why? 'Cause the Lord your God made you shine. The Holy One of Israel got you lookin' glorified.

6.text: Find the Lord while He's near. Call Him up before the line go dead.

7.text: Let the wicked man drop his ways, Let the shady one drop them thoughts. Come back to the Lord—He got mercy. Come back to our God—He forgives heavy.

8.text: "Look," says the Lord, "My thoughts ain't your thoughts, And My ways? They on a whole 'nother level.

9.text: Just like the sky higher than the ground, My ways higher than yours, And My thoughts? Way past yours."

10.text: Just like rain and snow come down from heaven, Waterin' the earth, Bringin' up fruit, feedin' the grower and the eater—

11.text: That's how My Word work. When I send it out, it don't come back empty. It's gon' do exactly what I wanted And prosper in the mission I sent it on.

12.text: You gon' leave with joy, And be led in peace. Even the mountains and hills gon' sing when they see you, And the trees out here? They clappin' for you like it's a standing ovation.

13.text: Instead of thorn bushes, cypress trees pop up. Instead of briers, myrtles grow. All this gon' be for the Lord's name—An eternal sign that won't ever be erased.

1.text: The Lord say: "Keep it just. Do what's right. My salvation comin' soon, And My righteousness 'bout to show up for real."

2.text: Blessed is the one who lives like this—Who hold tight to it, Don't break the Sabbath, And keep they hands clean from evil.

3.text: Don't let the foreigner who rolled with the Lord say, "God done pushed me out His circle." And don't let no eunuch say, "I'm washed up like a dead tree."

4.text: Nah, God say: To them eunuchs that hold down the Sabbath, Choose what pleases Me, And hold tight to My covenant—

5.text: I'ma give them a spot in My house, A name on My wall better than sons or daughters. An everlasting name that nobody can erase.

6.text: Same with the foreigners who ride for Me, Who serve Me and love My name, Who live like they belong to Me, Who keep the Sabbath and don't mess it up, And stick with My covenant—

7.text: I'ma bring them to My holy mountain. I'ma make 'em feel joy in My house of prayer. Their offerings? I'ma accept 'em. 'Cause My house? It's a house of prayer—for all nations.

8.text: The Lord God—the One who gathers all the outcasts of Israel—He say: "And I ain't done. I'ma gather even more to what's already been gathered."

9.text: All you wild beasts out there—come eat. You too, beasts of the forest—come feast.

10.text: The so-called watchmen? Blind as bats. Don't know nothin'. Can't speak up—just quiet like mute dogs. Laid out, sleepin' heavy, lovin' the nap life.

11.text: And they greedy too—like dogs that never get full. These "shepherds" don't understand the flock. They just out for self, Tryna get theirs from their own corners.

12.text: They say, "Come on, pour up the wine. Let's get lit. Tomorrow? It's gon' be just like today—Maybe even better."

1.text: The righteous folks die, And nobody really even cares. The kind-hearted get taken out, But ain't nobody askin' why—God spared 'em from the evil that was comin'.

2.text: They rest now, in peace. They lay down, Still walkin' in integrity, even in death.

3.text: But as for y'all? Come here, you sons of the sorceress, Children of adultery and scandal!

4.text: Who you out here clownin'? Who you makin' faces at, stickin' out your tongue? Ain't you the ones born in sin, Full of lies since day one?

5.text: You was wild under every green tree, Burnin' for them fake gods. Even sacrificed children in the valleys, Down in the shadows of the rocks.

6.text: You made them smooth river stones your gods. You poured drinks to 'em, brought grain offerings. You really think I'm cool with that?

7.text: Up high on the mountains, You laid out your bed—Went up there just to worship somethin' else.

8.text: Behind closed doors and secret spots, You stashed your idols. You opened yourself up to other lovers, Built bigger beds for 'em, Made shady deals and got comfortable in they beds, Lookin' at all that mess with lust in your eyes.

9.text: You chased after kings with perfumes and oils. You sent messages far away, Even down to the grave itself (Sheol). Chasin' every thrill.

10.text: You ran yourself ragged. But you ain't never say, "This ain't it." You kept chasin' what your hands could grab, So you ain't feel no remorse.

11.text: Who had you so shook That you had to lie? You forgot Me. Didn't even put Me in your heart. Was it 'cause I stayed quiet for a minute? That's why you stopped fearing Me?

12.text: I'ma call out your so-called righteousness And them deeds you brag on—They ain't gon' help you at all.

13.text: When you cry out, Let them idols you collected come save you. But the wind gon' blow them all away. Poof—gone. But whoever trusts Me? He gon' inherit the land. He gon' live on My holy mountain.

14.text: Somebody gon' say, "Clear the road! Move the mess out the way! Make room for God's people to walk free."

15.text: 'Cause the High and Holy One—the Eternal One—says: "I live way up in holiness, But I'm also close to the ones who feel low, The ones who know they need Me. I'm here to revive the brokenhearted, To breathe life into the humble."

16.text: I ain't gon' stay mad forever. I ain't gon' keep beef goin'. Y'all couldn't even survive if I did.

17.text: I was mad when y'all got greedy. I struck y'all down, hid My face. But y'all kept actin' up, Still runnin' with a hard heart.

18.text: But I seen it. And still—I'ma heal you. I'ma guide you. Bring comfort back to you and those who mourned with you.

19.text: I'ma speak peace into existence: "Peace, peace"—to the ones far and near. I will heal them, says the Lord.

20.text: But the wicked? They like a restless, raging sea—Can't chill. Just throwin' up dirt and mess everywhere.

21.text: Ain't no peace for the wicked. That's what my God said.

1.text: Shout it out loud! Don't hold back. Lift your voice like a trumpet—Tell My people what they doin' wrong, Call out Jacob's house on their mess.

2.text: They be actin' like they seek Me every day, Like they really want to know what I'm about. Like they some holy nation that stays righteous, And ain't turn they back on My commands. They ask Me for "justice," Actin' like they love to be in My presence.

3.text: "Why we fastin' and You ain't seein'? Why we afflictin' ourselves and You ain't payin' attention?" But check it—On the same day y'all fastin', Y'all still out here doin' whatever you want, Treatin' your workers dirty.

4.text: Y'all fastin' to start drama, Arguin' and fightin'—throwin' punches in the name of God. That ain't the kinda fast that's gon' move heaven.

5.text: You think I asked for that? Just for y'all to be lookin' sad, Head down, ashes on your face, Makin' a public show? That's what you call a fast? That's what you think I want?

6.text: This the fast I chose: Break the chains of injustice, Untie the heavy burdens, Free the oppressed, Tear down every yoke holdin' folks back.

7.text: Share your food with the hungry. Open your doors to the homeless. Give clothes to the ones out here naked. Don't act like you don't see your own people strugglin'.

8.text: Then—yeah, then—Your light gon' shine like the sunrise. Your healing? It gon' pop off fast. Your righteousness gon' be out front, And God's glory? It'll have your back.

9.text: Then when you call out, God gon' say, "Here I am." But you gotta stop with the heavy yokes, Stop pointin' fingers, And cut out all the hateful talk.

10.text: If you really look out for the hungry, If you care about the ones in pain—Then your light gon' break through the darkness, And even your night gon' feel like noon.

11.text: The Lord will keep guidin' you, Fillin' you up even in dry times, Strengthenin' your bones. You gon' be like a garden that stay green, Like a never-dry spring.

12.text: Your people gon' rebuild what was left in ruins. You gon' lay down legacy foundations. You'll be called "The Fixer of the Broken Walls," "The One Who Brought the Neighborhood Back."

13.text: If you stop wildin' on the Sabbath, And quit doin' your thing on My day—If you treat it like the gift it is, Holy and worthy, And stop speakin' on what you want…

14.text: Then you gon' be full of joy in the Lord. I'll lift you up to ride high on the land, And feed you from the inheritance I gave Jacob. The Lord Himself said that. No cap.

1.text: Look, God ain't too weak to save you. His hand still strong. His ears ain't clogged up either—He can hear you just fine.

2.text: The problem ain't with Him, it's with y'all. Your sins the ones buildin' a wall between you and God. Your mess done made Him turn His face away, So He ain't listenin' right now.

3.text: Your hands drippin' with blood, Your fingers dirty with wrongdoing. Your lips? Full of lies. And your tongue? Straight twisted.

4.text: Ain't nobody standin' up for what's right. Ain't nobody speakin' truth with their chest. They lean on lies, Plan evil, And birth nothin' but trouble.

5.text: They sittin' on snake eggs—Tryna hatch danger and poison. Crack one open, and a snake come out. Eat it? You dead.

6.text: All that mess they spun? It can't cover nothin'. Can't clothe you in righteousness. All their works are dirty, And they stay ready with violence in hand.

7.text: Their feet move fast toward evil. They quick to spill innocent blood. Their minds stay in the gutter, Leavin' destruction wherever they walk.

8.text: Peace? They don't know her. Justice? Ain't in their lane. Their paths are twisted, And anybody who follows 'em ain't gon' know peace.

9.text: That's why justice stay far from us. We try to chase righteousness, but it don't catch us. We lookin' for light, But keep walkin' in darkness.

10.text: We feelin' around like we blind, Like we got no vision at all. Stumblin' at high noon like it's midnight. We out here lookin' half-dead in these streets.

11.text: We growlin' like bears, Moanin' like doves—Lookin' for justice but not findin' it. Lookin' for a way out, but it's like salvation ghosted us.

12.text: Our sins? Yeah, they loud. They testify against us. We know what we did. Ain't even tryin' to pretend.

13.text: We turned our backs on the Lord, Lyin', schemin', Talkin' oppression and rebellion like it's cute, Pushin' out lies straight from the heart.

14.text: Justice got pushed back. Righteousness standin' off in the distance. Truth? Laid out in the street. Ain't no room for fairness.

15.text: Truth got shut down, And anybody who tries to do right becomes a target. Then the Lord looked… And He was not feelin' it. He saw the mess and said, "Ain't nobody steppin' up?"

16.text: He saw there was no one standin' in the gap—No intercessor. So He said, "Bet." I'll handle this Myself. His righteousness held Him down. His own arm brought the rescue.

17.text: He geared up: Righteousness on His chest like armor, Helmet of salvation on His head, Vengeance in His fit, Zeal wrapped around Him like a cloak.

18.text: He came with receipts. And He comin' to collect. Enemies? They gettin' what's owed. The whole earth, even the coastlines, gon' feel the payback.

19.text: Folks from the west to the east gon' respect His name. When the enemy rushes in like a flood, God's Spirit gon' raise the banner and say, "Back up!"

20.text: And guess what? The Redeemer gon' show up in Zion—For everybody in Jacob that turns away from sin.

21.text: "This right here My promise," says the Lord: "My Spirit stayin' with you. My words gon' stay in your mouth—And your kids' mouths, And your grandkids' mouths too. Forever. Bet on that."

1.text: Get up and shine, baby! Yo' light here now. God's glory? It's sittin' on you heavy.

2.text: Yeah, the world lookin' real dark, People deep in the shadows—But the Lord gon' rise over you, And His shine gon' be undeniable.

3.text: Nations gon' come follow your glow, Kings gon' pull up just to bask in your light.

4.text: Look up and take it all in: They comin'. From everywhere. Your sons comin' home, Your daughters right by your side, safe and held.

5.text: When you see it, your face gon' light up—Your heart gon' swell up with joy, 'Cause wealth from the seas and riches from all over Gon' be pourin' in.

6.text: Camels gon' flood your land—Midian, Ephah, Sheba too. They comin' with gold and incense, Puttin' praise on God's name with every step.

7.text: Kedar sendin' flocks, Nebaioth bringin' rams—All of 'em welcomed at the altar, All of it honorin' God's house.

8.text: "Who's that flyin' like clouds in the sky?" Like doves glidin' back home?

9.text: That's the coastlands waitin' on Me. Ships from Tarshish pullin' up first, Bringing your people home with silver and gold—All of it done for the name of the Lord, 'Cause He put His glory on you.

10.text: Even foreigners gon' be buildin' your walls, Their kings gon' serve you. I was mad for a minute—But now? Mercy.

11.text: Your gates? They stay open—day and night. Wealth flowin' in nonstop, Kings showin' up in long lines just to honor you.

12.text: Any nation that don't ride with you? They done. Wiped clean.

13.text: Lebanon sendin' its finest trees—Cypress, pine, and boxwood—All to deck out My sanctuary, To make My spot glow with glory.

14.text: The same folks who tried you? Yeah, they gon' bow down now. They gon' call you "The City of the Lord," Zion, where the Holy One stays.

15.text: You was once left out and looked down on, People ain't even walk through your hood. But now? You that eternal excellence. Generations gon' smile when they speak your name.

16.text: You gon' be nourished by the nations, Drink from the wealth of kings. Then you'll know—God is your Savior, Your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

17.text: God say: "I'm upgradin' everything—Gold instead of bronze, Silver instead of iron, Bronze where there was wood, Iron where there were stones. And yo' leaders? They gon' be peace and righteousness."

18.text: Violence? Gone. No more destruction in your streets. Your walls gon' be called Salvation, Your gates gon' shout Praise.

19.text: Forget the sun and moon—You don't need 'em no more. God Himself gon' be your light forever. His presence? Your glow.

20.text: No more nightfall. No more sadness. God stayin' lit in your life forever. Mourning? Over.

21.text: Everybody in your land gon' be righteous, Holdin' it down forever. God planted them, shaped them—All of it to reflect His glory.

22.text: That little one? Gon' turn into a thousand. That small one? A whole strong nation. And when God say it's time? It's happenin' quick.

1.text: The Spirit of the Lord God restin' on Me heavy, 'Cause He chose Me, anointed Me, To bring good news to the broke and hopeless, To patch up hearts that done been shattered, To let the captives know they free now, To swing open them jail doors for the ones locked down.

2.text: I came to tell y'all: This right here is the Lord's year—The year He say, "Enough's enough." And His payback? It's comin'. But for those who been cryin'? Comfort's on the way.

3.text: For the ones in Zion still in mourning, He got beauty comin' outta all that ash. He pourin' joy like oil on them sorrowful heads, Givin' folks praise instead of depression and heaviness. They gon' be called oaks of righteousness, Planted by the Lord—So folks know this His work, not theirs.

4.text: They gon' rebuild what been torn down, Raise up what generations let fall. All them hood blocks, all them ghost towns? They gon' shine again.

5.text: Strangers gon' work your fields and flocks, Outsiders tendin' to your vineyards—While you walkin' in favor.

6.text: Y'all gon' be known as God's priests, People gon' call y'all His crew. You gon' eat off the riches of the nations, And flex in the glory they used to claim.

7.text: Instead of shame? Double up. Instead of confusion? Pure joy. You gon' own double in your land, And joy that don't expire gon' be yours forever.

8.text: God say: "I love justice. I ain't here for that fake, shady worship. I'm gon' lead 'em right and lock in My covenant for eternity."

9.text: Their babies gon' be known across borders, Their descendants respected everywhere. People gon' point and say, "That right there? Yeah, God blessed them."

10.text: I can't help it—I'm rejoicin' in the Lord! My soul dancin' over here. He done dressed me in salvation, Covered me in righteousness like a fresh tailored fit. I look like a groom on wedding day, Or a bride decked out in all her glory.

11.text: Just like the earth push out flowers in spring, Just like gardens sprout what's been planted, That's how the Lord gon' make righteousness and praise bloom All over this earth, Where everybody can see.

1.text: I ain't stayin' quiet 'bout Zion. I ain't finna rest 'til she shine bright like justice, 'Til her salvation glow like a lit lamp.

2.text: The nations gon' peep your righteousness, Even kings gon' recognize your glow-up. And you? You gettin' a new name—One straight from God's own mouth.

3.text: You gon' be a crown of glory in His hand, A royal jewel God holds close.

4.text: You ain't gon' be called "Left Behind" no more, Your land won't be known as "Washed Up." Nah—your new name is Hephzibah ("My delight is in her"), And your land is Beulah ("Married"). 'Cause God got joy in you now, And He claimin' your land like a groom claims his bride.

5.text: Just like a young man puts a ring on his girl, That's how your people gon' come back to you. And the same way a groom get hype on his wedding day, That's how your God feel about you.

6.text: I got watchmen posted on the walls of Jerusalem—They don't clock out, day or night. All y'all who keep prayin'? Don't stop.

7.text: Keep remindin' God, keep pushin' til He make Jerusalem pop off And become praise on this earth.

8.text: The Lord swore—right hand raised, flexin' His strength: "You won't work hard and have it stolen anymore. No more foreigners eatin' what you sweated for."

9.text: Nah—you gon' eat the grain you gathered And praise the Lord while doin' it. You gon' sip that wine in His holy place Like royalty.

10.text: Go ahead, pass through the gates! Clear the way for the people! Build that road, raise it high, Toss the stones aside, Hold that banner up high so the world sees.

11.text: God done made the announcement—worldwide: Tell Zion's daughter: "Your salvation on the way. Look—He's bringin' His reward, And He got work lined up ahead."

12.text: They gon' call y'all The Holy People, The Ones the Lord Saved. And you? You gon' be known as Sought Out, That City That Ain't Been Left Behind.

1.text: Who that comin' up outta Edom, Rockin' that blood-red fit from Bozrah? Lookin' majestic, movin' strong, Talkin' like He got power AND righteousness? "It's Me—the one who speaks truth and saves souls."

2.text: Why your clothes look like you been stompin' grapes? Like you been in the winepress?

3.text: "I pressed that winepress all by Myself—ain't nobody helped Me. I stomped 'em out in My anger, Trampled 'em in My wrath. Blood flew up on My garments, Stained every robe I got.

4.text: Vengeance been sittin' in My heart for a minute, And now? Now it's payback time for My people.

5.text: I looked around for backup—nobody. Nobody stood up, so My own arm brought salvation. I held it down Myself.

6.text: I crushed nations, made 'em reel like drunk folks, Dropped 'em to the ground—done."

7.text: But lemme talk 'bout God's goodness now. All them blessings He gave us, All that mercy and love He showed Israel. He came through time and time again, Kept us close 'cause of His kindness.

8.text: He said, "These My people for real. They ain't gon' lie to Me." So He became their Savior.

9.text: When they suffered, He felt it. His Angel showed up and saved 'em. He loved 'em deep, had pity on 'em, Carried 'em through the years like a Father carries His baby.

10.text: But they wilded out. Grieved His Spirit. So He had to flip it—became their enemy, And fought back against 'em.

11.text: Then they started rememberin' the old days, When Moses was leadin' and God was movin'. They asked, "Where's the One who brought us through the sea? Where's the One who dropped His Spirit on us?"

12.text: He was the One who led Moses by the hand, Showed out with glory, split the sea in two—All to put some respect on His name.

13.text: He took 'em through the deep Like a horse ridin' smooth in the wilderness—Didn't let 'em trip.

14.text: Like cattle restin' in a quiet valley, His Spirit gave 'em peace. That's how You led Your people, God—To show off Your greatness.

15.text: God, look down from heaven, From Your holy, glorious crib—Where Your passion at? Your power? Don't hold back Your love on me now.

16.text: You our real Father. Abraham might not know us, Israel might forget us, But You, Lord? You been our Redeemer forever.

17.text: Lord, why You let us wander so far? Why our hearts so cold, like we forgot how to fear You? Please come back—for Your people's sake. We Your chosen ones.

18.text: We had Your holy place for a moment, Then our enemies came through and stomped it out.

19.text: Now we feel like strangers—Like folks You ain't never ruled, Like folks who ain't even called by Your name.

1.text: Lord, if only You would just tear the sky open and come down! Let the mountains shake when You show up.

2.text: Like fire hittin' dry branches, Like a pot boilin' over—Show these folks who You are, So every nation trembles when You roll in.

3.text: When You did stuff nobody saw comin', You stepped down, And the mountains had to bow down just from Your presence.

4.text: Ain't nobody ever heard, Ain't no ear ever caught it, Ain't no eye ever seen a God like You—One who moves on behalf of the one who waits on You.

5.text: You come through for the ones who got joy in doin' right, Who keep Your ways in mind. But You got angry 'cause we kept messin' up—We been stuck in these sins… Lord, we need You to save us.

6.text: Truth be told, we all messed up. Even our "best behavior" look like dirty rags. We fade like dead leaves in the wind, Our sins blow us wherever like we got no roots.

7.text: Ain't nobody even callin' on Your name like they should. Ain't nobody reachin' out to hold onto You. You turned Your face from us, Let our sins eat us up.

8.text: But still—You our Father, Lord. We just the clay, You the potter. We all the work of Your hands.

9.text: Don't stay mad at us forever, Lord. Please don't hold these sins over us. Just look at us—we still Your people!

10.text: Your holy cities? Straight up wastelands now. Zion look like a ghost town. Jerusalem in ruins.

11.text: The temple we loved—Where our ancestors gave You praise? Burned up. All the beautiful stuff? Gone.

12.text: Lord… are You really gon' stay silent over this? You not gon' say nothin'? You just gon' let us keep sufferin' like this?

1.text: "I let Myself be found by folks who wasn't even lookin'. People who didn't even ask about Me—found Me anyway. I said, 'Here I am! Here I am!' To a nation that wasn't even claimin' My name."

2.text: "I kept My hands outstretched all day To a stubborn, rebellious people Who stay doin' whatever they want, Goin' off their own thoughts instead of My way.

3.text: They keep testin' Me to My face—Burnin' incense in wild gardens, Buildin' altars on bricks instead of where I told 'em.

4.text: They sittin' out by graves, spendin' nights in tombs, Eatin' pig meat and messin' with all kinds of unclean stuff.

5.text: Then they got the nerve to say, 'Back up, don't touch me! I'm too holy for you!' Man, that's like smoke in My nose—That kinda mess stay irritatin' Me."

6.text: "I got all this written down. I ain't just gon' sit quiet—nah, I'ma pay y'all back.

7.text: Your sins and your ancestors' sins both, Burnin' incense on them hills, Disrespectin' Me constantly—So now I'ma pay it all back to y'all straight up."

8.text: "But just like you don't throw out a whole grape cluster 'Cause there's still juice in it—I ain't gon' wipe everybody out. I got some faithful ones, And for their sake, I'ma hold back the wrath.

9.text: Outta Jacob and Judah, I'ma bring out a people Who'll actually inherit what I promised. They My chosen ones, and they gon' live in it.

10.text: The plains of Sharon? Gonna be full of sheep. The Valley of Achor? Peaceful place for cattle. All for My folks who truly sought Me."

11.text: "But y'all who ditched Me? Who forgot all about My mountain, Who out here pourin' drinks for fake gods—Yeah, I see you.

12.text: That's why y'all gon' be numbered for the sword. You gon' be laid out, 'Cause when I called, you ignored Me. When I spoke, y'all didn't listen. Instead, you did the opposite of what I asked."

13.text: So this is what God says: "My servants gon' eat good—But y'all gon' be hungry. They'll drink—Y'all stay thirsty. They'll be out here celebratin'—Y'all gon' be ashamed.

14.text: My servants gon' be singin' with joy, But y'all? Y'all gon' be weepin', heartbroken, Cryin' in pain.

15.text: Your name gon' be used like a curse by My chosen ones. But I'm gon' call My real ones by a whole new name."

16.text: "From now on, if somebody bless theyself, They gon' bless theyself in the name of the true God. Ain't nobody thinkin' about them old hard times no more. That stuff been wiped clean from My view."

17.text: "Look, I'm creatin' a new heaven and new earth. The past? Gone. Forgotten.

18.text: Be glad, for real. Jerusalem gon' be full of joy. Her people? Straight happiness.

19.text: I'm gon' be smilin' over Jerusalem, Lovin' on My folks. Ain't gon' be no more cryin' or heartbreak there.

20.text: Babies won't die young no more. Old folks gon' live long, full lives. If somebody dies at a hundred, folks'll think, 'Dang, they must've done somethin' wrong!'

21.text: Folks gon' build houses—and actually live in 'em. Plant vineyards—and eat their own fruit.

22.text: No more buildin' for somebody else to move in. No more workin' just for somebody else to take the harvest. Nah, My people gon' live long like trees, And enjoy the fruit of their grind.

23.text: They ain't gon' waste their energy. Their kids ain't gon' grow up for pain and destruction. They're the blessed ones, And their kids? Blessed too.

24.text: Before they even call Me—I'm already respondin'. While they still talkin', I'm already movin'.

25.text: The wolf and the lamb gon' eat together in peace. The lion gon' munch on straw like an ox. And snakes? They'll stay eatin' dirt. Ain't nobody gon' hurt or destroy nothin' In all My holy mountain," says the Lord.

1.text: God said, "Heaven is My throne, and earth? That's just My footrest. So what house could y'all build for Me? What place could actually hold My presence?"

2.text: "I made all this—everything you see. But the one I look at with love? That humble one. That broken-spirited one who trembles at My Word."

3.text: "Some of y'all actin' holy, but y'all outta pocket. Killin' a bull like it's murder. Offerin' lambs like breakin' a dog's neck. Burnin' incense like it's some idol party. You chose your own path, delighted in mess—So I'ma let that mess turn right back on you.

4.text: When I called, you ignored Me. When I spoke, y'all ain't listen. So now? I'ma give y'all exactly what you feared. 'Cause you chose what I hate."

5.text: "Listen up, y'all who really honor My word—Even when your own people kick you out for My name. They said, 'Let the Lord be glorified...' But really, they just hatin'. Don't worry—shame comin' their way."

6.text: You hear that noise from the city? That voice in the temple? Yeah, that's Me. God speakin'—and I ain't holdin' back.

7.text: "Before she even felt the pain, she gave birth. A son, just like that.

8.text: Who's ever heard somethin' like that? A whole nation born in one day? But that's how Zion rolled—Soon as labor hit, boom!—her kids came through."

9.text: "You really think I'ma bring you to the edge of breakthrough And not deliver? Nah. If I open the womb, I'ma bring life too."

10.text: "Y'all better rejoice with Jerusalem. Celebrate her—especially y'all that cried over her.

11.text: 'Cause now? She about to pour out comfort like milk. Y'all gon' be full, satisfied, delighted."

12.text: "I'm sendin' peace like a river, And blessings flowin' like a stream. Gentiles gon' bring gifts, And you gon' be held, carried, and comforted.

13.text: Just like a mama rockin' her baby—That's how I'ma comfort y'all in Jerusalem."

14.text: When y'all see it, your heart gon' light up. Bones gon' be strong again. Servants get grace. Enemies? Gonna feel that heat.

15.text: Look, the Lord comin' with fire. Chariots spinnin' like tornados. Wrath ain't just poetic—it's real.

16.text: By sword and flame, God judge everybody. And it's gon' be a whole lotta bodies.

17.text: "Those folks tryna 'cleanse' themselves to chase idols? Eatin' pork and all kinds of mess? They all gettin' wiped out together."

18.text: "I see what folks do and what they think. And soon, I'm gatherin' every nation and tongue. They gon' see My glory.

19.text: I'ma mark the survivors, Send 'em out to far nations—Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Tubal, Javan. Places that ain't heard of Me—yet. And My name gon' hit every corner of the earth."

20.text: "They gon' bring your brothers and sisters back to Me—From every nation, like a holy parade. On horses, chariots, wagons, mules—whatever it takes. Just like Israel used to do with clean offerings.

21.text: And guess what? Some of these outsiders? Yeah, I'ma make 'em priests and Levites too."

22.text: "The new heaven and new earth I'm buildin'? That's permanent. Just like your descendants and your name—They ain't goin' nowhere."

23.text: "From one New Moon to the next, From Sabbath to Sabbath, All flesh—everybody—gon' come worship Me."

24.text: "And they gon' see the bodies—The ones who went against Me. Their worm never dies. Their fire never goes out. It's gon' be a horror show for all to witness."

1.text: These the words of Jeremiah, son of Hilkiah—one of the priests from a lil' town called Anathoth, out in Benjamin's territory.

2.text: The word of the Lord came to him back when Josiah, son of Amon, was king of Judah—in the 13th year of his reign.

3.text: God kept speakin' to him during the time of Jehoiakim (Josiah's son), all the way until Zedekiah (also Josiah's son) was king. That's when Jerusalem got taken over in the fifth month.

4.text: Then God pulled up on me and said:

5.text: "Before I even formed you in your mama's belly, I knew you. Before you took your first breath, I had already set you apart. I chose you to speak to nations."

6.text: I said, "Lord God… I don't know how to speak like that—I'm just a kid!"

7.text: But God said, "Don't say you too young. You gon' go wherever I send you and say whatever I tell you to."

8.text: "Don't be scared of folks, 'cause I'm with you. I got you," says the Lord.

9.text: Then God reached out, touched my mouth, and said, "Look—I just put My words in your mouth."

10.text: "Today, I'm putting you in position. You got authority over nations and kingdoms—To rip out and tear down, To destroy and demolish, To rebuild and replant."

11.text: Then God asked me, "Jeremiah, what you seein'?" I said, "I see a almond branch."

12.text: God said, "Good eye. You seein' right. I'm watchin' close to make sure My word come true."

13.text: God came back a second time: "What you see now?" I said, "I see a pot boilin' over, tilted from the north."

14.text: Then the Lord said: "Trouble comin' from the north—about to spill out over the whole land."

15.text: "I'm callin' all them northern kingdoms to roll up. They gon' set up right at Jerusalem's gates, pressin' against her walls and all Judah's cities."

16.text: "I'm about to lay down judgment for all the wrong they been doin'—turnin' they back on Me, burnin' incense to fake gods, and worshippin' what they hands built."

17.text: "So get up, get dressed, and speak every word I give you. Don't let fear shake you, or I'ma shake you up in front of them."

18.text: "Today I made you strong—like a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls. You standin' against kings, officials, priests, and all the people."

19.text: "They gon' come at you—but they won't win. I'm with you," says the Lord, "I'm the One deliverin' you."

1.text: Then God spoke to me again, sayin'—

2.text: "Go speak loud in Jerusalem so everybody hear: I remember you. How sweet you used to be, How you loved Me like we was engaged. You followed Me through that dry wilderness, Even when the land ain't have nothin'."

3.text: "Israel was holy to Me—My first pick. Anybody who messed with them? They brought trouble on they own heads."

4.text: Listen up, y'all—whole house of Jacob, all the fams in Israel:

5.text: God say: "What did I do wrong to your ancestors? Why'd they dip on Me? Started chasin' worthless idols, And turned into nothin' theyself."

6.text: "They ain't even ask, 'Where's the Lord?' The One who brought us outta Egypt, Led us through them deserts, Through all that dry land, danger, and death— Places nobody dared to live."

7.text: "I brought y'all into a land full of blessings, Fruitful and rich. But soon as y'all touched it, You trashed it. Defiled what I gave you."

8.text: "The priests ain't call out for Me. The law folks didn't even know Me. Leaders rebelled. Prophets out here speakin' on Baal's behalf, Chasin' nonsense that don't help nobody."

9.text: "So yeah—I got beef with y'all," says the Lord. "And I'ma keep bringin' this case against you—and your grandkids too."

10.text: "Look out past Cyprus. Peep Kedar in the desert. See if any other nation switched out their gods— Even if they fake!"

11.text: "But My people? They swapped out their glory for garbage."

12.text: "Even the heavens shook they head. Y'all got creation itself confused and scared."

13.text: "They did Me dirty two ways: 1. Walked away from Me—the source of livin' water. 2. Tried to dig they own wells—cracked ones that can't even hold no water."

14.text: "Is Israel just some house slave? Somebody born to be used? Why he always gettin' ran through?"

15.text: "Lions roared on him. Tore his land up. Burned his cities to the ground. Ain't nobody livin' there no more."

16.text: "Noph and Tahpanhes? Them Egyptians busted y'all crown—took y'all pride."

17.text: "And why? 'Cause you turned your back on Me When I was tryna guide you."

18.text: "Now you out here beggin' Egypt for help, Drankin' from their rivers. Or runnin' to Assyria tryna sip from theirs. Why you keep flirtin' with bondage?"

19.text: "Your own mess is catchin' up with you. Your wrong turns clappin' back. You gon' see—leavin' Me was a bad and bitter move. Ain't no fear of Me left in you," says the Lord God of Heaven's armies.

20.text: "I already freed you—broke your chains. You promised, 'I won't wild out again.' But next thing I know, You up under every shady tree, Actin' like you don't know Me. Bein' fast."

21.text: "I planted you like premium seed—top quality vine. How'd you turn into some wild, raggedy off-brand?"

22.text: "You could scrub all day with bleach and lye, But your sins still loud and clear to Me," says the Lord God.

23.text: "How you gon' say, 'I ain't did nothin'? 'I ain't chase no fake gods'? Look at your trail. You movin' reckless—like a wild camel runnin' loose."

24.text: "Like a donkey in heat, sniffin' the wind for attention. Ain't nobody gotta chase her—she out here findin' them."

25.text: "I tried to warn you— Told you to slow down, rest, protect yourself. But you said, 'Ain't no hope for me. I'm too deep in this—I love these foreign gods, And I ain't lettin' go.'"

26.text: "Just like a thief feel shame when they caught— That's how Israel feel now. Them, their kings, their officials, their priests, and their prophets too."

27.text: "They out here tellin' a tree, 'You my daddy,' And a stone, 'You gave me life.' Turned their backs on Me, But soon as trouble hits: 'God, come save us!'"

28.text: "Where them gods you made now? Tell them to pull up and save you. You got gods in every city—but none of 'em show up when it counts."

29.text: "Why you even arguing with Me? Y'all all been disobedient," says the Lord.

30.text: "I tried disciplining your kids—but they ain't listen. Y'all even killed the prophets I sent. Tore them up like wild lions."

31.text: "Y'all better recognize My word! Was I ever a dry place to y'all? Was I darkness and confusion? So why y'all actin' like y'all runnin' things, Sayin', 'We don't need You no more'?"

32.text: "Can a bride forget her wedding dress? Can a young woman forget her jewelry? But My people? They forgot Me for days on end—like I ain't never done nothin' for them."

33.text: "You even learned how to make your wild behavior look cute— Taught the worst of women how to do what you do."

34.text: "And I ain't even had to dig deep— Your clothes got innocent blood on them. You out here killin' the poor and actin' like it ain't happen."

35.text: "Still, you say, 'I'm innocent. God's anger ain't gon' last.' But I'm comin' for you— 'Cause you keep sayin', 'I ain't did nothin.'"

36.text: "Why you jumpin' from one scheme to the next? Tryna switch up your alliances? You gon' be just as ashamed of Egypt As you was when Assyria let you down."

37.text: "You gon' walk away from them lookin' defeated— Hands on your head, stressed. 'Cause the Lord already rejected them folks you trusted. They not gon' save you."

1.text: "They say if a man divorces his wife, And she run off, marry somebody else— Can he take her back? Ain't that land already messed up?" God say, "But you? You been out here with all kinds of lovers… And I'm still sayin', come back to Me."

2.text: "Look around—high places, empty roads— Where haven't you laid down? You was waitin' for them like a desert bandit, Pollutin' the land with your reckless ways."

3.text: "That's why the rain stopped. The sky been holdin' back. You walkin' around bold-faced like it ain't nothin', Ain't even tryna be ashamed."

4.text: "Ain't you gon' cry out to Me now? 'My Father, the One who raised me up right.'"

5.text: "You really think I'm just gon' stay mad forever? You talk real sweet, but your actions been off. You doin' dirt every chance you get."

6.text: Then God said to me while Josiah was king: "Did you see what Israel did? She ran up every mountain, Under every shady tree—wildin' out."

7.text: "I told her, 'Come back to Me.' She said no. And her sister Judah saw it all."

8.text: "I divorced Israel for all that spiritual cheatin', Gave her the papers. But Judah? She ain't even flinch. She went and acted just as bad."

9.text: "Judah made it casual—like it was no big deal. She even started messin' with trees and rocks like they was gods."

10.text: "And even with all that, Judah didn't come back with her heart. She just put on a show," says the Lord.

11.text: Then the Lord said: "Backslidin' Israel actin' more right Than fake-hearted Judah."

12.text: "So go north and tell 'em: Come home, Israel," says the Lord. "I ain't gon' stay mad. I'm merciful. I ain't built to stay angry."

13.text: "Just own up to it. Admit you crossed Me. You ran off after other gods And stopped listenin' to Me."

14.text: "Come back, My rebellious kids," says the Lord. "I'm still married to you. I'll take one from a city, two from a fam, And bring y'all back to Zion."

15.text: "I'ma give y'all real shepherds—leaders that got My heart. They gon' feed you knowledge and understanding."

16.text: "When y'all grow and flourish in the land again," says the Lord, "You won't even talk about the Ark of the Covenant no more. Ain't gon' think about it, miss it, or try to rebuild it."

17.text: "Back then, Jerusalem gon' be called 'The Lord's Throne.' Nations gon' pull up there, And folks ain't gon' follow their messed-up hearts no more."

18.text: "In those days, Judah and Israel gon' walk together again, Returnin' from the north, Back to the land I gave their ancestors."

19.text: "I been tryna treat y'all like My own kids, Give y'all a sweet inheritance— A beautiful land among the nations. I wanted you to call Me 'Father' And never turn away."

20.text: "But like a wife who sneaks out on her husband, That's how Israel did Me dirty," says the Lord.

21.text: There's a voice cryin' out in the hills— Weepin', beggin'. It's Israel's kids, Realizin' they went the wrong way And forgot their God.

22.text: "Come back, rebellious ones, And I'll heal all that backslidin'." Then they say: "We comin' to You— You really are the Lord our God."

23.text: "Them high hills and mountaintop altars? They ain't never saved nobody. Only in the Lord do we find salvation."

24.text: "Our shame ate up everything— Our parents' work, our animals, Even our sons and daughters."

25.text: "We layin' down in our shame, Covered in guilt. 'Cause we sinned against the Lord— Us and our people, From way back to right now. We just ain't listened to His voice."

1.text: "If you really gon' come back, Israel," says the Lord, "Then come back to Me. Cut out all that fake god worship— Put it away where I can't see it, Then you'll be solid."

2.text: "You gon' swear by My name and mean it this time— Sayin', 'The Lord lives,' With truth, with justice, with righteousness. Then even other nations gon' wanna be blessed through Me."

3.text: This what God tellin' the people of Judah and Jerusalem: "Break up that hard ground in your heart. Stop tryin' to plant seeds in thorny mess."

4.text: "Y'all need to circumcise your hearts. Yeah, I said hearts—not just bodies. Cut away that stubbornness, Before My anger blaze out like a wildfire— Unstoppable, All 'cause of your wicked ways."

5.text: Let Judah know. Blast it in Jerusalem: "Sound the trumpet! Tell everybody: Fall back! Head for the fortified cities!"

6.text: "Put the signal up toward Zion. Run for cover—don't wait around! I'm bringin' disaster from the north. It's gon' hit hard."

7.text: "That lion done left his cave. The nation destroyer is on the move. He comin' to wreck your land, Tear up your cities— Ain't gon' be nobody left in 'em."

8.text: "Y'all better throw on that sackcloth, Cry out loud. God's wrath ain't lettin' up."

9.text: "That day," says the Lord, "Even kings gon' lose heart, Leaders gon' be shook, Priests confused, And prophets stunned."

10.text: I said, "Lord God… You really let these folks believe they was safe, Like peace was on the way— But the sword done cut deep."

11.text: A dry, scorching wind gon' blow in From the desolate hills. It ain't no breeze for cleanin' or coolin' down—

12.text: This wind's too strong. It's a storm of judgment— God's own verdict blowin' through.

13.text: "The enemy ridin' in like storm clouds, Whippin' up whirlwinds with chariots. Their horses faster than eagles." We finished. We been robbed.

14.text: "Jerusalem—wash your heart clean! That's the only way to get saved. How long you gon' keep them evil thoughts Rentin' space in your mind?"

15.text: A voice shoutin' from Dan, Trouble comin' down from Ephraim.

16.text: "Tell the whole world— Judgment is comin' for Jerusalem. Enemies posted like guards, Surroundin' the city— 'Cause she went rogue against Me," says the Lord.

17.text: "They settin' up shop like watchmen in the fields, 'Cause y'all crossed Me."

18.text: "You brought this on yourself. Your own actions caused this pain. It's your mess— Bitter and deep, Right down to the heart."

19.text: Ohhh my soul! My chest hurt bad! My heart beatin' crazy— I can't keep quiet! I hear the trumpet. I hear the war cry.

20.text: It's back-to-back destruction! The whole land gettin' ripped apart. One minute I got tents, Next minute they snatched. My shelter—gone in a blink.

21.text: How long I gotta watch this warning flag wave? How long I gotta hear that trumpet?

22.text: "My people so foolish," God says. "They don't know Me. They actin' like little kids with no sense. They smart when it comes to doin' wrong— But good? They clueless."

23.text: I looked at the earth— It was empty, chaotic. The sky? Dark and blank.

24.text: I looked at the mountains— They was shakin'. Even the hills was doin' the Harlem shake.

25.text: I looked— Ain't nobody around. Even the birds flew off.

26.text: The land, once fruitful, was straight-up wilderness. Cities? Destroyed. God's anger was heavy.

27.text: "The land gon' be wrecked," says the Lord. "But I ain't wiping everything out."

28.text: "The whole earth gon' grieve. The sky gon' go dark— 'Cause I said what I said. This judgment? Locked in. I ain't takin' it back."

29.text: When the enemy comes with their horses and bows, Everybody gon' dip— Hide in bushes, climb rocks. Every city left empty. No soul in sight.

30.text: "So when you get stripped of everything, What you gon' do then? Dress yourself up in red, Wear gold, beat your face— But it's all a waste. Your lovers gon' turn on you. They out to kill you now."

31.text: I hear the cries of a woman in labor— Her first child, Her first pain. It's Zion's daughter, Cryin' with her hands stretched out, sayin': 'I'm done. I'm tired. Murderers all around me.'"

1.text: "Run up and down Jerusalem's streets. Look around. See if you can find one person—just one— Who stands on justice, who loves the truth. If you find one, I'll let the whole city slide."

2.text: "They say, 'As sure as the Lord lives,' But they lyin'. Ain't no truth in that."

3.text: Lord, ain't You watchin' for truth? You tried to check them— But they ain't even flinch. You burned off the nonsense— But they still act brand new. They got faces hard like stone, Refusin' to turn back.

4.text: So I said, "Maybe it's just the broke folks. They don't know no better. They ain't been taught God's way."

5.text: "Let me talk to the big dogs—leaders and wise folks. Surely they know better." But nah—they broke loose too. Snapped God's commands like twigs.

6.text: So now, lions from the woods gon' tear 'em up, Desert wolves gon' pounce, Leopards watchin' their streets. Step outside? You finished. All 'cause they done piled up sin on sin, Backslide after backslide.

7.text: "So tell Me—how I'm supposed to forgive this? Your kids turned they back on Me, Swearin' on fake gods. I fed 'em till they full— And they repaid Me by creepin' to the brothel."

8.text: "They actin' like wild stallions in heat, Neighin' after their neighbor's wife."

9.text: "You think I ain't gon' check 'em for this?" says the Lord. "You think I ain't gon' handle a whole nation actin' like this?"

10.text: "Go up to their city walls—tear some stuff down. But don't destroy it all. Trim the branches. Those folks don't even belong to Me no more."

11.text: "Both Israel and Judah been shady," says the Lord. "They two-timin' Me."

12.text: "They straight up lied on Me, sayin', 'God ain't really doin' all that. We ain't gon' see no trouble— No sword, no famine.'"

13.text: "Now the prophets? Just blowin' hot air. Ain't no Word in 'em. They just talkin'. They gon' get what they deserve."

14.text: So God said, "Since they said all that, I'ma make My words in your mouth like fire— And this people? Like wood. It's gon' burn them up."

15.text: "Listen, Israel: I'ma bring a nation from far off," says the Lord. "They strong. They old. They speak a language you don't understand."

16.text: "Their arrows like open graves— They soldiers don't miss."

17.text: "They gon' eat your harvest, your bread, What your kids supposed to eat. They takin' your animals, your vineyards, your fig trees. They gon' wreck the cities y'all trust in—with the sword."

18.text: "But even then," says the Lord, "I ain't gon' wipe y'all out completely."

19.text: "When y'all finally ask, 'Why God doin' this to us?' Tell 'em: 'Same way y'all left Him to serve other gods— Now y'all gon' serve foreigners in a land that ain't yours.'"

20.text: Announce this in Jacob's house, Preach it in Judah:

21.text: "Y'all foolish and clueless. Got eyes—but don't see. Got ears—but don't hear."

22.text: "Ain't you scared of Me?" says the Lord. "I'm the One who told the ocean, 'This far and no more.' Waves crash all they want— But they can't cross My boundary."

23.text: "But y'all? Y'all got rebellious hearts— Hardheaded and gone."

24.text: "Ain't nobody sayin', 'Let's fear God— He the One sendin' the rains, The One keepin' the seasons goin, Bringin' the harvest on time.'"

25.text: "Y'all sins blocked all that. That's why good things ain't reachin' you."

26.text: "My own people got snakes among 'em. Liars settin' traps, Catchin' folks like hunters catch birds."

27.text: "Their houses full of dirty deals— Like cages full of birds. That's how they got rich."

28.text: "They fat with greed, Outdo even the worst evildoers. They ain't fightin' for the orphans. They ain't helpin' the poor. But they still stay winnin'? Nah."

29.text: "You think I ain't gon' check that?" says the Lord. "You think I ain't gon' step in on a nation this foul?"

30.text: "Something wild and evil Happening in the land—"

31.text: "The prophets out here lyin'. The priests runnin' the show off vibes. And the people? They love it like that." "But what y'all gon' do when it all crashes down?"

1.text: Yo, children of Benjamin, y'all better dip—get outta Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet down in Tekoa, light that signal fire in Beth Haccerem. Trouble comin' from the north, and it's gon' be bad.

2.text: I pictured Zion like a beautiful, delicate woman—now look at her.

3.text: The shepherds gon' roll up with they flocks, settin' up tents all around her. Everybody takin' what's theirs.

4.text: They say, "Time to go to war. Let's hit her at noon." But then they panic—"The day's almost gone, shadows creepin'. We waited too long!"

5.text: "Nah, let's go at night then. We takin' her down, palaces and all."

6.text: The Lord of Heaven's Armies said: "Cut down some trees. Build up that siege ramp. This city 'bout to get it—it's full of straight-up evil.

7.text: Just like a fountain bubbles up with water, Jerusalem overflowin' with wickedness. Violence, robbery, cries and pain—they never stop.

8.text: Listen up, Jerusalem. Learn your lesson before I walk out on you. Don't make me turn this place into a ghost town."

9.text: The Lord said, "They gon' pick through what's left of Israel like harvesters lookin' for the last grapes—don't leave nothin'."

10.text: Who can I even talk to? Ain't nobody tryin' to hear Me. Their ears blocked, heart cold. My word's like trash to them—they don't want it.

11.text: I'm filled up with God's anger. I can't hold it in no more. Gotta pour it out on the kids, the grown folks, husbands and wives, old heads and young bucks—nobody safe.

12.text: Their houses, fields, and wives—gone. I'm stretchin' My hand against everybody in the land," says the Lord.

13.text: "From the broke to the bougie, they all greedy. Even the prophets and priests stay lyin'.

14.text: They act like they fixed the people's pain, sayin', 'It's all good, peace, peace!' But it ain't no peace!

15.text: Did they even feel bad when they did wrong? Nope. Couldn't even blush. That's why they gon' fall when judgment comes. I'm takin' 'em down," says the Lord.

16.text: The Lord said, "Stand at the crossroads, look around. Ask for the old paths, the good ones. Walk that road—you'll find rest for your soul." But they said, "We ain't walkin' that way."

17.text: I posted watchmen to warn y'all. Told you to listen for the trumpet. But they said, "Nah, we good."

18.text: So now the nations gon' hear this. Everybody, take notes—see what's goin' down.

19.text: Earth, listen up: I'm bringin' disaster on this crew, the consequences of their own thoughts. They ain't tryna hear My words, they threw out My law.

20.text: What good is incense from Sheba or imported sugar cane when your sacrifices don't mean nothin' to Me?

21.text: So yeah, I'm throwin' obstacles in front of 'em. Daddies and sons gon' trip. Neighbors, homies—everybody gon' fall."

22.text: The Lord says, "Here come the soldiers out the north—whole army risin' from way out.

23.text: They strapped with bows and spears. No mercy in 'em. They loud like a stormy sea, ridin' in deep on horses, ready for war against Zion's daughter."

24.text: We heard the news. Hands shakin'. Hearts racin'. Pain hittin' like labor contractions.

25.text: Don't even go outside. Don't walk nowhere. The enemy got swords everywhere. Fear's on every corner.

26.text: My people, mourn like you lost your only child. Put on that sackcloth. Roll in the ashes. The destroyer comin'—and it's gon' hit hard and fast.

27.text: God said, "I put you here to test these folks, to see what they really about."

28.text: But they hardheaded rebels. Always talkin' slick. Like dirty metal—bronze and iron—all of 'em corrupt.

29.text: The furnace burns hot. The lead's melted. But even with all that refining, the evil ones still won't come out right.

30.text: Folks gon' start callin' them 'rejected silver'—'cause the Lord ain't claimin' 'em no more.

1.text: This the word God gave Jeremiah:

2.text: "Stand at the church doors—right at the gate of the Lord's house— And shout this to everybody walkin' in to worship: 'Hear what the Lord say, y'all from Judah comin' up in here!'"

3.text: "The Lord of Heaven's Armies, Israel's God, says this: 'Fix how y'all livin' and how y'all treat people— And I'll let you stay in this land.'"

4.text: "Stop fallin' for them churchy lies like, 'The temple of the Lord! The temple of the Lord!' Just 'cause you here don't mean you safe."

5.text: "If you really switch up— Do right by folks, Handle justice between each other,

6.text: Stop oppressin' foreigners, orphans, and widows, Quit killin' the innocent, And stop chasin' after fake gods that do you dirty—

7.text: Then yeah, I'll let you stay in this land I gave your ancestors forever."

8.text: "But nah… Y'all trustin' in lies that won't help you."

9.text: "You stealin', killin', creepin' around, Swearin' false oaths, burnin' incense to Baal, And runnin' after gods you don't even know—"

10.text: "Then got the nerve to show up in My house talkin' about, 'We safe! We free!' So you can keep wildin'?"

11.text: "This house with My name on it? Y'all treatin' it like a hideout for thieves. But I see everything," says the Lord.

12.text: "Go look at Shiloh— That's where I used to put My name first. See what I did to it 'Cause of how Israel acted."
