13.text: "Same thing happenin' now. I warned y'all over and over— But y'all ain't listen. I called, and y'all hit 'Ignore.'"

14.text: "So I'ma treat this temple— The one you put all your hope in— Just like Shiloh. I'ma shut it down."

15.text: "And I'ma throw you outta My sight Just like I did your cousins from Ephraim."

16.text: "Don't even pray for these people, Jeremiah. Don't cry, don't beg. I ain't listenin'."

17.text: "You see what they doin'? Out in the streets of Judah and Jerusalem?"

18.text: "Kids gather wood, Daddies start the fire, Mamas bakin' cakes for the 'queen of heaven.' They pourin' out drinks for fake gods— Tryna get a rise outta Me."

19.text: "But really, they just hurtin' theyself. They bringin' shame to they own face."

20.text: "So now My wrath is spillin' out On people, animals, trees, even the crops. It's gon' burn hot— Ain't nobody puttin' it out."

21.text: "Y'all might as well throw your burnt offerings On top of your regular food— Eat all of it. It don't mean nothin' to Me."

22.text: "When I brought your people outta Egypt, I ain't ask for burnt offerings— I said obey Me."

23.text: "I told them: 'Listen to My voice. I'll be your God. You'll be My people. Walk in My ways, and life'll go well.'"

24.text: "But they ain't listen. They followed they own shady hearts, Walked backwards instead of forward."

25.text: "Since day one, I been sendin' My prophets— Early, consistent, every single day."

26.text: "But they ain't hear Me. They stiffened up, Actin' worse than the folks before them."

27.text: "So yeah, go ahead and speak these words— But they not gon' listen. Call 'em—they not pickin' up."

28.text: "Say this: 'This nation don't listen to God. They don't accept correction. Truth packed up and left they mouth.'"

29.text: "Shave your head in mourning, Toss it away, Cry on the hills— The Lord done walked away from this generation."

30.text: "Judah's kids done evil right in My face," says the Lord. "They brought trash into My house And defiled it."

31.text: "They built altars at Tophet In the Valley of Hinnom— Burnin' their own kids alive. I never told them to do that. Never even crossed My mind."

32.text: "So now—soon—it won't be called Tophet no more, Or the Valley of Hinnom… It'll be known as the Valley of Slaughter."

33.text: "Dead bodies gon' be food for vultures and wild animals— And nobody gon' be around to chase them off."

34.text: "I'm shuttin' down all joy— Ain't gon' be no weddings, No parties, No laughter in Judah or Jerusalem. Just silence. Desolation."

1.text: "Around that time," says the Lord, "They gon' dig up the bones— Kings, princes, priests, prophets, regular folks— Everybody who lived in Jerusalem."

2.text: "And they gon' lay them bones out Under the sun, the moon, and the stars— All them things they used to love, serve, follow, chase, and worship. Ain't nobody gon' gather 'em up or bury 'em. They gon' be left out like trash."

3.text: "And the folks that's left— They gon' wish they was dead. 'Cause the pain gon' be so deep, They'd rather die than live," says the Lord of Heaven's Armies.

4.text: "Jeremiah, tell the people: 'If somebody fall, don't they get back up? If they turn off the road, don't they find their way back?'"

5.text: "But this crew? They stay fallin'. Jerusalem stuck in reverse— Holdin' on to lies, Refusin' to come back to Me."

6.text: "I been listenin'— Ain't nobody sayin' the right stuff. Ain't nobody askin', 'Dang... what have I done?' Everybody movin' fast— Like horses rushin' headfirst into battle."

7.text: "Even birds—storks, doves, swallows— They know when to migrate. But My people? They don't even know when judgment is knockin'."

8.text: "Y'all out here sayin', 'We wise. We got God's law.' But your scribes be writin' lies in the margins. They out here twistin' the truth."

9.text: "The so-called wise lookin' real dumb now. They ashamed, confused, caught slippin'. They rejected God's word— So how they gon' claim wisdom?"

10.text: "I'ma give they wives to strangers, And they land to somebody else. Everybody, high and low, Got greedy and dirty. Prophets and priests? All crooked."

11.text: "They out here puttin' a Band-Aid on bullet wounds, Sayin', 'Peace, peace,' When ain't no peace."

12.text: "And the worst part? They ain't even embarrassed. No shame. No blush. So when I bring judgment, They gon' fall like everybody else," says the Lord.

13.text: "I'm cleanin' house," says the Lord. "No grapes on the vine, No figs on the tree, Even the leaves gon' wither. Everything I gave 'em? Gone."

14.text: "Why we just sittin' around? Let's go hide in the strong cities. Let's be quiet and accept it— The Lord already shut us down. He gave us bitter water 'cause we sinned."

15.text: "We was lookin' for peace... But trouble pulled up instead. We hoped for healing— But it was all bad."

16.text: "We hear the enemy horses all the way from Dan. The whole land shook from their neighing. They came through and ate up the land, The cities, the people—everything."

17.text: "I'm sendin' snakes among y'all," says the Lord. "Vipers you can't charm. They gon' strike—and keep striking."

18.text: I tried to comfort myself... But I'm tired. Heart heavy.

19.text: Listen... That cry way off in the distance— That's My people. They say, "Isn't the Lord still in Zion? Ain't He still our King?" God answers: "Then why y'all keep makin' Me mad With these carved idols and knockoff gods?"

20.text: "The harvest passed. Summer's done. And we still not saved."

21.text: I'm tore up over what's happenin' to My people. Hurt deep. Grievin'. Straight up shocked.

22.text: "Ain't there no balm in Gilead? No doctors there? So why ain't My people healin'? Why they still out here broken?"

1.text: Man… if my head was full of water And my eyes flowed like a fountain, I'd be cryin' day and night For all the lives lost in My people's mess.

2.text: I wish I had a little cabin in the wilderness, Somewhere far from everybody— So I could leave these folks behind. They all cheatin', Snakes in the grass.

3.text: "They tongues like weapons— Lyin' is their favorite sport. Ain't no truth in the streets. They go from one foul act to the next, Actin' like they don't even know Me," says the Lord.

4.text: "Don't trust nobody. Your brother'll snake you, Your neighbor stay gossipin'."

5.text: "Everybody out here lyin' to each other. They trained they mouths to lie, Put in work just to do wrong."

6.text: "Your whole neighborhood built on lies. And with all this deceit, They still won't recognize Me," says the Lord.

7.text: So the Lord of Heaven's Armies says: "I'ma test 'em, Refine 'em like metal. 'Cause how else I'm supposed to deal with this?"

8.text: "They mouth speak peace, But they really plottin'. Their words sharp—like arrows."

9.text: "You think I ain't gon' handle this?" says the Lord. "You think I'm lettin' this slide?"

10.text: I'ma cry loud for the mountains, Mourn for the fields and forests. Ain't nobody left— Even the animals and birds done dipped.

11.text: "I'ma make Jerusalem a pile of rubble, A jackal's hangout. Judah's cities? Empty. No people."

12.text: Who wise enough to understand why? Why the land look scorched like this?

13.text: God says: "'Cause they walked away from My law. They ain't listen. They did whatever they felt like, Chasin' after fake gods they daddy's introduced."

14.text: "So I'ma give 'em bitter food, Nasty water to drink."

15.text: "I'ma scatter 'em all over the place— Among people they ain't never met. And I'ma send a sword behind 'em Till they done."

16.text: The Lord says: "Go call the mourning women. Get the ones who know how to cry right."

17.text: "Tell them: hurry up. Come cry for us. Let tears flood our faces."

18.text: The voice of sorrow ringin' from Zion: 'We been robbed! We ashamed! Kicked out our homes, Torn from the land!'"

19.text: "Listen, women: Hear God's word. Teach your daughters how to cry, Show your homegirls how to mourn."

20.text: "Death slid in through the window, Steppin' right into the palace. It took the kids—ain't no more playin' outside. Snatched the young men right off the block."

21.text: God says: "Bodies gon' be everywhere— Layin' out in the fields Like leftovers from harvest. Ain't nobody even pickin' 'em up."

22.text: This what the Lord say: "Don't brag on your smarts. Don't flex your muscles. Don't show off your riches."

23.text: "If you gon' brag, brag on this: That you know Me. That you understand I'm the Lord— Full of love, justice, and righteousness. That's the kind of stuff I vibe with," says the Lord.

24.text: "The days comin'," says the Lord, "Where I'ma deal with everybody— Circumcised or not. Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon, Moab— Even the folks out in the cut, Way out in the wilderness."

25.text: "All of 'em uncircumcised. And Israel? Yeah, y'all might be cut in the body— But y'all hearts still wild and unclean."

26.text: Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon, Moab—even them folks way out in the cut, livin' in the wild—all of 'em uncircumcised. But don't get it twisted, Israel too. Y'all got the mark on your body but not in your heart. Y'all hearts ain't been changed. God ain't impressed with outside religion when the inside still dirty.

1.text: Listen up, Israel— This the word the Lord speakin' straight to y'all:

2.text: "Don't follow the ways of them other nations. Don't be spooked by stars or signs in the sky— That's what got the Gentiles shook."

3.text: "All they customs? Straight up nonsense. They cut trees out the forest, Craft 'em with axes like it's art."

4.text: "Then they dress it up in silver and gold, Nail it down so it don't fall over. It's givin' pretty… but powerless."

5.text: "They stand tall like palm trees, But can't say a word. You gotta carry them 'cause they can't move theyself. Don't fear 'em— They can't hurt you. And they sure can't help you neither."

6.text: Ain't nobody like You, Lord. You mighty. Your name carry weight.

7.text: Who wouldn't respect You, King of the nations? That's what You deserve. Outta all the so-called wise folks and kingdoms— Ain't none compare to You.

8.text: These other nations? A bunch of fools— Fallin' for wooden statues And empty teachings.

9.text: They rockin' silver from Tarshish, Gold from Uphaz, All crafted by folks with tools. They got blue and purple robes on— But it's all just dress-up. Work of human hands.

10.text: But the Lord? He the real One. The living God. The forever King. When He gets angry, The whole earth trembles. Ain't no nation standin' up under that heat.

11.text: Tell 'em: "Any so-called god that ain't make heaven and earth? They gettin' wiped out— Gone from under the skies."

12.text: God made the earth with raw power. Set the world in place with wisdom. Stretched out the skies like a boss.

13.text: When He speaks, rainclouds show up. Water piles up in the sky. He makes lightning flash, And sends the wind out from His stash."

14.text: Everybody out here clueless— Craftsmen embarrassed by their fake gods. Them statues? Lies. Ain't no breath in 'em.

15.text: Worthless. Mistakes. And when judgment comes? They gon' be gone.

16.text: But Jacob's portion? He ain't like them. He made everything. And Israel is His. His name? The Lord of Heaven's Armies.

17.text: Pack your stuff, y'all livin' behind the walls— Time to go.

18.text: The Lord says: "I'm 'bout to toss the people out the land. I'ma shake things up So they feel what I'm sayin'."

19.text: "I'm hurt bad," says the people. "This pain deep… But I'ma carry it."

20.text: "My home got wrecked. My kids gone. Ain't nobody left to help set up the tent again."

21.text: "The leaders? Clueless. They ain't even checkin' for the Lord. So yeah—they failing, And all the people under 'em gettin' scattered."

22.text: You hear that rumblin'? News comin' from the north— Judah's cities 'bout to be left empty. Just jackals and silence.

23.text: Lord, I know this much: Humans don't run the show. We ain't built to guide ourselves right.

24.text: So correct me, Lord— But do it with care and justice. Not in full wrath— Or I'm done for.

25.text: Unleash that fury on the ones who don't know You, The ones who don't call on Your name. They ate up Jacob, Devoured us, Left our home in ruins.

1.text: This the word God gave to Jeremiah:

2.text: "Tell Judah and everybody in Jerusalem: Listen up—this covenant matter."

3.text: "This what the Lord God of Israel say: 'Cursed is anybody who don't follow the terms of this agreement—'"

4.text: "'The same one I gave y'all ancestors Back when I brought 'em outta Egypt, out that iron furnace. I said: Obey Me. Do what I say. Be My people, and I'll be your God.'"

5.text: "'That's how I'd keep My promise— To give y'all a land flowin' with milk and honey, Just like I told your forefathers.'" And I said, "Amen, Lord. Say less."

6.text: Then the Lord told me, "Preach this all through Judah, Out loud in the streets of Jerusalem: 'Y'all need to actually do what the covenant says.'"

7.text: "'From day one—when I brought y'all outta Egypt— I been tellin' y'all, day in and day out: Obey Me!'"

8.text: "'But nah… they ain't wanna hear it. Everybody kept followin' they own wicked ways. So now they gotta deal with the consequences Of a covenant they never took seriously.'"

9.text: Then the Lord said, "There's a whole conspiracy brewin' in Judah and Jerusalem."

10.text: "They slid back into the same foolishness Their ancestors was on— Ignoring Me. Chasin' after other gods. Both Israel and Judah done broke the deal I made with their people."

11.text: "So here's what I'm bringin': Trouble they can't run from. And when they finally call on Me? I ain't pickin' up."

12.text: "They gon' run to them fake gods they been burnin' incense to— But guess what? Them gods ain't savin' nobody when the heat hits."

13.text: "Y'all got as many fake gods as you got cities. Altars to Baal on every block in Jerusalem."

14.text: "So Jeremiah, don't even pray for 'em. Don't cry. Don't plead. I'm not listenin' when they finally start beggin'."

15.text: "Why My people tryna pull up to My house Actin' holy, when they out here wildin'? They celebratin' evil like it's cute. That 'holy flesh' they brought? It don't mean nothin' now."

16.text: "I used to call you My green olive tree— Healthy, beautiful, full of good fruit. But now I'ma set fire to it. The branches gettin' chopped off."

17.text: "The same Lord who planted you Just pronounced judgment— 'Cause both Israel and Judah got Me heated Burnin' incense to Baal and bringin' destruction on theyselves."

18.text: Then the Lord let me in on somethin'. I saw what was goin' down— 'Cause He showed me the whole plot.

19.text: I was movin' like a lamb headin' to slaughter— Didn't even know folks was plottin' on me. They was sayin': "Cut him down like a tree. End his life. Erase his name from the earth."

20.text: But You, Lord of Heaven's Armies, You judge fair. You see hearts and motives. So I'm askin'—let me see You handle 'em. I'm bringin' this case to You.

21.text: And this what the Lord said about them folks in Anathoth That was tryin' to kill me— Talkin' 'bout, "Stop prophesyin' in the Lord's name Or we gon' take you out."

22.text: The Lord said: "Bet. I got somethin' for 'em. The young men? Killed by the sword. Their kids? Gon' starve."

23.text: "Ain't gon' be no leftovers. I'ma bring judgment down heavy On the whole city of Anathoth. Their time is up."

1.text: Lord, You always right when I bring my case to You— But I gotta ask somethin' real… Why the wicked out here winnin'? Why fake folks stay smilin' and comfy?

2.text: You the One who let 'em grow— They got roots now. They out here bearin' fruit. Talkin' like they close to You, But they don't think about You at all.

3.text: But You know me, Lord. You done seen my heart. You tested me. So go head—snatch 'em out like sheep for slaughter. Line 'em up for what's comin'.

4.text: How long the land gotta grieve? Why all the plants dryin' up? The animals and birds gone too— All 'cause these people out here wildin'. They really think You not gon' catch up to 'em?

5.text: God replied: "If you tired runnin' with folks on foot, How you gon' keep up when horses start runnin'? If you stressed in a calm land, What you gon' do when the flood hits near the Jordan?"

6.text: "Even your own family got smoke for you. They smilin' in your face, But don't trust 'em— They callin' folks to come for you behind your back."

7.text: "I had to let go of My house. I stepped away from My people. The one I loved? I handed her over to her enemies."

8.text: "She supposed to be Mine, But now she roarin' at Me like a wild lion. So yeah… I can't even claim her no more."

9.text: "My people turned into some spotted vulture, Gettin' circled by other birds. Go ahead—bring all the wild animals. Let 'em feast."

10.text: "So many rulers stomped through My vineyard, Treated it like trash. They wrecked My garden, Turned it into wilderness."

11.text: "Now the land cryin' out to Me. Everything desolate. And ain't nobody even care."

12.text: "Raiders showin' up on every hilltop. And the sword of the Lord Gon' sweep from one side of the land to the other. Ain't nobody gon' know peace."

13.text: "They plantin' wheat but harvestin' thorns. All that grindin'—no payoff. Shame gon' cover they harvest, 'Cause My wrath ain't lettin' up."

14.text: The Lord says: "All them shady neighbors who try touch what I gave My people? I'ma yank 'em out they own land— And I'ma pull Judah up outta their mix too."

15.text: "But after I pluck 'em out, I'ma show 'em some grace. Bring 'em back to their own spot, Each one to their own hood."

16.text: "And if they learn how My people move— If they say 'As the Lord lives' like they used to say 'Baal lives,' I'll let 'em live among My people."

17.text: "But if they don't listen? I'ma tear that nation up from the roots. Gone. For good," says the Lord.

1.text: The Lord told me, "Go grab you a linen belt. Wrap it around your waist— But don't let it touch no water."

2.text: So I did what He said, Got the belt and wore it.

3.text: Later on, God spoke again:

4.text: "Take that belt you rockin', Head over to the Euphrates River, And hide it in a crack in the rocks."

5.text: So I packed up and hid it there—just like He told me.

6.text: After a while, God said, "Now go back to the Euphrates And dig up that belt I told you to stash."

7.text: I did, and sure enough— The belt was ruined. Tore up. Worthless.

8.text: Then God hit me with this:

9.text: "This how I'ma ruin the pride of Judah— And the pride Jerusalem swear they got."

10.text: "These people hardheaded. They won't listen. They out here followin' whatever their hearts say, Worshippin' fake gods. So now they just like that belt— Useless."

11.text: "I wanted 'em to stay close to Me— Like a belt clings to your waist. They was supposed to be My people, My name, My glory out loud. But they ain't wanna hear Me."

12.text: God said, "Tell 'em this: 'Every bottle gon' get filled with wine.'" And they gon' say, "Duh. Of course every bottle get filled with wine."

13.text: But hit 'em back with this: "The Lord says: I'm fillin' all y'all—kings, priests, prophets, regular folks— With drunken confusion."

14.text: "Y'all gon' crash into each other— Fathers and sons both. No mercy. No pity. No holdin' back. I'ma wreck y'all."

15.text: Listen up! Don't let your pride talk over God. He already said what He said.

16.text: Give God His glory before things go dark. Before your feet trip up in the night, And what you thought was light Turns into death's shadow.

17.text: But if you still ain't listenin'? Then I'ma cry behind closed doors for y'all. Big tears. Heavy sorrow. 'Cause the Lord's people gettin' snatched up.

18.text: Tell the king and his mama: "Y'all better sit down and humble yourselves. That crown? It comin' off."

19.text: The southern cities? Locked up tight. Ain't nobody openin' nothin'. Judah's gettin' taken, Every last one of 'em.

20.text: Look up north— See who comin' for you. Where the people you was supposed to protect at? Your fine flock?

21.text: What you gon' say When God flip the script on you? You trained them enemies to lead you— Now they doin' just that.

22.text: If you sittin' there wonderin', "Why this happenin' to me?" It's 'cause your sin too loud. God exposin' you—skirt lifted, feet bare.

23.text: Can a Black person switch they skin? Can a leopard drop its spots? Then what makes you think You can do right when all you know is wrong?

24.text: That's why I'ma blow y'all away like desert dust.

25.text: This your portion from Me, 'Cause you forgot Me And put your trust in lies.

26.text: I'ma pull your skirt over your face So everybody see your shame.

27.text: I seen what you been up to— The cheating, the lust, The wild behavior on every hill. It's nasty. Woe to you, Jerusalem. What's it gon' take For you to get right?

1.text: This the word God gave Jeremiah about the drought.

2.text: Judah cryin'. The city gates saggin'. Folks mournin' for the land— Jerusalem's cries echoin' through the air.

3.text: The rich sent they servants to fetch water. They got to the wells—bone dry. Came back with empty jars, Head hangin', faces full of shame.

4.text: The ground was cracked and dry— Ain't no rain fell in a minute. Even the farmers was embarrassed, Pullin' they cloaks over they heads.

5.text: Out in the fields, even the deer gave birth, Then dipped—'cause no grass was growin'.

6.text: Wild donkeys stood on the hills, Sniffin' the air like stray dogs. Eyes dim from hunger. Ain't no grass nowhere.

7.text: Lord, we know our sins speak loud… But for Your name's sake—please move! Yeah, we messed up a lot, But we still Yours.

8.text: You the Hope of Israel— Our help when trouble hit. Why You movin' like You don't even stay here? Like You just passin' through?

9.text: Why You lookin' shocked, like You can't save? But Lord, You with us. We reppin' Your name. Don't leave us hangin'.

10.text: But God said: "They stay wanderin' off—feet just doin whatever. I ain't acceptin' that. I'm done overlookin'. They 'bout to feel this judgment."

11.text: Then the Lord told me, "Don't pray for them no more. Not for they good."

12.text: "When they fast—I ain't listenin'. When they bring offerings—I ain't acceptin' that. What's comin'? Sword. Famine. Disease."

13.text: Then I said, "But Lord, The prophets out here tellin' folks, 'Ain't gon' be no sword. Ain't gon' be no famine. Peace comin' for sure.'"

14.text: God clapped back: "They lyin' on My name. I ain't send 'em. Ain't tell 'em nothin'. They makin' up visions, Fake prophecies, lies from they own hearts."

15.text: "So here's what's gon' happen to them prophets talkin' 'No sword, no famine': They gon' die by sword and famine. Period."

16.text: "And the folks that listened? Left out in the streets. No funerals. No burials. Wives, sons, daughters—all of 'em. Their sins caught up to 'em."

17.text: God told me, "Say this to the people: 'My tears fall nonstop, day and night. My people been hit hard— Like a young daughter with a fatal blow.'"

18.text: "I walk outside—bodies in the field. I step in the city—folks dyin' from hunger. Prophets and priests wanderin' lost, Don't even recognize the land no more."

19.text: Lord… have You really given up on Judah? You done with Zion? Why You hit us like this and ain't no healing? We hoped for peace… But pain came instead.

20.text: We own up to it, Lord— Our sins. Our parents' sins. We wrong. We admit it.

21.text: Don't reject us, Lord—do it for Your name. Don't throw Your throne in the dirt. Remember Your covenant. Don't break it.

22.text: Can idols make it rain? Can the skies rain on command? Nah—it's only You, Lord. That's why we waitin' on You… You the one who controls it all.

1.text: Then the Lord told me straight up: "Even if Moses and Samuel was standin' here beggin', I still wouldn't change My mind about this crew. Tell 'em: 'Y'all gotta go.' Get out My face."

2.text: And if they ask, "Where we supposed to go?" Say this: "The Lord said: Some gon' die—so they gon' die. Some gon' get sliced up—so the sword for them. Some gon' starve—famine waitin'. Some gettin' locked up—captivity for them."

3.text: "I'm sendin' four ways to break 'em," says the Lord: "Swords to kill, Dogs to drag, Birds to peck, Beasts to feast."

4.text: "I'ma let 'em be embarrassed all across the nations. And it's all 'cause of what Manasseh—Hezekiah's son—did in Jerusalem."

5.text: "Ain't nobody gon' care about you, Jerusalem. Nobody feelin' bad. Ain't even gon' ask how you doin'."

6.text: "You left Me. You turned back. So now I'ma stretch out My hand and tear it all down. I'm tired of holdin' back."

7.text: "I'ma scatter y'all like wheat in the wind— Right at the city gates. I'ma take y'all children. I'ma wreck what's Mine, Since y'all don't wanna come back."

8.text: "Too many widows to count—like sand by the sea. Mamas losin' sons in broad daylight. Pain gon' drop outta nowhere—fear too."

9.text: "That woman who had seven sons? She gon' be crushed. Her light gon' go out in the middle of the day. She gon' be ashamed. What's left of her boys? I'm handin' them over to the sword."

10.text: Jeremiah said: "Man, why I even born, Mama? I stay beefin' with everybody. I ain't owe nobody money. Ain't nobody owe me. But folks curse me anyway."

11.text: The Lord replied: "Don't worry—I got a remnant gon' ride with you. Even your enemies gon' come beggin' for you When the pressure hit."

12.text: "Can anybody break iron from the north? Iron that's mixed with bronze? Nah."

13.text: "I'm givin' your riches and treasures away— No price tag, no mercy. All 'cause y'all been sinnin' everywhere you go."

14.text: "I'ma make you cross into a foreign land with your enemies. I lit a fire in My anger— And it ain't goin' out."

15.text: Jeremiah said: "Lord, You know me. Don't forget about me. Please come see about me. Get back at the folks who tryna take me out. You know I took this heat for You."

16.text: "I found Your word—ate it up. It gave me joy. It filled my heart. You put Your name on me, Lord of Heaven's Armies."

17.text: "I ain't sit with clowns or jokers. Didn't laugh, didn't join the foolishness. I stayed solo 'cause Your hand was heavy on me. You put fire in my bones."

18.text: "But why this pain still hangin' on? Why this wound won't heal? Lord, are You gon' be like a stream that dries up on me? A river that ghosted me?"

19.text: Then the Lord said: "If you come back right, I'll bring you back in. You'll stand before Me again. If you learn to separate what's good from all that mess, You'll speak for Me again."

20.text: "I'ma make you like a bronze wall to these folks. They gon' try you— But they can't beat you. 'Cause I'm with you to save and rescue you," says the Lord.

21.text: "I'ma pull you outta wicked hands. I'ma snatch you from the grip of the ruthless."

1.text: God came to me with another word.

2.text: He said, "Don't get married, Jeremiah. Don't have no kids in this place."

3.text: "Why? 'Cause them kids born here, And their mamas and daddies too— They all gon' die messed up deaths."

4.text: "Ain't nobody gon' cry for 'em or bury 'em. They gon' be laid out in the street like trash. Birds and wild animals gon' eat their bodies. Famine and war takin' 'em out."

5.text: "And don't go to no funerals. Don't mourn or show sympathy. I took My peace away from these folks," says the Lord. "No more love. No more mercy."

6.text: "From the big shots to the nobodies, They all gon' die. No burials, no eulogies. Ain't nobody cuttin' theyself or shavin' they head in grief."

7.text: "No one breakin' bread for mournin', No 'I'm sorry for your loss' meals, No comfort drinks for nobody's mama or daddy."

8.text: "Don't even pull up at no parties, either. Don't eat. Don't toast with 'em."

9.text: "I'ma make the joy stop," says the Lord. "No more laughs, No more weddings, No more turn-ups. You gon' see it happen with your own eyes."

10.text: "When you tell them all this, They gon' ask: 'Why God trippin' like this? What we even do?'"

11.text: "Tell 'em: 'Y'all daddies left Me for fake gods— Served 'em, bowed to 'em, forgot all about Me. Didn't keep My Word.'"

12.text: "But y'all? Y'all worse than they was. Everybody doin' whatever their wicked heart tell 'em. Ain't nobody listenin' to Me."

13.text: "So now I'ma throw y'all out this land— Into some foreign place y'all never known. And over there, you gon' serve them fake gods 24/7. And I ain't showin' no favor."

14.text: "But one day soon," says the Lord, "People ain't gon' say, 'God brought Israel outta Egypt' no more."

15.text: "They gon' say, 'God brought Israel outta the North— Outta all the places He scattered them.' And I'ma bring y'all back home To the land I gave your ancestors."

16.text: "I'm sendin' out fishers first— They gon' hook y'all one by one. Then I'ma send hunters— They gon' track y'all down from every cave, hill, and hole."

17.text: "Ain't nothin' you do hidden from Me. I see all your mess. And yeah, I'm watchin'."

18.text: "First, I'ma pay y'all double for the dirt y'all done. Y'all polluted My land with y'all idol worship And all them disgusting sacrifices."

19.text: Then I said: "Lord, You my strength, my safe spot, my cover when it's hard. Nations gon' come from all over sayin': 'Our ancestors lied to us— Gave us nothin' but fake gods and nonsense.'"

20.text: "Can folks even make real gods for theyself? Nah—those ain't even gods!"

21.text: "So I'ma show 'em— For real this time— Who I am and how I move. They gon' know My name is the Lord."

1.text: Judah's sin? Man, it's carved in deep— Like somebody scratched it in stone with a diamond tip. It's written on they hearts and even on the altars they worship at.

2.text: Even they kids remember the wild worship parties With them fake gods under the trees on the hills.

3.text: "I'ma take everything from y'all— Your riches, your treasures, Even the so-called 'sacred' spots you turned sinful."

4.text: "You gon' lose the land I gave you. You gon' serve your enemies In a land you don't even know. You lit a fire in Me, And that anger ain't goin' nowhere."

5.text: The Lord says: "Cursed is the one who puts all their trust in other people, Who lean on human strength, And forget 'bout Me."

6.text: "They gon' be like dry bushes in the desert— Ain't gon' see no blessings, Just stuck in a salty, lonely place Where life don't grow."

7.text: "But the one who trusts Me? They blessed for real."

8.text: "They like a tree right by the river— Roots deep, leaves green, No stress when the heat hit, Still bearin' fruit in drought season."

9.text: "The heart?" It's shady. Trickier than anything out here. It's sick. Who really understands it?"

10.text: "But I do," says the Lord. "I check hearts. I test minds. And I pay folks back Based on what they really out here doin'."

11.text: "Gettin' rich the wrong way? That's like sittin' on eggs that never hatch. All that fake flexin' gon' fade, And you gon' look like a fool in the end."

12.text: God's throne been sittin' high since day one— That's our true place of worship.

13.text: Lord, You the only hope Israel got. Whoever walks away from You? Shame gon' follow. They names gon' be dust 'Cause they turned from the fountain of living water.

14.text: "Heal me, Lord—and I'll be healed. Save me—and I'll be saved. You the only one I praise."

15.text: Folks keep jokin': "Where that word from God at? Let's see it then."

16.text: "But Lord, You know I stayed faithful. I ain't run from my calling, I ain't ask for doom— I just said what You gave me."

17.text: "Please don't be scary to me, God. You my only safety net when the world's fallin' apart."

18.text: "Let them haters fall, not me. Let them be shook, Not me. Let Your judgment hit them hard— Double it if You got to!"

19.text: Then the Lord told me, "Go stand at the main gate where the kings roll in and out, And tell everybody this word—Judah, Jerusalem, all of 'em."

20.text: "Listen up, y'all!"

21.text: "God say: 'Don't carry no load or do no work on the Sabbath. Don't bring your hustle through these gates on that day.'"

22.text: "Keep the Sabbath holy, Just like I told your ancestors."

23.text: "But they ain't listen. They got hard-headed, Blocked their ears, Wouldn't take no correction."

24.text: "If y'all take Me serious And stop the work on Sabbath, Respectin' it like you supposed to—"

25.text: "Then kings gon' keep ridin' through these gates, Sittin' on David's throne, Bringing praises, And this city? It'll stand forever."

26.text: "Folks from all over—Judah, Jerusalem, Benjamin, the hills and valleys— Gon' bring offerings and worship Me right."

27.text: "But if y'all keep treatin' the Sabbath like it don't matter— Still carryin' loads and breakin' rules— Then I'ma set these gates on fire. Jerusalem's palaces gon' burn, And nobody gon' put that fire out."

1.text: This what the Lord told Jeremiah:

2.text: "Get up, go down to the potter's shop. I got somethin' to show you."

3.text: So I pulled up to the spot— Dude was workin' the wheel, shapin' clay.

4.text: The jar he was makin' got messed up in his hands, So he reshaped it into somethin' else, Whatever he thought looked right.

5.text: Then God spoke to me:

6.text: "Y'all see this? Israel, can't I do the same with y'all as this potter? You the clay—I'm the one holdin' you."

7.text: "If I say I'm 'bout to tear down a nation—

8.text: But they flip the script and turn from evil? Then cool—I'ma back off the punishment."

9.text: "Same way, if I say I'm 'bout to build somethin' up—

10.text: But they start actin' shady? Then nah, they ain't gettin' that blessing no more."

11.text: "So go tell the folks in Judah and Jerusalem: 'I'm plottin' judgment, and it's comin' fast. So switch up your ways. Start doin' right—right now.'"

12.text: But they said, "Ain't no point. We gon' do what we wanna do anyway. We gon' follow our hearts—even if they wicked."

13.text: So God clapped back: "Ask the nations— Who ever heard of somethin' this wild? Israel actin' like they ain't got no home training."

14.text: "Who leaves fresh snow water from Lebanon? Who trades in cold, clean streams For dirty, foreign runoff?"

15.text: "That's what My people did. They forgot Me. Started burnin' incense to trash idols. They left the real path And got lost in back alleys."

16.text: "Now they land gon' be empty and cursed— So bad folks gon' just shake they heads when they pass by."

17.text: "I'ma scatter them like dry leaves in the wind. When trouble hits, They gon' see My back, not My face."

18.text: Then the haters said, "Let's shut Jeremiah up. We still got priests, we still got wisdom, We still got other prophets. Let's come at him with slick talk And ignore whatever he sayin'."

19.text: I said, "Lord, You hear this, right? They tryna take me out."

20.text: "I was speakin' up for them— Beggin' You not to wild out. And this how they repay me? By diggin' a grave with my name on it?"

21.text: "So let the consequences fall, Lord. Let they kids go hungry, Let the soldiers hit 'em hard, Take they men, take they peace."

22.text: "Let the war cries hit they homes Like a surprise attack— 'Cause they straight up plotted on me."

23.text: "You see it, Lord. You know they schemes. Don't forgive 'em. Don't wipe it clean. Let judgment hit 'em hard— And don't hold back."

1.text: God told Jeremiah, "Go buy a clay jar from the potter, And take some OGs—elders from the people and the priests—with you."

2.text: "Take 'em to the Valley of Hinnom, Right by the Potsherd Gate, And speak what I'm 'bout to tell you."

3.text: "Say this to Judah's kings and folks in Jerusalem: 'Listen up! This what the Lord of Heaven's Armies say— I'm about to drop judgment so heavy, It'll make folks ears ring when they hear it.'"

4.text: "'Why? 'Cause y'all turned your back on Me. Made this land foreign—burnin' incense to fake gods Y'all don't even know. And worse, y'all spilled innocent blood out here.'"

5.text: "'Built altars to Baal, Burned y'all own kids in fire like it was an offering! I ain't never told y'all to do that mess. Didn't even cross My mind.'"

6.text: "'So now, days comin' where this place Ain't gon' be called Tophet or the Valley of Hinnom no more. It's gon' be called the Valley of Slaughter.'"

7.text: "'Right here, I'ma shut down all Judah's plans. They gon' fall by the sword, And the folks chasin' 'em down Gon' leave their bodies for the birds and wild animals.'"

8.text: "'This city gon' be so wrecked, People gon' walk by like "What happened here?" It'll be nothin' but ruins and sickness.'"

9.text: "'It'll get so bad, they gon' eat their own kids Just tryin' to survive the siege. Neighbors eatin' neighbors. That's how deep the desperation gon' go.'"

10.text: Then God said, "Jeremiah, break that flask Right in front of the elders."

11.text: "Tell 'em: 'This what God say— Just like this jar broke, That's how I'm gon' break this people and this city. Ain't no gluin' it back together. They gon' bury folks in Tophet Till there ain't no space left.'"

12.text: "'I'ma make this city just like Tophet. Disrespected. Desecrated. Destroyed.'"

13.text: "'Even the royal cribs gon' be filthy— 'Cause they out here burnin' incense on rooftops To the stars and pourin' out drinks to idols. Every last house stank of rebellion.'"

14.text: After all that, Jeremiah left Tophet And came back to the temple court. He faced the people and dropped the mic one more time:

15.text: "Y'all better listen—this from the Lord of Heaven's Armies: I'm bringin' every bit of that judgment I said I would 'Cause y'all got stiff necks And straight up refused to listen."

1.text: So Pashhur, son of Immer—one of the top priests and chief of security at the Lord's house— Heard what Jeremiah been sayin'.

2.text: Man got mad, hit Jeremiah, and had him thrown in stocks near the Benjamin Gate by the temple.

3.text: Next day, Pashhur let him out. But Jeremiah wasn't done—he said, "God ain't callin' you Pashhur no more. Your new name? Magor-Missabib—'Terror All Around.'"

4.text: "'Cause this what God say: I'ma make you a whole nightmare to yourself and all your friends. Y'all gon' watch each other fall by enemy swords. Babylon gon' take Judah, And they ain't gon' be gentle with it."

5.text: "The city's money, crops, jewels, treasures— All of it gettin' looted. Your enemies takin' it straight to Babylon."

6.text: "And you, Pashhur—you and your whole household? Y'all goin' too. Y'all gon' die over there, You and everybody you been lyin' to."

7.text: Jeremiah said, "Lord… You pulled me into this, And I said yes. Now I'm the joke of the day— They clown me nonstop."

8.text: "Every time I speak, it's judgment. Violence. Destruction. Your words made me a punchline."

9.text: "I tried to quit. I really did. I said, 'I'm done talkin' about God.' But yo… it was like FIRE Locked up in my bones. I got tired of holdin' it back. I couldn't keep quiet."

10.text: "Everybody sayin', 'Terror everywhere!' They tryna snitch—'Go ahead, report him!' Even folks I thought I knew Waitin' on me to slip, Schemin' for revenge."

11.text: "But the Lord with me like a warrior. My haters gon' trip and fall— They ain't gon' win. They gon' be embarrassed forever. Never gon' live it down."

12.text: "Lord of Heaven's Armies, You test hearts and motives— Let me see justice done. I laid my case at Your feet."

13.text: "Sing to the Lord! Praise Him! He came through for the broke and beat down, Snatched us outta evil hands."

14.text: Then Jeremiah spiraled again— "Cursed be the day I was born. Don't celebrate my birthday no more."

15.text: "Forget the man who told my pops, 'It's a boy!'— He shouldn't have been so happy."

16.text: "Let him end up like Sodom—no mercy. Let him wake up to screams, Hear chaos at lunch."

17.text: "Shoulda just died in the womb. Let my mama's belly be my coffin."

18.text: "Why was I even born? Just to suffer? Just to feel pain and shame all my days?"

1.text: This the word God gave Jeremiah when King Zedekiah sent Pashhur son of Melchiah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, the priest, to holla at him.

2.text: They said, "Can you talk to the Lord for us? Nebuchadnezzar out here wagin' war, and maybe—just maybe—God gon' do one of His miracles like before and make Babylon back off."

3.text: But Jeremiah replied, "Tell Zedekiah this right here—

4.text: 'This what the Lord, God of Israel, said: I'ma flip the script. The very weapons y'all holdin' to fight Babylon with? I'ma turn them against y'all. I'ma let them Babylonian soldiers walk right into the city.

5.text: And I ain't sittin' this one out—I'm fightin' you, not them. My hand stretched out, My arm strong, and I'm comin' with anger, fury, and smoke.

6.text: I'ma hit this whole city—people and animals alike. A deadly plague gon' sweep through.

7.text: And after that? Zedekiah, his crew, and whoever still alive from famine, sword, or disease—I'ma hand y'all over to Nebuchadnezzar. Y'all enemies gon' get y'all, and he ain't showin' no mercy. No pity. No chill.'"

8.text: "Now tell the people this," Jeremiah continued. "This what the Lord say: 'I'm givin' y'all two choices—life or death.

9.text: If you stay in this city, you gon' die—by sword, starvation, or sickness. But if you surrender to Babylon and go out to them, you'll live. Your life'll be the only thing you keep, but that's better than nothin'.

10.text: I done turned My face against this city, not for it. It's over. Babylon gon' take it and burn it down. Period.'"

11.text: And to the royal fam—yeah, the House of David—God got something to say:

12.text: "Wake up and do right, early in the morning! Rescue the ones gettin' robbed. If not, My anger gon' blaze up like a wildfire, And y'all won't be able to put it out. It's gon' burn 'cause of y'all's wickedness."

13.text: "I'm comin' for you too," says the Lord. "You sit up high in the valley, feelin' safe on your lil' hill, Actin' like, 'Who gon' check us? Who can step up in here?'

14.text: Well, I'ma check you. I'ma judge you by your actions, And I'ma light a fire in your woods, And everything around you? It's gettin' torched."

1.text: The Lord said, "Go down to the king's crib in Judah and give him this word.

2.text: Tell him, 'Listen up, king of Judah—you sittin' on David's throne. You, your servants, and everybody who come through these gates, hear what the Lord gotta say!

3.text: This what the Lord says: Do right. Judge fair. Save the folks being robbed. Don't mistreat or hurt the foreigners, the orphans, or the widows. And don't be out here spillin' innocent blood in this place.

4.text: If y'all really do this, then kings from David's line gon' ride through them gates again—on horses and in chariots—with they people and crews behind them.

5.text: But if y'all ignore what I'm sayin', I swear on Myself," says the Lord, "this whole palace gon' end up in ruins."

6.text: The Lord got this to say about the king's house: "You might be like Gilead to Me, Or like the heights of Lebanon, But I'ma still turn you into a wasteland, A bunch of ghost towns with no one in 'em.

7.text: I'ma bring wreckers with tools To chop down your best cedar wood And toss it in the fire."

8.text: When the nations walk by and see Jerusalem lookin' like a graveyard, they gon' ask, "What happened? Why'd the Lord do this to such a great city?"

9.text: And the answer gon' be, "'Cause they broke the Lord's covenant and ran off worshipin' fake gods."

10.text: Don't cry for the ones already dead. Cry for the ones who get exiled, 'Cause they ain't never comin' back home.

11.text: This what the Lord says about Shallum (a.k.a. Jehoahaz), son of Josiah, who ruled after him: He ain't comin' back here no more.

12.text: He gon' die in the foreign land where they dragged him, and he'll never see Judah again.

13.text: Woe to the one who builds his house off shady deals, Who don't pay folks what they earned, Just usin' people like they ain't human.

14.text: Talkin' 'bout, "I'mma build me a big house, real fly, Decked out with cedar and painted all nice."

15.text: You think bein' surrounded by cedar make you royalty? Your daddy—Josiah—he ate, drank, And he still did what was right. That's why it went well for him.

16.text: He looked out for the poor and the needy— That's what it really means to know Me," says the Lord.

17.text: But you? Your eyes only see greed. You shed innocent blood. You oppress. You abuse. You wildin'.

18.text: So the Lord says this about Jehoiakim, son of Josiah: Ain't nobody gon' mourn him. No "RIP my brother!" No "Alas, my king!"

19.text: He gon' get tossed out like a dead donkey, Dragged outside the city gates and left there.

20.text: Climb up to Lebanon and cry your heart out, Scream from Bashan, Cry from the peaks— 'Cause all your homies gone.

21.text: I tried talkin' to you when you had it good, But you ain't wanna hear it. That's been your vibe since way back—you never listened.

22.text: Now the wind gon' blow away your leaders, Your allies gon' get snatched up, And that's when the shame and regret gon' hit you hard.

23.text: You livin' all comfy in cedar palaces, But when the pain hit, You gon' squirm like a woman givin' birth.

24.text: The Lord said, "Even if Coniah (a.k.a. Jehoiachin), son of Jehoiakim, was a ring on My hand, I'd still snatch him off.

25.text: I'ma hand him over to the folks tryin' to kill him— Nebuchadnezzar and the Babylonians.

26.text: Him and his mama gon' get exiled to a place they ain't even from, And that's where they'll die.

27.text: They wish they could come back, But that wish ain't comin' true.

28.text: Coniah—he ain't nothin' but a broken, tossed-away piece of pottery. Him and his family—rejected and exiled to a strange land.

29.text: Earth, earth, earth—listen up! This what the Lord say:

30.text: 'Write this man down as childless. Ain't none of his descendants gon' sit on David's throne, Or run things in Judah ever again.'"

1.text: "Woe to the so-called leaders who out here wreckin' My people and tearin' up My flock," says the Lord.

2.text: So this what the Lord, the God of Israel, got to say to the ones supposed to be feedin' His people: "Y'all scattered My flock, pushed 'em away, and ain't even checked on 'em. Don't worry—I'ma check on y'all real close for all that mess you been doing."

3.text: "But I'ma gather up the rest of My people from all the spots I had to send 'em to, and bring them back home safe. They gon' grow and multiply again."

4.text: "I'ma raise up real leaders over them—ones that feed them right. They won't be scared, stressed, or missing anymore," says the Lord.

5.text: "The days coming," says the Lord, "When I'ma raise up from David's line A real one—righteous, just, and wise. A King that's gon' rule right and win.

6.text: When He reigns, Judah gon' be safe, Israel gon' live secure. And His name gon' be: THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS."

7.text: "Look, the time's comin'," says the Lord, "where folks won't be sayin', 'As surely as the Lord brought Israel outta Egypt,'

8.text: but instead they gon' say, 'As surely as the Lord brought us back from the north and all over the world where He scattered us.' And they gon' live in their own land again."

9.text: My heart is shattered Because of these so-called prophets. I'm shakin' in my bones. I feel like I'm drunk or high, But really, it's from the weight of the Lord's words.

10.text: The land full of cheaters and backstabbers. The whole earth mournin'. Even the wild places lookin' dry. Why? 'Cause these folks wicked, and their strength ain't even real.

11.text: "Both the prophets and the priests outta pocket. I done caught 'em wildin' out— Even in My own house," says the Lord.

12.text: "So now they walkin' on slippery ground, Gon' fall in the dark. I'm bringin' disaster down on 'em— This they year to feel it," says the Lord.

13.text: "The prophets in Samaria was already trippin'— They was out here speakin' for Baal, Leadin' My people off track.

14.text: But them prophets in Jerusalem? Whew. They cheatin', lyin', helpin' evil folks stay evil. Ain't nobody repentin'. To Me, they lookin' like Sodom and Gomorrah out here."

15.text: "So here's what the Lord of Heaven's Armies say: I'ma serve these prophets some bitter wormwood tea, And have 'em drink poison water. They done infected the whole land with they foolishness."

16.text: This what the Lord says: "Stop listenin' to these fake prophets. They gassin' y'all up. They talkin' dreams they made up— Ain't nothin' come from Me."

17.text: They out here tellin' rebels, 'God said y'all gon' have peace.' And tellin' folks followin' they own ways, 'Ain't nothin' bad gon' happen to you.'

18.text: But who really stood in My inner circle? Who actually heard My words?

19.text: Watch out—God's storm is comin'. It's fierce. It's gon' slam the wicked upside the head.

20.text: The Lord ain't lettin' up Till He get done with what's in His heart. Later, y'all gon' finally get it.

21.text: "I ain't send these prophets, But they ran anyway. I ain't speak to 'em, But they prophesied anyway.

22.text: If they had sat down and listened to Me, They woulda turned folks away from their sin.

23.text: Y'all think I'm just a local God?" says the Lord. "You think I ain't everywhere?

24.text: You think folks can hide from Me? Don't I fill the whole universe?"

25.text: "I heard what them dream-havin', lie-tellin' prophets said: 'I had a dream from the Lord!'

26.text: How long they gon' keep lyin' like this? These dreams they dreamin'? They comin' from they own twisted hearts.

27.text: They tryna make My people forget Me, Just like their ancestors forgot Me for Baal.

28.text: If a prophet got a dream, fine—let him share it. But if he got My word, He better preach that truth straight up. Wheat ain't the same as chaff," says the Lord.

29.text: "Ain't My word like fire? Like a hammer that shatters rock?"

30.text: "I'm against these prophets," says the Lord, "Who out here copyin' each other's fake messages, Like they mine."

31.text: "I'm against the ones Who twist up words and blame it on Me, Like I said it."

32.text: "I'm against them dream-sellin' prophets Who lead My people astray with their lies. They reckless, I ain't send them, And they ain't helpin' nobody," says the Lord.

33.text: "So if the people—or a prophet or a priest—ask you, 'What's the oracle of the Lord?' You tell them: 'What oracle? The Lord said He done with y'all.'"

34.text: "And anybody—prophet, priest, or people— Who keep sayin' 'the oracle of the Lord,' I'ma deal with them and their whole household."

35.text: Instead, folks should ask each other, 'What's the Lord sayin' to you?' 'What's the message He gave?'

36.text: Don't say 'the oracle of the Lord' no more. Y'all twisted My words And tried to turn My truth into your own foolish talk.

37.text: So if you wanna know the real deal, Ask, 'What did the Lord answer you?' Or 'What did the Lord say?'

38.text: But since y'all love to say 'the oracle of the Lord,' Even after I told you not to,

39.text: I'm done. For real. I'ma forget y'all, Throw you and your city outta My presence.

40.text: I'ma put shame on y'all name forever. A disgrace that never gets erased."

1.text: The Lord gave me a vision—two baskets of figs sittin' in front of the temple. This was after King Nebuchadnezzar snatched up Jeconiah, the nobles, and the skilled workers from Jerusalem and hauled them off to Babylon.

2.text: One basket had some real good figs—like early season, fresh-picked sweet ones. The other basket? Trash. So rotten they couldn't even be eaten.

3.text: The Lord said, "Jeremiah, what you see?" I said, "Figs. The good ones real good… but the bad ones? Whew—unbearable."

4.text: Then the Lord hit me with this word:

5.text: "These good figs? That's how I see the ones I let get carried off to Babylon. I sent 'em outta here for they own good. They gon' be alright."

6.text: "I got My eyes on them. I'ma bless 'em. I'ma bring 'em back to this land. I'ma build 'em up, not tear 'em down. Plant 'em deep—ain't nobody uprootin' them."

7.text: "I'ma give them a new heart— A heart that really knows Me. They gon' be My people, and I'ma be they God. They gon' come back to Me with everything they got."

8.text: "Now them bad figs? The ones you can't even eat? That's how I feel about Zedekiah, his boys, the leftovers in Jerusalem, And them folks tryna hide out in Egypt."

9.text: "I'ma make 'em an example— A straight-up warning, a curse, a punchline, In every place I scatter 'em. Folks gon' be like, 'Don't end up like them.'"

10.text: "And I'ma send the sword, the famine, and disease Until they wiped off the land I gave their ancestors."

1.text: This the word God gave Jeremiah 'bout all Judah, In the fourth year of Jehoiakim's reign— That's also year one for King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon.

2.text: Jeremiah spoke this to everybody in Judah and Jerusalem.

3.text: He said, "I been preachin' for 23 years straight— Since Josiah's thirteenth year—and y'all still ain't listenin'."

4.text: "God sent prophet after prophet, Wakin' y'all up early with warnings, But you stayed sleep."

5.text: "They all said the same thing: 'Turn from y'all evil ways. Stop doin' dirty. Then you can stay in the land God gave your people.'"

6.text: "They said, 'Don't chase after other gods. Don't provoke God with them idols you made. If you stop, He won't bring harm.'"

7.text: "But nah, y'all didn't listen. And now y'all done brought this heat on yourselves."

8.text: So God says, "Since y'all ain't listenin' to Me—

9.text: I'm bringin' Nebuchadnezzar—yeah, My servant— And all them nations from the north. They gon' wreck this place, Turn it into a horror story, a punchline, a ghost town."

10.text: "No more laughter, No more weddings, No more grindin' grain or lightin' lamps. It's gon' be dark and quiet."

11.text: "This whole land? Desolate. Judah and the surrounding nations Gon' serve Babylon for seventy years."

12.text: "Then after seventy years up, I'm comin' for Babylon too. They gon' get theirs. I'ma make they land just as wrecked."

13.text: "Everything I said 'bout Babylon gon' come true— Every prophecy in this book, All them words I had Jeremiah speak on the nations."

14.text: "The tables gon' turn. Babylon gon' serve others too, And I'ma pay 'em back for what they did."

15.text: Then God said to me, "Take this wine cup of My wrath And make every nation I send you to drink from it."

16.text: "They gon' drink it, Stumble like they drunk, And lose their minds— 'Cause of the sword I'm sending through 'em."

17.text: So I took the cup and did what God said— Had each nation sip His fury.

18.text: First up: Jerusalem and Judah— Kings, princes, the whole city. They gon' be a mess. Everybody talkin' bad on 'em.

19.text: Then Egypt—Pharaoh, his crew, and all the people.

20.text: The mixed crowds, Uz, the Philistine kings—Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, Ashdod leftovers.

21.text: Edom, Moab, Ammon.

22.text: Tyre, Sidon, and the island kings way off.

23.text: Dedan, Tema, Buz, folks way out on the edge.

24.text: Arabia and all the desert crews.

25.text: Zimri, Elam, and the Medes.

26.text: All the northern kings, Far and near—every nation on earth. Even Sheshach gon' drink last.

27.text: And I had to tell 'em: "Drink up. Get drunk. Stumble and fall. Y'all ain't gettin' up. The sword is comin'."

28.text: If they refused the cup, I was to tell 'em straight: "Nah, you drinkin' this. No dodgin' it."

29.text: "If I'm bringin' judgment to the city with My name on it, Y'all really think y'all gon' be safe? The sword's comin' for everybody," says the Lord.

30.text: Then God said, "Prophesy loud. Tell 'em: 'God roarin' from heaven— He shoutin' like a lion over His people. He gon' stomp the nations Like folks crushin' grapes in the winepress.'"

31.text: "The whole earth gon' hear it— 'Cause God got beef with all nations. He ain't lettin' nothin slide."

32.text: "Disaster comin' Nation to nation. A whirlwind stirrin' up From every direction."

33.text: "And that day? Bodies everywhere—from one end of the earth to the other. Ain't nobody mournin'. No burials. Just bodies layin' like trash."

34.text: "Cry out, y'all fake shepherds. Roll in the dirt. Your time is up. Y'all gon' fall hard."

35.text: "Ain't no escape. Y'all done led the people wrong— Now y'all in the crosshairs."

36.text: "Listen close— The leaders cryin', the people hurtin', 'Cause God just cleared out their peace."

37.text: "The calm homes? Cut down and gone."

38.text: "God stepped out like a lion from His den. Why? 'Cause the land full of evil, And He fed up."

1.text: At the start of King Jehoiakim's reign (Josiah's son), the Lord gave Jeremiah a word.

2.text: God said, "Go stand in the courtyard of My house and speak to all them folks from Judah that come to worship. Say everything I told you—don't leave out nothing.

3.text: Maybe, just maybe, they'll actually listen and turn from their wicked ways. If they do, I'll call off the disaster I planned to drop on 'em for how they been acting."

4.text: "Tell 'em this too: 'The Lord says—if y'all don't listen to Me, and don't walk in the law I gave y'all,

5.text: and if you keep ignoring the prophets I been sending—day after day, even though y'all ain't tryna hear them—

6.text: then I'ma treat this temple like I did Shiloh, and this whole city gon' be cursed by every nation out there.'"

7.text: So the priests, the prophets, and all the people heard Jeremiah drop this message in God's house.

8.text: And when Jeremiah was done sayin' all God told him to say, the crowd snapped. The priests, prophets, and everybody grabbed him and said, "You gon' die for this!"

9.text: They shouted, "How dare you prophesy in God's name and say His temple gon' be like Shiloh and this city gon' be empty?" They turned the whole crowd against Jeremiah right there in the temple.

10.text: When Judah's officials heard what was goin' down, they rushed over from the palace and posted up at the New Gate in God's house.

11.text: The priests and prophets told the officials and the crowd, "This man need to die! Y'all heard him—he was talkin' crazy against the city!"

12.text: But Jeremiah stood up to everybody and said, "The Lord sent me to say all this—everything you heard, it came straight from Him."

13.text: "So y'all better check yourselves. Change your ways. Obey God. Then maybe He won't do what He said He would."

14.text: "As for me? I'm right here. Do what you gotta do. Whatever you think is right."

15.text: "But know this: if you kill me, you killin' an innocent man. And that blood? It's gon' be on you, this city, and everybody in it. 'Cause the Lord really did send me to give y'all this word."

16.text: Then the officials and the crowd told the priests and prophets, "This man don't deserve death. He just spoke what God told him to."

17.text: Then some of the elders stood up and said to the crowd,

18.text: "Remember Micah from Moresheth? He prophesied in King Hezekiah's day, and he said: 'Zion gon' get plowed like a field, Jerusalem gon' be rubble, And God's mountain gon' be bare like a hilltop.'"

19.text: "Did King Hezekiah or the people kill him? Nah. Hezekiah feared God and begged for mercy. And God changed His mind. But look at us—we about to do something real foul if we kill Jeremiah."

20.text: Now, there was another dude named Urijah from Kirjath Jearim. He also spoke a word from the Lord—same kind of message Jeremiah was preachin'.

21.text: When King Jehoiakim heard about it, he wanted Urijah dead. Urijah got scared and dipped to Egypt.

22.text: But Jehoiakim wasn't done. He sent Elnathan and some others down to Egypt to go get him.

23.text: They snatched Urijah back, brought him to Jehoiakim, and the king straight up murdered him—left his body in some random public grave.

24.text: But Jeremiah? He was covered. Ahikam (Shaphan's son) had his back, so they didn't hand Jeremiah over to the mob to get killed.

1.text: Early in the reign of Jehoiakim, son of Josiah, king of Judah, the Lord gave Jeremiah a word.

2.text: God told him, "Make some straps and yokes—like the kind you put on oxen—and wear 'em on your neck.

3.text: Then send 'em to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon, through the messengers who came to Jerusalem to holla at King Zedekiah of Judah.

4.text: Tell them messengers to deliver this message to their bosses: 'This what the Lord of Heaven's Armies, the God of Israel, gotta say—

5.text: I'm the one who made the earth, the people, and the animals, with My own mighty hand and power. And I give it to whoever I want.

6.text: Right now, I done handed all y'all land over to Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon. He My servant, and even the wild animals gon' serve him.

7.text: All nations gon' serve him, his son, and his grandson—until Babylon's time is up. Then big empires gon' rise and bring Babylon down.

8.text: But listen—any nation that won't serve Nebuchadnezzar or won't put their neck under his yoke? I'm comin' for 'em," says the Lord. "With war, famine, and disease, till Babylon wipes 'em out."

9.text: So don't listen to y'all fake prophets, fortune tellers, dreamers, magicians, or witches who say, 'You ain't gotta serve Babylon.'

10.text: They lyin' to y'all. All that talk gon' get you kicked out the land and left to die.

11.text: But the nations that humble themselves and wear Babylon's yoke? I'll let them stay in their land," says the Lord. "They can farm it and live in peace."

12.text: I told Zedekiah king of Judah all this straight up too. I said, "Yo, put your neck under the yoke of Babylon's king. Serve him and live!

13.text: Why choose death for you and your people—by sword, famine, or plague—when God already said this would happen to whoever refuses Babylon's rule?"

14.text: "Don't let those so-called prophets gas y'all up saying, 'You ain't gotta serve Babylon.' They lyin'.

15.text: I didn't send them," says the Lord. "But they out here lying in My name. And if y'all keep listening, you and they both gon' die for it."

16.text: I also told the priests and the people: "Don't listen to them fake prophets sayin', 'The Lord's stuff gon' be brought back from Babylon any day now.' That's a lie too.

17.text: Don't believe the hype. Serve Babylon and stay alive. Why let this whole city get wrecked?"

18.text: "If those prophets really got a word from God, let them pray to Him and ask Him to keep the rest of the temple stuff from being taken to Babylon too!"

19.text: 'Cause here's what the Lord of hosts says about what's still left in the temple, the royal palace, and the city—

20.text: The stuff Nebuchadnezzar didn't snatch the first time when he took Jeconiah (Jehoiakim's son) and all the elite folks to Babylon—

21.text: This is what the Lord says about all those remaining items:

22.text: "They gon' get taken to Babylon too. And they'll stay there until the day I come for 'em," says the Lord. "Then I'll bring it all back home."

1.text: So in that same year, during the reign of King Zedekiah—fourth year, fifth month—Hananiah, son of Azur from Gibeon (claimin' he a prophet), came up to me at the Temple.

2.text: In front of everybody—priests, people, all of 'em—he said, "This what the Lord of Heaven's Armies say: I done broke Babylon's yoke off y'all!"

3.text: "In two years, tops, all them temple treasures Nebuchadnezzar took? They comin' right back."

4.text: "Jeconiah and all the folks taken to Babylon? They comin' home too. God said it."

5.text: Then I, Jeremiah, looked at Hananiah in front of everybody and said:

6.text: "Amen! I hope the Lord do exactly what you said. I hope He bring back all our people and all the sacred stuff from Babylon."

7.text: "But hold up—listen to me, and everybody else listen too."

8.text: "The real prophets before us? They didn't sugarcoat nothin'. They spoke on war, disaster, and plagues hittin' all the kingdoms."

9.text: "So if somebody talkin' 'bout peace and good vibes? We'll know they real only when what they say actually comes true."

10.text: Then Hananiah went bold with it. He straight snatched the yoke off my neck and broke it.

11.text: And he doubled down: "This how the Lord gon' break Babylon's yoke off everybody in two years. Mark my words!" So I just walked away.

12.text: Later on, the Lord pulled up on me with a word—right after Hananiah pulled that stunt.

13.text: God said, "Go tell Hananiah: You broke that wooden yoke? Cool. Now it's gon' be iron."

14.text: "I'm puttin' an iron yoke on these nations' necks. They gon' serve Nebuchadnezzar whether they like it or not. Even the animals report to him."

15.text: So I came back to Hananiah and said, "Listen here—you not sent by God. You out here feedin' the people false hope."

16.text: "So here's God's final word: You gon' die this year, 'cause you taught rebellion against the Lord."

17.text: And just like that—Hananiah dropped dead that same year, in the seventh month.

1.text: These the words Jeremiah the prophet wrote in a letter from Jerusalem. He sent it to the rest of the elders still alive, to the priests, prophets, and all the folks that Nebuchadnezzar done carried off from Jerusalem to Babylon.

2.text: (This happened after Jeconiah the king, the queen mama, the officials, Judah and Jerusalem's leaders, and all the skilled workers and craftsmen had already been taken from the city.)

3.text: Jeremiah sent the letter through Elasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah—these two were headed to Babylon, sent by King Zedekiah to deliver something to King Nebuchadnezzar.

4.text: The letter said: "This what the Lord of Heaven's Armies, the God of Israel, tellin' all y'all who I had carried from Jerusalem to Babylon:

5.text: Build y'all some houses and actually live in 'em. Plant gardens and eat what you grow.

6.text: Go 'head and get married. Have sons and daughters. Then let your sons get married, and your daughters too. Let them have kids so y'all can grow in number and not fade out.

7.text: And seek peace for the city I sent y'all to. Pray for it, 'cause when that city at peace, you gon' have peace too.

8.text: Don't get played by them prophets and fortune tellers living among y'all. Don't fall for the dreams you keep tellin' yourselves.

9.text: They out here prophesyin' lies in My name. I ain't send them!" says the Lord.

10.text: "But this what I really said: After seventy years in Babylon, I'ma come check on y'all. I'ma keep My promise and bring you back home.

11.text: I know the plans I got for y'all," says the Lord, "Plans to give y'all peace, not harm. A future. Hope.

12.text: Then you gon' call Me, pray to Me—and I'ma listen.

13.text: You gon' seek Me and find Me—if you look for Me with all your heart.

14.text: I'ma let Myself be found," says the Lord. "And I'ma bring you back from exile. I'll gather y'all from every nation and spot I scattered you to and bring y'all back to where you started."

15.text: Y'all been sayin', "The Lord gave us prophets here in Babylon too"—

16.text: So here's what the Lord says about the king sittin' on David's throne and the folks still back in Jerusalem—the ones that didn't get taken into captivity with you:

17.text: "I'ma send war, hunger, and disease on them. They gon' be like rotten figs—so nasty, nobody even want 'em."

18.text: "I'ma chase 'em down with the sword, famine, and plague. I'ma scatter 'em across the earth, and wherever they land, folks gon' look at 'em like a bad omen. They gon' be a warning, a joke, a scandal."

19.text: "Why? 'Cause they ain't listen to My words. I kept sending prophets, rising up early, tryna talk to 'em—but they ain't wanna hear. And y'all ain't listen either."

20.text: So hear this word, all y'all I sent to Babylon from Jerusalem.

21.text: This what the Lord of Heaven's Armies, the God of Israel, say about Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who out here lyin' to y'all in My name: "I'ma hand them over to Nebuchadnezzar. He gon' roast them alive right in front of y'all."

22.text: After that, folks in Babylon gon' use them as a curse. They gon' say, "May the Lord do you like He did Zedekiah and Ahab—the ones the king of Babylon burned up."

23.text: "Why? 'Cause they out here wildin'. Committing adultery with other men's wives, and speakin' lies in My name—sayin' stuff I never told 'em to say. And I seen it all," says the Lord.

24.text: Now you need to holla at Shemaiah the Nehelamite too.

25.text: This is what the Lord says: Shemaiah done wrote letters in his own name to everybody in Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the other priests, sayin'—

26.text: "The Lord picked you to take Jehoiada's spot as priest, so you supposed to deal with all these crazy folks claimin' they prophets. You shoulda locked Jeremiah up in the stocks by now."

27.text: "So why you ain't shut down Jeremiah from Anathoth yet? He claimin' to be a prophet too!"

28.text: "He done sent letters to us in Babylon sayin', 'This exile gon' last a while. So build houses, settle down, plant gardens, and eat what you grow.'"

29.text: Zephaniah read that whole letter out loud to Jeremiah.

30.text: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah.

31.text: "Tell everybody in exile: This is what the Lord says about Shemaiah the Nehelamite—He out here prophesyin' lies to y'all, and I ain't send him. He makin' y'all believe a straight-up lie."

32.text: "So this is what I'ma do," says the Lord: "I'ma punish Shemaiah and his whole bloodline. He won't have no descendants livin' among My people. And he won't see the good I got planned for My people—'cause he encouraged rebellion against Me."

1.text: God gave Jeremiah another word.

2.text: He said, "Write everything I told you in a book."

3.text: "'Cause the days comin' when I'ma bring My people—Israel and Judah—back from captivity. They comin' home. Back to the land I gave they ancestors."

4.text: This the message God gave 'bout Israel and Judah:

5.text: "It's been fear in the air—not peace. Folks tremblin'."

6.text: "Ever seen a man act like he in labor? Why they all holdin' they stomach like a woman bout to give birth? Why everybody lookin' ghost-pale?"

7.text: "That day gon' be somethin' else—ain't nothin' like it. It's Jacob's time of trouble. But hold up… he gon' get saved outta it."

8.text: "When that day come," says the Lord, "I'ma snap that yoke off y'all neck. Bust the chains. No more foreign rulers bossin' y'all around."

9.text: "Instead, y'all gon' serve Me—your God. And y'all gon' serve David, the king I raise up."

10.text: "So don't trip, My servant Jacob. Don't be shook, Israel. I'm comin' to save y'all— You and your kids— from far-off places. Y'all comin' home. Y'all gon' rest easy. Ain't nobody gon' scare you again."

11.text: "I'm with you to rescue you. I might wipe out the nations I scattered you in, But I ain't gon' completely wipe you out. I'ma discipline you though. Can't let you slide like nothin' happened."

12.text: "Look, the wound you got? It's deep. Real deep."

13.text: "Ain't nobody steppin' up for you. No healing. No medicine. No advocate."

14.text: "Your so-called lovers ghosted you. Ain't checkin' for you. I hit you like an enemy would— 'Cause your sins been stackin' up heavy."

15.text: "So why you cryin' now? You brought this on yourself. I had to check you."

16.text: "But don't worry—everybody who messed with you? They gon' get got. The ones who stole from you? They about to get robbed. Every enemy? I got somethin' for 'em."

17.text: "I'ma heal you. I'ma patch you up. Even though folks been callin' you an outcast— Like, 'That's Zion, nobody even care about her.'"

18.text: "But I ain't forgot y'all. I'ma bring Jacob's people back home. They houses gon' be restored. The city gon' get rebuilt where it belongs. The palace? Reestablished, just how it used to be."

19.text: "Joy gon' come outta them places again. Singing, dancing, praise. I'ma grow they numbers—no more dwindling. They gon' shine. They won't be small no more."

20.text: "They kids gon' be straight. The community gon' be locked in before Me. And anyone tryna oppress 'em? I'ma handle that."

21.text: "They own leaders gon' rise up from among them. And I'ma let him come near Me. But tell Me— Who bold enough to step up and get that close to Me?" Says the Lord.

22.text: "Y'all gon' be My people. And I'ma be y'all God."

23.text: "Look, the Lord's storm is comin'. It's wild and ain't lettin' up. It's gon' drop hard on the wicked."

24.text: "That rage? It ain't coolin' off 'til God finishes what He planned. And when all's said and done, You gon' look back and get it."

1.text: Around that time," says the Lord, "I'ma be God to all the families of Israel, and they gon' be My people."

2.text: The Lord said: "The folks who made it through all the violence? They found grace in the wilderness—That's when I stepped in and gave 'em rest."

3.text: The Lord showed up sayin', "Look, I been loving you since way back—That love ain't ever run out. I pulled you in close with kindness."

4.text: "I'ma rebuild you, girl. You gon' rise up again. You gon' be dancing with your tambourines, Back in the streets with joy."

5.text: "You gon' be planting vineyards in them Samaria hills, And this time? You gon' eat the fruit, too."

6.text: "A day comin' when watchmen gon' shout from Mount Ephraim, 'Let's go, y'all—Zion bound! Time to see the Lord!'"

7.text: The Lord says, "Sing loud for Jacob! Shout it from the rooftops! Give Me praise and pray like this: 'Lord, save Your people—the leftover crew from Israel!'"

8.text: "I'ma bring 'em back from up north, From way out on the ends of the earth—Blind folk, folks limpin', pregnant women, laborin' mamas—Everybody coming home together."

9.text: "They comin' in tears, But I'ma guide 'em gentle, Lead 'em by flowing waters, Keep 'em on solid ground. I'm their Father, and Ephraim? That's My firstborn."

10.text: "Hey nations, listen up! Tell everybody far off: The One who scattered Israel is gathering His people back—Just like a shepherd with his flock."

11.text: "The Lord bought Jacob back, Snatched him from hands stronger than his own."

12.text: "They gon' come singin' in Zion, Flowin' in like rivers—Blessed with grain, wine, oil, and baby animals. Their souls gon' feel like watered gardens—And sorrow? Gone."

13.text: "The girls gon' dance again, Young and old celebratin' together. I'ma flip their mourning into joy, Comfort 'em, and bring laughter back."

14.text: "The priests gon' eat good, My people gon' be satisfied with My goodness," says the Lord.

15.text: The Lord said, "I heard a cry in Ramah—Rachel mournin' for her babies, Cryin' so deep, She couldn't even be comforted…'Cause they was gone."

16.text: But the Lord said, "Stop cryin', baby girl. Wipe them tears. You gon' get rewarded for holdin' on. Them kids comin' back from enemy land."

17.text: "You got a future, Hope is alive. Your children comin' home," says the Lord.

18.text: "I heard Ephraim out here talkin' like, 'You checked me, Lord, and I needed it. I was wild—But bring me back, and I'ma come runnin'. You still my God.'"

19.text: "'After I came back, I felt bad. You taught me, and it hit deep—I was ashamed of how I acted. All that foolishness from when I was young.'"

20.text: "Ephraim still My baby. Yeah, I had to speak tough, But I ain't stopped lovin' him. My heart breaks for him. I'ma show mercy. That's My word."

21.text: "Set up some signs, leave some markers—So you know how to get back. Trace your steps, daughter of Israel—It's time to come home."

22.text: "How long you gon' keep runnin', Actin' all restless and rebellious? I'm doin' something brand new—A woman gon' cover and protect a man."

23.text: The Lord of Heaven's Armies said: When I bring y'all back home, Y'all gon' say again, 'God bless you, city of justice, mountain of holiness.'"

24.text: Farmers gon' settle in, flocks back in the fields—Life gon' feel like it's supposed to.

25.text: "I'll fill up every soul that's tired, And heal every heart that's hurtin'."

26.text: Jeremiah said, "I woke up from that vision, And the sleep was sweet."

27.text: "Look, the time's comin', Where I'ma plant new seed in Israel and Judah—People and animals, blessings all around."

28.text: "I watched over y'all to tear down, break up, and judge…Now I'ma watch to build you back up."

29.text: "Ain't nobody gon' say no more, 'Our daddies ate sour grapes and now our teeth hurt.'"

30.text: "Nah—everybody gon' answer for their own sins. You eat sour grapes? That's your toothache."

31.text: "The day's comin'," says the Lord, "Where I'ma make a brand new covenant—With Israel and Judah."

32.text: "It won't be like the old one I made when I brought 'em outta Egypt—They broke that deal, even though I was good to 'em."

33.text: "This time? I'ma put My law in them—on they minds, written on they hearts. I'ma be their God, and they gon' be My people."

34.text: "Ain't nobody gon' need to teach their neighbor, 'Know the Lord,' 'Cause everybody—from the least to the greatest—Gon' know Me for themselves. I'ma forgive their mess, and I ain't bringin' up their sins no more."

35.text: The Lord—who runs the sun by day, And the moon and stars by night, Who stirs up the sea like a DJ scratchin' waves—He said:

36.text: "If them things stop workin'…Only then will Israel stop being My people."

37.text: "If the skies can be measured And the earth searched all the way through, Only then will I reject Israel For all they done wrong."

38.text: "The day's comin', says the Lord—Jerusalem gon' be rebuilt, From the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate."

39.text: "The surveyor's line gon' stretch out to Gareb, Then turn to Goath."

40.text: "Every field, valley, and ashes pit—All the way to the Kidron Valley and the Horse Gate—It's all gon' be holy ground. Ain't nobody tearing it down ever again."

1.text: This word came to Jeremiah in the 10th year of Zedekiah's reign. That was Nebuchadnezzar's 18th year.

2.text: Babylon had Jerusalem surrounded, and Jeremiah was locked up in the courtyard of the palace prison.

3.text: Zedekiah had him jailed for sayin': "This what the Lord said—'I'ma hand this city over to the king of Babylon. He gon' take it.'"

4.text: "'Zedekiah ain't gon' escape neither—he gon' get caught, meet the king of Babylon face to face, eye to eye.'"

5.text: "'And he gon' get dragged to Babylon and stay there till I visit him again,' says the Lord. 'You can try to fight the Babylonians, but it won't work.'"

6.text: Then Jeremiah said, "The Lord told me somethin' else."

7.text: "He said, 'Your cousin Hanamel gon' come to you and say, "Buy my field in Anathoth—it's your right to buy it, you got next of kin privileges."'"

8.text: And sure enough, Hanamel showed up at the prison yard just like God said and told me, "Please buy my field—it's yours to redeem." That's how I knew the Lord was speakin'.

9.text: So I bought the field from Hanamel. Seventeen shekels of silver.

10.text: I signed the deed, sealed it, brought in witnesses, and weighed the silver on the scales.

11.text: I took both copies of the deed—sealed and open.

12.text: Then I handed it over to Baruch (son of Neriah, son of Mahseiah), with Hanamel and the witnesses all present—right there in the prison yard.

13.text: I told Baruch in front of everybody,

14.text: "The Lord says: Take these papers—the sealed deed and the open one—and stash 'em in a clay jar so they last a long time."

15.text: "'Cause the Lord says: Folks gon' own homes, land, and vineyards in this place again."

16.text: After I gave Baruch the deed, I prayed:

17.text: "Lord God, You made heaven and earth with Your power. Ain't nothin' too hard for You."
