9.text: Low-class folks? Just a puff of smoke. High-class folks? A whole lie. Put both on a scale—they don't even weigh more than air.

10.text: Don't lean on injustice. Don't bet on dirty money. And if your pockets get heavy? Don't let your heart get caught up in it.

11.text: God already said it once—and I heard it twice: Power belongs to God.

12.text: And mercy? That's Yours too, Lord. 'Cause You pay everybody back for how they move.

1.text: God, You my God. I'm up early searchin' for You. My soul thirsty, my body reachin'—like I'm in a dry land with no water.

2.text: I been lookin' for You in the sanctuary—tryna see Your power, tryna feel Your glory.

3.text: Your love? Better than life itself. So I'ma praise You with these lips.

4.text: Long as I'm breathin', I'ma bless You. I'ma lift my hands high in Your name.

5.text: You fill me up like a soul feast—like rich food for the spirit. My mouth gon' praise You with joy.

6.text: Even when I'm layin' in bed at night, I'm thinkin' 'bout You. Meditatin' on You when everything quiet.

7.text: You been my help, Lord. So under the shadow of Your wings? I'ma rejoice.

8.text: My soul clings tight to You—and Your right hand holdin' me up.

9.text: But the ones tryna take me out? They headed straight to the dirt.

10.text: They gon' fall by the sword—left out in the wild for jackals to claim.

11.text: But the king? He rejoicin' in God. Everybody who swears by Him gon' celebrate. But liars? They mouths gon' get shut.

1.text: God, listen to me when I pray—protect me from fear when the enemy out here movin'.

2.text: Hide me from the ones schemin' in secret—from folks plottin' rebellion and evil.

3.text: They sharp with their tongues like swords. They pull back words like arrows—biting, bitter words.

4.text: They shoot from the shadows at people who ain't even done nothin'. No hesitation. No fear.

5.text: They hype each other up to do wrong. They talk slick about setting traps in the dark. Like, 'Ain't nobody gon' see us.'

6.text: They plotting deep—slick with it. 'We got this plan down to a science.' But God sees that mess—He know every hidden thought.

7.text: But God? He got arrows too. He gon' shoot back—and they gon' get hit quick.

8.text: They gon' trip over their own mouths—get caught up in their own lies. Folks gon' see it and run the other way.

9.text: Then everybody gon' fear God. They gon' talk about what He did—and really think on it.

10.text: The righteous? They gon' be glad in the Lord, put their trust in Him. And everybody with a real heart? They gon' praise loud.

1.text: Praise stay ready for You, God, up in Zion. And we gon' keep our vows to You.

2.text: You the One who hears prayer. That's why everybody—no matter who they are—gonna come to You.

3.text: Sin been heavy on us. But You? You step in and cover our wrongs.

4.text: Blessed is the one You choose—who You let come close and live in Your space. We stay full off the goodness in Your house, in Your holy place.

5.text: You answer us with wild, righteous works, God of our salvation. You the hope for folks way off across the globe—even way out on the ocean.

6.text: You built the mountains strong, dressed in power.

7.text: You the One who calms the seas when they loud—and hushes the chaos in the people too.

8.text: People way out in the corners of the earth stand in awe when You show up. From sunup to sundown, You make everything sing with joy.

9.text: You visit the earth and give it rain. You bless it heavy. God's river stay full. You make sure there's grain—You planned it all out.

10.text: You drench the soil. Loosen it up. You water every row. Everything start growin' 'cause of Your hand.

11.text: You crown the year with Your goodness, and every step You take drips with blessing.

12.text: Even the wild fields get touched. The little hills dance with joy.

13.text: The pastures dressed up in flocks, the valleys packed with grain. They shout and sing—they can't hold it in.

1.text: Shout for joy to God, everybody—whole earth, lift Him up!

2.text: Sing loud for His name! Make His praise sound glorious.

3.text: Tell God: 'Yo, Your works are crazy amazing! Your power so strong, even Your enemies gotta bow down.'

4.text: The whole earth gon' worship You. They gon' sing praise to You. They gon' lift up Your name with songs.

5.text: Come see what God do. His works toward people? Straight up awesome.

6.text: He turned the sea into dry land—they walked across the river on foot. And we still celebratin' Him for that.

7.text: He rules with power that don't fade. He watchin' every nation. So don't think rebellion gon' slide past Him.

8.text: Bless God, y'all! Let His praise ring loud!

9.text: He's the one keepin' us alive. He don't let us slip.

10.text: You tested us, God. You refined us like silver in the fire.

11.text: You let us get caught up. You laid weight on our backs.

12.text: People rode over our heads—we been through the fire and the flood. But You brought us out into a good place, a rich spot.

13.text: Now I'ma bring offerings to Your house. I'ma pay my vows, Lord.

14.text: The ones I promised when I was beggin' You for help.

15.text: I'ma bring the fat offerings—rams smellin' sweet, bulls and goats—all for You.

16.text: Come here, everybody who respects God—let me tell y'all what He did for me.

17.text: I cried out to Him with my mouth, and I lifted Him up with my words.

18.text: If I had hidden sin in my heart? He wouldn't have listened.

19.text: But God did hear me. He paid attention when I prayed.

20.text: Praise God! He didn't shut me out. He didn't withhold His mercy!

1.text: God, show us mercy and bless us. Let Your face shine on us.

2.text: So that the whole world can know Your way—and every nation can see Your salvation.

3.text: Let the people praise You, God—all the people.

4.text: Let the nations rejoice and sing with joy! 'Cause You judge with fairness, and You run this earth right.

5.text: Let the people praise You, God—every last one of 'em.

6.text: Then the earth gon' produce more. Our God—the One who's ours—He gon' bless us.

7.text: Yes, God will bless us. And every corner of the earth gon' respect Him.

1.text: Let God rise up! Let His enemies scatter! Let everybody who hate Him run for cover.

2.text: Blow 'em away like smoke in the wind. Melt 'em like wax near fire. That's what happens when God shows up.

3.text: But the righteous? They gon' be glad. They gon' rejoice in His presence—big time.

4.text: Sing to God! Praise His name! Lift up the One who rides the clouds. His name is Yah—go ahead and shout before Him.

5.text: He's a Father to the fatherless, defender of widows—that's who God is in His holy place.

6.text: He puts lonely people in families. He sets prisoners free and blesses 'em. But the rebellious? They stay stuck in dry places.

7.text: God, when You stepped out in front of Your people, when You marched through the wilderness—

8.text: The earth shook, the skies poured rain when You showed up, God. Mount Sinai moved at the presence of Israel's God.

9.text: You sent rain, Lord—plenty of it. You refreshed Your tired people.

10.text: Your people lived in that place. You took care of the poor outta Your own goodness.

11.text: You dropped the Word, Lord—and a whole army of women shouted it loud.

12.text: Kings ran off—they fled! And the women back home divided the loot.

13.text: Even y'all layin' low by the sheep pens—y'all gon' shine like silver-winged doves, gold feathers in the sun.

14.text: When the Almighty scattered kings, it looked like fresh snow on Mount Zalmon.

15.text: The mountain of Bashan? That big ol' peak? Yeah, it's majestic.

16.text: But don't be jealous, Bashan—'cause God picked Zion as His forever home.

17.text: God rollin' deep—thousands on thousands of angelic chariots. The Lord is right there among them, just like He was at Sinai.

18.text: You rose up high, Lord. Took captivity captive. You even got gifts from the rebels—so You could dwell there.

19.text: Bless the Lord—He load us up with blessings daily. He's the God who saves!

20.text: Our God saves. And when death try to come for us? God got the escape plan.

21.text: But His enemies? He gon' strike 'em down—right in the head.

22.text: God said, 'I'ma bring 'em back from Bashan. Pull 'em up from the sea's depths.'

23.text: So y'all can walk in victory. Even the dogs gon' get their portion from the defeated.

24.text: We saw it—Your parade, God. You, our King, marchin' into the sanctuary.

25.text: Singers in front, musicians followin'. Young women on tambourines dancin' through.

26.text: Praise God in the gathering! Bless the Lord—from the root of Israel.

27.text: There go little Benjamin leadin'. Then Judah's princes, Zebulun's crew, Naphtali's squad.

28.text: God, You gave us strength—now strengthen what You started.

29.text: Because of Your temple in Jerusalem, kings gon' come with gifts.

30.text: Shut down the beasts in the reeds. The bulls and their calves—let all who love war fall back. Bring peace—with silver in hand.

31.text: Envoys comin' from Egypt. Ethiopia stretchin' out her hands to God.

32.text: Sing to God, all nations! Sing praises to the Lord!

33.text: To the One ridin' the ancient heavens! He speaks with power—loud and clear!

34.text: Tell everybody how strong God is. His majesty covers Israel. His power rides in the clouds.

35.text: God, You more awesome than the temple itself. You the One who gives strength and power to Your people. Blessed be God!

1.text: God, save me! I'm in deep—water up to my neck.

2.text: I'm sinkin' in the mud, can't find no solid ground. I'm caught in the flood, gettin' swept under.

3.text: I've cried 'til I'm worn out. My throat dry, my eyes tired from waitin' on You, God.

4.text: I got more enemies than I got hairs on my head—hatin' for no reason. They powerful, tryna take me down, even though I ain't done nothin'. Still endin' up payin' for things I didn't take.

5.text: You know me, God. You see my foolish moments. Ain't nothin' hid from You.

6.text: Don't let the ones who trust You be embarrassed because of me, Lord. Don't let folks who seek You feel played on account of me, O God of Israel.

7.text: I've been clowned and shamed for reppin' You. My face stay covered in it.

8.text: Even my own family don't recognize me. I'm a stranger to them.

9.text: I care so much about Your house, it eats me alive. And when folks hate on You, I end up catchin' that heat too.

10.text: I fasted, I cried, I humbled myself—and they made fun of that too.

11.text: I wore sackcloth to mourn, and they turned me into a joke.

12.text: Leaders at the gate talk about me. Drunks made me their punchline.

13.text: But I'm still prayin' to You, Lord. I know You'll hear me when the time is right. Answer me with Your love and truth.

14.text: Pull me out the mud. Don't let me drown. Rescue me from the haters and the deep water.

15.text: Don't let the flood take me under. Don't let the pit swallow me whole.

16.text: Hear me, Lord—Your love is good. Turn toward me with all that mercy You've got.

17.text: Don't hide from me. I'm in trouble—please answer me quick.

18.text: Come close, redeem me. Save me from these enemies.

19.text: You know what I'm dealin' with—my shame, my pain, my haters? You see it all.

20.text: They broke my heart with all that disrespect. I'm heavy. I looked for someone to care—nobody. Looked for comfort—found none.

21.text: They gave me bitter stuff to eat, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.

22.text: Let their fancy setups turn into traps. Let their blessings backfire.

23.text: Let them go blind to what's real. Make their strength shake.

24.text: Pour out Your anger on them, God. Let Your wrath hit heavy.

25.text: Let their homes stay empty. Let nobody live where they lived.

26.text: They mess with the ones You already wounded. They mock the pain You allowed.

27.text: Pile sin on top of sin. Don't let them walk into Your righteousness.

28.text: Erase their names from the book of life. Don't list them with the righteous.

29.text: But I'm low, Lord. I'm hurtin'. Let Your salvation lift me up.

30.text: I'ma praise Your name with a song. I'ma thank You loud.

31.text: That kind of praise mean more to You than sacrifices.

32.text: The humble gon' see this and celebrate. If you seek God, your heart gon' come alive.

33.text: God listens to the poor. He don't ignore those locked up.

34.text: Let heaven and earth praise Him—even the oceans and everything in 'em.

35.text: God gon' save Zion. He gon' rebuild Judah. His people gon' live there and own it.

36.text: The kids of His servants gon' inherit it. The ones who love His name? They gon' dwell in it.

1.text: Hurry up, God—come get me. Move fast, Lord—I need help!

2.text: Let the ones tryna take me out be embarrassed. Let the ones who want me hurt be shut down and confused.

3.text: Turn 'em around in shame—especially the ones talkin' slick, like, 'Aha! Got him!'

4.text: But everybody who's lookin' for You? Let 'em rejoice. Let 'em be glad in You. And let the ones who love Your salvation keep shoutin', 'God is great!'

5.text: But me? I'm broke and strugglin'. Come quick, God! You my help. You my deliverer. Lord, don't take too long!

1.text: I'm trustin' in You, Lord—don't let me end up embarrassed.

2.text: Come through for me in righteousness. Get me outta this. Lean in and hear me—save me.

3.text: Be my strong spot, my safe place—the one I run to over and over. You already told me You'd save me. You my rock. You my fortress.

4.text: God, pull me outta the hands of the wicked—these cruel, shady people tryna take me down.

5.text: You been my hope since the jump, Lord. I been leanin' on You since I was young.

6.text: You held me up from the womb. You the One who brought me out. So I'ma keep praisin' You—nonstop.

7.text: People look at me like I'm a mystery, but You my safe place.

8.text: Let my mouth stay full of praise for You—all day, every day.

9.text: Don't leave me when I get old, Lord. Don't walk off when my strength start slippin'.

10.text: My enemies whisperin'. They plottin' behind my back.

11.text: They sayin', 'God left him. Now's the time. Ain't nobody comin' to save him.'

12.text: But Lord, don't stay far. Come quick. I need help now.

13.text: Let everybody tryin' to hurt me be embarrassed. Let 'em be brought low and shut down.

14.text: But me? I'ma keep hopin'. I'ma keep praisin'—more and more.

15.text: I'ma talk about how right You are. How You save. All day. And I still don't even know the full of it.

16.text: I'm walkin' in Your strength, God. And I'm only talkin' about Your righteousness.

17.text: You been teachin' me since I was a kid. And I'm still out here tellin' folks about the amazing things You've done.

18.text: So even now that I'm older, with gray hair—don't leave me, God. Let me keep tellin' this generation how strong You are. Let me show the next ones Your power.

19.text: Your righteousness, God? It's sky high. You do great things. Ain't nobody like You.

20.text: You've let me see hard times—deep pain. But You'll lift me back up. You'll raise me out the pit again.

21.text: You gon' increase my influence—and surround me with comfort.

22.text: I'ma praise You with the strings, Lord. I'ma sing about Your faithfulness. You holy, You Israel's One and Only.

23.text: When I sing, my lips gon' rejoice. My soul gon' praise too—'cause You the One who saved me.

24.text: My tongue stay talkin' about how righteous You are—all day. 'Cause the folks who came for me? They embarrassed. They lost.

1.text: God, give the king Your justice. Pass down Your righteousness to the king's son.

2.text: Let him judge Your people the right way—give the poor what's fair.

3.text: Let the mountains bring peace to the people. Let the hills overflow with righteousness.

4.text: Let him stand up for the poor. Save the kids in need. And break the oppressor into pieces.

5.text: May folks fear and respect You as long as the sun and moon shine—through all generations.

6.text: Let him show up like rain fallin' on cut grass, like fresh showers waterin' the land.

7.text: In his days, may the righteous flourish. Let peace be abundant—until the moon gone.

8.text: His reach? From sea to sea. From the river all the way to the edge of the earth.

9.text: Even folks out in the wild gon' bow down. His enemies? They gon' eat dust.

10.text: Kings from Tarshish and the islands gon' bring gifts. Kings from Sheba and Seba showin' up with offerings.

11.text: All kings gon' kneel before Him. Every nation gon' serve Him.

12.text: 'Cause when the needy cry, He hears. When the poor got nobody, He steps in.

13.text: He got mercy on the weak and the broke. He gon' save the souls of the desperate.

14.text: He gon' rescue them from violence and oppression. Their lives matter to Him—they precious in His eyes.

15.text: Long live the King! Folks bringin' Him gold from Sheba. They prayin' for Him every day. Praisin' Him nonstop.

16.text: Grain gon' grow like crazy—even on mountaintops. Fruit flowin' like Lebanon trees. City folks gon' thrive like grass after rain.

17.text: His name? Gon' last forever. Shine as long as the sun. Everybody blessed through Him. All nations gon' call Him blessed.

18.text: Bless the Lord God—the God of Israel—'cause only He does wonders like this.

19.text: Bless His glorious name forever. Let the whole earth be filled with His glory. Amen and amen.

20.text: This wraps up the prayers of David, son of Jesse.

1.text: For real—for real—God is good to Israel, especially to the ones who got a pure heart.

2.text: But me? I almost slipped. My feet were shakin'. I was close to fallin' off.

3.text: I was jealous of the arrogant—'cause I saw how the wicked was livin' large.

4.text: They don't struggle when they die. Their bodies strong all the way through.

5.text: They don't deal with the pain regular folks do. Life ain't hittin' them like it hit us.

6.text: That's why they walkin' around with pride like it's jewelry. Violence wrapped around them like designer coats.

7.text: They got more than enough—eyes full of excess. Hearts overflowin' with everything they want.

8.text: They mockin' folks, speakin' evil. They act like oppression ain't a problem.

9.text: Mouth talkin' reckless about heaven. Tongue out here wildin' through the whole earth.

10.text: And somehow, people still follow them. Drinking it all in like it's sweet.

11.text: They even bold enough to say, 'How God gon' know? Like the Most High really watchin'.'

12.text: This what the wicked look like—livin' easy, stackin' wealth.

13.text: Man… I started wonderin' if livin' right was even worth it. Like I cleaned up for nothin'.

14.text: All day I stay gettin' hit. Every morning it's another lesson.

15.text: But if I had really said all that out loud, I would've been fake toward Your people, Lord.

16.text: Tryin' to make sense of it all messed me up inside.

17.text: Till I stepped into Your sanctuary—and then I saw the bigger picture.

18.text: You got them on slippery ground. They headed straight for a crash.

19.text: One minute they up, next they destroyed. Gone in a blink—shook and swallowed up.

20.text: They like a dream You forget when You wake up. When You show up, Lord, it's a wrap.

21.text: That realization broke me. Had my heart all twisted.

22.text: I was trippin'. Ignorant. Actin' like a wild animal in front of You.

23.text: But even then—you stayed with me. Held me by the hand.

24.text: You still givin' me wisdom. And when it's all said and done? You gon' bring me into glory.

25.text: Ain't nobody in heaven but You. And down here? You the only One I really want.

26.text: My flesh? My heart? They may fail. But God? You my strength and my portion—forever.

27.text: Folks who wander from You? They gon' perish. Anybody leavin' You for idols? Done.

28.text: But me? I'm stayin' close to God. I'm puttin' my trust in the Lord—so I can tell the world about what He's done.

1.text: God, why You actin' like You done with us? Why Your anger burnin' against Your own sheep—Your people?

2.text: Remember Your crew, Lord—the ones You bought way back. The tribe You claimed, the folks You saved. This Mount Zion where You used to dwell.

3.text: Step up, Lord—look at the ruins. The enemy wrecked everything in Your sanctuary.

4.text: They loud in the middle of Your meeting place—screamin' like they own it. They put up their own banners where Yours used to be.

5.text: They came in swingin' like lumberjacks, axes in hand, choppin' like they was cuttin' down trees.

6.text: They smashed up all the carved art—busted it up with axes and hammers like it meant nothin'.

7.text: Then they set fire to Your holy place—burned it down and dragged Your name through the dirt.

8.text: They said, 'Let's wipe them out completely.' And they really torched every spot where You used to be worshiped.

9.text: We can't see no signs from You. No more prophets. Nobody even knows how long this gon' last.

10.text: God, how long You gon' let the enemy clown us? They out here disrespectin' Your name nonstop—forever?

11.text: Why You keep holdin' back Your hand? Pull out Your power and handle them.

12.text: You've always been our King, Lord. You save right here in the middle of the world.

13.text: You split the sea with power. You crushed sea monsters in the deep.

14.text: You broke Leviathan's head into pieces—served him up like scraps for folks in the wilderness.

15.text: You opened up springs and rivers. You dried up strong currents with a word.

16.text: You own the day and the night. You set the sun in place. You made light what it is.

17.text: You drew the borders of the earth. You created summer and winter.

18.text: Lord, remember this: the enemy been out here talkin' reckless. Foolish people draggin' Your name.

19.text: Don't let Your precious ones—like Your turtledove—get snatched by wild beasts. Don't forget the poor forever.

20.text: Remember Your promise. The world feel dark and violent out here. Evil lurks in every corner.

21.text: Don't let the oppressed stay ashamed. Let the poor and the broken rise up and praise You.

22.text: Get up, God! Fight for Your name. Don't forget how they mock You every day.

23.text: Don't ignore the voices of Your enemies. The noise of their hate just keeps gettin' louder.

1.text: We thank You, God—we thank You loud! 'Cause Your works let everybody know You close.

2.text: God says, "I move when the time is right. I judge fair, no cap."

3.text: "When the earth feel like it's fallin' apart and folks panickin'? I'm the one holdin' the pillars steady."

4.text: "I told the cocky folks, 'Chill with all that pride.' Told the wicked, 'Don't be out here flexin' like you untouchable.'"

5.text: "Don't lift yourself up like you run things. Don't talk slick with that proud energy."

6.text: "'Cause elevation don't come from the east, west, or south."

7.text: "God is the one who promotes. He the Judge. He bring folks down—and He lift folks up."

8.text: "The Lord got a cup in His hand—it's full, strong, and mixed. He pour it out, and the wicked gon' drink it to the last drop—bitter dregs and all."

9.text: "But I'ma keep speakin' on this forever. I'ma keep singin' to the God of Jacob."

10.text: "God gon' cut off all the horns—all that power—from the wicked. But the righteous? Their horn gon' rise."

1.text: God got a name in Judah. He's known, and His name ring out in Israel.

2.text: His place of worship is in Salem. His home base? Zion.

3.text: That's where He broke the arrows, snapped the shields, shut down the swords and the whole battle setup.

4.text: You shine brighter than any mountain full of trophies. You more glorious than anything they ever conquered.

5.text: The bold and brave? They laid out. Sleepin' like they never knew how to fight. Their strength don't mean nothin' now.

6.text: One word from You, God of Jacob—and the chariots and horses knocked out cold.

7.text: You deserve to be feared. Who can even stand when You get mad?

8.text: From heaven, You let judgment be heard. Earth went silent—shook and still.

9.text: You stood up to judge, God. You rose to rescue the ones gettin' crushed down here.

10.text: Even human anger gon' end up praisin' You. And whatever rage is left? You gon' wear that like a belt.

11.text: So go ahead—make those vows to the Lord your God and keep 'em. Everybody close to Him? Bring Him gifts. He's worthy of that fear.

12.text: He cuts off the breath of princes. He don't play with power. God is awesome—even kings gotta bow.

1.text: I cried out to God with everything in me—yeah, I lifted my voice to Him. And He heard me.

2.text: In my worst moment, I reached for the Lord. I was up all night, hands stretched out—couldn't stop. But my soul? Wouldn't even take comfort.

3.text: I tried to remember God—but it just made me feel worse. I kept complainin' till I felt completely overwhelmed.

4.text: You the one keepin' my eyes wide open, Lord. I'm so stressed, I can't even speak.

5.text: I started thinkin' back on the old days… on how it used to be.

6.text: I pulled up songs from the night. I tried to talk to myself, tried to search my own heart for answers.

7.text: Did the Lord leave me for good? He done being good to me?

8.text: Did His mercy run out? Are His promises done forever?

9.text: Did God forget how to show grace? Is He mad forever—holdin' back His love?

10.text: And I said, 'This pain I feel is real… but I'm still gon' remember the years when the Most High moved His right hand.'

11.text: I'ma think on all the things You've done, Lord. I won't forget the wonders You worked back in the day.

12.text: I'ma meditate on all Your works—and I'ma talk about how You move.

13.text: God, Your way is holy. Ain't no god like our God.

14.text: You the One who do miracles. You show Your strength to the world.

15.text: With Your own arm, You saved Your people—the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.

16.text: When the waters saw You, God—they panicked. Even the deep parts shook in fear.

17.text: The clouds poured heavy. The sky cracked loud. Lightning flew like arrows.

18.text: Thunder roared through the storm. The sky lit up like fire. The earth trembled and shook.

19.text: Your path was through the sea, Your way through deep waters—but nobody could track Your footsteps.

20.text: Still, You led Your people like sheep—guiding them by Moses and Aaron's hand.

1.text: Listen up, my people—hear the law. Lean in to what I'm about to say.

2.text: I'ma speak in parables. I'm bringin' up deep stuff from way back.

3.text: Stories we heard and already know—the ones our folks passed down to us.

4.text: We ain't keepin' it to ourselves. We tellin' the next generation how great God is—His strength, His works, all He's done.

5.text: He set up a testimony with Jacob, gave Israel the law, and told our fathers, 'Pass this on to your kids.'

6.text: So the next generation would know, and their kids would rise up and tell their kids.

7.text: So they'd put their hope in God, remember His works, and keep His commandments.

8.text: Not like their stubborn, rebellious ancestors—folks whose hearts were off, whose spirit ain't stay true to God.

9.text: Ephraim's people had weapons, they were strapped—but still turned back when it was time to fight.

10.text: They broke God's covenant. Refused to walk in His law.

11.text: They forgot what He'd done—His wonders they had seen with their own eyes.

12.text: He did wild miracles in front of their daddies—out in Egypt, in the fields of Zoan.

13.text: Split the sea wide open. Led them through. Made water stand tall like walls.

14.text: Gave 'em cloud cover by day, and fire light all night.

15.text: Split rocks in the desert—gave 'em water like rivers from the depths.

16.text: Made streams flow from stone—water gushed like it came from a faucet.

17.text: But they still sinned. Kept testin' God out there in the wilderness.

18.text: They got bold—demanded food they craved, like they was in charge.

19.text: Talkin' slick like, 'Can God even set a table in the desert?'

20.text: 'Yeah, He hit the rock and water poured out—but can He bring us bread? Meat, though?'

21.text: God heard that and got heated. Fire broke out in Jacob. Anger rose against Israel.

22.text: Why? 'Cause they ain't believe in God. Ain't trust His deliverance.

23.text: But He still opened up heaven and dropped blessings.

24.text: Rained down manna—bread straight from glory.

25.text: They ate angel food. And they had more than enough.

26.text: He stirred up the wind—brought meat from the skies.

27.text: Rained down quail like dust—birds like sea sand.

28.text: They landed right in camp, all around their tents.

29.text: They ate 'til they was full. God gave 'em what they asked for.

30.text: But while they were still chewin', God's judgment hit.

31.text: He struck down the strongest men—took out the best of Israel.

32.text: Even after all that, they kept sinning. Still didn't believe in His power.

33.text: So He let them waste years in vanity—livin' scared.

34.text: When folks started droppin', then they ran back to God.

35.text: They remembered—'Oh snap, He's our rock. Our Redeemer.'

36.text: But it was just talk. They flattered Him with lies.

37.text: He saw their hearts weren't real. They stayed breakin' the covenant.

38.text: Still, God was full of mercy. He forgave, didn't wipe them out. Pulled back His anger over and over.

39.text: He remembered—they just flesh. Like breath in the wind—here, then gone.

40.text: Over and over, they disrespected Him in the wilderness. Broke His heart in the desert.

41.text: Kept testin' Him. They put limits on the Holy One of Israel.

42.text: They forgot how powerful He is—how He saved them from Egypt.

43.text: All the signs He did there—wonders in Zoan.

44.text: Turned rivers to blood. Water undrinkable.

45.text: Sent flies and frogs—infestations that wrecked everything.

46.text: Crops got eaten by bugs. Everything they worked for—gone.

47.text: Hail took out their vineyards. Frost hit their fig trees.

48.text: Hail hit their cattle. Lightning hit the flocks.

49.text: God unleashed full wrath—anger, fury, trouble—sent destructive angels on 'em.

50.text: He cleared the way for His judgment. No mercy. They faced death and plague.

51.text: Took out all Egypt's firstborn—strength of their homes, gone.

52.text: But His people? He led them like sheep. Guided them gently in the wild.

53.text: They walked safe. No fear. Meanwhile, the sea drowned their enemies.

54.text: He brought them to holy ground—the mountain He picked.

55.text: Drove out nations. Handed over the land. Gave every tribe their spot.

56.text: But they still tested God. Still pushed His limits. Still ignored His laws.

57.text: Just like their ancestors—unfaithful, unreliable, like a bow that won't shoot straight.

58.text: Made Him mad with idols. Got Him jealous with carved images.

59.text: God heard it, got furious. Started to hate what Israel had become.

60.text: Left Shiloh—His dwelling place. The tent where He lived among them.

61.text: Let His power get captured. His glory snatched by enemies.

62.text: Let His people fall by the sword. Was angry with His own inheritance.

63.text: Fire consumed the young men. The women had no weddings.

64.text: Priests killed in battle. Widows too numb to cry.

65.text: Then God woke up—like a warrior sobering up from wine.

66.text: He beat the enemy back. Shamed them permanently.

67.text: He dropped Joseph's tribe. Didn't choose Ephraim.

68.text: He picked Judah instead. Picked Zion. Said, 'This where I stay.'

69.text: Built His sanctuary strong—high like the heavens, grounded like the earth.

70.text: Then He chose David—pulled him from the sheep pen.

71.text: Took him from watching ewes to lead His people—Jacob and Israel.

72.text: And David led with integrity and guided them with skilled hands.

1.text: God... the nations came in and wrecked what's Yours. They violated Your holy temple. They left Jerusalem in ruins.

2.text: Your people—Your servants—they left their bodies in the streets. Birds eatin' on them. Wild animals feedin' off saints like it's nothin'.

3.text: They spilled blood like water all around the city—and ain't nobody left to bury them.

4.text: Now we a joke to the neighbors. Everybody around us mockin' and laughin'.

5.text: How long, Lord? You gon' stay mad forever? Is Your jealousy burnin' like wildfire?

6.text: Pour that anger on the ones who don't even know You. On kingdoms that never called Your name.

7.text: They the ones who destroyed Jacob. Tore up everything we had.

8.text: Don't hold our past sins against us. Let Your mercy meet us quick—'cause we down bad.

9.text: Help us, God of our salvation—for Your name's glory! Save us. Forgive us. Not 'cause we deserve it, but to rep Your name right!

10.text: Why should these nations get to say, 'Where's their God now?' Let 'em see You avenge the blood of Your servants.

11.text: Let the cries of the locked-up reach You. Use Your power to keep alive the ones marked for death.

12.text: Pay our enemies back, Lord—sevenfold. They been throwin' Your name in the dirt.

13.text: But we? We Your people. The sheep You shepherd. We gon' thank You forever. We gon' praise You through every generation.

1.text: Listen up, Shepherd of Israel—You who lead Joseph's tribe like a flock. You sittin' between the cherubim—shine!

2.text: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh—flex Your strength and pull up to save us!

3.text: Bring us back, God. Let Your face shine bright—and we'll be saved.

4.text: Lord God of Heaven's armies, how long You gon' be mad—even while we pray?

5.text: You been feedin' us tears for bread. Our cups overflowin'—with sorrow.

6.text: You made us a problem to our neighbors. Our enemies over there crackin' jokes at our pain.

7.text: Restore us, Lord of hosts. Let Your face shine again—and we gon' be alright.

8.text: You pulled a vine up outta Egypt. You cleared out the nations and planted it.

9.text: You made space, gave it room to grow. It rooted deep and spread all over the land.

10.text: The hills were shaded by its branches. Even the tallest trees got covered.

11.text: It stretched all the way to the sea—its branches reached to the river.

12.text: So why You tear down the hedge around it? Now everybody walkin' by pickin' at it.

13.text: The wild boar from the woods tearin' it up. Beasts from the field feastin' on it.

14.text: Please, God of hosts—turn back to us. Look down from heaven. Come check on Your vine.

15.text: That vineyard You planted with Your own hand. That branch You made strong for Yourself.

16.text: It's burned up. Cut down. Perishin' from just one look from You.

17.text: Put Your hand on the one at Your right hand—the son of man You raised up.

18.text: Then we won't turn from You again. Breathe life into us, and we'll call Your name for real.

19.text: Restore us, Lord God of hosts. Let Your face shine—and we gon' be saved.

1.text: Sing loud to God—He our strength! Shout for joy to the God of Jacob!

2.text: Start up the music—hit the tambourine, the sweet harp, and the lute!

3.text: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, and again at the full moon on our feast day.

4.text: This ain't random—it's law. A command from the God of Jacob.

5.text: He set it in place for Joseph when He went through Egypt—back when I heard a language I ain't even understand.

6.text: God says, "I took that burden off your shoulders. Your hands ain't carry no more heavy baskets."

7.text: "You called Me when you were in trouble—and I came through. I answered from the storm. I tested you at Meribah's waters."

8.text: "Listen, My people—I'm tryin' to teach you something! Israel, hear Me out!"

9.text: "Don't let no foreign gods in your life. Don't bow to anything that ain't Me."

10.text: "I'm the Lord your God—the One who brought you outta Egypt. Open your mouth wide—I'll fill it."

11.text: "But My people ain't tryna hear Me. Israel acted like I wasn't even there."

12.text: "So I let 'em go—they chose stubbornness, they followed their own plans."

13.text: "But oh, if they would just listen… If they'd walk the way I laid out for 'em…"

14.text: "I would've crushed their enemies quick. I would've flipped the script on their oppressors."

15.text: "Even My haters would've had to fake submission—but they'd be stuck in their fate."

16.text: "And My people? I would've fed 'em the best of wheat. I would've satisfied 'em with honey straight from the rock."

1.text: God showin' up in the middle of the courtroom—standing in the circle of power, judging all these so-called gods.

2.text: He askin': 'How long y'all gon' keep ruling unfairly? How long you gon' keep siding with the wicked?'

3.text: Stand up for the poor and the fatherless. Give real justice to the oppressed and those in need.

4.text: Rescue the ones who can't fight for themselves. Pull them out the grip of the wicked.

5.text: These folks ain't got no clue. No understanding. They movin' blind—and the whole earth shakin' because of it.

6.text: I told y'all, 'You gods, right? You children of the Most High.'

7.text: But you still gon' die like mere men. You gon' fall like every other fallen prince.

8.text: So rise up, God! Bring real judgment to the earth—'cause all nations belong to You anyway.

1.text: Don't stay quiet, God! Don't hold back! Don't be still—please, speak up!

2.text: Look, Your enemies wildin'—makin' noise, gettin' bold, liftin' their heads in pride.

3.text: They schemin' behind closed doors against Your people. Plotting on the ones You protect.

4.text: They say, 'Let's wipe 'em out—make Israel disappear so nobody even remembers them.'

5.text: They all linkin' up with the same goal—they rollin' deep against You, God.

6.text: It's Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites,

7.text: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, Philistia and Tyre's people—

8.text: Even Assyria joined the squad. They backin' up the children of Lot.

9.text: God, do 'em like You did Midian, like Sisera and Jabin at the Kishon stream—

10.text: Who got dropped at En Dor, turned into nothin' but dust on the ground.

11.text: Take their leaders down like Oreb and Zeeb—yeah, like Zebah and Zalmunna too.

12.text: These fools said, 'Let's take God's land for ourselves. We gon' own what He set up.'

13.text: God, make 'em like dust in the wind—like trash blowin' down the street.

14.text: Burn 'em up like wildfire in the woods, like flames racin' up the mountain.

15.text: Chase 'em with Your storm. Scare 'em with Your whirlwind.

16.text: Cover their faces in shame—so maybe they'll finally call on Your name, Lord.

17.text: Let 'em be confused and embarrassed forever. Let 'em fall off and perish.

18.text: So the world knows that You, and You alone, are the Lord—the Most High over the whole earth.

1.text: Lord of Heaven's Armies, Your house is beautiful—straight up lovely.

2.text: My soul is cravin' it—like I'm about to pass out from hunger. My heart and even my body cryin' out for You, the living God.

3.text: Even the sparrow got a spot to call home, and the swallow found a nest to lay her babies—right there by Your altars, Lord of hosts, my King and my God.

4.text: Blessed are the ones who get to live in Your house. They stay praisin' You.

5.text: Blessed are the ones who lean on Your strength, who keep movin' with purpose toward You.

6.text: When they pass through the Valley of Baca (that dry, sorrowful place), they turn it into a spring. Rain falls, blessings flow.

7.text: They go from strength to strength—every one of 'em shows up before God in Zion.

8.text: Lord God of hosts, please hear me. God of Jacob, I'm callin'—listen close.

9.text: God, look out for us like a shield. Keep Your eyes on the one You've chosen.

10.text: One day in Your courts? That's better than a thousand anywhere else. I'd rather hold the door at Your house than live large in the tents of wickedness.

11.text: The Lord God is both sun and shield. He gives grace and glory. And He don't hold back any good thing from those who walk right.

12.text: Lord of hosts, the one who trusts You? That one's already blessed.

1.text: Lord, You been real good to this land. You brought Jacob's people back home.

2.text: You forgave all our sins. Covered every wrong we ever did.

3.text: You pulled back Your anger. You put out the fire of Your wrath.

4.text: Bring us back, God our Savior. Let the beef be over.

5.text: You gon' stay mad forever? Gon' keep this going for generations?

6.text: Ain't You gon' revive us again? So we can rejoice in You for real?

7.text: Show us that mercy, Lord. Drop that salvation.

8.text: I'ma listen for what the Lord God says. He gon' speak peace to His people, His faithful ones—but we can't go back to the same old foolishness.

9.text: His saving power stay close to the ones who respect Him—so glory can live in the land again.

10.text: Mercy and truth finally met up. Righteousness and peace locked lips.

11.text: Truth gon' rise up from the ground. Righteousness lookin' down from the sky.

12.text: Yes—God gon' bless us with good things. The land gon' produce again.

13.text: Righteousness walkin' ahead of Him—makin' a way for His steps to lead us.

1.text: Lord, lean in and hear me. I'm broke and needin' You bad.

2.text: Protect my life—I'm Yours. You my God. Save me, Your servant, 'cause I trust You for real.

3.text: Have mercy on me, Lord. I been cryin' out to You all day.

4.text: Bring joy to this tired soul, 'cause I'm liftin' it up to You.

5.text: You good, Lord. Quick to forgive. Overflowin' with mercy for anybody who calls on You.

6.text: Listen to my prayer, Lord. Pay attention when I'm callin' out.

7.text: When trouble hits, I call You—'cause I know You gon' answer.

8.text: Ain't no other gods like You, Lord. Nobody do what You do.

9.text: Every nation You made? They gon' come worship You and give You glory.

10.text: You do great things—wonders. Only You are truly God.

11.text: Teach me how to move in Your ways, Lord. I'ma walk in truth. Tie my heart to Yours so I fear Your name right.

12.text: I'ma praise You, Lord my God, with everything I got. I'ma lift Your name up forever.

13.text: Your mercy for me is major. You pulled me out the grave—rescued me from the deep.

14.text: Lord, arrogant folks gunnin' for me. Violent people tryna take me out. They don't care nothin' about You.

15.text: But You? You full of compassion, Lord. You gracious. Patient. Overflowin' with mercy and truth.

16.text: Turn toward me. Show me that mercy. Give me strength—I'm Your servant. Save me like You would save Your own mama's child.

17.text: Give me a sign—something good. Let my haters see it and feel ashamed. 'Cause You, Lord, been helpin' me… and holdin' me down.

1.text: God built His foundation up in the holy mountains.

2.text: The Lord got a special love for the gates of Zion—more than any other place in Jacob's territory.

3.text: Glorious things been said about you, city of God. You legendary.

4.text: God says, "I'ma shout out Rahab and Babylon when I talk to those who know Me. Same with Philistia, Tyre, and Ethiopia—'That one was born there.'"

5.text: But when it comes to Zion, folks gon' say, 'This one—and that one too—was born right here.' And the Most High? He's the one who made her solid.

6.text: God Himself keeps the receipts. When He take roll and count the nations, He gon' say, 'That one right there? Born in Zion.'

7.text: And all the singers, all the musicians gon' say the same thing: 'All my roots, all my joy, all my flow—it started in you.'

1.text: Lord, You my God—my only hope of salvation. I been cryin' to You day and night.

2.text: Please hear me. Let my prayers reach You. Don't ignore my cry.

3.text: I'm full of pain. My life feel like it's right on the edge of the grave.

4.text: People treat me like I'm already gone. Like I'm dead weight with no strength left.

5.text: I'm floatin' in the land of the dead—like the bodies in the grave You don't even seem to see no more. Like I'm cut off from Your hand.

6.text: You the one who let me sink this low. I'm in deep darkness. Rock bottom.

7.text: Your anger is crushin' me. Every wave hittin' me, over and over.

8.text: You pushed everybody away from me. Now they act like I'm cursed. I'm trapped. Ain't no way out.

9.text: My eyes done cried themselves out. Still, Lord—I call You every day. I stretch my hands out to You.

10.text: Can the dead see miracles? They gon' rise up from the grave and praise You?

11.text: Can anybody talk about Your love from the grave? Can folks buried in ruin speak on Your faithfulness?

12.text: Who gon' know Your power in the darkness? Who can testify to Your righteousness from the place where people forgotten?

13.text: But I keep cryin' to You, Lord. Every morning I'm right back at it—prayin', callin', beggin'.

14.text: Why You pushin' me away, God? Why You hidin' from me like this?

15.text: I been sufferin' since I was young. Now I'm barely holdin' on. Your terrors got me paralyzed.

16.text: Your anger swept over me like a storm. Your blows cut me deep.

17.text: Trouble surroundin' me like floodwater—all day, every direction. I'm drownin' in it.

18.text: You done pulled everybody from my life. Now all I got left… is darkness.

1.text: I'ma sing about the Lord's mercy forever. I'ma let everybody—generation to generation—know He's faithful.

2.text: I said, 'God's mercy gonna last forever.' And His truth? It's locked in place—up in the heavens.

3.text: God said, "I made a covenant with My chosen one. I swore to David, My servant—

4.text: 'Your bloodline gon' last forever. Your throne? I'ma build that to stand through all generations.'

5.text: The heavens stay shoutin' about how You move, Lord. All the saints speak on Your faithfulness.

6.text: Ain't nobody in heaven like You. None of the mighty can match You.

7.text: God's feared in the assembly of the saints. Everybody near Him shows respect.

8.text: Lord God of Heaven's Armies—ain't nobody mighty like You. You wear faithfulness like a robe.

9.text: You the one who runs the sea. When it gets wild, You shut it down.

10.text: You crushed Rahab like a dead man. Your strong arm scattered enemies.

11.text: Heaven and earth? That's all Yours. You made the whole world and everything in it.

12.text: North and south? You built that too. Tabor and Hermon sing about Your name.

13.text: Your arm strong, Your hand firm, and Your right hand lifted high.

14.text: Righteousness and justice? That's the foundation of Your throne. Mercy and truth always walk ahead of You.

15.text: Blessed are the ones who know the joyful sound. They live in the light of Your presence.

16.text: They celebrate Your name all day. They lifted high by Your righteousness.

17.text: You're the reason they strong. Your favor is what raises their head.

18.text: Our shield? Belongs to the Lord. Our King? That's the Holy One of Israel.

19.text: You spoke in a vision, Lord, and said: 'I lifted up a strong one. I picked him from the people.'

20.text: 'I found David, My servant. I poured holy oil on him.'

21.text: 'My hand gon' keep him steady. My arm gon' keep him strong.'

22.text: 'Enemies won't trick him. Wicked folks can't hurt him.'

23.text: 'I'ma crush his haters and take down anybody comin' for him.'

24.text: 'My mercy and truth gon' walk with him. And I'ma lift him up in My name.'

25.text: 'He'll rule over sea and river—his hands on both.'

26.text: 'He gon' call Me, "Father—my God, my Rock, my salvation."'

27.text: 'I'ma make him My firstborn—top of the top, highest king on earth.'

28.text: 'My love? Forever. My covenant? Solid.'

29.text: 'His line will last. His throne gon' stand like heaven.'

30.text: 'But if his sons wild out—disrespect My law and ignore My ways—'

31.text: 'If they break My rules and skip My commands—'

32.text: 'I'ma check them. I'ma discipline them with the rod and stripes.'

33.text: 'But I still won't cut off My love. I won't cancel My faithfulness.'

34.text: 'I ain't breakin' My promise. I'm not goin' back on what I said.'

35.text: 'I swore by My own holiness—I don't lie to David.'

36.text: 'His line gon' last forever. His throne gon' shine like the sun.'

37.text: 'Locked in like the moon. A faithful witness in the sky.'

38.text: But Lord… You pushed us away. You rejected the one You anointed. You mad.

39.text: You tossed aside the covenant You made. His crown? In the dirt.

40.text: You broke down every wall around him. Left his strongholds in ruins.

41.text: Now everybody passin' by just takin' what they want. He a joke to the neighbors.

42.text: You let his enemies win. Gave them the upper hand.

43.text: You made his sword dull. Didn't even back him in the fight.

44.text: You ended his glory. Threw his throne to the ground.

45.text: You cut his youth short. Covered him in shame.

46.text: How long, Lord? You gon' stay hidden forever? Is Your anger permanent?

47.text: Remember how short life is! You made humans so fragile—was all this just for nothin'?

48.text: Who can escape death? Who can dodge the grave?

49.text: Where's that love You promised, Lord? The one You swore to David in truth?

50.text: Look at how Your servants are gettin' mocked, Lord. I carry that pain in my chest every day.

51.text: Your enemies ain't just mocking us—they clownin' the steps of Your anointed.

52.text: But still—blessed be the Lord forever. Amen and Amen.

1.text: Lord, You been our home—generation after generation.

2.text: Before the mountains showed up, before the earth was even formed—from forever to forever, You still God.

3.text: You send people back to the dirt, sayin', 'Return, y'all just human.'

4.text: To You, a thousand years ain't nothin'—just yesterday gone by. Just a quick night shift.

5.text: You sweep folks away like a flood. Life be like a dream. Like grass that grow in the morning—

6.text: Sproutin' up early, but by sunset? Cut down and withered.

7.text: We feel the weight of Your anger. Your wrath got us shook.

8.text: You see all our mess—stuff we try to hide? It's out in the open in Your light.

9.text: Every day we livin' under Your judgment. We end our years with nothin' but a tired breath.

10.text: We get 70 years—maybe 80 if we strong. But even then, it's struggle and stress. Then it's over—and we gone.

11.text: Who really understands how deep Your anger is? The way we fear You should match the weight of Your wrath.

12.text: So Lord, teach us to count our days—help us get a wise heart.

13.text: Come back, Lord. How long You gon' wait? Show mercy to Your people.

14.text: Let us wake up to Your love early—so we can be glad, not just sometimes, but all our days.

15.text: Balance it out, Lord—give us joy to match the years we been hurtin'.

16.text: Let us see You work again. And let our kids see Your glory shine.

17.text: Put Your beauty on us, Lord. Bless the work of our hands—make it count. Yes, Lord—make it last.

1.text: The one who stays close in God's secret place gon' live under His shadow—safe under the Almighty.

2.text: I'ma say it loud: the Lord is my safe spot, my fortress—my God. I trust Him with it all.

3.text: He gon' save you from traps set by the enemy, and from every deadly disease out there.

4.text: He gon' cover you with His feathers—wrap you up under His wings. His truth gon' be your armor and shield.

5.text: You ain't gotta be scared of things goin' bump in the night—or arrows flyin' in the daytime.

6.text: You ain't gotta fear no disease creepin' in the dark, or destruction showin' up midday, loud and reckless.

7.text: A thousand might fall right next to you—ten thousand on your other side—but it won't touch you.

8.text: You'll see it with your own eyes—the wicked gettin' what's theirs.

9.text: Why? 'Cause you made the Lord your refuge—the Most High your home.

10.text: Ain't no evil comin' for you. No sickness touchin' your spot.

11.text: God got His angels on assignment—keepin' you safe wherever you go.

12.text: They'll hold you up with their hands—so you won't even stub your toe on a rock.

13.text: You'll walk right over lions and cobras—stomp on serpents and beasts like it's nothin'.

14.text: God says, "Because you love Me for real, I'm gon' rescue you. I'll lift you up 'cause you know My name."

15.text: "You'll call Me—I'ma answer. I'll be right there in the struggle. I'll pull you out and lift you up with honor."

16.text: "I'll give you a long life, full of My goodness—and let you see what salvation really looks like."

1.text: It's a beautiful thing to give thanks to the Lord—and to sing praises to You, Most High!

2.text: To wake up talkin' about Your love, and end the night speakin' on Your faithfulness.

3.text: On a ten-string, a smooth lute, and a harp—playin' real harmonious.

4.text: Lord, You got me smilin' off what You done. I'ma shout in victory over the work of Your hands.

5.text: Lord, Your works go crazy! And Your thoughts? Deep, deep.

6.text: Fools don't get it. People with no sense won't even try to understand.

7.text: Yeah, the wicked might pop up fast like weeds. And the evil might be flourishin'—but that's just setup for their downfall. They won't last.

8.text: But You, Lord? You stay high. Forever.

9.text: Your enemies, Lord—they gon' be wiped out. Every one of 'em scattered.

10.text: But me? You lifted my horn like a wild ox—gave me fresh oil, a whole new anointing.

11.text: My eyes already seen the fall of my enemies. My ears heard about them haters goin' down.

12.text: The righteous? They flourish like palm trees. Growin' tall and strong like cedars in Lebanon.

13.text: They planted in God's house—rooted deep. They flourish right there in His courts.

14.text: Even in old age, they still bear fruit. Still fresh. Still vibrant.

15.text: All to say one thing: the Lord is righteous. He my solid rock—and there ain't no wrong in Him.

1.text: The Lord runnin' it all. Dressed in majesty, wrapped in power—He strapped up with strength.

2.text: His throne been standin' since way back. He always been. Ain't no start point to His reign.

3.text: Yeah, the waters been risin', Lord. They loud. They wild. The floods tryna talk big.

4.text: But You? You higher than all that noise. Stronger than ocean waves. Louder than the storm.

5.text: Your Word don't miss. Solid all the way through. Holiness stay in Your house, Lord—forever.

1.text: O Lord, God of vengeance—the one who serves justice—show up and shine!

2.text: Rise up, Judge of the whole earth. Put the proud in they place.

3.text: Lord, how long? How long the wicked gon' keep winnin'? How long they gon' act like they untouchable?

4.text: They talk reckless, real arrogant. All these evil workers just gassin' themselves up.

5.text: They crush Your people, Lord. They do harm to the ones You call Yours.

6.text: They kill widows, mistreat immigrants, and murder orphans with no remorse.

7.text: And they say, 'God ain't lookin'. He don't know what's goin' on.'

8.text: Y'all slow if you believe that. For real—when y'all gon' wise up?

9.text: The one who made ears—you don't think He hears? The one who shaped eyes—you think He can't see?

10.text: The one who teaches nations—you think He won't correct y'all? You think the Creator of knowledge don't know how this works?

11.text: The Lord knows exactly what folks be thinkin'. And He know it's all pointless.

12.text: But blessed is the one You teach, Lord—the one You school through Your Word.

13.text: You give 'em peace in hard times—while You settin' up the downfall of the wicked.

14.text: God ain't abandoning His people. He ain't done with His inheritance.

15.text: Justice gon' come back lined up with righteousness—and all those with right hearts gon' follow behind it.

16.text: Who gon' stand up for me against this evil? Who steppin' to defend me from these wicked folks?

17.text: If the Lord hadn't held me down, I woulda been laid out in silence.

18.text: Every time I slipped and said, 'I'm fallin'!'—Your love caught me, Lord. You held me up.

19.text: When my mind overwhelmed and anxious, Your comfort brought joy to my soul.

20.text: You really think crooked systems—built on injustice—can link up with You, Lord?

21.text: They gang up against the righteous. They frame innocent folks with blood on their hands.

22.text: But the Lord is my defender. My God is the rock where I run to hide.

23.text: He gon' flip their evil back on them. They gon' get cut off in their own wickedness. The Lord our God gon' shut it all down.

1.text: Come on, y'all! Let's sing to the Lord! Let's shout with joy to the One who saves us.

2.text: Let's pull up in His presence with thanksgiving. Let's praise Him loud with psalms.

3.text: 'Cause the Lord is the real MVP—greatest of all. King above every so-called god out here.

4.text: The deepest parts of the earth? In His hands. The mountaintops too—He hold all that.

5.text: The sea? He made that. The dry land? Shaped it with His own hands.

6.text: So come on—let's worship. Let's bow low. Let's kneel before the One who made us.

7.text: He our God. We His people—His sheep. He the Shepherd with us in His hand. Now hear this part real clear:

8.text: Today, if you hear His voice—don't harden your heart. Don't be stubborn like they were in the wilderness.

9.text: They tested Me, even after everything I showed 'em. They saw My work—but still tried Me.

10.text: I was fed up with that whole generation. I said, 'These folks hearts always off track. They still don't get My ways.'

11.text: So I swore in My anger: 'They not entering My rest.'

1.text: Sing a new song to the Lord! Whole earth—yeah, everybody—sing to Him!

2.text: Sing to the Lord, bless His name. Spread the good news—He savin' folks every single day.

3.text: Tell the nations how glorious He is. Brag on His wonders to every people.

4.text: The Lord is great—and worthy of every bit of praise. He should be feared more than any 'god' out there.

5.text: 'Cause them other gods? Just statues. Just idols. But our God? He made the heavens.

6.text: Honor and majesty surround Him. His sanctuary? Full of strength and beauty.

7.text: Y'all families from every nation—give the Lord His glory. Acknowledge His strength.

8.text: Give Him the glory that's due. Bring your offering and come step into His courts.

9.text: Worship the Lord in holy beauty. Whole earth—tremble in His presence!

10.text: Tell the nations loud: 'The Lord reigns!' The world ain't goin' nowhere—He keeps it steady. And He gon' judge everybody right.

11.text: Let the skies rejoice. Let the earth be glad. Let the ocean make some noise and everything in it!

12.text: Let the fields turn up in joy—and every single tree in the woods praise like they know what's up!

13.text: 'Cause He's comin'. Yep—He's on the way to judge the earth. He gon' judge the world in righteousness, and every nation in real-deal truth.

1.text: The Lord reigns! Let the whole earth turn up with joy—let all the islands be glad too!

2.text: Clouds and deep darkness surround Him, but righteousness and justice hold up His throne.

3.text: Fire goes ahead of Him—burnin' up His enemies like it's nothin'.

4.text: Lightning flashin' everywhere—lightin' up the whole world. The earth see it and start shakin'.

5.text: Mountains? They melt like wax in front of the Lord—yeah, the Lord who runs the whole earth.

6.text: The sky testifies to His righteousness—and every nation gon' see His glory.

7.text: Anybody still out here worshippin' statues? Y'all oughta be ashamed. Those idols can't do nothin'. All fake gods—bow down to Him.

8.text: Zion heard that and got hype. Judah's daughters celebratin'—'cause Your judgments, Lord, are righteous and true.

9.text: You, Lord, are high above the earth—lifted way above every so-called god.

10.text: If you really love the Lord, hate what's evil. He got His people's souls protected—and He rescues them from wicked hands.

11.text: Light is planted like seeds for the righteous—and joy for the ones with clean hearts.

12.text: So go 'head and rejoice in the Lord, y'all who live right. Give thanks when you think on His holy name.

1.text: Sing somethin' brand new to the Lord—He done did amazing things! His right hand, His holy strength, got Him the win.

2.text: The Lord showed the world He saves. Everybody saw His righteousness out loud, not hidden.

3.text: He remembered His mercy. He remembered His promises to Israel. And now the whole world done seen our God bring salvation.

4.text: Shout with joy to the Lord, earth! Break out in song—rejoice and sing loud!

5.text: Sing with the harp. Strum it smooth and drop a psalm while you're at it.

6.text: Blow the trumpets! Let the horns go up! Make joyful noise for the King—He's here!

7.text: Let the sea go wild with praise—all the waves and everything in it. Let the whole world lift it up.

8.text: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the hills throw a joy party together—

9.text: All in front of the Lord, 'cause He comin' to judge the earth. He gon' judge the world right—and treat every people with fairness.

1.text: The Lord reigns. So everybody need to tremble. He sittin' between the cherubim—let the whole earth shake!

2.text: The Lord is mighty in Zion. He lifted high above all the people.

3.text: Let 'em praise Your great and awesome name—'cause He holy.

4.text: The King strong and He love justice. You set things right. You brought real justice and righteousness to Jacob.

5.text: Lift the Lord up high. Worship at His footstool—He holy.

6.text: Moses and Aaron were part of His priests. Samuel was one of the ones who called on His name. They called—and the Lord answered.

7.text: He spoke to 'em out the cloud. They followed what He said—kept His laws and listened close.

8.text: Lord our God, You answered when they called. You were the forgiving God—but You still checked them when they got outta line.

9.text: Exalt the Lord our God. Worship at His holy mountain. 'Cause the Lord our God? He holy.

1.text: Shout loud with joy to the Lord, everybody—everywhere!

2.text: Serve the Lord with gladness. Pull up to His presence singin' like you mean it.

3.text: Know this for sure: the Lord is God. He the one who made us—we ain't make ourselves. We belong to Him. We His people, His sheep, and He our Shepherd.

4.text: Step through His gates with thanks on your lips. Come in His courts with praise. Be grateful—and speak well of His name.

5.text: 'Cause the Lord is good—like, real good. His mercy don't ever run out. And His truth? That's gon' stand through every generation.

1.text: I'ma sing about Your mercy and justice, Lord. I'ma lift up praise straight to You.

2.text: I'ma move with wisdom and keep it clean. Lord, when You comin' through? 'Cause I'ma walk with integrity—startin' right in my own home.

3.text: I ain't puttin' nothin' wicked in front of my eyes. I hate what shady folks do—it ain't stickin' to me.

4.text: Twisted hearts? Not around me. I ain't even entertaining wickedness.

5.text: If you talkin' slick behind folks' backs, I'ma shut that down. If you walkin' around with a proud look and puffed-up heart, I'm not toleratin' you.

6.text: I got my eyes on the faithful—the ones walkin' right. They the ones welcome in my space. They the ones I'ma put to work.

7.text: Liars and schemers? They can't stay in my house. If you fake, you not standin' in front of me.

8.text: Every morning, I'm clearing out the wicked—cutting off all that evil from the Lord's city.

1.text: Lord, hear me when I pray. Let my cry reach You.

2.text: Don't hide from me when I'm in trouble. Lean in close. When I call, please answer quick.

3.text: My days burn up like smoke. My bones feel like they sittin' in a fire pit.

4.text: My heart hurt bad—withered like dead grass. I be forgettin' to eat.

5.text: I'm groanin' so much, I'm shrinkin'. My bones clingin' to my skin.

6.text: I'm out here feelin' like a lonely bird in the wilderness—like an owl in a dried-up land.

7.text: I can't sleep. I'm sittin' up like a sparrow by myself on a rooftop.

8.text: My enemies mock me all day. Folks usin' my name to curse.

9.text: I've eaten ashes like bread. My drink mixed with tears.

10.text: That's all from Your anger, Lord. You lifted me up—then tossed me aside.

11.text: My life stretchin' out like a long shadow. I'm dryin' up like cut grass.

12.text: But You, Lord? You last forever. Your name gon' be known through every generation.

13.text: You gon' get up and show mercy to Zion. The time is here—it's time for favor.

14.text: Even the servants love the rubble. They honor the dust from her streets.

15.text: Nations gon' fear Your name, Lord. Kings gon' see Your glory.

16.text: The Lord gon' rebuild Zion—and show up in glory, no doubt.

17.text: He gon' hear the cries of the broken. He ain't turnin' away from their prayers.

18.text: Write this down for the next generation—so folks who ain't even born yet can praise the Lord.

19.text: God looked down from His high-up place—from heaven He saw what was happenin' on earth.

20.text: He heard the prisoners groanin'. He gon' set the ones bound for death free.

21.text: So His name can be lifted in Zion—and His praise shouted in Jerusalem.

22.text: When all the nations link up—when every kingdom shows up to serve the Lord.

23.text: He drained my strength. Cut my life short.

24.text: I said, 'God, don't take me out in my prime. You eternal—You last from generation to generation.'

25.text: Way back, You laid earth's foundation. The heavens? You built them too.

26.text: They gon' fade. But You gon' last. They wear out like clothes. You'll swap 'em out like a coat. And they'll be gone.

27.text: But You? You don't change. Your years don't run out.

28.text: The children of Your servants gon' keep on. Their descendants gon' be planted solid in front of You.

1.text: Bless the Lord, O my soul—every part of me, bless His holy name!

2.text: Bless the Lord, O my soul—and don't forget none of the ways He came through for you.

3.text: He's the one who forgives all your sins—and heals every disease.

4.text: He snatched your life out the pit. And then crowned you with love and mercy like royalty.

5.text: He fills your life with good things—so your youth feel brand new, like an eagle on the rise.

6.text: The Lord stands up for the oppressed. He brings justice where it's overdue.

7.text: He let Moses know His ways. The whole nation of Israel saw His power.

8.text: The Lord is merciful and gracious. Slow to anger. Heavy on mercy.

9.text: He don't stay mad forever. He ain't in it to punish.

10.text: He didn't treat us how we deserve. He ain't pay us back for all our wrongs.

11.text: His mercy? It's as high as the heavens over those who fear Him.

12.text: And our sins? Gone—as far as east is from west. That's how far He threw 'em off us.

13.text: Just like a father shows love to his kids—that's how the Lord looks out for those who reverence Him.

14.text: He know what we made of. He remember we just dust.

15.text: Humans? We here today, gone tomorrow. Like grass—we bloom and fade quick.

16.text: The wind pass through and we disappear. Ain't even a trace left.

17.text: But the Lord's mercy? Everlasting to everlasting for those who fear Him. His righteousness stay flowin' to their kids' kids.

18.text: To the ones who keep His word. Who actually do what He said.

19.text: The Lord's throne locked in up in heaven—and He runnin' everything, everywhere.

20.text: Bless the Lord, angels—y'all strong, y'all listen, y'all move when He speaks.

21.text: Bless the Lord, heavenly armies—every one of y'all who carry out His will.

22.text: Bless the Lord, all His works, in every place He reigns. Bless the Lord, O my soul!

1.text: Bless the Lord, O my soul! Lord, You somethin' serious—You drippin' in honor and majesty!

2.text: You wrap Yourself in light like a fit, like the whole sky Your outfit—stretchin' out the heavens like curtains in Your crib.

3.text: You lay the beams of Your upstairs room on the waters. The clouds? That's Your ride. You movin' through the wind like it's wings beneath Your feet.

4.text: Your angels be spirits. Your ministers? Straight fire—burnin' with purpose.

5.text: You laid the earth's foundation solid—ain't nobody movin' it. It's stuck forever.

6.text: You covered the earth like it had on a deep-sea coat—waters sittin' up high like mountaintops.

7.text: But when You checked them with Your voice, they dipped quick. Your thunder had 'em runnin' scared.

8.text: They climbed up mountains, dipped in valleys, hittin' the exact spot You designed for them to stop.

9.text: You set a line they can't cross—ain't no flood gonna overrun the earth again.

10.text: You send springs to flow through the valleys—water slidin' between hills like a DJ mixin' smooth.

11.text: All the wild animals drink from it—even the wild donkeys out here stay hydrated.

12.text: Birds sing right by the water, postin' up in the trees like it's choir practice.

13.text: You water the hills from Your upstairs spot—the earth so full, satisfied from what You put out.

14.text: You make grass grow for cattle, plants for us to work and harvest—food straight from the dirt.

15.text: You give us wine to make the heart glad, oil to make our skin glow, and bread to keep us solid.

16.text: Your trees? Full and lively—the cedars in Lebanon? You planted those Yourself.

17.text: Birds build homes in 'em—the stork found her whole vibe up in the fir trees.

18.text: High hills? That's for the wild goats. The cliffs? Rock badgers chillin' up there like it's penthouse living.

19.text: You made the moon to keep track of time—the sun know exactly when to clock out.

20.text: You flip the switch, make it night—and now all the forest creatures clockin' in for the graveyard shift.

21.text: Young lions out here roaring, tryna get their meal—waiting on You to come through.

22.text: Then the sun rise up—they clockin' out, headed back to their dens like night never happened.

23.text: Meanwhile, humans go out to hustle—grindin' till the sun clock out again.

24.text: Lord, Your work is deep and wide. Everything You made got wisdom written all over it. The earth? Full of Your stuff!

25.text: The sea—so big, so wide—it's like a whole other world. Full of life—big, small, everywhere.

26.text: Ships cruising through, Leviathan out there playin' like You made that sea just to be his playground.

27.text: All of 'em waitin' on You—lookin' to You for that meal, right when they need it.

28.text: When You open Your hand, they gather it up. You got them full, satisfied, blessed.

29.text: But when You turn away? They freak out. You take that breath? They done. Back to dust.

30.text: You send out Your Spirit, and boom—they created again. Earth get a full refresh.

31.text: May Your glory stay forever, Lord. May You keep smilin' at Your masterpiece.

32.text: You just look at the earth—it trembles. Touch the hills—they start smokin'.

33.text: I'ma sing to the Lord as long as I got breath. I'ma praise God while I'm still here.

34.text: Let my thoughts be sweet to Him—I'm rejoicing, straight vibin' in the Lord.

35.text: Let sinners disappear off this earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the Lord, O my soul! Praise the Lord!

1.text: Go 'head and thank the Lord! Call on His name like you know Him—let everybody know what He done did!

2.text: Sing to Him, praise Him for real! Talk about all the wild, wonderful stuff He done pulled off.

3.text: Shine in His holy name! Let everybody who chasin' after the Lord rejoice out loud!

4.text: Seek the Lord and His strength—don't stop, keep looking for His face constantly.

5.text: Don't forget all the incredible things He's done—His miracles, His judgments, His words that hit different.

6.text: Y'all are Abraham's descendants, His servant's bloodline—Jacob's children, the ones He picked out Himself.

7.text: He the Lord our God—His judgments stretch across the whole earth.

8.text: He don't forget His promises. That covenant? Locked in. It's still good after a thousand generations.

9.text: The one He made with Abraham. The same promise He swore to Isaac.

10.text: Then passed it down to Jacob like family tradition. To Israel, it became an unbreakable deal.

11.text: He said, 'This land—Canaan? That's yours. That's your inheritance. Hold on to it.'

12.text: Back when they was just a small crew—real few, and foreign in the land.

13.text: They was wanderin' from nation to nation, passin' through kingdoms like travelers.

14.text: God ain't let nobody mess with 'em. He shut down kings for their sake.

15.text: He told 'em straight: 'Don't touch My anointed ones. Don't bring no harm to My prophets.'

16.text: Then He called a famine on the land—cut off all the bread supply.

17.text: But He already sent somebody ahead—Joseph, sold as a slave, but movin' in purpose.

18.text: They hurt his feet with chains, locked him up in iron.

19.text: But when the time was right, when his word came through, the Lord tested and proved him.

20.text: The king sent for him—set him free. Ruler of the land said, 'Let him go.'

21.text: Joseph got promoted—put in charge of the whole house, all the goods under his authority.

22.text: He had princes followin' orders, elders sittin' down to learn wisdom.

23.text: Then Israel came into Egypt—Jacob posted up in the land of Ham.

24.text: God made His people multiply—stronger than their enemies, no cap.

25.text: But then He flipped Egypt's heart—they started hatin' on His people and plottin' slick moves.

26.text: So He sent Moses, His servant—and Aaron, the one He chose.

27.text: They showed out with signs and wonders in Egypt, miracles all through the land of Ham.

28.text: He spoke darkness into the land—and it got dark, quick. Egypt couldn't even push back.

29.text: He flipped the waters into blood—killed all their fish with it.

30.text: Frogs popped up everywhere—even in the king's bedroom. No peace, nowhere.

31.text: Then came the flies. Then lice all over their land—on sight, just like He said.

32.text: He turned their rain into hail—sent down fire like fireworks across the country.

33.text: Hit their vines and fig trees—broke trees left and right like twigs.

34.text: Then He spoke again—locusts swarmed in. A whole army, no limit.

35.text: They ate every green thing in sight—left the land bare.

36.text: Then God took every firstborn in Egypt—the strongest ones, the pride of the nation.

37.text: But when He brought His people out? They had silver, gold—nobody was limpin'.

38.text: Egypt was relieved when they left—fear of Israel had them shook.

39.text: God gave them a cloud for shade in the day—and fire for light in the night.

40.text: They got hungry? He sent quail. Then fed 'em with heavenly bread till they was full.

41.text: He cracked a rock—and water came pourin' out like a river in the desert.

42.text: All 'cause He remembered His holy promise—the one He gave Abraham, His guy.

43.text: So He brought His people out with joy—His chosen ones dancin' and shoutin'.

44.text: He handed them land from other nations—gave 'em the work others had done.

45.text: Why? So they would live by His laws and stay faithful to His word. Praise the Lord!

1.text: Praise the Lord! Y'all better thank Him—'cause He good, and His mercy? That thang lasts forever.

2.text: Who can even put into words all the powerful stuff the Lord done? Who got enough praise for all He is?

3.text: Blessed are the ones who stay true to justice—who keep doin' right no matter what.

4.text: Lord, remember me when You show favor to Your people. Slide through with Your salvation, too.

5.text: Let me witness the blessings You got for Your chosen ones. Let me be part of the joy, the glory, the whole inheritance.

6.text: We messed up—just like our ancestors. We sinned, we wilded out, we did dirty.

7.text: Back in Egypt, our folks ain't understand Your wonders. They forgot Your mercy—right at the Red Sea, they rebelled.

8.text: But still, He saved 'em—not for them, but to show off His power and keep His name clean.

9.text: He checked the Red Sea—and it backed up. He led them through like they was walkin' through dry wilderness.

10.text: He rescued them from the ones who hated them—snatched them out the enemy's grip.

11.text: Then the sea came back and swallowed their enemies—not one was left standin'.

12.text: After that, they believed. They sang songs. They praised hard.

13.text: But they forgot quick. Didn't wait on God's direction.

14.text: Instead, they got greedy in the wilderness—tested God like He was regular.

15.text: So He gave 'em what they wanted—but their souls came up empty.

16.text: Then they got jealous of Moses—and of Aaron, the one God had set apart.

17.text: The ground said bet—opened up and swallowed Dathan. Abiram and his squad got covered too.

18.text: Fire blazed up in the camp—burned the wicked clean off the map.

19.text: They built a gold calf at Horeb—and bowed down to that molded thing.

20.text: They swapped their glory for a statue of a cow eatin' grass. Tragic.

21.text: They straight up forgot God—the same One who saved them, the One who wrecked Egypt with wonders.

22.text: The same God who showed out in Ham, and did the impossible by the Red Sea.

23.text: He was ready to wipe them out—if Moses hadn't stepped in, beggin' for mercy.

24.text: They disrespected the land God promised. Didn't believe a word He said.

25.text: Sat in their tents, complainin'. Ignored God's voice completely.

26.text: So God swore they wouldn't make it—said they'd fall in the wilderness.

27.text: Their kids too—scattered 'em all over foreign lands.

28.text: Then they linked up with Baal at Peor—started eatin' food offered to the dead.

29.text: God was heated at their actions—and a deadly plague broke out.

30.text: Phinehas stood up, shut it down—and that act was counted as righteousness for him forever.

31.text: And God counted that as righteousness for Phinehas—set it down in the record, stamped it eternal, passed down through every generation like legacy.

32.text: They even got God mad at Meribah—made Moses suffer for their mess.

33.text: They pushed God so far, Moses snapped and said things he shouldn't've.

34.text: They didn't clear out the enemy nations like God told them to.

35.text: Instead, they mixed in with the nations—and picked up all their bad habits.

36.text: Started worshiping their idols—which ended up trappin' them.

37.text: They even sacrificed their own kids—to demons.

38.text: Innocent blood on their hands. Their sons and daughters gone. They gave 'em up to idols—and now the land was soaked in blood.

39.text: They defiled themselves with their choices—actin' wild and unfaithful.

40.text: So God's anger burned against His own people. He couldn't stand lookin' at 'em.

41.text: He handed them over—to the same folks they tried to be like. Now their enemies had power over them.

42.text: Those enemies kept them down—treated them like nothin'.

43.text: God rescued them again and again—but they kept rebelin', kept fallin' back into sin.

44.text: Yet even then—when they were sufferin'—He saw 'em and heard their cries.

45.text: For their sake, He remembered His promise. His mercy showed up heavy.

46.text: He even made their captors feel sorry for 'em. Had folks show pity when they didn't have to.

47.text: Save us, Lord our God! Bring us back from these foreign lands—so we can thank You, praise You, and shout Your name loud!

48.text: Bless the Lord, God of Israel—from forever to forever! Let the whole people say, 'Amen!' Praise the Lord!
